jobs.title: Acting Group Mgr E/E Architecture
jobs.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

We are looking for a Group Manager Electrical/Electronic Architecture with the leadership ability and ambition to bring out the best in people to join the Electrical and Software Architecture department at Volvo Buses.

The Volvo Group is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of trucks, buses, construction equipment and marine and industrial engines. At Volvo Buses we are driven by a purpose to ensure that millions of people reach their travel destination every day, reliably, safely and with respect for the environment. We want to make a difference being pioneers of sustainable transport solutions of the future.

We believe it is you and your personality that is the most important asset of all. Are you a passionate leader with a coaching approach for developing people, operations, and products? Do you thrive in leading change and have the ability to create a climate based on trust and cross functional teamwork, where everyone is accountable and proud of the products and solutions we deliver to support our customers success? Great, then we could be a match!

JOB DESCRIPTION

Platform Development is a function within Global Bus Technology at Volvo Buses. We are responsible for developing platform solutions within the areas of Electrical & Software Architecture and Chassis & Drivelines.

We are now seeking a temporary acting Group Manager Electrical/Electronic Architecture within Electrical & Software Architecture who has the drive and passion to contribute to Volvo Buses profitability and who see that the key to success is to develop people and technologies to have products meeting future needs.

This group has a central role in the department with many interfaces to the other groups within Volvo buses as well as within Volvo group, since it is responsible for development of end user functions, systems and components within the platform area. This includes ownership of the platform core ECUs and functions such as vehicle modes. This group secures that we have a stable platform for the other product teams in the department to develop their functions upon.

As a Group Manager in the Electrical & Software Department at Volvo Buses you will have the responsibility to develop the group, technology and the people to support future needs contributing to Volvo Buses profitability. You will report to the Director of Electrical and Software Architecture.

Within your responsibility you will define, communicate and execute strategies and targets for the group and you will be the owner of the technology area. You will be part of delivering technical solutions to concept, industrialization, maintenance as well as advanced engineering projects according to quality, delivery, cost and feature targets. Prioritization and direction setting for short- and long-term activities are part of your day-to-day activities.

Since we are a rather small company, we all work with broad responsibilities and cross-functionally through the entire company, across many different departments, cultures, and competence areas and to manage your future challenges you will need to build a broad network within and outside of the Volvo Group.

THIS IS US, YOUR NEW COLLEAGUES

We at the Electrical & Software Architecture department are purpose driven, inspire each other to teamwork and recognize achievements. We use our curiosity and engagement as energy into our continuous transformation journey, staying relevant in our ever-changing world.

In close cooperation with colleagues at different departments across Volvo Group, we are supporting each other in reaching our mission in helping millions of travellers reaching their travel destination. All over the World. Every day.

THIS PROBABLY DEFINES YOU

We see that you are business oriented with a clear customer focus, preferably from automotive. You have a technical knowledge within the electrical and electronics area with a university degree in engineering or equivalent. You have previous leader experience with the ability to recruit and develop efficient teams.

We think you are a structured, inclusive, collaborative and a team-oriented leader with a high customer focus. You are curious and continuously searching for new knowledge by promoting continuous learning and improvement.

You have excellent communicational skills and ability to work in a global environment with various cultures and languages. You are open minded, flexible and can easily adapt. You are also driven and able to motivate others to perform at their best. We see you as engaged and innovative.

ARE WE A PERFECT MATCH?

The societies where many of us live would not function without the type of products and services the Volvo Group provides. Like a circulatory system, our trucks, buses, engines, construction equipment and different, related services are involved in several of the functions that most of us rely on every day.

We want to be there for our customers providing uptime and reliability, all over the world every day. Volvo Buses is leading the biggest technology shift in public transport in decades with our electromobility offer. We work with passion; we trust each other and we embrace change to stay ahead. We make our customers win.

Do you have a passion for electrical and electronics development and would you like to be a part of Volvo Buses next step in advancing our products, then Welcome to our team and Volvo Buses!

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will work with real field quality challenges in an automotive environment, investigating issues found in vehicles on the market and testing new or updated in-car functions before they reach customers. The role combines hands-on work in vehicles with analytical work at your desk, where you turn findings into clear problem descriptions, supporting data, and recommendations that help teams resolve issues faster. You will collaborate with quality, engineering, and aftermarket stakeholders and contribute directly to better customer experience through both investigation and function acceptance testing. This is a strong fit if you enjoy practical fault tracing, structured analysis, and work that has visible impact on the product.

Job Description

    You will investigate product quality issues in vehicles on the market and reproduce faults to clarify the problem and support resolution.
    You will perform failure mode analysis and support root cause analysis for field quality problems.
    You will propose containment actions based on findings and available data.
    You will manage product improvement issues within your technical area in Jira and GQMP.
    You will perform advanced fault tracing and provide technical support to the aftermarket organization.
    You will carry out customer-focused in-car function acceptance testing for new or revised vehicle functions prior to introduction.

Requirements

    Experience of automotive aftermarket and quality issue resolution work.
    B.Sc. in engineering or equivalent experience.
    Communication skills for issue reporting.
    Good awareness of practical implications of GDPR legislation.
    Root cause analysis and in-car fault tracing skills.
    Documented experience of vehicle diagnostic tools.
    Driver's license for passenger vehicles.
    A well-developed ability to assess vehicle functions.

Nice to have

    You are comfortable switching between hands-on work in a vehicle and desktop-based analysis.
    You bring strong business acumen in customer-facing situations.
    You enjoy working in a role that combines investigation, testing, and technical support.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

jobs.title: Ph.D.-scholarship in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems
jobs.description:
Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for PhD Research Fellow in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (Høgskulen på Vestlandet, HVL) has an open Ph.D. position with a project period of 4 years at the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Maritime Studies. The Ph.D. candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary project involving three research groups on energy and environmental technology, on wind, water and waves and on data science. 

Due to the nature of the work to be carried out in the project, the candidate will be a part of the Ph.D.-programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing. (https://www.hvl.no/en/research/phd-programmes/phd-programme-in-computer-science/). The research programme in Computer Science currently includes 20 professors and associate professors, more than 30 PhD and post-doctoral fellows, and a large number of master’s students.

This programme is located at the Faculty of Technology, Environmental and Social Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. PhD research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment.

Workplace will be at HVL Campus Bergen.


Tasks and areas of responsibility:

Wind Assisted Propulsion Systems (WAPS) are moving from demonstration to commercial scale. Rotor sails and rigid wing sails are currently installed on tankers, bulkers, and Ro-Ro vessels, and a growing number of wind-cargo ships are being purpose-built for sail propulsion. Sails reduce the ship’s onboard energy demand, and with it fuel consumption and emissions.


This PhD project will develop simulation and optimisation methods for modern sail design based on the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) as part of the optimisation loop. The developed method will be applied to optimise both existing sail technologies and novel concepts depending on ship size, route, and operation in order to determine fuel and emission savings.
 

The project will extend an existing Julia LBM in-house code, with established HPC LBM frameworks as references, benchmarks, and potential building blocks combined with Bayesian optimisation.

As part of the required duties (25% of the position), the candidate will join the team focusing on regional development at the faculty and the department. This might include:


• Promote more externally funded research projects in collaboration between our research environment and the shipping industry.
• Interact with regional, national and international partners, and work to promote cooperation between the department and the surrounding society (e.g., bachelor and master theses).
• Mobilization to promote research-based innovation in the shipping industry in collaboration with our participation in the project FORREGION Vestland.
• Supporting the department in our work related to lifelong learning in the shipping industry, with emphasis on strengthening the portfolio of flexible and decentralized education.


Qualifications (requirements):

•Admission to the PhD programme requires that the applicant holds a master’s degree in computer science or a closely related field, such as a master’s degree in informatics, software engineering, communication systems, engineering computing, scientific computing, or computational engineering.
•Candidates from other natural sciences or engineering disciplines holding a master’s degree with a strong emphasis on ICT and computing, for example mechanical, marine or aerospace engineering, applied mathematics or computational physics, may also qualify for admission to the PhD programme.
•Admission into the programme requires that the applicant has obtained strong grades for both the master’s thesis and the course work of the master’s degree. Specifically, admission into the programme normally requires that the applicant has obtained:
- a grade of B (Norwegian/ECTS scale) or better on the master’s thesis,
- an average grade higher than C (Norwegian/ECTS scale) on the coursework associated with the master’s degree
•Documented programming skills beyond scripting in Julia, or in a language Julia can call (Python, C, C++, Fortran).

The PhD research fellow must enrol in the PhD programme in Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and must meet the formal admission requirements for admission into the PhD programme. The position is announced for a period of 4 years with 25% of the 4-year period will be designated to duties such as teaching, development and administrative tasks.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisors at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. An application for enrolment should first be submitted after an appointment is made and the supervisors will help with this procedure. The candidate must be enrolled as a PhD student within 3 months from the start of the employment.


Favoured qualifications (not requirements):

- Master’s thesis in computational fluid dynamics, ideally applied to wings, foils, rotors, or similar configurations.
- Knowledge of and experience with Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) and/or Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
- Knowledge of and experience with optimisation methods.

 

Personal abilities:

- Ability to contribute towards a good work environment and in teamwork.
- Excellent communication skills, ability to communicate well in both written and spoken English. Proficiency, written and spoken, in a Scandinavian language is an advantage.
- The candidate must be diligent and display the ability to work independently, supplemented with regular guidance, and is expected to carry out high-quality research and to publish the results in international workshops, conferences, and journals.

 

Candidates who have submitted a master’s thesis and who have not yet been awarded a master’s degree may also qualify for the position, provided that the master`s degree is awarded within four weeks of the deadline for applications to this position. Proof of successfully finishing the master’s degree along with the grade for the thesis and the final average grade must be submitted to HVL as soon as possible. Applicants already holding a Ph.D. are not eligible for this position.


In addition to the required educational and scientific background, the following criteria will be evaluated: competence and grades on completed course work, quality of the master's thesis, publications (if any), research and teaching experience, practical software engineering skills and experience. A possible outline of a research plan for a potential PhD project will also be taken into account.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisor(s) at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. The necessary application to join the Ph.D. programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing must be submitted and accepted within 3 months of starting in the position. The supervisors will help with this procedure.


Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to the regulation for export control system. The regulation might be applied in the processing of the applications.


For more information, contact: Associate Prof. Norbert Lümmen: Norbert.Lummen@hvl.no 


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation must be uploaded as an attachment to the online application:


•A brief cover letter including a description of research interests and motivation for working within the current project. The cover letter should include a detailed justification of your qualifications in relation to the listed requirements.
•CV (summarizing education, positions and a complete list of academic publications)
•Master thesis
•Transcripts and diplomas of bachelor’s and master’s degrees. If you have not yet completed your master’s degree, please submit a statement from your institution confirming the expected date of award of your master’s degree.
•Diplomas and certificatesAt least one letter of recommendation preferably from a previous academic supervisor.
•Names and contact details of 2 references. One of these should be the main supervisor of the master’s thesis.

At least one letter of recommendation preferably from a previous academic supervisor.

In case the applicant already has publications, a complete list of these and copies of up to five selected publications should be uploaded. Applicants should indicate which of these publications or parts of these publications should be given special consideration in the evaluation.

If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. The transcripts must specify the topics, the course works, and the grades at the bachelor`s and master`s degree levels. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the  application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

Applicants should note that the evaluation will be based on the documentation submitted electronically via Jobbnorge within the submission deadline. The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. It is of utmost importance that all publications to be considered in the evaluation are uploaded as an attachment with the application, since these are sent electronically to the expert panel. Applications cannot be sent by e-mail or to individuals at HVL.

Applicants may be called in for an interview.


Salary:
  • Good occupational pension, insurance and loan schemes from The Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Exciting academic environment with the possibility of competence enhancement and development
  • Opportunities for training within the working hours 

The Research Fellow position is compensated according to position code 1017 Research Fellow.

There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte)". Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences Bergen has therefore adopted a personnel policy objective to ensure that we achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons of various ethnic backgrounds.

Information about the applicant may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence permit (must be considered individually).

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications. 


Inclusion, challenging norms, collaboration

Homepage

https://www.hvl.no/en/research/phd-programmes/phd-programme-in-computer-science/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Høgskulen på Vestlandet (HVL) er en av de største høgskolene i landet, med om lag 1 800 tilsette og 16 000 studenter fordelt på fem campus i Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund. Hvert år uteksaminerer vi 3000 kandidater som er med på å løse viktige samfunnsoppgaver.


HVL har sterke og innovative fagmiljø innen helse- og sosialvitskap, ingeniør- og maritime utdanningar, lærer-, kultur- og idrettsfag, natur- og samfunnsvitskap, og økonomi og ledelse. HVL skal være tett på arbeidslivet, regionen og studentene. Den overordnet ambisjonen vår er å bli et universitet med en tydelig profesjons- og arbeidslivsrettet profil.


HVL sin visjon er "Kunnskap som bygger menneske og samfunn". Strategiske ambisjoner og mål har særlig oppmerksom på berekraftig samfunnsutvikling, velferd og innovasjon, forankret i våre verdier - inkludere, utfordre og samhandle - som kjennetegner identiteten og kulturen hos oss.


 Fakultetet for teknologi, miljø- og samfunnsvitskap har et bredt utdanningstilbud både på bachelor og masternivå innenfor ingeniør- og naturfag, økonomiske og administrative fag, maritime fag, samfunnsvitskap og humaniora, i tillegg til phd-utdanninger i datateknologi, ansvarlig innovasjon og regional utvikling og i nautiske operasjoner.

Fakultet har fem institutt med om lag 500 tilsette og 5700 studenter. Fakultetet blir ledet av dekan som har det overordnet ansvaret for den faglige og administrative virksomheten ved fakultetet og som rapporterer til rektor. Hoveddelen av fakultetet sin virksomhet er i Haugesund, Bergen, Sogndal og Førde, men fakultetet har også aktivitet ved campus Stord.


Institutt for maskin- og maritime studium har om lag 900 studentar og 80 tilsette i Bergen og Haugesund. Instituttet har ansvaret for fagtilbud innen maritime utdanninger, maskinfag, marinteknikk, bærekraftig produksjon og sirkulærøkonomi og energi- og havteknologi. Havrommet er en fellesnemnar - sammen med fagfelt som samhandling mellom mennesker, organisasjon og teknologi (inkludert system), framtidas utfordringer i blant annet grønn omstilling, og økt digitalisering og autonomi i maritim og marin sektor. Instituttet har syv bachelorprogram, to masterprogram og ph.d.-i Nautiske operasjoner. Det er flere mulige veier til gjennomgående utdanninger fra bachelor til ph.d. i instituttet.

Käy lukemassa lisää Tokmannin jouluapulaisen työstä Venlan ja Saran kertomanahttps://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/...

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

jobs.title: Skyddsvakt till Securitas Gotland
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Securitas har en viktig roll i samhället och förvaltar ett av Sveriges viktigaste uppdrag - att skydda och hjälpa människor att känna sig trygga. Nu har du chansen att bli en del av Sveriges största säkerhetsföretag. Oavsett om du vill jobba mycket eller lite, dag eller natt så behöver vi bli fler.

Som landets största arbetsgivare i vår bransch kan vi erbjuda dig utvecklingsmöjligheter och variation som få andra företag kan. Vi strävar efter ett enhetligt ledarskap med balans mellan förväntningar och förutsättningar.

Securitas Sverige krigsplacerar sin personal. Detta innebär i korthet att du som anställd kommer, i händelse av krig, ha kvar din anställning och arbetsledas av Securitas.

Du tar hand om människors säkerhet – Securitas tar hand om dig.

Om rollen

Securitas söker nu skyddsvakter till uppdrag att skydda samhällsviktig verksamhet för Sverige. Det här är ett uppdrag för dig som inte bara söker ett arbete – utan är redo att ta dig an en uppgift med stort ansvar och verklig betydelse för vårt lands försörjning och säkerhet. Det handlar om att skydda det som måste fungera – dygnet runt, året runt.

Som skyddsvakt har du en avgörande roll i att upprätthålla säkerheten för verksamheter som är viktiga för Sverige. Du arbetar med utökade befogenheter, ofta i nära samarbete med våra uppdragsgivare.

Arbetet är varierande och kan omfatta både stationär och ronderande bevakning, inpasseringskontroller eller arbete i bevakningscentral. Du kommer att behöva fatta egna beslut i skarpa lägen, ha god uthållighet och ett stabilt omdöme. Därför söker vi en person som har förmågan att behålla lugnet när andra inte gör det – och är lojal mot de svenska intressena.

Skyddsvaktsbevakningen bedrivs såväl inomhus som utomhus, dag som natt. Arbetspassens längd skiljer sig åt, men förläggs ofta i 12-timmarspass enligt rullande schema. Då vi jobbar i en verksamhet som är igång årets alla dagar är det vanligt med arbete varannan helg.

Tjänsten innebär bland annat att du:

    Skyddar samhällsviktiga verksamheter rån obehörigt tillträde och andra hot
    Utför kontroller enligt gällande föreskrifter och instruktioner
    Samverkar med personal och myndigheter i säkerhetsfrågor

Vi är trygghet. Vi är Securitas.

Krav:

    Har godkända betyg i svenska och engelska från första året i gymnasiet
    B-körkort

Meriterande om du även har:

    Civil eller militär skyddsvaktsutbildning; har du genomfört skyddsvaktsutbildning hos Försvarsmakten inom ramen för Försvarsmaktens grundutbildning (GMU) så kan denna valideras för civilt bruk. Skyddsvaktsutbildningen, samt GMU, ska vara genomförd 2016 eller senare och ditt utbildningsbevis får inte vara äldre än fem år vid ansökningstillfället
    Utbildad väktare
    Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med bevakning av skyddsobjekt, annan bevakning eller säkerhetsarbete.

Vi söker en person med integritet, mognad och förmåga att ta ansvar – både för sin egen och andras säkerhet. Du har en naturlig fallenhet för struktur och ordning, och en vaksamhet som andra litar på. Det här är en tjänst för dig som har livet och erfarenheten i ryggen, och som nu är redo att använda det till att göra skillnad.

Säkerhetsprövning

Observera att tjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass och innebär att du kommer att genomgå en säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585). För att utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven för att bli godkänd enligt gällande regelverk kommer det genomföras säkerhetssamtal, bakgrundskontroll och registerkontroll. Bedömningen syftar till att utreda laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter enligt Säkerhetspolisens föreskrifter och vägledningar. Uppgifter som inhämtas kan ex. komma från dig själv, öppna källor eller myndigheter. Vi tillämpar en helhetsbedömning om dig, din livssituation samt ekonomiska förhållanden vid prövning av din lämplighet.

I förekommande fall kan motsvarande kontroll göras av den som du sammanbor med, eller har en liknande relation med.

För att bli aktuell för tjänsten krävs därför (som lägst) att;

    Du/ni inte förekommer i Polismyndighetens olika register, ex misstankeregister, belastningsregister, osv.
    Du/ni har ordnad ekonomi; inte har betalningsanmärkningar, oreglerade skulder, förekommer hos inkassoföretag eller Kronofogden

Det här är inte ett vanligt jobb - det är ett uppdrag i tjänst för samhället. Är du den vi söker?

Övrig information

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg. Vi jobbar med löpande urval, så om du är intresserad av tjänsten – skicka din ansökan redan idag!

Har du frågor kring rollen är du välkommen att höra av dig till kontaktperson: jenny.andersson2@securitas.se.

    Tjänsten är timanställning, med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar 6mån provanställning
    Vi arbetar med urvalstester
    Vi kommunicerar i första hand via mail
    Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-10-31

För anställning För anställning inom Securitas Sverige AB krävs det att du har godkända betyg från första året i gymnasiet i svenska samt blir godkänd av Länsstyrelsen för anställning i auktoriserat bevakningsföretag enligt Lag (1974:191) om bevakningsföretag (den ansökan görs av Securitas).  Inför ansökan görs en bakgrundskontroll och säkerhetssamtal för att bedöma om kandidaten uppfyller ställda krav på laglydnad, lämplighet och medborgerlig pålitlighet samt inte har några sårbarheter. Det är ett krav att ha ordnad ekonomi och inga oreglerade skulder.

Vi har gjort medieval för samtliga rekryteringar så vi undanber oss därför samtal från annonssäljare eller säljare av rekryteringstjänster.

Lön och anställningsförhållanden baseras på kollektivavtal mellan arbetsgivarorganisationen Säkerhetsföretagen och Svenska Transportarbetareförbundet.

Mer info om Securitas som arbetsgivare och vår rekryteringsprocess hittar du på securitas.se.

This will include all development phases, from conceptual design to end of production, and will require close collaboration with all parts of the organization, including but not limited to Prototype, Testing, Procurement, Production, Quality, CAE, and Homologation.

You will:

    Create and maintain 3D models, assemblies, and 2D drawings using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE for the catalogue of standard parts (commercial off-the-shelf products).
    Maintain the internal table for fastener tightening torques and standards.
    Create and maintain the materials and surface treatments library using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE.
    Support the Low Voltage Electronics department in releasing engineering data, such as PCB/FPC and Bootloader data, using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE.
    Create Koenigsegg Technical Standard (KTS) documents, engineering instructions, specification drawings for families of parts, etc.
    Facilitate tests to verify component functionality and ensure that requirements are met when needed.
    Apply data-driven analysis to identify root causes, enhance product reliability, and optimize performance.
    Assist in selecting and interacting with suppliers and technology providers to ensure quality and performance targets are met.
    Provide technical support to ensure the successful introduction of off-the-shelf components and systems into and throughout production.

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
    3+ years of experience in engineering design within the automotive, aerospace, or similar industries.
    Proven understanding of part and assembly design, DFM, and component durability.
    3+ years of CAD experience, preferably with CATIA V5/V6 or 3DEXPERIENCE.
    Experience with Microsoft Power BI Essentials and proficiency in Word and Excel.
    Professional-level English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious experience:

    Work experience in the top-tier automotive or motorsport industry.
    Experience with standard parts (commercial off-the-shelf products), especially fasteners used in the automotive industry.
    Practical, hands-on experience working with cars, racing, or similar activities, either professionally or as a hobby.
    Knowledge of material science, including material selection, heat treatment, and surface treatments.
    Experience in composite design and manufacturing.
    Understanding of automotive regulations and homologation requirements.
    Experience with supplier management and technical partnerships.

Koenigsegg is most known for building some of the fastest cars in the world; with almost all of our megacar technologies that are patented and made in-house by our almost 750 world-class technicians, engineers, sourcing experts, production craftsmen, and communicators.

What we’ve created is a unique proving ground of engineering creativity that makes use of our breakthrough megacar development and legacy to push the boundaries of sustainable mobility technology.

So, what’s next?

We are on a universe-denting mission to develop the next generation of breakthrough tech and products. We are looking for outstanding, impactful, and authentic individuals to grow with us. Our ambitions are inspiring but will push the limits of what is possible – requiring one to work efficiently amid our cross-functional teams to execute at high-quality levels.

The goal is clear: innovate and transform.

jobs.title: Sähköhuoltopäällikkö
jobs.description:
Haemme Sähköhuoltopäällikköä Pirkanmaalle

Kasvatamme taloteknistä huolto- ja ylläpitotoimintaamme ja haemme sähköhuoltopäällikköä vahvistamaan taloteknistä toimialaamme Pirkanmaan alueella.

Sähköhuoltopäällikkönä vastaat Pirkanmaalla oman vastuualueesi organisaation, asiakkuuksien ja liiketoiminnan johtamisesta sekä kehittämisestä. Vastaat oman vastuualueesi kannattavasta kasvusta ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuudesta. Osallistut aktiivisesti uusasiakashankintaan sekä asiakassuhteiden ylläpitämiseen ja kehittämiseen.

Johdat henkilöstöäsi hyvän johtamisen periaatteiden mukaisesti hyödyntäen Constin johtamisjärjestelmää. Kehität tiimisi osaamista liiketoiminnan tarpeiden mukaisesti ja huolehdit turvallisen, motivoivan ja tehokkaan työympäristön ylläpitämisestä.

Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen päivätyö, jossa työaika painottuu klo 7.00–15.30 välille. Työn aloitus sovitaan valitun henkilön kanssa.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa yksikönpäällikkö Jarkko Viikki, p. 050 592 2499.



Etsimältämme henkilöltä toivomme

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa koulutusta tai vahvaa kokemusta sähköhuollosta, huolto- ja korjaustöiden organisoinnista sekä kunnossapidosta

- Kokemusta tarjouslaskennasta ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisesta johtamisesta

- Kokemusta sähköhuollon pien- ja palvelu-urakointiprojektien läpiviennistä sekä aikataulu- ja kustannushallinnasta

- Hyviä henkilöstöjohtamisen taitoja

- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja

- Huoltopäällikkönä sinulta vaaditaan itsenäistä työskentelyä ja vastuunkantamista

Hakemamme sähköhuoltopäällikkö on aikaansaava ja ratkaisukeskeinen henkilö, joka nauttii toiminnan suunnittelusta, organisoinnista ja kehittämisestä. Sinulla on kyky rakentaa ja ylläpitää pitkäjänteisiä yhteistyösuhteita asiakkaiden, yhteistyökumppaneiden ja alihankkijoiden kanssa.

Henkilöstö on toimintasi keskiössä ja johdat tiimiäsi esimerkillisesti luoden pohjan pitkäaikaisille työsuhteille, hyvälle työilmapiirille ja osaamisen kehittämiselle. Sinulla on hyvät neuvottelutaidot ja toimit toimintaperiaatteidemme mukaisesti. Haluat rakentaa turvallisen ja laadukkaan työympäristön kaikille osapuolille ja olet valmis tekemään töitä sen eteen.




Consti Talotekniikka Oy

Consti on yksi Suomen johtavista korjausrakentamiseen ja taloteknisiin palveluihin keskittyneistä yhtiöistä. Tarjoamme kattavasti korjausrakentamisen ja talotekniikan sekä valikoidusti uudisrakentamisen palveluita taloyhtiöille, yrityksille ja sijoittajille sekä julkiselle sektorille Suomen kasvukeskuksissa. Työllistämme noin 1000 korjausrakentamisen ja talotekniikan ammattilaista ympäri Suomea.

Uudistamme asunto-, teollisuus-, kauppa-, hotelli- ja toimistokiinteistöjä sekä julkisen sektorin kohteita. Consti tarjoaa myös palvelu-urakointia sekä sopimusasiakkaille toteutettavia huolto- ja ylläpitopalveluja.

jobs.title: Vuoropäällikkö, St1 Oriketo Turku
jobs.description:
Oletko sinä etsimämme VUOROPÄÄLLIKKÖ St1 Orikedolle Turkuun

Haemme nyt asiakkaallemme St1 Orikedolle Turkuun vuoropäällikköä. Orikedon St1 asema sijaitsee vilkkaan ohikulkutien varrella ja palvelee asiakkaita vuorokauden ympäri. Asemalle pysähdytään nauttimaan herkullisesta ruoasta, pizzoista, kahvitauosta ja aidosti ystävällisestä palvelusta. Nyt joukkoon etsitään vuoropäällikköä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen (112,5 h / 3 viikkoa).

Vuoropäällikkönä olet tärkeä osa aseman arkea ja toimit yksikönpäällikön oikeana kätenä. Johdat työvuoroja omalla esimerkilläsi, pidät huolen siitä, että päivä sujuu mutkattomasti ja autat tiimiä onnistumaan parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla. Sinulla on jo kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai vastuullisesta roolista sekä asiakaspalvelu-, liikenneasema- tai ravintola-alalta. Ennen kaikkea oikea asenne ratkaisee.

Työtehtäväsi tulevat olemaan:

- työvuorojen johtaminen aseman kaikissa vuoroissa ja tiimin tukeminen päivittäisessä työssä

- asiakaspalvelun ja tuotteiden laadun varmistaminen

- henkilöstön ohjaaminen, kannustaminen ja palautteen antaminen

- tilausten tekeminen ja varastonhallinta

- konseptin mukaisten toimintatapojen sekä yhteisten pelisääntöjen toteutumisesta huolehtimista yhdessä yksikönpäällikön kanssa

Työntekijälle tarjoamme:

- kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen työhösi

- monipuolisen työn ja tehtäväkentän

- kannustavan työilmapiirin ja mukavat työkaverit

Työnhakijalta odotamme:

- kokemusta ihmisten johtamisesta positiivisella otteella

- rauhallista työskentelytapaa kiireenkin keskellä sekä priorisointikykyä

- toimeen tarttuvuutta

- joustavuutta ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä kolmessa vuorossa

- kykyä omaksua uusia asioita sekä hyviä IT taitoja

jobs.title: Deltids regnskabsassistent til Nordens førende restaurantsite
jobs.description:
Er du struktureret og har en god forståelse for bogholderi? Nyder du at kunne gå på weekend og vide, at tallene stemmer? Så er du måske vores nye regnskabsassistent. 

DinnerBooking er en danskejet IT-baseret virksomhed, som leverer et markedsførende online bookingsystem til restauranter på tværes af Norden og flere lande i Europa.  

DinnerBooking fornemmeste opgave er at give gæster inspiration og nem adgang til restauranter gennem vores digitale platform, samtidig med at vi leverer det mest værdiskabende bookingsystem til restauratører.  

Din rolle 

Vi søger en kollega til vores bogholderi, som vil få berøring med en bred pallette af bogføringsopgaver og mulighed for at få masser af ansvar. Derfor er det også en styrke, at du kender dine begrænsninger og siger til, hvis du løber ind i en udfordring, du ikke selv kan løse. Her prioriterer vi at løfte som et team og hjælpe hinanden, så vi får løbet opgaverne i mål. 

Dine opgaver 

  • Debitorbogholderi og håndtering, herunder rykkerprocedurer, sikre opfølgning på kundebetaling og korrespondance vedrørende mellemværende 

  • Finansbogføring 

  • Fakturering og håndtering af ordrer 

  • Håndtering af moms samt varetage dialog til offentlige myndigheder 

  • Afstemning af diverse konti 

  • Lønkørsel (kun danske lønninger via Danløn) 

 

Vi forestiller os, at du: 

  • Har nogle års erfaring med forskellige opgaver inden for bogholderi  

  • Du mestre dansk og engelsk i både skrift og tale 

  • Er struktureret i din måde at løse opgaver på samt formår at overholde deadlines 

  • Navigerer hjemmevant i Excel 

  • Er nysgerrig og altid interesseret i at forbedre processer og kvalitet 

Hvordan du har opnået din erfaring, er ikke centralt for stillingen, men vi forventer, at du har en god grundforståelse for tal og bogholderi.  

 
Vi tilbyder  

En spændende rolle i en voksende virksomhed, hvor du får masser af ansvar og frihed. Du bliver desuden del af et kontor, som i dag består 35 dedikerede medarbejdere fra både Danmark, Estland, England, Ukraine, Polen, Norge, Finland og Rumænien.  

Vi er et socialt kontor med en uformel tone, og hvor to dage sjældent er ens. Vi nyder at tage en dialog omkring kaffemaskinen, og to gange om året spiser vi sammen til restaurantfestivalen DinnerDays, som vi selv arrangerer. 

Vi tilbyder en god frokostordning og et kontor placeret tæt ved Amagerbro Metro. 

Arbejdstid: 12-16 timer med mulighed for fleksibilitet. 

Løn: Løn forhandles efter kvalifikationer. 

Deadline 
Send os dit CV og ansøgning i én samlet PDF allerede i dag til job@dinnerbooking.com. Vi kigger på ansøgningerne løbende. 
 
Nysgerrig? 

Hvis du ønsker at høre mere ind til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Peter Thygesen på pt@dinnerbooking.com.

jobs.title: Verkostosuunnittelija
jobs.description:
**Tule piirtämään sähköverkkojen seuraavia reittejä kanssamme!**

**Pidätkö siitä, että suunnitelmat eivät jää paperille, vaan muuttuvat oikeiksi sähköverkoiksi maastossa? Sitten tämä paikka voi olla juuri sinua varten!**

**Mitä pääset meillä tekemään**

Tarvetta olisi verkostosuunnittelijalle vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Turkuun sähkönjakeluverkon liiketoimintamme projektitiimiin. Tässä roolissa pääset suunnittelemaan sähköverkkoja ja olemaan mukana hankkeissa aina ensimmäisistä laskelmista valmiisiin verkkoratkaisuihin asti. Työpäiviisi kuuluu muun muassa sähköverkon laskentaa, verkosto- ja maastosuunnitelmien laatimista sekä kartoitus- ja dokumentointitehtäviä.

Käytännössä pääset tekemään esimerkiksi sähköisiä laskelmia, rakenne- ja reittisuunnittelua sekä hankkimaan maankäyttöön ja rakentamiseen liittyviä lupia. Lisäksi osallistut katselmointeihin, laadit sopimuksia ja hakemuksia sekä kartoitat valmistuneita verkkoja maastossa. Myös suunnitelmien merkitseminen maastoon ja työselostusten laatiminen kuuluvat tehtäväkenttääsi. Tehtävässä on myös halutessasi mahdollista osallistua varallaoloon ja viankorjaukseen.

Työssä et jää yksin suunnitelmien kanssa, vaan teet tiivistä yhteistyötä asiakkaiden, alihankkijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Jokainen päivä tuo mukanaan hieman erilaisia tilanteita ja ratkaistavia asioita.

Omexom on VINCI Energies konsernin energiainfrastruktuureihin keskittyvä brändi, joka toimii Suomessa energianjakelun koko ketjun parissa aina tuotannosta siirto- ja jakeluverkkoihin. Tarjoamme kokonaisvaltaisia palveluita avaimet käteen -projekteina tai esimerkiksi suunnitteluna ja kunnossapitona. Omexomilla on Suomessa 450 työntekijää.

**Mitä taskustasi olisi hyvä löytyä**

- Sähköalan koulutus

- Hyvät yhteistyötaidot

- Turvallisuuslähtöinen ajattelutapa

- Aktiivinen ote tehtävien hoitamiseen ja ongelmanratkaisuun

- Vähintään B-luokan ajokortti

- Hyvä suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen kielen taitoa (muusta kielitaidosta lisäpisteitä)


Työturvallisuus on toimintamme perusta, ja odotamme sinulta myös verkostosuunnittelijana vahvaa turvallisuusajattelua sekä kykyä suunnitella projekteja ja työkohteita turvallisuus edellä, töihin liittyvät riskit huomioiden. Huolehdit osaltasi siitä, että turvalliset toimintatavat toteutuvat käytännössä ja että jokainen pääsee työpäivän päätteeksi turvallisesti kotiin.

**Millaiseen porukkaan tulet?**

Omexomilla osaamista jaetaan, onnistumisia juhlitaan yhdessä ja apua saa aina kysyä. Arvostamme korkealentoista huumoria, matalaa hierarkiaa ja sitä, että töihin on mukava tulla. Meillä et jää yksin pohtimaan haasteita. Ympärilläsi on joukko asiantuntijoita, jotka jakavat osaamistaan, sparraavat ja auttavat tarvittaessa. Työskentelemme tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaiden, alihankkijoiden ja ennen kaikkea toistemme kanssa.

Perehdytämme sinut tehtävään kunnolla, joten kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Riittää, että tuot mukanasi uteliaisuutta, tekemisen meininkiä ja halun kehittyä.

Tule mukaan porukkaan, jossa työkaverit tekevät työpäivistä parempia!

**Mitä lupaamme sinulle:**

- Osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön

- Mahdollisuuden kasvaa alan huippuosaajaksi

- Työn, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä energiamurroksen ja yhteiskunnan toimivuuden kannalta

- Tehtävän vaativuutta ja osaamista vastaavaa palkkaa, joka on tehtävässä 3200-3600€/kk

- Arkea tukemaan kattava työterveyshuolto, virike-etu ja osakesäästöohjelma


**Sinustako seuraava omexomilainen?**

Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään **23.9.2026,** sillä aloitamme keskustelut sopivien hakijoiden kanssa jo hakuaikana, joten älä jätä hakemista viime tippaan.

jobs.title: Manager Sustainability Reporting & Non-Financial Disclosures
jobs.description:
We’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’ve transformed our business and are building our future on one clear purpose—to deliver a smoke-free future. Swedish Match is an affiliate of PMI and has been a leader in the industry for more than 200 years.

We are now looking for a Manager Sustainability Reporting & Non-financial disclosures to be based in Stockholm.

Impact You’ll Own

You will lead the development of key sustainability reports, including the Group Value Report and global non-financial disclosures. Working with reporting specialists and subject-matter experts, you will turn strategy, performance, and data into clear, accurate, and credible content.

What You’ll Do

    Lead the development of the Group Value Report and key global non-financial disclosures
    Manage the reporting process from initial drafting through review, approval, and publication
    Work with reporting specialists and subject-matter experts to gather and validate content
    Turn complex sustainability data and insights into clear, engaging, and credible narratives
    Ensure all reporting outputs are accurate, consistent, evidence-based, and traceable
    Coordinate timelines, inputs, review cycles, version control, and approvals
    Apply sustainability reporting requirements and disclosure expectations throughout the process
    Monitor reporting trends, regulatory developments, and peer practices to identify improvements
    Strengthening the structure, readability, and overall quality of sustainability communications
    Adapt sustainability content for reports, websites, presentations, and other external materials



Skills & Capabilities

    University degree in sustainability, business, finance, communications, public policy, or a related field
    5+ years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience in sustainability, corporate, annual, or other non-financial reporting
    Excellent written and spoken English
    Strong knowledge of sustainability reporting requirements and sound judgment in drafting and review
    Ability to connect narrative claims to data source inputs, and approved documentation
    Ability to ask the right questions, interpret input, and turn technical expertise into clear insights
    Ability to communicate complex ideas clearly, compellingly, and accurately
    Disciplined management of timelines, inputs, reviews, versions, and approvals without compromising quality
    Ability to lead projects end to end, ensuring quality and escalating risks when needed



Please note that relocation support is not available for this role.



Rewards & Benefits

Our success depends on the people who come to work every single day with a sense of purpose and an appetite for progress. Join Swedish Match and you too can:

• Seize the freedom to define your future and ours. We’ll empower you to take risks, experiment and explore.

• Be part of an inclusive, diverse culture, where everyone’s contribution is respected; collaborate with some of the world’s best people and feel like you belong.

• Enjoy flexibility of hybrid way of working - split your time between working from our office or the comfort of your home, where it works best for you in line with business needs.

• Pursue your ambitions and develop your skills with a global business – our staggering size and scale provide endless opportunities to progress.

• Take pride in delivering our promise to society: to deliver a smoke free future.

jobs.title: Head Chef at Clarion Hotel The Edge
jobs.description:
Head Chef at Clarion Hotel The Edge – Ready to Make Your Mark?

We’re not looking for just any chef. We’re looking for someone who wants to own the kitchen, shape our menus with the finest local Arctic produce—and confidently present our food concepts to our event guests. Are you ready to elevate the culinary experience at The Edge?

At Clarion Hotel The Edge, "good enough" never is. Driven by energy, courage, and enthusiasm, we create memorable moments for our guests. As our new Head Chef, your mission is clear: raise the bar for both banquet and à la carte dining, craft bold food concepts, and serve as a passionate ambassador for our kitchen.

The best part? Day-to-day line management is not your primary focus. Here, your main energy goes toward craft, flavor, presentation, and incredible ingredients.

What the role is all about:

  • Crafting menus with local identity: You get the creative freedom to propose, experiment, and refine our à la carte and banquet menus using premium local produce. All menus are developed in close partnership with and approved by our Executive Chef and Strawberry central F&B team.

  • Presenting the food: You step up at major events to present the menu and the stories behind the dishes to our guests with confidence and pride.

  • Delivering under pressure: Main hours are during the evening when the heat is on and expectations are high.

  • Driving sustainability in practice: We mean it when we say "We Care". Through short-traveled ingredients, strong local supplier partnerships, and a clear commitment to reducing food waste, you’ll run a more sustainable kitchen operation.

  • Close collaboration and leadership backup: Reporting directly to our Executive Chef, you will be a key player in driving our culinary philosophy. The role may also involve temporary team leadership duties, particularly when stepping in while the Executive Chef is away or on vacation.

Our vision—and who you are:

Strawberry and Clarion share a clear vision: "To increase the quality of life for guests and colleagues."

To thrive with us, that purpose needs to resonate with you.

You are:

  • A highly skilled, uncompromising chef with a trade certificate and solid experience in banquet and/or à la carte service.

  • Sustainability-minded, innovative, and deeply passionate about local produce and Arctic flavor profiles.

  • Comfortable communicating and presenting food concepts to large groups when required.

  • Ready and willing to step up to take charge of the team when the Executive Chef is away.

  • At your absolute best during high-pressure evening shifts, bringing positive energy that inspires everyone around you.

Why join us?

We give you the platform to shine, grow, and push your limits:

  • Pure culinary focus: Spend your time where you shine brightest—at the stove, developing concepts, and executing top-tier service, while stepping up to lead when duty calls.

  • The power of Strawberry: Access unique opportunities for culinary competitions, leadership courses, and professional development across the group.

  • World-class team: Become part of an energetic, courageous, and enthusiastic culture at one of Northern Norway's most iconic hotels.

  • Unbeatable perks: Great employee discounts on stays and experiences across the entire Strawberry chain.

Ready to step up?

Apply now! We review applications continuously and will hire as soon as we find the right match.

  • Position: Head Chef (Banquet & À la Carte)

  • Working hours: Evening shifts

  • Reports to: Executive Chef

  • If you have any question please contact Lene Larsen, Executive Chef at  phone+47 41144512.  or email lene.larsen@strawberry.no

jobs.title: Vastaanottovirkailija Aava Glass Igloosille – tule osaksi ainutlaatuista matkailukohdetta!
jobs.description:
Etsimme asiakkaallemme Aava Glass Igloosille vastaanottovirkailijaa tulevaan talvisesonkiin.


Aava Glass Igloos tarjoaa vierailleen ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden kokea Lapin taian korkeatasoisessa majoitusympäristössä. Etsimme asiakaspalvelun ammattilaista, joka haluaa olla mukana luomassa vieraille unohtumattomia elämyksiä kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä.

Vastaanottovirkailijana toimit Aava Glass Igloosin käyntikorttina ja tärkeänä osana vieraskokemusta. Tässä tehtävässä toimit resortin kasvona ja tärkeänä osana vieraiden kokonaisvaltaista elämystä. Olet ensimmäinen henkilö, jonka vieraat kohtaavat saapuessaan, ja viimeinen, jonka he näkevät lähtiessään.


Siksi etsimme henkilöitä, jotka ovat luontevia ja elegantteja asiakaspalvelijoita, kykenevät luomaan vieraille lämpimän ja henkilökohtaisen vastaanoton sekä ymmärtävät luksusmatkailun korkeat palveluodotukset. Haluat ylittää asiakkaiden odotukset ja varmistaa, että jokainen vierailu jää mieleen poikkeuksellisen hyvänä kokemuksena.

Tehtävän kuvaus

Vastaanottovirkailijana vastaat vieraiden vastaanotosta ja heidän sujuvasta palvelukokemuksestaan koko vierailun ajan. Työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista vastaanottotiimiä kansainvälisessä ympäristössä, jossa palvelun laatu, yksityiskohtien huomioiminen ja erinomainen asiakaskokemus ovat keskeisessä roolissa.



Tehtäviisi kuuluvat

- vieraiden vastaanotto ja korkeatasoinen asiakaspalvelu
- sisään- ja uloskirjautumiset sekä maksutapahtumien käsittely
- varausten hallinta ja vastaanottojärjestelmien käyttö
- asiakkaiden neuvonta resortin palveluista, aktiviteeteista ja alueen nähtävyyksistä
- asiakkaiden toiveiden ja erityistarpeiden huomioiminen
- tiivis yhteistyö resortin muiden osastojen kanssa
- ensiluokkaisen palvelukokemuksen varmistaminen kaikissa tilanteissa


Etsimme sinua, joka

- olet luonteva, tyylikäs ja aidosti palveluhenkinen asiakaspalvelija
- viihdyt kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa
- osaat kohdata vieraat lämpimästi, ammattimaisesti ja yksilöllisesti
- tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja pystyt ennakoimaan niitä
- toimit rauhallisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti myös kiireellisissä tilanteissa
- työskentelet huolellisesti ja tarkasti järjestelmien sekä varausten parissa
- haluat olla osa laadukasta palvelukulttuuria


Edellytämme

- aiempaa kokemusta vastaanoton tehtävistä korkeatasoisessa hotellissa, resortissa tai muussa premium- tai luksusmatkailun toimintaympäristössä
- kokemusta vaativasta asiakaspalvelusta ja vahvaa palveluasennetta
- erinomaista englannin kielen taitoa
- hyviä tietoteknisiä valmiuksia ja kykyä omaksua uusia järjestelmiä
- täysi-ikäisyyttä
- omaa autoa työmatkojen sujuvuuden vuoksi
- Suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa.


Tarjoamme

- mahdollisuuden työskennellä korkeatasoisessa ja kansainvälisessä resort-ympäristössä
- arvokasta kokemusta luksusmatkailun ja premium-palveluiden parissa
- ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön
- kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan
- mahdollisuuden kehittyä matkailu- ja hospitality-alan huippuammattilaisena


Työsuhteen tiedot

Työt alkavat 9.11.



Työsuhde on määräaikainen kausityö ja kestää maaliskuun loppuun saakka.

Palkkaus on sopimuspalkka, joka määräytyy kokemuksen, osaamisen ja aiemman työhistorian perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä.

Jos tunnistat itsesi laadukkaasta palveluasenteesta, viihdyt kansainvälisessä ympäristössä ja haluat olla mukana luomassa vieraille ainutlaatuisia elämyksiä maailmanlaajuisesti tunnetussa matkailukohteessa, kuulemme mielellämme juuri sinusta.

Hae jo tänään ja tule osaksi unohtumattomia vieraskokemuksia.

jobs.title: Security & Compliance Specialist - Gothenburg or Hälsingland
jobs.description:
Help us build trust, strengthen resilience, and shape the future of compliance in a growing software company.

At Bjorn Lunden, we develop software and services that help businesses manage critical financial and administrative processes. Every day, thousands of customers trust us with sensitive data and business-critical information, making security, transparency, and compliance a natural part of everything we do.

We're now looking for a Security & Compliance Specialist who wants to help strengthen our work within governance, risk, security, and compliance. If you enjoy turning regulatory requirements into practical business solutions and collaborating across both business and technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

As a Security & Compliance Specialist, you will play an important role in developing and strengthening Bjorn Lunden Group's work within information security, compliance, governance, and risk management.

Working closely with our Security & Compliance Officer and colleagues across IT, Development, Operations, Product, and Management, you will help ensure that our processes, controls, and regulatory requirements are translated into practical and effective ways of working.

This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of business, technology, and regulation, supporting initiatives within ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, GDPR, ISAE 3000, and AI governance while helping strengthen security and compliance across the Group.

You will:

    Support control monitoring, audit readiness, and ongoing compliance activities
    Maintain and improve policies, documentation, and governance processes
    Support process owners and stakeholders in strengthening governance, controls, and risk-based ways of working
    Contribute to compliance initiatives related to ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, GDPR, and the EU AI Ac
    Monitor regulatory developments and help assess their impact on the business
    Perform gap analyses and follow up on improvement initiatives
    Advise stakeholders across the business on security, risk, and compliance matters
    Support customer audits, security questionnaires, and compliance inquiries
    Create awareness and training materials that strengthen security culture across the Group

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build broad expertise within information security and compliance while working close to both technology and business.

About You

We're looking for someone who combines analytical thinking with strong collaboration and communication skills. You enjoy bringing structure to complexity and can translate security and compliance requirements into practical actions that support the business.

We believe you have:

    1-3 years of experience within information security, compliance, audit, risk management, privacy, or IT governance
    Knowledge of frameworks and regulations such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, ISAE 3000/3402, GDPR, or similar
    A structured and detail-oriented way of working
    Strong communication skills and the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders
    The confidence to challenge existing processes and identify opportunities for improvement
    Fluent Swedish and strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Dutch or Danish is considered an advantage.

A degree within information security, IT, business administration, law, risk management, audit, or a related field is preferred, but we also value equivalent work experience and practical knowledge.

Certifications such as ISO 27001 Foundation, CISA, CRISC, CISSP, CISM, CIPP/E, CIPT, or similar are considered an advantage. Most importantly, you have a genuine interest in continuous learning and professional development within the security and compliance field.

Who We Are

We are Bjorn Lunden, the business platform that simplifies everyday life for small and medium-sized businesses. Our belief is simple: every business deserves opportunities to grow, and we’re here to make that happen 🐻.

We’re on an exciting journey. With bold ambitions, our vision is to become one of the leading providers of accounting and financial software solutions in Northwestern Europe. With our roots in Hälsingland, specifically in the small village of Näsviken, we’ve grown rapidly in recent years, transforming from a smaller national company into an international group. Today, we operate in Sweden, the Netherlands, and Denmark.

Our goal is straightforward: to make life a little easier for entrepreneurs and business owners. We believe we can do that through great software, knowledge, innovation, and TACO. Not the kind you might be thinking of - but our version: Trust, Ambition, Collaboration, and Ownership.

What We Offer

We offer you a role in an international, growing company with a strong market position and the ambition to challenge industry giants. The wellbeing of our employees truly matters to us, and we want to be a fair and responsible employer where people feel good and enjoy their work.

We strive for a healthy work-life balance and support this through competitive conditions and benefits and flexible work opportunities. We want to be the natural first choice for people who want to thrive and have fun at work.

Application

We are looking for a Security & Compliance Specialist located in Gothenburg, Stockholm, Hudiksvall, Näsviken, or Ljusdal.

The application deadline is 4th October 2026, but selection and interviews may take place on an ongoing basis. The position may therefore be filled before the deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the role, please contact:

Robert Dahlin, Group Head of IT Robert.Dahlin@bjornlunden.com

*For this recruitment, we kindly ask that recruitment agencies or other external partners refrain from contacting us.

jobs.title: Säljare av renhållningsfordon
jobs.description:
Teknisk Säljare av Renhållningsfordon



Vill du sälja kvalitetsprodukter inom en bransch som aldrig står still?

Megins satsar på att växa inom produktion och försäljning av renhållningsfordon på den svenska marknaden och söker nu en driven och affärsorienterad säljare som vill vara med på resan.

Megins erbjuder tillsammans med Kaoussis ett brett sortiment av renhållningsfordon – från 1- och 2-facks sopbilar till 3-fackslösningar och sopaggregat på lastväxlarram. Produktionen omfattar omkring 350 sopbilar per år inom Europa, vilket ger en robust och beprövad produkt till ett konkurrenskraftigt pris.

Om rollen

Som säljare får du en central roll i att utveckla Megins försäljning av renhållningsfordon i Sverige.

Du kommer att arbeta nära kunder inom exempelvis kommuner, renhållningsbolag, entreprenörer och andra aktörer inom avfallshantering. Rollen innebär ett stort eget ansvar där du själv driver affären från första kontakt till avslut och leverans.



Du kommer bland annat att:

· Bearbeta nya kunder och bygga långsiktiga relationer

· Ansvara för försäljning av renhållningsfordon på den svenska marknaden

· Identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och utveckla befintliga kunder

· Sätta dig in i kundens behov och presentera rätt fordonslösning

· Ta fram offerter och driva förhandlingar fram till avslut

· Delta i kundmöten, mässor och produktvisningar

· Arbeta nära Megins organisation i Sverige och Kaoussis organisation i Grekland kring teknik, produktion och leverans

· Följa marknaden och utvecklingen inom renhållning och avfallshantering



Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som tycker om att göra affärer och som trivs med att bygga relationer över tid. Du behöver inte ha arbetat med just sopbilar tidigare, men det är meriterande. Det viktigaste är att du har ett starkt kommersiellt driv, tekniskt intresse och förmågan att förstå kundens verksamhet och omsätta deras behov till rätt lösning.



Vi tror att du:

· Har erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning

· Är van vid att självständigt driva hela säljprocessen

· Har ett starkt affärs- och resultatfokus med långsiktigt värdeskapande

· Är relationsskapande och förtroendeingivande

· Har tekniskt intresse och lätt för att förstå komplexa produkter

· Trivs med att vara ute hos kunder och bygga nätverk

· Är självgående, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad

· Har B-körkort (C-körkort är meriterande)

Erfarenhet med försäljning av lastbilar eller påbyggnationer ser vi som meriterande.



Vad erbjuder vi?

En spännande möjlighet att bli en del av ett innovativt och snabbväxande företag där du får arbeta med marknadsledande produkter och avancerad teknik.

Du får arbeta med en produkt som fyller en konkret och samhällsviktig funktion. Avfall måste samlas in varje dag – vilket innebär att våra kunders fordon måste fungera varje dag.



Placering:

Huvudkontoret är i Hörby i Skåne

Rollen innebär resor till kunder över hela Sverige och tjänsten kan erbjudas som distansarbete.



Om Megins Superstructure AB

Megins Superstructure AB är ett snabbväxande företag mitt i Skåne som utvecklar och producerar vakuum-lastbilar för kunder i hela Norra Europa. Våra produkter kombinerar modern teknik inom mekanik, hydraulik, styrsystem och pneumatik för att skapa effektiva och hållbara lösningar för marknaden. Företaget har också ett nära samarbete med Kaoussis och erbjuder robusta renhållningsfordon som byggs på chassin i Sverige.

Bolaget grundades 2023 och omsätter idag närmare 100 miljoner kronor per år, med målsättningen att växa till över 300 miljoner kronor fram till 2030. Produktionen sker i

helt nya och moderna lokaler i Hörby där innovation, kvalitet och teknisk utveckling står i fokus.



Läs gärna mer om oss här: Megins | Superstructure Megins Superstructure AB – YouTube

Är du den vi söker?

Har du frågor om tjänsten eller vill presentera dig själv i samband med din ansökan, kontakta ansvarig rekryterare, Jerry Stenberg på jerry.stenberg@prowork.
