jobs.title: R&D Mechanical Engineer  HVDC Windings
jobs.description:
For our HVDC Transformers research and development team we are looking for a R&D mechanical engineer in the field of Transformer Winding/Active part technology. You will lead activities to improve transformer winding/active part performance, design and manufacturing methods while challenging legacy routines and developing better suited concepts for the future. The role will cooperate closely with experts in different transformer technology fields as well as with transformer design and manufacturing specialists globally. You will build and maintain a network with the HVDC Transformer factories globally, collecting the inputs and supporting implementation of new development.  

Working in R&D will give you the possibility to use your creativity to solve a wide spectrum of challenges. You will have exciting and varied work in front of you where you will get a broad network internally and externally. Work with both the local factory and the global organization within Transformers and have career development opportunities as a Specialist or as a Project Manager.

Your responsibilities

    Creating conceptual designs of Transformer windings to meet specified requirements (functional, technical, quality, etc).
    Ability to create detailed design and 3D modeling as well as running mechanical verifications using simulation tools.
    Running Design for Excellence practices (DFA, DFM, FMEA, etc.).
    Preparing reports and related documents in accordance with internal and external requirements.
    Technical standards: Ensure that winding-related processes and calculation methods are state of the art. Work with programmers to implement and test new methods in the design software.
    Technical support: Support the design, manufacturing, quality and supply chain organizations with technical expertise to ensure that technical requirements are fulfilled.
    Technical leadership and knowledge sharing: Coach and provide support and technical advice to colleagues on winding-related topics. Maintain a network of engineering professionals to share best practices across different disciplines and the HVDC Transformer factories.

Your background

    Master’s or Bachelor’s degree combined with work-life experience in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.
    3+ Years of experience in Design & Engineering.
    Domain expertise in Power transformers.
    Fundamental knowledge of using different materials and manufacturing methods.
    Understanding of electrical, magnetic and thermal phenomena.
    Advanced knowledge of 3D CAD software Creo/ProE.
    Fluent command of English, both written and spoken.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
As a Forward Deployed Engineer in the customer organisation, you are the technical spearhead of monday.com's AI transformation motion for our most strategic customers. You will carry a portfolio of 1 to 2 strategic accounts, deeply embedded with C-level and technical teams to architect, build, and ship AI solutions in production, and you will be accountable for the business outcomes those engagements promised, not just the build.

This is part of a growing motion, and you will be joining a team that’s already working on active deployments.

Please note this is a hybrid position of 3 days/week in our Paris office.

About the Role

Enterprises don't struggle to access AI capability; they struggle to deploy it. Your job is closing that gap for a small portfolio of monday.com's highest-value customers. You will advise executives on AI-driven operational change, design and ship the systems that make it real, and feed what you learn back into the product with evidence, not anecdotes.

You will work with: monday AI agents, MCP-based integrations into customer systems, vibe apps, and production workflows. You will take these from discovery through architecture, build, rollout, and measurable adoption.

This is an autonomous, high-visibility role that shapes both customer outcomes and the future of forward-deployed engineering at monday.com.

What You'll Do

Strategic transformation. Embed with C-level stakeholders across your accounts to architect end-to-end AI solutions and scalable workflows that solve complex, mission-critical business pains. You own the narrative from pilot to full production rollout.

Outcome ownership. Your success metric is the business result the engagement committed to: adoption, workflow throughput, measurable ROI. You define the success criteria with the customer up front and you own getting there.

Build and ship. Design sophisticated platform configurations, build monday agents and vibe apps, wire MCP integrations into customer systems, and prototype custom scripts where the platform ends. Your leverage is architecture and judgment; your credibility is that you can build it yourself.

Eval-driven product feedback. Instrument your deployments, run evals against real customer workflows, and translate what you find into PRDs and roadmap input that changes what we build. You are a sensor for the product org, with data behind every claim.

Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Sales and CS as the technical authority on account strategy. Productize what you learn: patterns, agents, and assets from one account become reusable machinery for the whole motion.

What we promise

This role has been built with a direct line into the product roadmap, a mandate to productize rather than repeat, and outcome-based success criteria agreed before the build starts.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building applications from scratch using TypeScript/Node.js/React, with full-stack depth

  • Experience leading hands-on projects end-to-end in a production environment, preferably client-facing

  • Background in Solution Architecture or Software Engineering with a strong grasp of AI/LLM systems: agent architectures, MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, evals, and prompt-to-production workflows

  • Experience navigating C-suite relationships and influencing executive decisions in ambiguous environments

  • Track record of turning one-off delivery work into reusable assets, product requirements, or repeatable playbooks

  • Entrepreneurial, fast-moving, and focused on long-term impact over immediate fixes

Dei som blir tilsett vil få god opplæring og skal jobbe innan alle desse fagområda, ut frå dei behova som blir meldt til Bemanningssenteret. Dette er ein stilling med mykje variasjon i arbeidet og kor ein får god innsikt i drifta i sjukehuset.

På oppdrag frå Hospitaldrift planlegg Bemanningssenteret kor vikarane til ei kvar tid skal arbeide. Medarbeidarane har fast turnus med arbeidstid 07.00-15.00, og pt arbeid kvar 4. helg.

Vikarane våre er viktige arbeidstakarar i Hospitaldrift og vi søker deg som sett store krav til deg sjølv når det gjeld kvalitet i arbeidet. Stor variasjon i arbeidet og fleire arbeidsstader krev svært gode norskkunnskapar og gode kommunikasjonsevner. Arbeidet kan vere fysisk krevande og krev god helse. Det er ein fordel med erfaring frå fleire av fagområda i Hospitaldrift.

  • Dagleg reinhald av pasientområde, kontorlokale og fellesareal

  • Smittevask/spesialreinhald

HOSPITALDRIFT MATFORSYNING (Kjøkken - Kantine - Keitering - Konferanse)

  • Assistere i matproduksjon

  • Rydding og oppvask
Kvalifikasjonar

  • Gode kunnskapar i norsk
  • Forståing av logistikk- og transportsystem
  • God kunnskap om hygiene
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Sjølvstendig og fleksibel
  • Likar og meistrar varierte arbeidsoppgåver
  • Jobbe strukturert og effektivt i eit til tider hektisk miljø
  • Punktleg og nøyaktig
  • Serviceinnstilt
  • Helse til fysisk krevande arbeid
  • Bidra til eit godt arbeidsmiljø
Vi tilbyr
  • Utfordrande arbeidsoppgåver i gode fagmiljø med hyggelege kollegaer

jobs.title: Directeur / Directrice de structure d'hébergement touristique (H/F)
jobs.description:
La Ligue de l'enseignement - Fédération des Œuvres Laïques de la Moselle (FOL57) recrute un(e) Directeur(rice) pour son centre d'hébergement permanent ouvert toute l'année « Les Jonquilles », situé à Xonrupt-Longemer, au cœur du massif des Vosges. D'une capacité de 250 lits, le centre accueille principalement des classes de découverte, des séjours de vacances pour enfants et jeunes, ainsi que des groupes d'adultes, familles et individuels.
En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
Vous partagez pleinement les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de la laïcité, de l'engagement citoyen et de l'accès aux vacances pour tous en conjuguant vision stratégique, sens du collectif et capacité d'action.
Au sein du centre, le(la) directeur(rice) s'appuie sur une équipe permanente composée notamment de deux directrices adjointes, d'une cheffe de cuisine, d'une seconde de cuisine, d'une animatrice environnement, d'un agent technique et de personnels saisonniers et occasionnels ainsi que les services de la fédération.
Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE
- Superviser l'entretien du patrimoine immobilier et des équipements avec l'agent technique
- Organiser les commissions de sécurité et assurer la tenue des registres réglementaires.
- Veiller à la mise en œuvre des 3 labels : Familles Plus, Ecolabels, Tourisme et Handicap
- Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des programmes de travaux et d'investissement en collaboration étroite avec le siège de la fédération
GESTION ADMINISTRATIVE ET FINANCIERE
- Organiser le suivi des réservations et de l'occupation du centre (rooming)
- Contrôler les caisses et le compte courant du centre, Transmettre les pièces comptables au siège de la fédération où est tenu la comptabilité.
- Superviser l'économat avec la cheffe de cuisine et établir avec les adjointes la gestion du tarifs jour

CONDITIONS DU POSTE
- CDI à temps plein.
- Prise de fonction : 1er septembre 2026.
- Classification cadre selon la Convention Collective ECLAT. Indice 400 avec reprise d'ancienneté selon les dispositions conventionnelles.
- Logement de fonction possible. - Astreintes organisées avec l'équipe du centre.
- Véhicule de service, téléphone de fonction
- Mutuelle, Avantages du CSE,

jobs.title: Technical Sales & Business Development Manager - Paper & Board
jobs.description:
At Nouryon, our global team takes positive action every day, to reach higher collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs – today and in the future.

We are looking for team members who bring ideas forward, champion others and work together to do better. Does that sound like you?



About the job

In this exiting role as Business Development Manager Paper & Board, you will lead the technical and commercial advancement of Nouryon’s Paper, Board and tissue business in Europe. With ownership of key CMC applications, you will drive innovation, strengthen customer partnerships, and help position Nouryon as the preferred solutions provider in tissue and barrier coatings.



In your future role as Business Development Manager, you will

    Conduct technical audits and diagnostics at Nordic key accounts and selected distributors to identify opportunities for CMC, surfactants and chelates (with focus on wet end tissue and barrier coating).
    Work closely and support the Account Manager to develop and manage a strategic key account plan implementing innovation and enabling multi‑level engagement, thereby strengthening customer proximity and long‑term partnership.
    Maintain regular technical and innovation touchpoints with key account R&D and distributor technical teams to align on project pipeline and application roadmaps.
    Provide second line technical support and training for the EMEA distribution network, including joint customer visits and troubleshooting of complex cases.
    Manage sales related KPIs for assigned accounts (volume, margin, price development, project pipeline value, hit rate) and report progress versus targets.



You will work closely with internal stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, and R&D to drive customer projects, technical development, and business growth. Externally, you will build strong relationships with paper mills, industrial customers, distributors, and customer R&D and application teams, acting as a trusted technical advisor and partner.

This role requires travel approximately 40-50% of the time, primarily across Europe. Occasional travel to the Middle East and North Africa, including Egypt, may also be required to support customer engagement, technical projects, and business development activities.



We believe you bring

    Great experience within the paper and board process industries, ideally in technical and application, process, or customer-facing role.
    Proven experience in technical sales, or technical service, with direct customer interaction.
    Hands-on experience with tissue, board, specialty paper, barrier coatings, or related applications.
    Experience planning and executing laboratory and mill trials and translating technical outcomes into commercial value.
    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Paper Engineering, Chemistry, Process Engineering, or a related technical field.



We believe you are...



To be successful in this position you combine strong technical expertise with commercial acumen and can turn technical insight into customer value. You thrive in an independent role with a high degree of ownership, while also collaborating effectively across functions, teams, and countries. Structured and proactive in your approach, you value knowledge sharing, transparency, and strong teamwork to drive results.



We offer you

At Nouryon, we provide a great job and friendly coworkers, plus benefits in addition to salary. Our collective agreement is with IKEM. Plus, we offer unilateral perks, such as bonus, reduced hours, health care allowance, lunch allowance, and more.



Have we got your interest?

This is a permanent position on a full-time basis, reporting to Nicolo Marelli, Regional Sales Director EMEIA, based in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/

As an applicant, you will be subject to a background check before employment. You will receive more information about this later in the recruitment process.

We work actively and systematically with HSE matters to ensure a safe and sustainable working environment for our employees. As an employee, you may therefore be required to undergo drug testing on a random basis. This is part of our commitment to safeguarding the safety and well-being of our staff.



We look forward to receiving your application!



About Nouryon

Explore careers and life at Nouryon  

If you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. Our employees are driven by the wish to make an impact and actively drive positive change. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, diverse, and proactive working environment.

Visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn.



Contact

For additional information about the vacancy please contact hiring manager Nicolo Marelli, Regional Sales Director EMEIA at nicolo.marelli@nouryon.com

jobs.title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö - Arsenaali Oy
jobs.description:
[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/51a48aea-9cb3-42cf-8080-ca1ef36998cf/original.jpeg]


ASIAKKUUSPÄÄLLIKKÖ – HALUATKO TEHDÄ TULOSTA JA NÄHDÄ SEN MYÖS PALKASSASI?

Sytytkö tavoitteista, kaupoista ja onnistumisista? Oletko parhaimmillasi silloin, kun ympärillä tapahtuu paljon ja tilanteet vaativat nopeita päätöksiä?

Arsenaalissa pääset vauhdikkaaseen kaupalliseen rooliin, jossa yhdistyvät myynti, asiakkuudet ja ihmiset. Tässä työssä et jää odottamaan, että puhelin soi. Tartut itse mahdollisuuksiin, kontaktoit asiakkaita ja pidät huolen siitä, että oikeat työntekijät ja oikeat työtehtävät kohtaavat mahdollisimman tehokkaasti.

Arsenaali on luotettava, vakavarainen ja moderni henkilöstöpalveluyritys. Työllistämme päivittäin 250–300 rakennus-, kuljetus- ja ravintola-alan ammattilaista Uudenmaan alueella. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli 10,9 miljoonaa euroa.

Nyt etsimme joukkoomme tavoitteellista ja energistä asiakkuuspäällikköä, joka haluaa tehdä tulosta – ja menestyä yhdessä muun joukkueen kanssa.


TÄSSÄ TYÖSSÄ TEKEMISELLÄSI ON SUORA VAIKUTUS TULOKSEEN

Asiakkuuspäällikkönä vastaat omista asiakkuuksistasi ja niiden kehittämisestä. Samalla pidät silmät auki uusille kaupallisille mahdollisuuksille.

Yksi tärkeimmistä tehtävistäsi on huolehtia henkilöstöpoolimme mahdollisimman korkeasta käyttöasteesta. Kun työntekijän toimeksianto päättyy, tavoitteena on löytää hänelle nopeasti seuraava työ. Kun asiakkaalle syntyy äkillinen tarve, meidän tehtävämme on ratkaista se.

Työpäivääsi kuuluu:

* aktiivinen myynti nykyisille ja uusille asiakkaille

* uusien asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja tapaaminen

* omien asiakkuuksien kehittäminen

* vapautuvien työntekijöiden aktiivinen tarjoaminen asiakkaille

* uusien työntekijöiden rekrytointi yhdessä rekrytointitiimimme kanssa

* työntekijöiden työvuoroihin ja toimeksiantoihin liittyvien asioiden hoitaminen

* nopeasti muuttuvien tilanteiden ratkaiseminen.

Työssä tulee vastaan päiviä, jolloin monta asiaa tapahtuu yhtä aikaa. Asiakkaan tarve muuttuu, työntekijä vapautuu ennakoitua aikaisemmin tai sovittu henkilö ei pääsekään töihin. Silloin etsimme ihmistä, joka ei jää ihmettelemään ongelmaa vaan miettii: miten tämä ratkaistaan?


TUNNISTATKO ITSESI?

Emme etsi ensisijaisesti tietyn toimialan osaajaa tai tietyn tutkinnon suorittanutta. Etsimme ennen kaikkea oikeanlaista draivia.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:

* haluat voittaa ja saavuttaa tavoitteesi

* saat energiaa kaupoista ja onnistumisista

* raha ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan ansaintaasi motivoivat sinua

* tartut puhelimeen mieluummin kuin jäät odottamaan

* pystyt tekemään päätöksiä nopeasti myös paineen alla

* osaat hahmottaa, missä on hyvä kauppa ja mihin ei kannata käyttää aikaansa

* olet järjestelmällinen ja tarkka, vaikka ympärillä olisi kiire

* uskallat olla jämäkkä asiakkaiden ja työntekijöiden kanssa

* epäonnistuminen tai muuttunut tilanne ei pysäytä sinua – siirryt nopeasti seuraavaan ratkaisuun

* olet energinen, ahkera ja nautit korkeasta tekemisen temposta.

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla kokemusta henkilöstöpalvelualalta. Kiinnostava taustasi voi löytyä yhtä hyvin esimerkiksi myynnistä, logistiikasta, kuljetusalalta, resursoinnista tai muusta nopeatempoisesta liiketoiminnasta.

Toivomme kuitenkin, että olet jo päässyt näyttämään kaupallista osaamistasi ja tiedät, mitä tavoitteellinen työskentely käytännössä tarkoittaa.

Emme etsi kaikkien miellyttäjää. Etsimme hyvää tyyppiä, joka tulee toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa, mutta uskaltaa myös tehdä päätöksiä, pitää sovituista asioista kiinni ja viedä tilanteet loppuun.


MITÄ SAAT MEILTÄ?

Kun odotamme sinulta paljon, haluamme myös palkita onnistumisesta.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* 2 500–4 000 euron suoritusperusteinen pohjapalkka plus bonus kuukaudessa – onnistuminen näkyy omassa palkassasi

* mahdollisuuden työsuhdeautoon

* vahvan perehdytyksen ja henkilökohtaisen mentoroinnin

* kokeneen rekrytointitiimin tuen

* osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön

* miellyttävät toimitilat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella

* säännöllisen työajan arkisin klo 8–16 toimipaikassamme Helsingissä

Arsenaalissa tavoitteet ovat korkealla, mutta niitä ei saavuteta kyynärpäätaktiikalla. Tiimissäsi työskentelee muita asiakkuuspäälliköitä sekä rekrytoinnin ammattilaisia. Autamme toisiamme onnistumaan, ja kaupoista sekä hyvistä tuloksista iloitaan yhdessä.


HALUATKO NÄYTTÄÄ, MIHIN PYSTYT?

Jos haluat työn, jossa päivät kuluvat nopeasti, tulokset näkyvät konkreettisesti ja omalla aktiivisuudellasi on merkitystä sekä asiakkaalle, työntekijälle että omalle ansainnallesi, haluamme tutustua sinuun.

Emme etsi täydellistä CV:tä. Etsimme oikeaa asennetta, kaupallista vaistoa ja halua onnistua.

Ota seuraava askel ja osoita meille, miksi juuri sinä olisi hyvä vahvistus Arsenaalin joukkueeseen.

jobs.title: Central quality vie f/h (H/F)
jobs.description:
Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés.

Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.



Safran Nacelles conçoit, intègre et assure le support et le service après-vente des nacelles d'avions. La société est un leader mondial sur le marché des avions commerciaux de plus de 100 places, des avions d'affaires et des avions régionaux. A la pointe de la technologie, Safran Nacelles propose des nacelles toujours plus intégrées au moteur, aérodynamiques, légères avec des traitements acoustiques avancés afin de contribuer à la réduction des émissions de CO2 et sonores des aéronefs.



Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.


Descriptif missionSafran Nacelles is looking for a VIE Digital Quality & Audit Improvement Engineer to join its Quality team in Burnley, UK.



As part of the Quality organisation, you will contribute to the development and deployment of a new digital internal auditing tool, supporting Safran Nacelles' ambition to transform and digitalise its audit practices.



This assignment will provide the opportunity to work at the intersection of Quality, digitalisation and continuous improvement, while collaborating with different teams across the organisation.



Your missions :



Working closely with the Quality team and relevant stakeholders, you will contribute to the following activities:



Support the development of a new digital internal auditing tool for Safran Nacelles, contributing to the transition towards a more digital and efficient approach to internal audits.

Contribute to the deployment of the digital auditing tool, including supporting users during implementation, preparing training materials and contributing to training sessions.

Support the definition and development of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) associated with the auditing tool, helping to monitor its adoption, performance and effectiveness.

Develop and support the implementation of processes and templates to facilitate the consolidation and analysis of audit results.

Contribute to trend analysis of audit results and associated action plans, helping the Quality team identify recurring issues, improvement opportunities and areas requiring attention.

Support the monitoring of action plans resulting from audits and contribute to the follow-up of improvement actions with the relevant stakeholders.

Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to the internal audit process and contribute to sharing lessons learned and best practices.

Work collaboratively with Quality, Operations, Engineering and other stakeholders to support the successful deployment and continuous improvement of the digital audit approach.

jobs.title: Comercial de Software B2B | IA y Transformación Digital
jobs.description:
El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar
  • Acompañamiento inicial para que puedas conocer nuestro producto, nuestros sectores y nuestra metodología comercial
  • Condiciones competitivas acordes a la experiencia aportada, con fijo + variable por objetivos


Esperamos recibir su solicitud.

Más que un perfil que simplemente "venda software", buscamos a una persona que quiera convertirse en referente comercial de nuestras soluciones. Alguien capaz de sentarse con un cliente, entender cómo funciona su negocio, detectar dónde están sus problemas, explicar cómo puede ayudar la tecnología y construir una propuesta que tenga sentido tanto operativa como económicamente.Y, especialmente, alguien que entienda que la IA no es solo una tecnología más, sino una nueva forma de trabajar, vender y aportar valor a nuestros clientes.Si te motiva vender soluciones tecnológicas complejas, disfrutas entendiendo el negocio del cliente, tienes curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA y te gusta construir relaciones comerciales basadas en confianza, conocimiento y resultados, nos encantará conocerte.Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos brevemente qué proyectos de venta consultiva tecnológica has liderado, qué tipo de soluciones has vendido y cómo estás utilizando actualmente la IA en tu trabajo.

jobs.title: Can you combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations?
jobs.description:
Bergen Engines is entering an important phase of factory development and production ramp-up. To support this, we are strengthening the Special Projects team with two to three Project Managers who can lead cross-functional initiatives and help turn our operational ambitions into practical, executable projects. Reporting to the Head of Special Projects, you will work closely with Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, HSE, Facilities and Finance. The project portfolio is expected to include assembly-capacity and ramp-up initiatives, factory layout and material-flow improvements, tooling and facility investments, CAPEX projects and other operational-improvement activities required to increase manufacturing capability towards 2028.     Your key responsibilities
  • Define project scope, objectives, deliverables and success criteria.
  • Develop and maintain credible project plans covering milestones, resources, costs and dependencies.
  • Coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure clear ownership of actions.
  • Identify and manage project risks, issues, changes and key decisions.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts and escalate constraints or decisions early.
  • Support business cases, investment requests and CAPEX governance where applicable.
  • Work directly with factory teams to understand constraints and implement practical solutions.
  • Drive projects relating to capacity, throughput, assembly flow, material readiness, layout, tooling and process improvement.
  • Provide concise and transparent progress reporting to project sponsors and relevant governance forums.
  • Ensure that projects are delivered safely, on time, within approved cost and with measurable operational benefits.
  • Coordinate effective handover of completed projects into the responsible operational organisation.
Who are we looking for?  We are looking for people who combine structured project delivery with a practical understanding of manufacturing and factory operations. You may already work as a Project Manager, or you may have led substantial projects or workstreams within Manufacturing, Assembly, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Facilities or another relevant area.   Your qualifications: 
  • Education within technical fields and knowledge of manufacturing. If you have particularly long and relevant experience the education requirement may be disregarded. 
  • 8-10 years of experience from related role.
  • Experience from planning and delivering cross-functional projects or significant work packages.
  • A good understanding of complex engineering or manufacturing environments.
  • The ability to convert broad objectives into clear actions, milestones and accountabilities.
  • A practical and visible approach, including working directly with teams on the factory floor.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of project costs, benefits and priorities.
  • A strong commitment to safety, quality and sustainable operational improvement.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Fluent skills in both writing and orally in English and preferably also in Norwegian.
Knowledge of Bergen Engines’ products, manufacturing processes, assembly operations and internal systems will be an advantage. A formal project-management or relevant technical qualification is beneficial, but a demonstrated record of successful delivery is equally important.   Your personal characteristics
  • Ability to work independently towards goals. 
  • A good team player. 
  • Good cooperative and communicative skills. 
  • Structured and analytical. 
  • Curious and outgoing, not afraid to ask questions and suggest improvements. 
  • The confidence to challenge constructively, resolve obstacles and escalate decisions when necessary.
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder-management skills.
 

Why choose Bergen Engines?

For more than 80 years, Bergen Engines has delivered world-class power and propulsion systems to customers around the globe. Today, we're playing a key role in the maritime industry through innovative and efficient engine technology.

From our headquarters in Bergen, Norway, we work closely with customers worldwide, combining Norwegian engineering expertise with international reach. As part of the Langley Holdings Power Solutions Division, we're investing in growth, new markets, and the people who will help drive our future success.

These positions offer an opportunity to:
  • Contribute directly to Bergen Engines’ future manufacturing capability.
  • Lead visible projects with tangible operational impact.
  • Work across multiple functions and broaden your business experience.
  • Help shape how strategic factory projects are planned, governed and delivered.
  • Develop further within project management and operational leadership.

 

What we offer:

  • At Bergen Engines, you'll have the opportunity to work with advanced technology, international customers and colleagues who are passionate about what they do.
  • Meaningful work that contributes to a more sustainable future.
  • An international environment with exciting growth opportunities.
  • Professional and personal development in a technology-driven company.
  • Competitive salary and company-wide bonus scheme.
  • Flexible working hours and strong work-life balance.
  • Excellent pension and insurance arrangements.
  • Company cabin at Kvamskogen and employee discount programs.
  • Active sports clubs and social activities.
  • Occupational health services.
  • A highly skilled team that supports and challenges each other.

 

Are you ready to join our team?

At Bergen Engines, you'll join one of Norway's leading industrial technology companies and help deliver the power solutions that keep the world moving.

Work location is our headquarters and production facility at Hordvikneset, approximately 20 km north of Bergen city centre.

The position reports to Head of Special Projects- Nanda Kishore. 

For questions please contact: Nanda per mobile +4748286461 or e-mail nanda.kishore@bergenengines.com

Application deadline: 20.09.2026. Applications will be reviewed continuously.


Bergen Engines bygger og utvikler medium speed-motorer til landbaserte anlegg og til applikasjoner i den maritime næringen. Våre motorer er kjent for kvalitet og pålitelighet, og har en ingeniørtradisjon som strekker seg tilbake til 1855 da Bergen Mekaniske Verksted (BMV) ble etablert. Bedriften bygde sin første dieselmotor i 1946, og siden den gang har over 7500 motorer blitt levert der over halvparten fortsatt er i drift i dag. Tidligere kjent som Rolls-Royce Bergen Engines, ble bedriften en del av det britiske, privateide ingeniørselskapet Langley Holdings plc. 31. desember 2021.

jobs.title: Teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentaja, Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab, Turku
jobs.description:
_Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab:n tuotemerkit Marli, Mehukatti, Juissi, Vital, Natur, God Morgon ja Brazil ovat luonnollinen osa suomalaisten arkea. Jokaisella meistä on mehujen joukossa omat suosikkituotteemme ja monet niistä tuovat mieleen mukavan nostalgisia muistoja._

_Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab on osa Euroopan johtavaa mehuliiketoimintakonsernia Eckes-Granini Group GmbH:ta, jonka pääkonttori sijaitsee Saksassa. Eckes-Granini Finlandin juomatehdas sekä muut liiketoiminnot sijaitsevat Turussa. Tavoitteemme on olla Suomen vastuullisin mehutalo_.

**Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab etsii teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentajaa Turun tuotantolaitokselle kolmivuorotyöhön.**

Teollisuuden kunnossapitoasentajana vastaat tuotantolaitteiden ja automaatiojärjestelmien toimivuudesta ja kehittämisestä. Työ on monipuolinen ja sisältää sekä kunnossapidon että tuotannon kehittämisen tehtäviä.

**Tehtävänkuva**

· Mekaanisten ja sähköautomaatioon liittyvien vikojen korjaus sekä häiriöiden poisto koko tuotannon ja logistiikan alueella

· Ennakkohuoltojen toteutus

· Tuotantolinjojen kehittäminen ja parantaminen yhteistyössä esihenkilösi, muiden tuotantoasentajien sekä kunnossapitoasentajien kanssa

**Edellytämme sinulta**

· Sähkö- ja automaatioalan ammatillista koulutusta tai riittävää kokemusta teollisuuden automaatiotehtävistä

· Halua ja kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn

· Hyviä ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

· Yhteistyökykyä muun henkilöstömme sekä urakoitsijoiden henkilöstön kanssa

Sähkö- ja automaatiotekniikan osaaminen on tehtävässä keskeinen perusvaatimus. Yrityksellä on mahdollisuus perehdyttää ja kouluttaa tehtävän mekaanisiin osa-alueisiin sekä laitteisiin, mutta sähkö- ja automaatiotekniikan perustaidot tulisi hakijalla olla jo valmiiksi hallussa.

**Tarjoamme**

· Vakituisen työn kansainvälisessä yrityksessä kaikkien suomalaisten tuntemien tuotebrändien parissa

· Yrityksen palkkausjärjestelmän mukaisen palkkauksen, kattavan sairaskuluvakuutuksen sekä liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun

· Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän modernissa tuotantoympäristössä

· Hyvät mahdollisuudet kehittyä työssäsi

**Palkkaus**

Tehtävän palkkahaarukka on 15,13 €/h - 18,20 €/h. Huomioimme palkkauksessa henkilön osoittaman osaamisen sekä työkokemuksen. Lisäksi palkkaukseen vaikuttavat TES:n mukaiset ilta- ja yötyölisät, yrityskohtainen kolmivuorolisä sekä työsuhteen aikana osoitettu monityötaitoisuus.

_Työkuutio toimii rekrytoinnissa Eckes-Granini Finland Oy Ab:n kumppanina. Pyydämme lähettämään hakemuksen ja CV:n osoitteeseen toimisto@tyokuutio.fi viimeistään 10.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme hakemusten läpikäynnin ja haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan sopivan ehdokkaan löytyessä – toimi siis ripeästi!_

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
jobs.description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.title: PhD Student in Building Materials
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.



The research subject of Building Materials (https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/Byggmaterial?l=en) consists of 15 people. The subject focuses on the development of sustainable materials and production technologies for the construction industry, as well as on ice and arctic conditions-related research and education.



Subject description

Building Materials includes sustainable building materials and their application technologies, recycling and reuse, and applied building physics, especially focusing on the Arctic conditions.



Project description

This research explores how mining waste, such as tailings and waste rock, can be reused rather than sent to landfill. Sweden, one of Europe's largest metal producers, generates large volumes of such waste each year, which can create environmental problems due to its reactive nature. This project aims to develop innovative ways to reuse this material in cement-based products, helping to reduce environmental impact and support more sustainable, resource-efficient mining.



Duties

As a PhD student, you are expected to perform both experimental and theoretical work within your research studies as well as communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. The tasks will include laboratory tests, analysis of data, and modeling.



Qualifications

To be eligible, you must have a master’s degree in materials science or chemistry. You should have basic knowledge of building materials and be fluent in English.



The following work or research experience will be an advantage: experience with cementitious materials, XRD with Rietveld analysis, SEM, TG, DSC, micro-CT, particle size analysis, calorimetry, and synchrotron experimental measurement techniques. Knowledge of AI-based and machine-learning methods is also beneficial.



For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en



Further information

Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years; teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. Placement: Luleå. Starting: as soon as possible but not later than January 1, 2027

jobs.title: Travel Development & Operations Specialist — Nordtours
jobs.description:
Join Nordtours as a Travel Development & Operations Specialist and help us grow through inspiring Norway itineraries, strong partnerships and excellent customer service. Full-time, one-year contract, primarily remote within Norway.

  • Support guests before, during and after their trips, coordinating suppliers and handling changes.

Vi tilbyr

  • A full-time position on a one-year contract.

  • A primarily remote working arrangement within Norway, with occasional travel and in-person work.

  • A varied role combining travel planning, partnerships, sales and customer service.

Mi Casa Tu Casa AS operates hotels, guesthouses and camping properties in Norway, welcoming travellers from around the world.

We are expanding into personalised travel experiences through Nordtours, our new tourism initiative focused on Norway's nature, local activities and routes beyond the usual tourist stops.

This position combines the development and daily coordination of Nordtours with customer service for our Nordhomes accommodation businesses. The employer for this position is Mi Casa Tu Casa AS.

Build software that matters — and help shape how it's built.

What if your .NET expertise could contribute to software that makes a real difference in healthcare?

At CellaVision, we develop innovative medical technology for digital blood cell analysis, helping laboratories automate diagnostics and enabling healthcare professionals to make faster, more reliable decisions.

We are now looking for an experienced Software Engineer (.NET) to join our Software Platforms team in Lund. This is an opportunity to work with modern software engineering while influencing the technology, architecture, and development practices used across the company.

The role

Software Platforms provides the infrastructure, shared capabilities, architecture, cybersecurity expertise, and reusable components that enable our engineering teams to develop and deliver software securely and at scale.

As a Software Engineer, you will work with:

    

C# and .NET development

    

SQL databases and data management

    

Windows-based applications and distributed systems

    

Software architecture and design for scalable, maintainable, and secure solutions

    

Reusable software components and shared platform capabilities

    

AI-assisted development tools to explore solutions, automate repetitive tasks, accelerate learning, and improve productivity

You will collaborate with experienced engineers, architects, product teams, and other stakeholders — and have the opportunity to influence solutions that benefit multiple teams and products.

About you

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and finding better ways to build software. You are curious, take ownership, and thrive in a collaborative environment where knowledge sharing and continuous improvement are part of everyday work.

We expect you to have:

    

A Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

    

Strong experience with C# and .NET

    

Solid knowledge of SQL

    

Experience with Windows applications and distributed systems

    

A good understanding of software architecture and design principles

    

Experience with AI-assisted software development

Most importantly, you are eager to learn, explore new technologies, and turn ideas into reliable, practical solutions.

Why CellaVision?

At CellaVision, software isn't just software. Our products are part of modern medical diagnostics, and the quality, reliability, and security of what we build genuinely matter.

You will join an international medical technology company where you can combine technical challenges, modern development practices, and meaningful impact — while helping shape how software engineering is done across the organization.

Join us!

This is a full-time position based at CellaVision HQ in Lund, Sweden, in our modern offices with excellent infrastructure and commuting options. We are looking to fill the position as soon as possible.

Ready to build software that makes a difference? We'd love to hear from you!

Si vous cherchez un environnement de travail sain, stable et humain, vous êtes au bon endroit.Côté localisation, l'entreprise est implantée à Differdange, à quelques minutes seulement de la frontier/ière française. Un emplacement idéal pour les frontaliers qui souhaitent profiter d'un meilleur équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle, sans subir les longues heures de trajet qui vont souvent de pair avec un poste au cœur de Luxembourg-Ville.L'activité principale de la société repose sur l'achat et la revente de marchandises. Les équipes sont entier/ièrement francophones, ce qui facilite l'intégration et le quotidien, tout en évoluant dans un contexte international enrichissant. Vos responsabilités / Responsable Financier - Société Commerciale - Luxembourg Vous prendrez en charge le management d'une équipe de 4 personnes. Votre rôle sera d'organiser le travail, de faire monter les collaborateurs en compétences et de créer une dynamique d'équipe positive au quotidien.Vous serez un acteur clé dans l'amélioration des processus internes. Concrètement, cela passe par l'identification des axes d'optimisation et la mise en place d'outils de gestion adaptés aux besoins de la structure.Vous aurez la responsabilité de produire un reporting financier clair et structuré à destination d'actionnaires internationaux. Vous devrez être capable de vulgariser et de présenter les chiffres de manier/ière lisible dans un environnement multiculturel.Vous assurerez un suivi rigoureux des coûts, des budgets et des indicateurs de performance financier/ière. La fiabilité de la donnée sera au cœur de vos priorités. Profil et parcours / Responsable Financier - Société Commerciale - Luxembourg Vous avez minimum 8 ans d'expérience en contrôle de gestion ou en audit externe, acquise au sein d'une entreprise basée au Luxembourg. Cette connaissance du tissu économique local est indispensable pour ce poste.Vous êtes parfaitement à l'aise en français et en anglais, et vous avez un niveau correct en allemand. Si vous parlez luxembourgeois, c'est clairement un plus qui fera la différence.Vous n'avez pas peur de mettre les mains dans le cambouis. Manager une petite équipe, oui, mais sans pour autant vous déconnecter du terrain et de l'opérationnel. C'est justement ce double rôle qui rend ce poste intéressant.Vous ne cherchez pas un tremplin de 2 ans. Vous avez envie de vous investir sur la durée, de construire quelque chose et de grandir avec une entreprise qui a de vraies perspectives. Offre & avantages / Responsable Financier - Société Commerciale - Luxembourg Une rémunération pouvant aller jusqu'à  € brut annuel, accompagnée de chèques-repas pour le quotidien et d'un bonus annuel venant récompenser votre implication et vos résultats.Un poste qui combine management et opérationnel, idéal pour quelqu'un qui aime avoir de la variété dans ses missions et ne pas se retrouver enfermé dans un rôle purement stratégique.Une ambiance de travail agréable, des équipes stables et une culture d'entreprise familiale où les gens se connaissent vraiment. Pas de turn-over excessif, pas d'open space impersonnel - juste un endroit où il fait bon travailler.Des avantages financiers concrets : cadeaux offerts à l'ensemble des collaborateurs tout au long de l'année, et une opportunité rare de pouvoir investir directement dans la société si vous le souhaitez. jobs.title: Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP (H/F)
jobs.description: Harry Hope, cabinet de recrutement accompagne candidats et entreprises dans leurs recherches des meilleures opportunités en France et à l'international. Afin de mieux répondre à vos enjeux, tous nos consultants sont spécialisés par secteur d'activité et zone géographique. POSTE Notre client est un acteur reconnu au Luxembourg dans le domaine des solutions SAP et de la transformation digitale. Il accompagne des entreprises de toutes tailles dans la mise en oeuvre, l'évolution et l'optimisation de leurs systèmes d'information SAP. Dans le cadre du développement de son activité et de la conduite de projets stratégiques, notre client recherche un(e) Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP afin de piloter des projets à forte valeur ajoutée et d'assurer la satisfaction de ses clients. Vous rejoindrez une équipe d'experts passionnés et évoluerez dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et international. Vos missions En tant que Delivery Manager / IT Project Manager SAP, vous serez responsable du pilotage de projets SAP, depuis leur lancement jusqu'à leur mise en production. Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivant/antes : Piloter des projets SAP (implémentation, migration, montée de version et évolution) dans le respect des délais, des coûts et des exigences qualité ; Assurer la coordination des équipes techniques, fonctionnelles et des différents partenaires du projet ; Être l'interlocuteur privilégié des clients tout au long du cycle de vie des projets ; Recueillir, analyser et challenger les besoins métiers afin de proposer des solutions adaptées ; Définir la gouvernance des projets, les plannings, les priorités et les indicateurs de suivi ; Identifier les risques, mettre en place les plans d'actions nécessaires et assurer leur suivi ; Garantir la qualité des livrables et le respect des engagements contractuels ; Superviser les phases de conception, développement, tests, recette, déploiement et accompagnement au changement ; Assurer le reporting auprès de la Direction et des parties prenant/antes ; Participer au développement de la relation client et identifier de nouvelles opportunités d'accompagnement. PROFIL Profil recherché Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en informatique, ingénierie ou gestion de projet, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative dans la gestion de projets SAP. Compétences indispensables : Expérience confirmée en gestion de projets SAP ; Excellente connaissance de l'écosystème SAP (SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA ou solutions SAP) ; Maîtrise des méthodologies de gestion de projet (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall ou SAP Activate) ; Expérience dans la coordination d'équipes multidisciplinaires ; Bonne compréhension des processus métiers et des environnements ERP ; Excellentes capacités de communication et de gestion de la relation client. Compétences appréciées : Expérience sur des projets de migration vers SAP S/4HANA ; Connaissance de SAP BTP, SAP Fiori ou des solutions Cloud SAP ; Expérience dans des environnements internationaux ; Connaissance des bonnes pratiques ITIL ou des processus de Delivery Management. Certifications Les certifications suivant/antes constituent un réel atout : SAP Activate Project Manager ; Certifications SAP (S/4HANA ou solutions SAP) ; PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP ou certification Agile/Scrum. Langues Anglais professionnel obligatoire ; La maîtrise de l'allemand constitue un réel atout ; Le français est indispensable.

La pratique du luxembourgeois constitue un atout ; Bonnes connaissances de la législation et de la réglementation du secteur financier ; Esprit critique, excellentes capacités rédactionnelles, d'analyse et de synthèse ; Rigueur, discrétion et sens de l'organisation ; Esprit d'équipe tout en ayant des capacités de travailler en autonomie. jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.description:
Máte skúsenosti s prácou s klientom alebo predajom a chcete v tom napredovať? Alebo ste ešte finančné poradenstvo neskúsili? Podporíme Vaše schopnosti a zručnosti a pomôžeme Vám zlepšiť svoj finančný rozhľad a predajné aktivity. Dáme Vám príležitosť stať sa regionálnym obchodným zástupcom. Vaše pracovné úlohy na uvedenej pracovnej pozícii budú: Aktívne vyhľadávanie klientov a následná starostlivosť o nich. Poistné poradenstvo a vypracovávanie návrhov na poistenie podľa potrieb klienta. Príprava, uzatváranie poistných zmlúv životného a neživotného poistenia v príslušnom regióne obchodného miesta. Starostlivosť o zverené klientske portfólio. Sprostredkovanie predaja vybraných bankových produktov.
Výhody:Stabilná a zaujímavá práca v najsilnejšej poisťovacej skupine na Slovensku Vienna Insurance Group. 6-mesačný program podpory nových regionálnych obchodných zástupcov s garanciou minimálneho príjmu a provízie bez obmedzenia. Systém vzdelávania, odborných školení a tréningov. Flexibilný pracovný čas. Príspevok na DDS III. pilier. Finančné odmeny pri pracovnom a životnom jubileu. Ak Vás ponuka zaujala, pošlite nám Váš štruktúrovaný životopis. Kontaktovať budeme len vybraných uchádzačov, ktorí spĺňajú požiadavky danej pozície.
