jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

Configure and provision switches, routers, and other network equipment.

At least two years of experience in network engineering, network provisioning, technical support, telecommunications, or data-centre operations.

Basic understanding of dynamic routing protocols, particularly BGP and OSPF.
Experience configuring network equipment through a command-line interface.
Ability to perform network diagnostics and resolve common connectivity and configuration issues.
Understanding of network redundancy and high-availability principles.
Experience preparing clear technical instructions or change requests.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow technical procedures accurately.
Ability to manage several requests and coordinate tasks with multiple teams.
Good analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Written and spoken English at Intermediate level or higher.

Nice to have
Experience with Juniper, Brocade, Extreme Networks, or Nokia equipment.
Knowledge of EVPN, VXLAN, or MPLS technologies.
Previous experience with hosting, IaaS, telecommunications, or data-centre networks.
Familiarity with network monitoring, IPAM, inventory, or configuration-management systems.
Basic experience with Python, Ansible, APIs, Git, or other network-automation tools.
Relevant certifications from networking hardware or software vendors.

Odborná způsobilost a požadavky: široké provozní zkušenosti s IP platformami (Cisco, Arista), mobilními daty a přenosovými technologiemi (fiber, xWDM) včetně dodavatelů jako Infinera a Ciena, prokazatelné technické know-how a dovednosti v oblasti odstraňování závad příslušných platforem (např. xWDM, TCP/IP, MPLS, BGP, QoS), úroveň výkonného uživatele operačních systémů Windows/Linux Server/Client, zkušenost s prací NOC nebo technické podpoře v mezinárodním telekomunikačním prostředí, zájem o softwarové nástroje a účast na iniciativách souvisejících s IT, plynulá angličtina na profesionální úrovni. Klíčová rozhraní: síťová rozhraní, včetně řízení závažných incident a výpadků, rozhraní pro zákazníky, s odpovědností za řešení incidentů souvisejících se službami, úzká spolupráce s ostatními provozními týmy. Téměř veškerá činnost je prováděna v anglickém jazyce.
Network Engineer is the key role in relation to Arelion clients and NOC base, performing defined tasks in fiber backbones network monitoring and escalation management at the workplace with uninterrupted service (24/7) in a shift working mode, including phase of comprehensive client support. Specific area of expertise, requirements: Solid operational experience with IP platforms (Cisco, Arista), Mobile Data, and Transmission technologies (fiber, xWDM) including vendors such as Infinera and Ciena Documented technical knowhow and skills in terms of troubleshooting per relevant platform (e.g. xWDM, TCP/IP, MPLS, BGP, QoS,) Power user experience on Windows/Linux Server/Client operating systems, Experience working in a NOC or technical support function within an international telecom environment, Interest in software tools and participation in IT-related initiatives, Fluent professional English. Key Interfaces: Network-facing, including major incident and outage management, Customer-facing, with responsibility for service-specific incident handling, Close collaboration with other operational teams. Almost all activities are done in English.

jobs.title: Stage - Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F)
jobs.description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) futur(e) Data Scientist / Data Analyst (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes à l’occasion d’un stage de 6 mois de fin d’études de M2 à partir de mars 2027. Ce stage est basé à Paris (75). 

Intégré(e) au sein du pôle E-commerce et rattaché(e) au Lead Data Science & Analytics, vous accompagnerez l’équipe dans les sujets du quotidien ainsi que dans la construction de projets dédiés. Vous serez amené(e)s à travailler sur les sujets suivants :

Data Analyse

Vous serez un(e) membre à part entière de l'équipe Data Science & Analytics et participerez activement à son quotidien :

  • Analyses Ad Hoc : Vous mènerez diverses analyses ponctuelles indispensables pour affiner notre compréhension de nos marques, de la performance de nos produits et du comportement de nos client(e)s.
  • Excellence Opérationnelle : Vous contribuerez au développement continu de l'équipe en identifiant les points de friction, en structurant de nouveaux process et en automatisant les tâches récurrentes.
  • Reporting & Communication Métiers: Vous prendrez la responsabilité de plusieurs mises à jour de reportings. Vous serez responsable du maintien de dashboards hebdomadaires, de reportings mensuels, et de l'initiation des communications clés à destination des équipes métiers.
  • Accompagnement Marketing : Vous participerez aux opérations courantes en réalisant des extractions de données ciblées pour nos initiatives marketing. Cela inclut la mise en place de groupes de contrôle rigoureux et la mesure de la performance incrémentale de ces campagnes.
  • Intégration de l'IA : Vous serez amené(e) à utiliser l'IA au quotidien dans vos missions et participerez activement à la définition et au partage des bonnes pratiques quant à son utilisation au sein de l'équipe.


Mise en place d’un moteur d'Embeddings Produits (NLP) : Vous serez au cœur du développement d’un socle algorithmique clé : la transformation de descriptions textuelles en représentations vectorielles (embeddings). Ce projet nourrira de multiples initiatives futures.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie du projet :

  • Data Preprocessing : Nettoyage des données textuelles issues du catalogue, normalisation, et préparation des corpus d'entraînement.
  • Modélisation : Benchmark, sélection fine-tuning des modèles appropriés (Sentence-Transformers, LLMs, etc.).
  • Industrialisation : Le stage ne s’arrête pas au prototype expérimental. Vous participerez activement au déploiement du pipeline dans notre environnement de production via Metaflow.
  • Monitoring : Mise en place de l'automatisation pour la mise à jour des vecteurs lors des nouvelles collections et monitoring de la qualité des embeddings dans le temps.

Requirements

  • Vous êtes étudiant(e) en dernière année de formation supérieure (BAC+5) avec une spécialité en Data Science / Machine Learning.
  • Une maîtrise suffisante de SQL est essentielle.
  • Des connaissances en Python seront valorisées.
  • Compréhension des algorithmes de Machine Learning et un fort intérêt pour le NLP.
  • Sensible aux problématiques business : vous êtes animé(e) par l’envie de comprendre nos clients, nos produits et nos process pour générer de l'impact.
  • Compétences en visualisation de données pour restituer vos analyses de manière claire.
  • Vous êtes rigoureux(se), structuré(e) et avez un fort esprit d'équipe.
  • Force de proposition : vous aimez évoluer dans un environnement où il reste des choses à construire.


Ce que ce stage vous apportera :

  • Une montée en compétences technique pointue en Python et SQL.
  • L’opportunité de travailler sur une stack data moderne et robuste (AWS, Redshift, Metaflow, Git, etc.).
  • Le passage de la théorie à la pratique : vous verrez votre code et vos modèles partir en production.
  • L’affinage de votre sens métier et de votre esprit critique au contact d'équipes variées (Tech, E-commerce, CRM, Marketing).

Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles.

As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how Premium Support adapts to new products, new customer expectations, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and driving clarity for your team.

 - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

 - Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication.

 - Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents.

 - Analyse recurring issues and identify process and documentation improvements to reduce time-to-resolution

 - Build and update internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

 - Experience managing and delivering against operational SLAs for enterprise accounts

 - Strong hands-on debugging experience with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages, including the ability to read and reason through an unfamiliar codebase.

 - Working knowledge of APIs, databases, and Git-based CI/CD workflows.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.



NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.).

WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

jobs.title: Graduate program | French market (Paris)
jobs.description:
Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Quand un utilisateur pose une question, le système la décompose en sous-questions précises, puis déploie des agents spécialisés qui explorent en parallèle codes, jurisprudence, doctrine et textes européens. Chaque document est analysé en profondeur, les liens implicites entre principes juridiques sont identifiés, et le tout est synthétisé dans un rapport structuré où chaque affirmation est sourcée. Ce qui prenait une semaine à une équipe entière se fait pendant une pause café.

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, et redonner aux avocats et aux directions juridiques le temps de se concentrer sur ce qui compte.

Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale française, et vous en serez l'un des tout premiers membres.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : la démo fait le travail. Vos prospects voient la différence en une session, pas après six mois de POC.

  • Un marché en forte demande : tous les cabinets français cherchent une réponse à l'IA, et les usages ne sont pas encore stabilisés.

  • Une équipe qui se construit : vous entrez tôt et vous pesez sur la façon dont on vend.

  • Une vraie école de vente : un parcours structuré, du coaching hebdomadaire et des objectifs clairs à chaque étape.

Vos responsabilités

Pour soutenir notre croissance, nous lançons un Graduate Program – Sales conçu pour les 3 % de jeunes talents les plus ambitieux.

Ce n'est pas un poste junior classique. C'est un parcours accéléré, avec des rotations structurées et un objectif clair : faire de vous un Account Executive performant en 18 mois, avec le soutien de la Lexroom Sales Academy.

Vous passerez par quatre rôles consécutifs, chacun avec ses objectifs, son coaching et ses KPI :

3 à 6 mois – SDR (Sales Development Representative)

  • Qualifier les leads inbound.

  • Apprendre les bases de la discovery, la qualification d'opportunités et le passage de relais à l'AE.

6 mois – BDR (Business Development Representative)

  • Apprendre à générer du pipeline à partir de zéro.

  • Maîtriser la prospection, les séquences outbound, le premier contact et la prise de rendez-vous.

Le point de bascule

Après vos neuf premiers mois, en fonction de vos performances, de vos points forts et des compétences acquises, vous rejoindrez l'une des deux trajectoires suivantes :

6 mois – AE Inbound

  • Gérer les deals inbound sur notre segment juridique.

  • Mener les calls de discovery et les démos, traiter les objections et closer vos premiers clients.

  • Travailler main dans la main avec les AE seniors, le Sales Coach et le Sales Director sur des deals en cours et sur la stratégie.

6 mois – AE Outbound

  • Prendre la responsabilité d'un territoire.

  • Piloter des deals outbound de bout en bout, avec plusieurs interlocuteurs et des cycles plus longs.

  • Contribuer à améliorer les scripts, les séquences et les playbooks au fil de vos apprentissages.

Tout au long du programme, vous serez formé et coaché au sein de la Lexroom Sales Academy, avec des modules structurés sur :

  • la méthodologie de vente (discovery, démo, négociation, traitement des objections) ;

  • la gestion du pipeline et du territoire ;

  • l'usage de l'IA dans la vente ;

  • la performance personnelle, le mindset et la communication.

Les meilleurs profils seront fast-trackés vers des rôles mid-market, enterprise ou managériaux.

Le profil que nous cherchons

  • Jeune diplômé (ou jusqu'à 1 an d'expérience) avec un vrai intérêt pour la vente B2B et la tech / l'IA.

  • Vous avez toujours été parmi les meilleurs dans ce que vous avez fait : études, sport, projets, travail.

  • Excellentes qualités de communication, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Français langue maternelle (ou C1+), anglais courant (B2 minimum, pour travailler avec les équipes transverses).

  • Drive et résilience : les objectifs ambitieux vous motivent et le "non" ne vous fait pas peur.

  • Vous apprenez vite, vous posez les questions qui dérangent et vous allez chercher le feedback.

  • Vous voulez des responsabilités tôt, pas une ligne "programme graduate" sur votre CV.

Ce que nous offrons

  • 45 000 55 000 € OTE, variable non plafonné et accéléré.

  • Equity : un package de stock-options.

  • 3 jours d'onboarding en présentiel à Milan, entièrement pris en charge.

  • Mutuelle d'entreprise (Alan) : prise en charge à 60 % par l'employeur.

  • Titres-restaurant (Swile) : 12 € par jour (pris en charge à 60 % par l'employeur).

  • Pass Navigo : pris en charge à 50 % par l'employeur.

  • Wellpass : abonnement sport & bien-être (cofinancé par l'employeur).

  • Programme Erasmus : 1 semaine par an, vol et logement pris en charge, pour travailler depuis nos bureaux de Madrid, Barcelone, Milan, Rome, Berlin ou Sofia.

  • Modèle hybride : entre le télétravail et notre bureau parisien.

Le process

  • Entretien Talent Acquisition : motivation et parcours.

  • Entretien commercial : potentiel et sens commercial.

  • Mise en situation : approche et résilience.

  • Entretien final : valeurs et culture.

  • Offre.

Chez Lexroom, nous sommes portés par des ambitions fortes et une exigence d'excellence. Nous construisons quelque chose de grand, et cela demande de l'engagement, du travail et une vraie envie de progresser. Si ce défi vous parle, nous serons ravis de recevoir votre candidature.

Compensation: €45K – €55K

jobs.description:
At Lexroom, we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust.

In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by thousands of legal professionals across Europe.

Our mission is clear: make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable, giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.

We’re growing fast, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team committed to rigor, clarity, and impact.

Today, Lexroom is a trusted partner, shaping the evolution of legal AI with the same rigor and precision that define our product.

Join us as Customer Success Manager to build Lexroom's customer base from the ground up.

You will be the first dedicated CS hire for the French market, owning the full portfolio of French customers end to end. The product already won in Italy, with the numbers to prove it. France is next, and you own it.

Your key responsibilities

  • Own the full French customer portfolio from handover to renewal, with a clear goal: keep every customer (retention first) and grow each account through proactive upsell and uplift.

  • Run a proactive, commercial CS motion. You do not wait for customers to call. You call them, spot the opportunity in every conversation, and bring it home.

  • Be the single point of contact for French customers, from onboarding and product expertise to support requests, gathering feedback and feeding it back to Product and Marketing.

  • Adapt the Italian playbook to France, importing what works and localizing it for the French market.

  • Own your numbers: build dashboards, monitor KPIs, and report on the health and growth of your portfolio.

What we're looking for

  • 2 to 4 years in Customer Success or account management, ideally at a SaaS, tech, or software company. Exposure to legal or professional-services customers is a plus.

  • A commercial mindset. You see every customer touch as a chance to add value and expand the account. Direct sales experience is a plus, not a requirement.

  • CRM fluency. Experience working a portfolio in a CRM; HubSpot is a plus.

  • Comfort building in a fast-moving market and staying hands-on, including operational support, while the market scales.

  • Languages: native-level French and fluent English are required.

How we work

Lexroom is building the platform where legal work gets done. Founded in Milan in 2023, we are the legal AI built data-first for civil-law Europe: a proprietary base of 7M+ verified legal sources, used today by 12,000+ law firms and in-house legal teams. We recently closed a USD 50M Series B led by Left Lane Capital, with investors including Base10 Partners and Eurazeo, bringing total funding to over USD 73M, to expand across Europe starting with Spain, Germany and France.

We move fast and accurate, own outcomes, and say what we mean. Impact is defined by execution, not by title.

What Sets Us Apart

An Exceptional Team. At Lexroom, you'll work alongside top talent in tech and legal AI. Our focused teams operate with purpose and autonomy, so every contribution delivers visible results. You'll collaborate with people who pair innovation with rigor, curiosity with discipline, ambition with depth.

Growth that Matters. We hire exceptional people to make a difference—and we give them space to lead. Your work will shape the future of legal technology and set new standards for the field. Impact is defined by vision and execution, not by age or title. If you're ready to take responsibility, you'll find real opportunities to grow and lead high-stakes projects.

Rewarding Your Contribution. We value excellence and share success:

  • Annual Salary Range: €48.000–58.000

  • Equity Package: align your growth with the company's long-term success.

Benefits That Matter

  • 3 days onboarding in presence in Milan, fully paid

  • Mutuelle d'entreprise (Alan): employer-funded at 60%

  • Meal vouchers (Swile): €12 per day (employer-funded at 60%)

  • Navigo pass: employer-funded at 50%

  • Wellpass: sport & wellness benefit (employer co-financed)

  • Erasmus Program: 1 week / year, flight and accommodation paid, to work from our Madrid, Barcelona, Milan, Rome, Berlin or Sofia offices

Hiring process and timeline

  1. Intro call with our Talent team: motivations, fit, and the essentials

  2. Interview with the Team Manager: your experience and potential for the role

  3. Interview with the CSM Team: get to know each other and discuss upcoming challenges together

  4. Final step:

    • Meet the Global Head of Customer Success to get to know each other and discuss Lexroom values

    • Practical exercise: a real customer scenario you prepare in advance, then a live call simulation with the Team Manager and the French Team

At Lexroom, ambition meets discipline and purpose.

We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) !

Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé.

🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions.

💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant(e), vous êtes au cœur des missions de recherche et d’innovation du Centre Ingénierie et Santé. Vous rejoignez l’équipe i4S pour développer les fondements scientifiques d’une nouvelle génération de jumeaux numériques populationnels (JNP) en santé, en lien étroit avec la société Dali.

Le Centre Ingénierie et Santé développe des recherches à l’interface entre ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique et santé. Ses travaux associent modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle et sciences des données pour répondre à des problématiques cliniques, organisationnelles et populationnelles en collaboration avec des acteurs académiques, hospitaliers et industriels.

Dali (Decision Aid · Live Innovation) est un bureau d’études innovant spécialisé dans la modélisation, la simulation et l’intelligence artificielle appliquées au système de santé. Son ambition est de transformer le système de soins grâce à une ingénierie de pointe basée sur des données : création de jumeaux numériques, modélisation prédictive, optimisation de parcours patients, modélisation de services hospitaliers et amélioration des performances des organisations de santé. Dali a été co-créée début 2025 par Martin PRODEL (PhD, 12 ans d’expérience en données de santé, ex-Heva) et Vincent Augusto (PhD, HDR, Pr, 20 d’expérience en ingénierie de la santé et recherche, Mines Saint-Etienne). 

Objectif stratégique : préparer les briques scientifiques des JNP à horizon 3 à 5 ans, au-delà des premiers démonstrateurs industriels déjà engagés.

 

Le post-doctorat doit permettre de lever des verrous en modélisation dynamique de cohortes, génération de patients virtuels, apprentissage des transitions et simulation de scénarios contrefactuels.

 

Vos missions principales :

  • Vous concevez et formalisez des modèles mathématiques et stochastiques de trajectoires de patients : chaînes de Markov, modèles multi-états, modèles d’état, processus de décision markoviens, simulation Monte-Carlo et approches hybrides.

  • Vous développez en Python des prototypes de JNP capables d’apprendre leurs paramètres à partir de données réelles, de générer des trajectoires virtuelles et de tester des scénarios thérapeutiques ou de prise en charge.

  • Vous proposez des méthodes de calibration, d’estimation, d’optimisation, de quantification de l’incertitude et de validation des modèles ; vous comparez les approches sur des cas d’usage issus de cohortes, registres ou données de vie réelle.

  • Vous contribuez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux (publications, conférences, logiciels), à la formalisation des briques transférables vers DALI et vous rendez compte de l’avancement au responsable scientifique du projet.

 

Votre capacité à passer d’un problème scientifique à un modèle formel puis à une implémentation robuste sera essentielle. Le poste demande un goût prononcé pour les mathématiques appliquées, l’algorithmique, la programmation scientifique et la recherche interdisciplinaire.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes impérativement titulaire d’un :

  • Doctorat (Bac + 8) en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, automatique, recherche opérationnelle, génie industriel, data science quantitative ou domaine proche.

Profil scientifique recherché :

  • Solide formation en probabilités, statistiques, processus stochastiques, optimisation, modélisation et simulation, et/ou systèmes dynamiques.

  • Appétence pour le domaine de la santé.

Compétences attendues :

  • Maîtrise avancée de Python scientifique (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn ou équivalents) et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel, versionnement et reproductibilité.

  • Expérience significative d’au moins une famille de modèles dynamiques : Markov / MDP, modèles multi-états, Monte-Carlo, équations différentielles, modèles d’état ou simulation multi-agents / à événements discrets.

  • Capacité à articuler modèles mathématiques et données : estimation de paramètres, calibration, analyse de sensibilité, validation, quantification de l’incertitude.

  • Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié) ; capacité à rédiger des articles et à présenter des travaux dans un contexte international.

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

  • Expérience sur données longitudinales, données de santé, cohortes, essais cliniques ou données de vie réelle.

  • Connaissance d’un environnement de simulation (AnyLogic, SimPy, MATLAB/Simulink ou équivalent) et/ou d’un langage compilé (C++, Java).

  • Expérience de publication dans des revues ou conférences en modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle ou santé numérique.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

· Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

jobs.title: Sr. Learning Experience Lead, Onboarding & Enablement
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is building a modern, AI-native learning function, and we're looking for a Sr. Learning Experience Lead to own it. You'll own our learning platform and the onboarding and enablement experiences that run on it: designing them, delivering them, turning them into durable on-demand learning, and proving they work. This is a builder-leader role. You'll design learning, facilitate it live, build it into the platform, and measure its impact, and you'll do much of that hands-on, in the tools, the way a modern builder works.

 

You'll start close to home and grow the mandate. Your initial focus is owning the onboarding experience for our Support organization, taking it end-to-end and turning it into a real, tracked, repeatable system. Over time, you'll elevate onboarding and enablement beyond Support to the broader company, partnering with our People team, with the learning platform as the vehicle.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the learning platform. As its DRI, you own the roadmap, the learning journeys, and the instructional design behind them. You make the calls and own the outcomes.

 - Support onboarding, end-to-end. Facilitation, the live-to-on-demand pipeline, and the role-based journeys that get new team members confident and productive fast.

 - Create content and learning plans. Prescriptive learning paths and the content that fills them.

 - Own measurement criteria and data-driven results: The layer that proves onboarding and enablement change behavior and speed ramp, not just completion rates, with the tracking and feedback loops that keep it healthy over time. As the mandate grows.

 - Grow the platform and the learning function as adoption expands, raising the bar for how people learn at Replit.

 


REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Deep L&D / learning-experience expertise. You've designed and run learning programs, not just authored content, and owned outcomes whose impact was visible across an org.

 - A builder. You turn ideas into working things with modern tools (you've built learning apps, LMS experiences, or similar yourself) and you'd rather ship and iterate than wait for a perfect spec.

 - A track record of leading multi-person, cross-functional efforts. You've stood up onboarding, cohort programs, or learning paths from scratch. You think about end-to-end experiences and create learning journeys that people actually use and love.

 - Facilitation chops. You can run the room live and convert what happens there into durable, on-demand content.

 - A measurement instinct. Pre/post, behavior change, co-designing metrics with the leaders and ICs who live with them; a healthy skepticism of vanity surveys.

 - Someone who quickly masters new domains and is comfortable with ambiguity on a small, fast, generative team where everyone builds.

 


BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Hands-on with AI-native build tools (Replit) or modern no-/low-code app builders.

 - Micro-learning and cohort-based program design; an experiment-and-report-back philosophy.

 - Experience extending learning experiences across an org.

 - Coaching or manager-development background.



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.title: responsabile di deposito
jobs.description: Per Cliente leader nel suo settore di riferimento, siamo alla ricerca di un* RESPONSABILE LOGISTICA. La risorsa, riportando alla Direzione, dovrà: Coordinare un gruppo di circa 10 persone fornendo supporto e supervisione per garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Collaborare con altri dipartimenti, come Produzione e Pianificazione, per coordinare la consegna dei materiali ai reparti di produzione e di assemblaggio. Gestire e supervisionare tutte le operazioni logistiche, garantendo l'efficienza e l'accuratezza delle attività di stoccaggio, movimentazione e trasferimento dei materiali. Assicurare il corretto ricevimento dei materiali in entrata, effettuando controlli di corrispondenza merce e quantità, garantendo l'integrità delle merci durante il processo di immagazzinamento. Ottimizzare i flussi di trasferimento dei materiali tra i due siti produttivi, definendo le opportune regole di gestione che possano correttamente bilanciare le esigenze di disponibilità dei materiali nelle aree produttive con la frequenza dei navettaggi. Supervisionare la gestione degli inventari, eseguendo controlli regolari per garantire l'accuratezza dei dati e risolvere eventuali discrepanze o errori. Utilizzare software avanzati per la gestione del magazzino, come i magazzini verticali, al fine di migliorare l'efficienza e l'automazione delle operazioni. Raccogliere e analizzare in modo strutturato con l'ausilio delle metodologie e degli strumenti più avanzati i dati relativi ai flussi fisici nelle diverse aree aziendali (accettazione, stoccaggio, reparti e bordo linee) al fine di proporre azioni di ottimizzazione volte all'eliminazione di eventuali attività a non valore aggiunto e alla riduzione di eventuali sprechi. Mappare e analizzare i flussi informativi a livello di sistema gestionale (ERP) e sistemi dipartimentali (WMS/magazzini automatici) con l'obiettivo di individuare possibili miglioramenti che rendano più completi e veloci i trasferimenti delle informazioni. Monitorare e garantire il rispetto delle normative sulla sicurezza e sulle pratiche di lavoro corrette nel magazzino. Gestire la manutenzione delle attrezzature e degli impianti del magazzino, compresi magazzini verticali e muletti. Coordinare le attività di manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, garantendo che le attrezzature siano in buone condizioni e che siano effettuate eventuali riparazioni o sostituzioni necessarie. REQUISITI Esperienza pregressa nella gestione di magazzini in realtà strutturate (meglio se operanti su commessa), preferibilmente caratterizzate dalla presenza di sistemi automatizzati (come magazzini verticali) e dall'utilizzo di software dipartimentali (tipo WMS - Warehouse Management Systems). Ottima capacità organizzativa per pianificare le attività logistiche e coordinare le risorse che a lui rispondono. Conoscenza delle best practice nella gestione del magazzino, inclusi processi di stoccaggio e movimentazione dei materiali. Leadership comprovata, con esperienza nella gestione di un team e nella delega di compiti. Capacità di analisi e problem-solving per identificare inefficienze, implementare soluzioni e migliorare i processi operativi. Familiarità con gli strumenti informatici utilizzati per l'analisi dei dati e capacità di elaborazione di report. Ottime competenze comunicative e capacità di collaborare con altri dipartimenti per garantire una gestione integrata delle operazioni. Familiarità con le normative sulla sicurezza e la salute sul lavoro relative alle attività di magazzino. RAL: 40-55K Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. Min. 26/11/04 Prot. n. 1101-SG), con un team di consulenti dedicati, si occupa della ricerca e selezione di risorse con esperienza, che hanno voglia di intraprendere nuovi percorsi professionali. I nostri consulenti ti aiuteranno a trovare la migliore opportunità lavorativa, grazie ad un'attenta analisi delle tue competenze e delle tue esperienze. Cerchiamo per azienda che progetta, realizza e mantiene in efficienza prodotti ad alto contenuto tecnico durante l'intero ciclo di vita, nel campo dei veicoli subacquei e dei sistemi subacquei una figura come Addetto/a Manutenzione. La risorsa sarà il punto di riferimento per il presidio, la gestione e la risoluzione delle problematiche manutentive ordinarie e straordinarie della sede aziendale, inclusi uffici, aree comuni e impianti. La figura garantirà il corretto funzionamento degli ambienti di lavoro e degli asset produttivi, intervenendo in autonomia sulle anomalie di primo livello e coordinando i fornitori esterni per gli interventi specialistici. Responsabilità principali - Eseguire ispezioni periodiche su uffici, aree comuni e impianti, individuando guasti, usure e non conformità e intervenire in autonomia su manutenzioni ordinarie e ripristini di primo livello. - Coordinare ditte esterne per interventi specialistici su impianti elettrici, idraulici, termoidraulici e di condizionamento - Presidiare e verificare lo stato delle attrezzature di cantiere e degli impianti tecnici di edificio - Supportare la manutenzione programmata nel rispetto delle disposizioni di sicurezza e delle scadenze normative - Effettuare piccoli lavori edili e di falegnameria, tra cui riparazioni murarie, ripristini di infissi, serrature e pavimentazioni - Gestire il magazzino ricambi e i materiali di consumo per la manutenzione, mantenendo aggiornate le registrazioni Requisiti essenziali - Diploma tecnico ad indirizzo meccanico, elettromeccanico, elettrotecnico o manutenzione industriale - Esperienza di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli analoghi, preferibilmente come manutentore di stabilimento - Competenze pratiche su impianti elettrici civili e industriali - Patentino o idoneità CEI 11-27 PES/PAV, oppure disponibilità a conseguirlo - Conoscenza delle principali norme di sicurezza sul lavoro (D.Lgs. 81/2008) - Capacità di lettura di manuali tecnici e schemi meccanici/idraulici in italiano; gradita la conoscenza della documentazione tecnica in inglese - Abilitazione o esperienza nella saldatura MIG/MAG o a cannello - Attitudine pratica al problem solving e alla diagnosi rapida dei guasti - Affidabilità, senso di responsabilità e disponibilità nella gestione delle urgenze - Metodo, ordine e capacità di prioritizzare più attività in parallelo - Attitudine alla collaborazione cross-funzionale con ufficio acquisti e fornitori - Proattività nella prevenzione e nell'individuazione precoce delle anomalie Condizioni economiche e benefit - Contratto a tempo indeterminato - CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria - Inquadramento livello D2 o C1 - RAL indicativa tra 26.000€ e 34.000€ - Orario full time: 40 ore settimanali dal lunedì al venerdì, 08:00-17:00 - Mensa aziendale gratuita - Welfare annuale - Premio di risultato aziendale - Luogo: Milano #LI-SD6 Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. jobs.title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
jobs.description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

jobs.title: Customer & Engagement Operations Coordinator (m/f)
jobs.description:
Customer & Engagement Operations Coordinator (F, M, X)

The Customer & Engagement Operations Coordinator will ensure success in implementing and monitoring customer and partner engagement processes. This includes ensuring proper monitoring of pipeline management, contract processing, invoicing accuracy, sales reporting and support marketing activities to enhance operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with experience in sales operations, CRM tools, and financial tracking. The candidate will work closely with the sales, partner, finance, and marketing teams to streamline LuxProvide's engagement cycle.

Your role consists in:

Key Responsibilities

Marketing support and execution:

• Ensure alignment between sales, partner and marketing, leveraging the execution of a B2B marketing strategy to generate brand awareness, customer engagement, and lead conversion.
• Support marketing team for industry events, conferences, and trade shows in HPC, Data Science, AI and Quantum.
• Support webinars, roundtables, and B2B networking events to showcase LuxProvide's capabilities and customer/partner success stories.
• Gather marketing KPIs, track performance metrics, and provide feedback to optimize marketing initiatives based on data-driven insights.

Engagement & Pipeline Management:

• Assist in maintaining and updating the sales pipeline, ensuring accuracy and timely follow-ups.
• Support the CCSO in sales forecasting by consolidating pipeline data and monitoring key metrics.
• Work closely with engagement and partner teams to track opportunities, ensuring leads are correctly recorded and progressing through the sales funnel.
• Identify process bottlenecks and propose improvements to enhance sales workflow efficiency.

Contract & Proposal Administration:

• Support invoicing processes by validating contract terms, and working with the finance team to generate invoices on time.
• Support customers regarding billing issues, and support the finance team in resolving disputes.

Sales Operations & Reporting:

• Develop sales reports and dashboards, providing insights on pipeline health, revenue performance, and customer contracts.
• Assist in preparing executive reports and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.

CRM & Process Optimization:

• Support the maintenance of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools, ensuring all data is up to date.
• Identify opportunities to improve sales efficiency, customer and partner experience through automation and process enhancements.

Required Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Sales Operations, or related fields.
• 3+ years of experience in sales, sales operations, or administrative role in a technology, SaaS, or IT services environment.
• Experience with CRM systems (odoo) and sales pipeline management.
• Strong knowledge of contract administration and invoicing in a B2B environment.
• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills with high attention to detail.
• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and generate insights.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and experience creating reports and dashboards.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams and with external customers.

Preferred Skills & Attributes:

• Knowledge of customer lifecycle management processes, tools and compliance tracking.
• Ability to work in fast-paced, dynamic environments, managing multiple priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French; additional European languages are a plus.

Why Join LuxProvide?

• Be a key enabler in the digital transformation journey of businesses and researchers, leveraging supercomputing and AI.
• Work in a high-tech environment with exposure to cutting-edge computing solutions.
• Collaborate with a diverse team of industry experts in HPC, AI, and cloud computing.
• Opportunity to contribute to streamlining sales operations and enhancing customer experience in a growing tech-driven organization.

jobs.title: Senior / Assistant Manager - Internal Audit (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior / Assistant Manager - Internal Audit

BDO Luxembourg is looking for a Senior / Assistant Manager in Internal Audit!

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing. At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships. With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees. Our core values, honesty, integrity, quality, respect and responsibility, define our culture. Hence, our People can expect to grow in a stimulating work environment that supports professional development and fosters inclusivity.

What will you do?

Participate actively in the realization of internal audit missions for a diversified client portfolio of the financial sector (Banks, PFS, Management Companies and Payment Institutions) under the supervision of your managers;
Identify, analyse and evaluate the internal control process in order to evaluate its relevance and efficiency;
Ensure mandates are performed in a correct manner and meet deadlines and requirements in accordance with the BDO and international/internal audit standards methodology.

This offer is for you if:

You have a Master's degree in economics, audit or controlling;
You at least 3 years of experience in Luxembourg in Internal Audit or External Audit of Banks, PFS, Management Companies or Payment Institutions;
You have been involved in risk management assignments;
You stay up to date in your knowledge of the Luxembourg and European regulatory environment applicable to financial institutions (CSSF regulations, CSSF circulars, AIFMD…);
You speak English fluently; French is considered a strong asset;

You are comfortable taking ownership of your work and, depending on your experience, coordinating assignments and supporting more junior colleagues.

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

Your mission

As a Project Manager, you will lead selected cross-functional projects from initiation through to successful delivery.

Working closely with teams across R&D, Production, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, IT and other key functions, you will ensure that projects are delivered in line with their technical, quality, cost and timing objectives.

Your role will be to provide structure, coordination and leadership throughout the project lifecycle while anticipating risks, solving complex issues and ensuring effective communication between all stakeholders.


Your key responsibilities

Project planning and organization

You will be responsible for structuring and organizing projects to ensure clear objectives and efficient execution:

    Set up and maintain project structures, including project timelines, team organization, budgets and resource planning

    Develop detailed project plans covering milestones, work plans, critical paths, risk management, cost and benefit analysis, staffing requirements and budgets

    Define, agree on and cascade project objectives to all relevant stakeholders

    Lead and coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure that everyone works towards common objectives

    Organize project meetings and key review sessions, including technical reviews and launch readiness reviews

    Assign and coordinate the activities required from the different functions involved in the project

    Monitor project progress and follow up on the completion of actions to ensure the project is delivered on time


Project coordination and prioritization

In a dynamic environment where multiple requests and priorities may arise simultaneously, you will play a key role in ensuring that project resources are focused on the right activities:

    Analyze, filter and prioritize incoming requests based on project priorities, business needs and available resources

    Ensure that the prioritization of customer requests is aligned and agreed upon with the Sales team

    Manage competing priorities and support teams in maintaining focus on the most critical activities

    Coordinate the different departments involved in the project, including Manufacturing, Purchasing, Engineering, Quality, Finance, IT and Sales

    Ensure alignment between project requirements, operational capabilities and available resources


Project performance and risk management

You will actively monitor project performance and identify potential risks before they impact project delivery:

    Systematically identify, assess and manage technical, financial, operational and project-related risks

    Develop and coordinate appropriate mitigation and corrective action plans

    Monitor project performance against customer and internal targets

    Ensure compliance with technical specifications, quality requirements, development budgets, cost objectives and project milestones

    Manage project cost calculations in collaboration with Purchasing, Production and Controlling

    Monitor project profitability and contribute to the achievement of internal financial objectives

    Identify and resolve issues and conflicts within the project team whenever possible

    Escalate critical issues to management when they cannot be resolved within the project team

    Make informed decisions based on technical, financial, quality and timing considerations


Customer and supplier coordination

You will contribute to ensuring efficient coordination with external stakeholders while working closely with the relevant internal teams:

    Support customer communication regarding project timing, project status, changes and key milestones

    Coordinate customer-related actions in close collaboration with the Sales department

    Help ensure that customer expectations and requirements are clearly communicated internally

    Support the preparation of customer communications using the appropriate language and format

    Follow up on supplier-related actions that may impact project timing, cost, quality or technical requirements

    Prepare and contribute to project reviews, progress reports and management updates

    Ensure that project documentation is complete, accurate and regularly updated

    Maintain project plans, action lists, risk assessments, meeting minutes and other key project records

    Record and distribute meeting minutes and ensure appropriate follow-up of agreed actions

    Use and maintain project management databases and centralized information systems to ensure reliable and consistent information

    Encourage the use of common project management tools and processes to maintain a single and reliable source of information

    Provide timely feedback on project team performance to the relevant functional managers when appropriate



Your profile

Education and technical background

    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical or Electromechanical Engineering, or an equivalent technical field

    A Master's degree would be considered an advantage

    Strong ability to understand, analyze and absorb technical information

    Knowledge of beverage systems would be a strong advantage

    Knowledge of valves and pressure regulators would also be highly appreciated


Professional experience

    At least 5 years of experience in project or program management

    Previous experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment

    Experience in sectors such as Medical, Automotive or Food & Beverage would be considered an advantage

    Proven experience managing complex and cross-functional projects

    Solid understanding of project management methodologies, tools and techniques

    Experience managing project budgets, costs and financial aspects would be an advantage


Technical and project management skills

    Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling and resource management

    Ability to develop and manage project timelines, milestones and critical paths

    Experience with risk management and problem-solving methodologies

    Ability to monitor project budgets, costs and profitability

    Strong ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and demanding environment

    Ability to filter and prioritize requests based on project and business priorities

    Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and MS Project

    Knowledge of financial management would be an advantage


Languages

    Fluent in English, both written and spoken

    French and/or German would be considered strong assets


Your professional strengths

    Strong leadership skills and the ability to motivate and engage cross-functional teams

    Excellent organizational and prioritization skills

    Ability to work independently while remaining aligned with project objectives

    Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

    Comfortable making decisions based on technical, financial, timing and quality considerations

    Excellent written and verbal communication skills

    Strong focus on quality and customer requirements

    Ability to manage conflicts constructively and bring stakeholders towards common objectives

    Results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

    Comfortable working in an international and multicultural environment

-Coordinate with Accounts Payable, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Group Accounting and local accounting providers.
-Analyse and account for complex, unusual or previously unresolved transactions.
-Prepare accounting position papers or technical memoranda when required.
-Support intercompany accounting, reconciliations and mismatch resolution.
-Investigate cash, bank-fee, foreign-exchange and transaction-flow discrepancies.
-Review historical balances and identify unsupported, unreconciled, duplicated or incorrectly classified items.
-Reconcile and remediate accounting data in SAP.
-Establish reliable opening balances and clear audit trails.
-Correct recurring posting, mapping and master-data issues.
-Help reinforce SAP as the primary accounting source of truth.
-Reconcile differences between the client's records and those maintained by local accounting providers.
-Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting evidence and accounting explanations.
-Respond directly and independently to external-auditor requests.
-Support statutory audits for European legal entities.
-Prepare or contribute to balance-sheet substantiation, going-concern assessments and other accounting papers.
-Maintain organised, complete and review-ready documentation.
-Document accounting procedures and month-end activities.
-Create or improve standard operating procedures, checklists and control evidence.
-Perform root-cause analysis of recurring accounting issues.
-Recommend and implement sustainable process improvements.
-Contribute to the development of the accounting control matrix.
-Use SAP and Excel for accounting operations, reconciliations and data analysis.
-Work effectively with large datasets and incomplete or imperfect source information.
-Identify accounting activities that can be standardised, simplified or automated.

Extrait de casier judiciaire exigé

Niveau d'étude demandé egal Master (Bac+5)

Demonstrate strong hands-on experience with month-end closing.
Demonstrate strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA (FI required; MM is a plus)
Have experience independently managing legal entities, material balance-sheet areas or accounting workstreams.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of accrual accounting, cut-off, reconciliations, intercompany accounting and financial controls.
Have experience investigating and resolving complex or historical accounting issues.
Have experience supporting statutory, group or external audits.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Corporate Security
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

 

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work. Protecting that trust starts with protecting the people who build Notion: our employees, their laptops, their identities, and the SaaS apps they rely on every day.



We are looking for a hands-on Corporate Security Engineer to own and improve the technical controls that keep our workforce and corporate environment safe. This is a security engineering role focused on building scalable controls and automation across identity, endpoints, SaaS, and workforce infrastructure, not a traditional IT support or corporate engineering role.



You'll own and evolve core security controls, design systems and automation that scale with the company, and help make security both stronger and easier to use. You'll partner closely with IT, Infrastructure, GRC, and Detection & Response to improve the security foundations that employees rely on every day.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Harden our identity and access management stack, including Okta and Google Workspace, with phishing-resistant MFA, strong SSO and SCIM lifecycles, and least-privilege access across SaaS.

 - Run our endpoint security program across a macOS-first fleet, including MDM, EDR, and configuration baselines, with working coverage for Windows and ChromeOS.

 - Secure AI tool usage at the endpoint, including governance of large language models, AI agents, and model context protocol (MCP) integrations; detect and prevent unauthorized or risky AI service access and data exfiltration through AI-enabled tools.

 - Reduce SaaS risk at scale through SSPM tooling and custom automation, including detection of risky OAuth grants, excessive permissions, shadow IT, and configuration drift.

 - Write code (Python, Terraform) to automate access reviews, onboarding and offboarding, configuration drift detection, and audit evidence collection.

 - Partner with Detection & Response to ensure corporate systems produce the telemetry needed to detect identity, endpoint, and SaaS abuse.

 - Support SOC 2, ISO 27001, and customer audits as a byproduct of good engineering, not a separate workstream.

 - Partner with Detection & Response on investigation and response for corporate security incidents, including phishing, account compromise, lost devices, and BEC.

 


SKILLS YOU NEED TO BRING:

 - Have 5+ years of hands-on experience in corporate security, enterprise security, or IT security engineering at a cloud-native company.

 - Have working knowledge of a major identity provider (Okta, Entra, or Google Workspace) and the underlying protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM).

 - Have hands-on experience operating endpoint management and detection tooling across macOS and enterprise environments.

 - Write production-quality scripts and automation in Python or Bash, and have shipped Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for security configuration.

 - Are familiar with SaaS security risks (OAuth governance, audit logging, SSPM) and the realities of integrating a long tail of vendors.

 - Have working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) at the security configuration level.

 - Communicate clearly in writing and work effectively across IT, Engineering, Legal, People, and GRC.

ZA PRIJEM UČITELJA/ICE RAZREDNE NASTAVE - 2 izvršitelja/ice na određeno, puno radno vrijeme (m/ž), 40 sati tjedno MJESTO RADA: Đačka 5, 10020 Zagreb UVJETI za zasnivanje radnog odnosa: • opći uvjeti sukladno općim propisima o radu • posebni uvjeti propisani Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22,156/23) i Pravilnikom o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN 6/19,75/20) Mjesto rada: Osnovna škola Odra, Đačka 5, 10020 Zagreb Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. U prijavi na natječaj kandidati navode osobne podatke: ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, kontakt broj telefona i e-mail adresa. Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Uz prijavu na natječaj kandidati su obvezni priložiti: • životopis • diplomu, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja • domovnicu, odnosno dokaz o državljanstvu • elektronički zapis o radno pravnom statusu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (ne starije od 8 dana) • uvjerenje da se protiv osobe ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (ne starije od 8 dana) Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave dostaviti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Rok za podnošenje prijave kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja, zaključno sa 11. rujna 2026. Kandidati koji se po posebnim propisima pozivaju na prednost pri zapošljavanju moraju prilikom prijave na natječaj dostaviti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju i dokaze koje posebni propisi propisuju pri ostvarivanju prava na prednost kod zapošljavanja te ostvaruju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate/kinje samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja navedeni su dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17). https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf Na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja navedeni su dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prednosti pri zapošljavanju temeljem Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21). popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju- Zakon o civilnim stradalnicima iz DR.pdf (gov.hr) Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete natječaja ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj. Lista kandidata koji ispunjavanju formalne uvjete i upućuju se na vrednovanje kao i vrijeme i mjesto održavanja vrednovanja bit će objavljeni na web stranici- https://www.os-odra.com/. Ukoliko ne pristupe vrednovanju, smatrat će se da su odustali od prijave na natječaj. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku od 15 dana od dana izbora. Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Škole i Hrvatskoga zavoda za zapošljavanje. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom dostaviti na adresu: Osnovna škola Odra, Đačka 5, 10020 Zagreb.
