jobs.title: Senior Innovation Consultant - EU Projects
jobs.description:
Job summary (Short promotional text)

We are looking for a Senior Consultant to strengthen our European Grants team in France.

You will advise innovative companies and organisations on European funding strategies and lead the development of complex grant applications for major R&D, industrial and innovation projects.

The role combines strategic consulting, project analysis, proposal writing and client management. We are looking for someone who can independently transform complex projects into compelling funding strategies and high quality European proposals.


Your mission (What are you going to do in text) summarised down below

Help ambitious organisations secure European funding for high impact innovation projects by combining strategic advice, technical understanding and excellent proposal development.


Your tasks 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead the development of complex European funding applications under programmes such as Horizon Europe, Innovation Fund, LIFE and CEF.
  • Assess R&D and innovation projects, identify the most appropriate funding opportunities and advise clients on funding strategy.
  • Structure compelling project narratives covering excellence, innovation, impact, implementation and European added value.
  • Interview senior client stakeholders, scientists, engineers and technical experts to extract and challenge the information required for successful proposals.


Your tasks 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Coordinate the complete proposal development process, including work plans, consortium inputs, budgets, deadlines and quality reviews.
  • Manage client relationships independently and act as a trusted advisor throughout the funding process.
  • Review and improve proposals prepared by other consultants and contribute to internal quality standards and methodologies.
  • Support the development of junior consultants and contribute to business development and the growth of PNO Innovation’s European Grants activities in France.


Your profile 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Master’s degree or PhD in a scientific, engineering, technical, economic or innovation related discipline.
  • Several years of relevant experience in European funding, innovation consulting, R&D project development or a closely related environment.
  • Proven experience with European funding programmes, ideally including Horizon Europe and/or other major programmes such as Innovation Fund, LIFE or CEF. Demonstrated experience writing or leading high quality grant proposals.
  • Excellent written and spoken French and English.


Your Profile 2nd part (In max 4 bullets)

  • Strong ability to understand complex scientific, technological and business concepts and turn them into persuasive narratives.
  • Strong client management, communication and project management skills.
  • Autonomous, rigorous and comfortable managing complex assignments under demanding deadlines.
  • Ability to mentor less experienced consultants and contribute to the development of the team.


Why us? (What do we offer) 1st part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Lead major European funding projects with innovative companies and organisations.
  • Work across technologies, sectors and European programmes rather than being limited to a single funding instrument.
  • Join one of Europe’s largest specialist innovation and funding consultancies.
  • Work with an international network of more than 600 colleagues and European funding specialists.


Why us? (What do we offer) 2nd part (in max 4 bullets)

  • Take ownership of client relationships and complex strategic assignments.
  • Contribute to developing junior consultants and strengthening our European Grants practice in France.
  • Benefit from clear opportunities for professional development and increasing responsibility.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package according to experience and seniority.

jobs.title: Responsable cellule « Open Banking » (F/H) h/f
jobs.description:
Notre activitéRejoignez un groupe de plus de 100 000 collaborateurs au cœur du développement de nos territoires et résolument tourné vers l'international ! En intégrant BPCE, vous intégrez une entreprise engagée au service du développement et de la coordination de toutes les enseignes du Groupe BPCE (Banque Populaire, Caisse d'Epargne, Crédit Coopératif, Casden, Natixis, Oney, Banque Palatine) afin de porter les ambitions du projet stratégique « Vision 2030 ». BPCE a créé le pôle Digital & Payments en 2021 pour réunir l'ensemble des métiers du digital avec l'ensemble des métiers des paiements du groupe. BPCE Digital & Payments aujourd'hui rassemble les services de paiement et du financement du commerce, le digital, l'IA et la data, l'open banking et l'innovation. Grâce aux 3200 collaborateurs travaillant au sein de marques renommées telles que Oney, BPCE Payment Services, Payplug et Xpollens, le pôle exerce une influence significative sur le marché français et européen. Il permet au groupe et à ses réseaux bancaires de s'appuyer sur des services de banque en ligne et des services de paiement aux meilleurs standards du marché. Pour plus d'informations n'hésitez pas à parcourir notre site : https://www.digital-payments.groupebpce.com/ Vos missions au sein de l'équipeLa direction Innovation & Open Banking du groupe BPCE a pour principales missions de piloter une veille marketing stratégique, d'impulser des transformations business en rupture et de gérer les relations avec les écosystèmes de partenaires innovants.

Les établissements du groupe BPCE sont soumis comme tous les teneurs de comptes aux exigences imposées par la Directive sur les Services de Paiement (DSP2) notamment en matière d'Open Banking. Ils mettent déjà à disposition des tiers régulés (Third Party Providers - TPPs) des interfaces API afin de fournir les services de paiement régulés : (1) d'Information sur les Comptes (AISP), d'Initiation de Paiement (PISP) et de Disponibilité des fonds (CBPII).

Depuis plusieurs années on constate une forte augmentation de l'usage de ce solutions Open Banking par les TPPs et les clients finaux qui se traduit également par une augmentation des sollicitations des tiers régulés (assistance, demandes, incidents, etc.).

A l'avenir, les exigences DSP2 sont amenées à se renforcer avec la publication à venir de la Réglementation sur les Services de Paiement (RSP) et au-delà du volet réglementaire le groupe BPCE s'est inscrit dans une démarche Open Finance business.
Compte tenu de ces enjeux réglementaires, business et de satisfaction client, le groupe BPCE fait évoluer son « dispositif Open » et souhaite renforcer la gestion de la relation entre les établissements du groupe et les TPPs ainsi que les activités transverses de coordination et de reportings.

Au sein de l'équipe « Innovation Produit et Ecosystèmes », le/la responsable de la Cellule « Open Banking » est le garant de la relation entre BPCE et les partenaires qui se connectent aux données et services du groupe BPCE aussi bien dans le cadre réglementaire (Directive sur les Services de Paiement 2 (DSP2), Règlement sur les services de paiement - RSP), que dans le cadre de relations d'affaires. Dans ce cadre, les principales missions du responsable de la Cellule Open Banking seront de :

- Piloter la relation avec nos partenaires tiers régulés (Third Party Providers - TPP) dans le cadre de la Directive sur les Services de Paiement 2 (DSP2)
- Coordonner les actions de support en lien avec les directions informatiques et digitales du groupe
- Coordonner l'instruction des incidents et demandes spécifiques et critiques
- Réaliser le reporting interne sur l'activité Open Banking
- Participer à l'évolution des dispositifs pour garantir une qualité de service au standard d marché
- Participer à la coordination des projets d'évolution sur le périmètre Open Banking
- Gérer les évolutions du portail API STORE du groupe BPCE transverse aux différentes lignes métiers du groupe et à destination des partenaires ;
- Participer aux activités de veille et d'écoute des besoins du marché en matière de finance embarquée
- Participer aux activités commerciales relatives aux produits API BusinessVos atouts pour réussirCompétences attendues :

- Connaissance des réglementations sur les services bancaires et les services de paiement notamment sur l'Open Banking (Règlement IP, DSP2, RSP, etc.)
- Connaissance des écosystèmes de startup, fintechs
- Capacité à animer des équipes pluridisciplinaires (produit, tech, business) de façon transverse
- Capacité à conduire et accompagner fonctionnellement des équipes dans le changement
- Esprit d'équipe
- Aisance relationnelle
- Capacité de synthèse et vulgarisation
- Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais (lu, écrit, parlé) indispensable pour interagir avec les partenaires internationaux.

Formation et Expérience :

- Formation supérieure (Bac+5)
- Expérience de 3 à 5 ans minimum dans le secteur bancaire, une Fintech, un cabinet de conseil ou u...

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Lietoon
jobs.description:
**Lähihoitaja Lietoon Kreivinkotoon – kädet saveen, liikkeelle yhdessä ja musiikki soimaan!**

**Etsimme lähihoitajaa, joka ei pelkää laittaa itseään likoon – ja välillä laittaa myös musiikin soimaan.**

Kuulostaako siltä, että voisit viihtyä meidän porukassamme?

Kreivinkoto Lieto on ikäihmisten yhteisöllinen koti, jossa **ei vain hoideta, vaan eletään hyvää arkea yhdessä**. Meillä päivä voi sisältää lääkehoitoa ja hoitotyötä, mutta yhtä hyvin myös leivontaa, askartelua, ulkoilua, musiikkia, naurua ja kaikenlaista yhdessä tekemistä.

Etsimme nyt joukkoomme **lähihoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä työtä ihmisten kanssa – ei vain heidän puolestaan.

**Mitä työ Kreivinkodossa on?**

Olet tärkeä osa asukkaidemme jokapäiväistä elämää. Tuet heidän toimintakykyään, hyvinvointiaan ja itsenäisyyttään sekä olet mukana luomassa mielekästä arkea.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- kokonaisvaltaista hoitoa ja huolenpitoa

- lääkehoitoa

- asukkaiden ohjaamista ja toimintakyvyn tukemista

- päivätoiminnan ja yhteisen tekemisen toteuttamista

- ulkoilua, virikkeitä ja arjen pieniä iloja

- kohtaamisia asukkaiden ja heidän läheistensä kanssa

- yhteistyötä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.


**Ja kyllä – välillä tärkein työtehtävä voi olla istua hetkeksi alas, kuunnella ja olla läsnä.**

**Millainen tyyppi meille sopii?**

Toivomme, että olet:

- koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja

- lämmin ja helposti lähestyttävä

- oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen

- hyvä tyyppi tiimipelaajaksi

- kiinnostunut ikäihmisten hyvinvoinnista ja hyvästä arjesta

- valmis tarttumaan tekemiseen ja kokeilemaan uutta.


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea valmiiksi. **Asenne ratkaisee.**

Jos tuot mukanasi ripauksen huumoria, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja halun tehdä työsi sydämellä, saatat olla juuri se henkilö, jota etsimme.

**Miksi Kreivinkoto?**

Koska meillä saat olla **lähihoitaja, ihminen ja työkaveri**.

Meillä arvostetaan toisiamme ja tehdään töitä yhdessä. Saat mahdollisuuden käyttää omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja olla mukana kehittämässä asukkaidemme arkea.

Meille yhteisöllisyys tarkoittaa sitä, että **asukkaat ja työntekijät tekevät arkea yhdessä**.

Ja ehkä juuri siksi täällä ei ole kahta samanlaista työpäivää.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos ajattelet, että **tuonne minä haluaisin töihin**, älä jää vain ajattelemaan – laita hakemus tulemaan!

Kerro meille lyhyesti itsestäsi ja siitä, **miksi juuri sinä sopisit Kreivinkotoon.**

**Kreivinkodossa hyvä arki ei synny itsestään – tehdään se yhdessä.**

Aloitamme haastattelut jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä, joten hae heti, niin päästään tutustumaan. Haluatko osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa kaikilla on tärkeä tehtävä ja halu menestyä yhdessä? Laita hakemuksesi Annelle (anne.holmberg@kototiimi.fi)

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi

Sairaanhoitaja uuteen Keisarinnaan!
jobs.description:
**Sairaanhoitaja, haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa jotain uutta?**

**Nyt on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan heti alusta asti.**

Keisarinnan uusi palvelukoti avaa ovensa, ja etsimme joukkoomme **sairaanhoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, mutta myös vaikuttaa siihen, millainen työpaikka ja arki meillä rakentuu.

Keisarinnassa tuotetaan **yhteisöllistä asumispalvelua ja ympärivuorokautista palveluasumista ikäihmisille**. Me emme halua vain avata uutta yksikköä – haluamme rakentaa paikan, jossa on hyvä asua, hyvä tehdä töitä ja hyvä tulla kohdatuksi.

**Miksi juuri Keisarinna?**

Koska tässä työssä et astu valmiiseen muottiin.

Uuden yksikön käynnistyessä pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan siihen, **miten meillä tehdään asioita**. Saat tuoda pöytään omat ideasi, osaamisesi ja persoonasi.

Me haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa ei tarvitse miettiä:

_"Näin tämä on aina tehty."_

Vaan kysytään:

**"Voisiko tämän tehdä vielä paremmin?"**

Sairaanhoitajana olet tärkeässä roolissa sekä asukkaiden kokonaisvaltaisen hoidon että turvallisen arjen rakentamisessa. Päivissä on vaihtelua, vastuuta, kohtaamisia ja ennen kaikkea mahdollisuuksia tehdä työ omalla ammattitaidollasi näkyväksi.

**Tässä työssä pääset**

- olemaan mukana käynnistämässä täysin uutta palvelukotia

- rakentamaan kanssamme hyvää työyhteisöä alusta asti

- hyödyntämään ja kehittämään omaa sairaanhoitajan osaamistasi

- kohtaamaan ikäihmiset yksilöinä – ei vain asiakkaina

- vaikuttamaan arjen toimintatapoihin ja niiden kehittämiseen

- tekemään työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä.


**Meille hyvä hoitotyö on muutakin kuin suorittamista**

Keisarinnassa asukkaiden elämä ei pysähdy siihen, että he muuttavat palvelukotiin.

Haluamme mahdollistaa **oman näköistä elämää, turvallisuutta, yhteisöllisyyttä ja hyviä hetkiä**. Siksi tarvitsemme hoitajia, joille ihminen tulee ennen rutiinia.

Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis paketti.

**Riittää, että olet ammattitaitoinen, utelias, vastuullinen ja valmis tekemään yhdessä.**

Arvostamme myös huumoria, hyvää energiaa ja sitä, että uskallat sanoa ääneen omat ajatuksesi.

**Tule tekemään tästä meidän näköisemme Keisarinna.**

Jos kaipaat työltäsi enemmän kuin valmista työvuorolistaa ja tuttua kaavaa, **Keisarinna saattaa olla juuri sinua varten.**

Täällä pääset näkemään oman kädenjälkesi.

**Uusi paikka. Uusi tiimi. Uudet mahdollisuudet.**

Ja ehkä juuri sinä olet yksi niistä ihmisistä, joiden ansiosta Keisarinnasta tulee paikka, jonne on maanantainakin kiva tulla töihin.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos olet **sairaanhoitaja** ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa uutta palvelukotia alusta asti, **lähetä meille hakemuksesi!**

Kerro meille lyhyesti, kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea:

**Mitä sinä haluaisit tuoda Keisarinnaan?**

**Tule mukaan rakentamaan Keisarinnaa. Meillä on paikka sinulle.**

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Ops
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills. Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our growing team at Mölnlycke.

In this role, you will leverage data, analytics, and digital solutions to support operational, tactical, and strategic decision-making across the Supply Chain organization. You will play a key role in improving procurement performance, inventory optimization, service levels, cost efficiency, and operational excellence through data-driven insights and continuous improvement initiatives.

This position will primarily focus on Level procurement, with Rosemount Tank Radar as the main area of responsibility. You will support procurement and inventory processes, monitor performance, identify opportunities for optimization, and collaborate with buyers across multiple sites to resolve system or setup-related issues.

If you are passionate about analytics, process improvement, and translating data into business value, we would love to hear from you.

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:

    Support Level procurement activities with a primary focus on RTR, ensuring effective procurement and inventory management processes.
    Provide guidance and support to buyers across global sites when procurement setup or process issues arise.
    Develop, maintain, and continuously enhance supply chain reporting, dashboards, and analytical tools that support business decision-making.
    Monitor, analyze, and report key supply chain performance metrics, including: Service Level and On-Time Delivery, Inventory Turnover and Procurement Performance
    Identify trends, risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities through quantitative and qualitative analysis of procurement and supply chain data.
    Recommend and drive fact-based actions and improvement initiatives based on business impact and operational priorities.
    Lead and support continuous improvement projects within Supply Chain and in partnership with cross-functional teams.
    Prepare reports, presentations, and data-driven recommendations to support management and business stakeholders.
    Drive inventory optimization activities through ABC classification reviews, safety stock analysis, and other inventory improvement initiatives.
    Partner with Global and European Supply Chain Analysts to leverage best practices, avoid duplication of efforts, and scale successful initiatives across the organization.



Who You Are:

You consistently apply analytical thinking to solve complex problems and make informed decisions. You collaborate effectively across teams, building strong working relationships and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You communicate clearly and confidently, translating data into actionable insights for diverse stakeholders. You proactively identify opportunities, embrace new technologies and ways of working, and drive meaningful improvements that create business value.

For This Role, You Will Need:

    Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Operations, Analytics, or a related field.
    Experience in supply chain, procurement, operations, business analytics, reporting, automation, or a related area.- a minimum of 2-5 years.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to transform data into business insights and recommendations.
    Experience working with data visualization, reporting tools, and performance metrics.
    Strong communication and presentation skills.
    Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional and global teams.
    A structured and organized approach with strong attention to detail.
    Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other analytical tools.
    English proficiency



Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:

    Experience working in a manufacturing, supply chain, or procurement environment.
    Knowledge of Oracle ERP systems.
    Swedish proficiency will be a plus
    Experience with supply chain analytics, inventory optimization, or procurement process improvement.
    Exposure to automation, digitalization, AI-driven solutions, or business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
    Experience participating in global or cross-functional improvement initiatives.



Our Culture & Commitment to You:

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

You’ll find us at our Innovation Center in Mölnlycke, just 10 minutes from Gothenburg, easily accessible by car, bike and public transport. Here, every employee is part of a dynamic and innovative environment where everyone understands how their work contributes to the success of our company.

At the office, you can enjoy access to our gym and share great lunches with colleagues in our restaurant. Customer focus, engagement, and courage are at the heart of our culture. We foster a friendly and positive atmosphere, and as part of a global organization with locations around the world, you’ll have plenty of opportunities for personal and professional development.

About Us

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability.

jobs.title: PhD position at the Department of Geography
jobs.description:
UiB - Knowledge that shapes society

UiB shall be among Europe's leading universities, internationally recognized for high quality in research and education. As a societal institution, we shall contribute to sustainable and democratic development and be an attractive and inclusive place to study and work.

Video: https://youtu.be/i4SDcLir6OcPhD position

There is a vacancy for a PhD position in System Dynamics at the Department of Geography. The position is within the project INTEGRATOR and for a fixed-term period of 3 years. Starting date is latest 1 April 2027.

System Dynamics Group at the Department of Geography

The System Dynamics group carries out research in several areas. The most important areas are: sustainability transitions, natural resources management, water-energy-food-ecosystems (WEFE) nexus, and model-based learning and communication. The group makes use of a variety of tools and techniques: stakeholder mapping, governance analysis, participatory modeling, non-linear feedback modeling, computer simulation, non-linear model analysis, interactive learning environments and decision-laboratory experiments.


About the project/work tasks:

Description of the INTEGRATOR project

The position is within the EU Horizon Europe project ‘Integrated Innovation Ecosystems for Transformative Nexus Governance towards Enhanced Water Resilience (INTEGRATOR)’. The overarching project objective is to strengthen Europe’s climate-resilient and fair water management by enabling anticipatory, evidence-based decision making at river basin scale under changing climatic and socio-economic conditions, directly supporting the implementation of the EU water strategy. Specific objectives of INTEGRATOR pertaining to this call include: (1) promoting system-wide transformation in water governance and management to strengthen resilience, preparedness, and fair allocation; (2) establishing site-specific, stakeholder-led strategies; (3) creating seasonal and long-term foresight by developing and coupling a suite of models, including data-driven, process-based, and system-dynamics approaches; (4) delivering a digital water intelligence system orchestrated by a prompt compiler translating human language into executable simulations.

INTEGRATOR is built on six case studies in Germany, Greece, Italy, Latvia, Spain and Türkiye with various socio-economic, sectoral development, land use, water quality and water quantity challenges. Among these case studies, two of them are particularly relevant to this call: (1) Ergene River Basin (Türkiye), a 17K km2 watershed and a major industrial and agricultural hub with 2M inhabitants, facing severe pressure on groundwater resources, water quality and allocation. (2) Jucar River Basin – Albufera system in Spain, a highly interconnected river-water-coastal continuum centered on the 210 km2 Albufera Natural Park with high ecological value, facing pressures from intensive irrigated agriculture, and urban and industrial development.

Responsibilities following the position:

The research fellow will use participatory system dynamics modelling and computer simulations to support INTEGRATOR in all work packages (abbreviated as WP), with a concentrated focus on two WPs: WP3 (Participatory Co-Design for Resilient and Equitable Water Solutions using a Decision Theatre Approach) is going to strengthen inclusive and transformational governance through structured participatory process in the INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres (DTs). More specifically, WP3 will deal with stakeholder mapping, problem co-definition, participatory scenario analysis and policy exploration embedded in INTEGRATOR’s Decision Theatres Approach (DTA). WP6 (Digital Water Intelligence System and the HydroFellow) is going to provide a Digital Water Intelligence System (DWIS) and a prompt compiler, integrating multisource information, including models and model generated data. More specifically, WP6 will work on integrated hydrological and system dynamics modeling, site-specific digital twin development and integration, and the prompt compiler HydroFellow development through interaction with the DTs. The research fellow will be working on the Ergene and Albufera case studies to fundamentally support the activities under WP3 and WP6 through systems thinking, dynamic systems modeling and computer simulations.


Qualifications and personal qualities:
  • The applicant must hold a master’s degree in System Dynamics or another discipline with a strong system, modeling and simulation focus. The master’s degree must have been completed by the application deadline.
  • The requirements are generally a grade B or better on the Master thesis and for the master’s degree in total.
  • Applicants must demonstrate a strong interest in socio-economic-hydrological scenario building; experience in participatory model-building is desirable.
  • Applicants must have strong quantitative and computational foundations.
  • Teaching assistance experience in the field of System Dynamics will be considered an advantage.
  • The applicant must be proficient in both written and oral English. Proficiency in Spanish and/or Turkish languages will be considered an advantage.
  • Applicants must be able to work independently and in a structured manner.
  • Applicants should have experience of working as a member of a multidisciplinary and multicultural research team and demonstrate good collaborative skills.
  • Experience in interdisciplinary working, linking social/economic and environmental sciences, is desirable.
  • Personal and relational qualities will be emphasized. Ambitions and potential will also count when evaluating the candidates.
  • The place of work for this position is Bergen, and the work requires that you are physically present at the Department of Geography on a daily basis.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for an interview. 


About the PhD position:

The duration of the PhD position is 3 years. 

About the PhD training:

As a PhD research fellow, you will take part in the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences, UiB. The programme corresponds to a period of three years and leads to the PhD degree. To be eligible for admission you must normally have an educational background corresponding to a master’s degree with a scope of 120 ECTS credits, which builds on a bachelor’s degree with a scope of 180 ECTS credits (normally 2 + 3 years), or an integrated master’s degree with a scope of 300 ECTS credits (5 years). Master’s degrees must normally include an independent work of a minimum of 30 ECTS credits. It is expected that the topic of the master’s degree is connected to the academic field to which you are seeking admission.


We can offer:
  • Salary as PhD (code 1017) NOK 593 700,- per year. Automatic salary increases for up to 3 years with a 3% annual increase 
  • A good and professionally challenging working environment
  • Enrolment in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Good welfare benefits

Project proposal:

A research proposal of maximum 2500 words (excluding reference list) must accompany the application. The project description should present the topic, the research questions(s) and choice of theory and methods. It should also include a progress plan for the different parts of the project. The research proposal must also include a short description of how the applicant envisions a fit with the INTEGRATOR project. Admittance to the PhD programme will be based on the research proposal. 


Your application must include:
  • A cover letter including a brief account of your research interests and motivation for applying for the position
  • The names and contact information for two reference persons. One of them must be the main advisor for the master's thesis or equivalent thesis
  • Project proposal
  • CV
  • Transcripts and diplomas showing completion of the bachelor's and master's degrees.
  • Relevant certificates/references
  • A list of academic publications
  • Academic publications that you want to submit for assessment (including your master’s thesis or equivalent)
  • If you have a master's degree from an institution outside of the Nordic countries, or a 2-year discipline- based master's degree (or the equivalent) in a subject area other than the one associated with the application, you may later in the application process be asked to submit an overview of the syllabus for the degree you have completed

The application and appendices with certified translations into English or a Scandinavian language must be uploaded at Jobbnorge following the link on this page marked “Apply for this job”.

Closing date: November 1, 2026.

Applications submitted without a project proposal or applications sent as e-mails will not be considered. Only submitted documents will be subjected to an expert assessment.


General information:

Detailed information about the position can be obtained by contacting Professor Ali K. Saysel, ali.saysel@uib.no.

Practical questions regarding the application procedures, please contact the HR section at: personal.svfa@uib.no. 

Appointed research fellows will be admitted to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Social Sciences. Questions about the programme may be directed to Adviser Elina Troscenko, elina.troscenko@uib.no

We are looking for a responsible, well-organised and motivated Cleaning Supervisor to join our team in Copenhagen.

Your responsibilities

  • Handling day-to-day operational issues and finding practical solutions

  • Supporting and motivating employees in their daily work

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and willing to work in shifts

  • Is available to work every second weekend

What we offer

We offer a responsible and varied position in a stable and established cleaning company in Copenhagen, where you will play an important role in our daily operations and future development.

L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements et plus d'1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement, réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité. Chez Hello Watt nous électrifions également les logements en installant des panneaux solaires ou des pompes à chaleur partout en France.
Nous recherchons un Frontend Engineer, aussi à l'aise dans une application React web/TypeScript que dans une page server-rendered avec HTMX et AlpineJS, supporté par notre design system basé sur TailwindCSS.
Chez Hello Watt, le frontend est un pilier de l'expérience utilisateur : courbes de consommation, pilotage d'appareils en temps réel, parcours de souscription, design system partagé entre React et Django, tu seras au cœur de l'expérience de centaines de milliers de foyers, sur le web comme sur iOS et Android.
Nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeurs-euses. Nous cherchons à garder une qualité de code et une facilité de maintenance élevés, tout en embrassant les nouvelles pratiques et workflows IA.
Tes missions :
- Faire vivre et évoluer Firebolt, notre design system (Tailwind + composants React et Django) en facilitant l'intégration et l'adoption par les développeurs-euses full-stack.

- Veiller à des temps de chargements rapides pour tous sur l'app et le site hellowatt.fr (SEO, Core Web Vitals).

- Implémenter le frontend de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android).

- Définir les pratiques et les outils communs du frontend, faire converger l'existant : data-fetching, formulaires, state management, conventions de composants côté Django/htmx.

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Élargir la couverture et les outils de tests du frontend : tests de composants et de hooks (Vitest, Testing Library), scénarios end-to-end (Playwright), Storybook.

Profil recherché
Nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs-ices, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Passion frontend : forte curiosité et veille active de son écosystème: supports des nouvelles fonctionnalités navigateurs, frameworks, tooling, patterns

- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- Architecture système : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement frontend avec React et TypeScript, dans un environnement produit exigeant sur l'expérience utilisateur.

- À l'aise avec le rendu côté serveur et l'approche hypermedia: Templates Django, htmx, Alpine.js ou similaires.

- Habitué à travailler et/ou définir un design system.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, composition, architecture modulaire par domaines métier.

- Apprécié : notions de Python/Django pour naviguer entre vues et templates, expérience du mobile hybride (capacitorjs).

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire.

- Bac +5 université ou équivalent

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Frontend web app & native apps
- Language : TypeScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Librairies: Tanstack Query, React Router, Lingui

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Radix ui, Storybook

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

- Language : Django templating language & TypeScript

- Librairies: Htmx, Alpinejs

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Alpinejs, Storybook

Infrastructure & Déploiement

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Growth Enablement
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT REPLIT

Replit is building the world's most ubiquitous AI coding agent. Replit Agent can be used by anybody to bring their ideas to life. Whether it's an app for yourself, the next great startup idea, or a tool to make you more productive at work, Replit Agent can help build it. Replit is also the leader in secure vibe coding. We protect apps, give users features to manage security risks, and help them vibe code more safely.





ABOUT THE ROLE:

Replit is changing how people and companies turn ideas into software. Reaching those customers requires engineering that connects acquisition to the product experience and gives teams trustworthy evidence about what works.


This role goes beyond operating conventional marketing technology. You will rethink growth systems for a world where agents can observe performance, diagnose problems, take action, and learn from the result.


As the founding engineer for Growth Enablement, you will set the technical direction for this area. You will build agentic systems alongside shared foundations for attribution, audiences, lifecycle engagement, referrals, and promotions. The work spans web, mobile, billing, and data.


You will work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to find the highest-leverage problems and ship the first solutions. Successful projects will become platforms that help these teams move faster and give Replit a clearer view of what drives durable growth.





YOU WILL:

 - Design agentic growth systems that monitor performance, diagnose failures, run approved experiments, and improve from the results.

 - Explore AI-native approaches to answer engine optimization, campaign operations, audience discovery, and measurement.

 - Build acquisition measurement across web and mobile, including click-ID capture, identity matching, server-side conversion APIs, and warehouse attribution.

 - Create a shared standard for deep links and context transfer across web, iOS, Android, and app-store handoffs.

 - Build reusable systems for promotions, referrals, campaign landing pages, fraud controls, attribution, and holdout measurement.

 - Build audience pipelines that sync warehouse-defined cohorts and exclusions to each delivery channel.

 - Work directly with marketing, sales, and partnerships to turn business needs into technical systems.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend expertise in TypeScript/Node, Python, Go, or a similar language.

 - Strong SQL skills and experience working with a data warehouse and event instrumentation.

 - Hands-on experience with attribution, marketing technology, deep linking, payment webhooks, or high-scale event pipelines.

 - A record of working with non-engineering partners to turn ambiguous business needs into shipped systems.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Built growth or martech infrastructure at a consumer or PLG company, such as referral systems, promotion platforms, lifecycle tooling, or CDPs.

 - Built agents that act on business data with clear evaluations, permissions, and human controls.

 - Experience with experimentation platforms such as Statsig and lifecycle tools such as Iterable.

 - Familiarity with privacy and consent handling in marketing data pipelines.




BONUS POINTS:

 - Experience shipping mobile attribution with OneLink, Universal Links, App Links, or SKAN.

 - Experience carrying attribution through payment systems such as Stripe or Razorpay.

 - Regular use of AI agents to plan, implement, test, or review your work.




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Extreme ownership: identify important work, carry it through launch, and resolve blockers quickly.

 - Data-driven decisions: define hypotheses and success criteria before launch, then change direction when the evidence calls for it.

 - No borders: solve the highest-impact problem, whether it requires a PRD, a warehouse query, code, or campaign setup.

 - Speed through reversibility: ship the smallest step that produces useful signal, and slow down for decisions that are hard to reverse.

 - Strong communication: make technical constraints and business requirements clear to engineers and go-to-market partners.
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.title: Financial Controller needed!
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced finance professional with 10+ years of experience in accounting or financial control? We are now looking for a structured, proactive and solution-oriented Financial Controller to join our client in a fast-paced industrial environment. Keep reading to find out more about the role!

About the position

We at Perido are now looking for a Financial Controller to our client, a Swedish industrial company developing large-scale production of green iron and steel using green hydrogen and renewable energy, with the aim of significantly reducing the steel industry’s carbon emissions. The position is based in Stockholm.

Your daily tasks

The role combines qualified accounting, financial control, process development and ERP implementation. You will work closely with stakeholders across the organisation and play an important part in ensuring accurate financial reporting while contributing to improved processes and internal controls. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a changing environment and who can combine attention to detail with a broader business perspective.

Key responsibilities

    Manage day-to-day accounting and month-end closing
    Perform balance sheet and intercompany reconciliations
    Handle VAT reporting
    Manage CAPEX, fixed assets and accounting classification
    Contribute to ERP implementation, experience in SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud is preferred
    Develop and document processes and internal controls
    Support audits and statutory reporting
    Collaborate with stakeholders across the organisation

Your characteristics

To succeed in this role, you are structured, proactive and solution-oriented. You take ownership of your responsibilities and have a strong attention to detail, while also being able to understand the bigger business picture. You enjoy working in a dynamic environment and are motivated by improving processes and finding effective solutions.

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!

In this recruitment process, we only accept applications written in English.

Qualifications:

    At least 10 years of relevant experience in accounting, financial control or a related finance role
    Strong knowledge of Swedish GAAP/K3
    Hands-on experience with reconciliations, intercompany transactions, VAT, CAPEX and fixed assets
    Experience from an industrial environment, preferably production, inventory or logistics
    Experience with ERP implementations (a plus)
    Excellent spoken and written English

Contract type and hours

Full-time consulting assignment until 2027-06-30. Start asap.

Let us help you take the next step in your career

Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. With us, you will find a wide variety of assignments, where you can either be employed directly by a company or work as a consultant through Perido. We are one of Sweden’s largest consulting firms for professionals, which gives you many opportunities. As a consultant, you become an important part of our organization and contribute your expertise within our clients’ organizations. Read more about us at Perido: https://perido.se/om-oss/

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still cannot find what you are looking for, you are welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se. Please always include the position reference number 35987 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status or disclose the client company if it is not stated in the job advertisement.

jobs.title: Breakfast staff (waiter / dishwasher)
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Indirect Procurement Specialist – IT Category
jobs.description:
Your New Role

We are now looking for an Indirect Procurement Specialist within the IT category to support a strategic project for a large international energy company. You will be part of a multidisciplinary programme team and take ownership of sourcing activities that are critical to the programme’s timeline, Day-1 readiness and the mobilization of the future organization.

The role offers the opportunity to combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery, while operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities, dependencies and requirements can evolve quickly.

Key responsibilities:

    

Conduct an IT category and supplier market analysis, identifying relevant services, capabilities and potential suppliers required by the programme.

    

Translate business, IT, architecture, security and transition requirements into practical sourcing strategies, supplier criteria and procurement plans.

    

Prepare, coordinate and issue RFI, RFQ and RFP documentation in collaboration with relevant business, IT, Legal, Security and Procurement stakeholders.

    

Plan and manage procurement milestones, dependencies and key decisions in alignment with the integrated IT programme roadmap.

    

Develop evaluation criteria, commercial models and scoring structures, ensuring transparent and well-structured supplier evaluations.

    

Support supplier shortlisting, clarification meetings, negotiations and the preparation of commercial recommendations.

    

Coordinate contracting activities and support supplier onboarding, mobilization and handover.

    

Maintain a consolidated overview of supplier selection status, timelines, commercial assumptions, risks and key decisions.

    

Provide procurement input to programme reporting, budget discussions and Steering Committee decision material.

    

Support collaboration with the company’s Indirect Procurement function and the future procurement organization.

    

Provide professional advice and support to internal stakeholders on procurement, contracts and sourcing-related matters.

Company Presentation

Our client is committed to a fossil-free future, bringing together diverse talents to drive real change. Employees apply their expertise, grow, and contribute to solutions that truly matter – a workplace where curiosity, creativity, and passion are highly valued.

Good to Know

Scope of employment: Full-time, 100% Type of contract: Fixed-term employment as a consultant via JobBusters. Working model: Hybrid Start date: As soon as possible End date: 2027-03-31, with the possibility of extension In your application: Please ensure that your CV clearly demonstrates how you meet the qualifications required by the client.

A relevant university or college degree in Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Finance, Law, IT or a related field.

    

Experience within IT procurement, indirect procurement or strategic sourcing.

    

Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to bridge commercial, technical and business perspectives.

    

High integrity and sound judgement, particularly when handling commercially sensitive and confidential information.

Secure employment with a collective bargaining agreement, insurance coverage and occupational pension

    

Wellness allowance and employee discounts and offers via Benifex (e.g., health, leisure, transport and healthcare)

    

Flex pension and access to the Lifeplan pension advisory service

    

Additional compensation during parental leave

    

Occupational health services

    

Long-term assignments and a dedicated Consultant Manager for personal support

    

Opportunities to build valuable experience, expand your network and grow your future career

jobs.title: Senior Statistician - Late Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism
jobs.description:
Do you have expertise in Statistics and a passion for Drug Development? Would you like to apply your skills to impact late-stage drug development in a company that frontiers science and turns ideas into life‑changing medicines? Then AstraZeneca might be the match for you.



At AstraZeneca, you will apply innovative and creative approaches to science while working across a strong pipeline of cutting-edge medicines. You'll join passionate professionals who push the boundaries of science and technology to develop and deliver medicines that help people live better lives. Our cardiovascular, renal and metabolism (CVRM) pipeline spans investigational therapies at varied stages of clinical development, from recently approved products to earlier stage molecules. We are currently looking for a Senior Statistician to join our global Biometrics team and contribute with statistical expertise within late-stage drug development projects. This role is based at AstraZeneca's R&D site in Gothenburg, Sweden.



Accountabilities:

We are looking for individuals who can work independently on complex statistical activities, collaborate cross-functionally, and communicate results clearly. In this role, depending on seniority, your responsibilities will include:

    

Provide statistical expertise for complex study design and interpretation across preclinical/clinical programmes, internal governance, regulatory submissions and commercialisation

    

Analyse internal and external data; perform modelling and simulation to inform design decisions and decision criteria

    

Develop Statistical Analysis Plans for complex studies and project deliveries

    

Coach and guide less experienced statisticians in producing analyses, graphics and tables for reports, Global Medical Affairs studies and publications

    

Analyse, interpret, summarise and communicate results; contribute to regulatory documents and responses

    

Identify and apply methodological improvements, including modelling and simulation, to enhance study design, process and delivery

    

Under guidance, investigate and apply novel statistical approaches; provide consultancy, engage with external scientists/academia, and communicate research (conferences/journals)



Essential Skills/Experience:

    

MSc/PhD in Statistics or Mathematics (containing a substantial statistical component)

    

Competent statistical programmer (SAS, R, and/or Python)

    

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate and work effectively in teams

    

Experience and knowledge of statistical methods and applications in study design, analysis and interpretation

    

Keen interest in research; Comfortable learning and applying new statistical methods.



Desirable Skills/Experience:

    

Knowledge of key technical and regulatory requirements related to the role

    

Experience of design, analysis and reporting of preclinical or clinical studies

    

Experience of pharmaceutical development

    

Ability to apply statistical expertise to problems, with strong problem solving and quality focus



AstraZeneca offers an environment where curiosity thrives. We are committed to making a difference by fusing data and technology with scientific innovations. With opportunities for lifelong learning and career development, you can explore without limits while contributing to life-changing medicines.



Ready to make an impact? Apply now to join our team at AstraZeneca!

Welcome with your application by September 20th, 2026.

jobs.title: Applied Physicist at CERN
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As an Applied Physicist, you will join the ATLAS Group at CERN and be part of the team which is working on the upgrade of the muon spectrometer of the ATLAS detector. In this upgrade you will play a crucial role, leading the electronics integration in the new RPC detectors to be used in the Inner layer of the Barrel Muon Spectrometer.

An important part of the job will be the installation and commissioning of the new detectors in the ATLAS cavern. Your experience in commissioning and operations of gaseous detectors will be a strong asset which coupled with your versatility, and strong team spirit will be essential to the success of the ATLAS muon upgrade program.

Your responsibilities:
-Testing and validating pre-production Front-End, Low Voltage, and connection boards.
-Coordinating quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC) activities.
-Supporting the integration of electronics boards into RPC detectors.
-Participating in QA/QC testing of fully equipped chambers.
-Debugging of problematic chambers.
-Coordinating testing before and after installation.
-Acting as the main contact between the RPC project and Technical Coordination during installation.
-Coordinating detector commissioning after installation.

Your profile:
-Strong experience in the design, debugging and operations of fast electronics boards for gaseous detectors.
-Demonstrated experience in operating and commissioning of gaseous detectors.
-Knowledge of gas detectors physics.
-Ability to work effectively in small to medium-sized teams under a leadership role.
-PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Physics or a related field.

Your skills:
-Design and simulation of front-end electronics for analog sensors and transducers.
-Knowledge and application of gas based particle detection technologies.
-Testing and validation of detector, accelerator and beam line components.
-Analysis and optimisation of detector performance,
-Assembly and integration of detectors,
-Uses openness and honesty to interact constructively with others.
-Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
-Produces workable and timely solutions that meet requirements.
-Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
-Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
A valid driving licence.
Work in Radiation Areas.
Interventions in underground installations.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

jobs.title: Allmänmedicin läkare till Danmark - Vi skräddarsyr ditt nästa äventyr!
jobs.description:
Går du i tankarna på att arbeta i Danmark, antingen nu eller i framtiden? Vi söker kontinuerligt duktiga specialister i allmänmedicin för kommande och långsiktiga uppdrag över hela Danmark.

Vi vet att livet består av mer än bara jobb. Därför utgår vi alltid från dina personliga önskemål. Om du har familj, vill bo på en specifik ort eller har specifika önskemål kring ditt schema, så anpassar vi vårt sökande efter dig, inte efter en fast låst list

Vill du arbeta i ett hälso- och sjukvårdssystem som värnar om din arbetsmiljö? Här får du chansen till ett meningsfullt arbete med stor flexibilitet, rimliga patientflöden och ett starkt team av sjuksköterskor runt dig. Du kommer att få mer stöd från övrig vårdpersonal och hanterar mindre administration. Det gör att du äntligen kan fokusera på det medicinska!

Vi erbjuder ett års visstidsanställning, men ser gärna att det leder till en tillsvidareanställning.

Arbetstider och balans i livet:

Arbetet är som utgångspunkt heltid, måndag till fredag kl. 08–16, men det finns möjlighet att arbeta på minst 75 % tjänstgöringsgrad. Du arbetar alltså vardagar 08–16, med betald lunch och helt utan jour, övertid eller helgarbete. Du får en mer förutsägbar arbetsdag och betydligt bättre möjligheter att planera livet utanför arbetet.

Ekonomi och förmåner:

Som svensk specialistläkare kan du, om du uppfyller kraven, omfattas av den danska expertskatten med en fast skattesats på 32,8 %. Det innebär mer pengar kvar i plånboken och större frihet på fritiden.

Vi löser det praktiska åt dig:

Att flytta till ett annat land ska inte behöva vara krångligt. Du behöver inte börja om, du tar med dig din erfarenhet och kompetens, så hjälper vi dig genom hela processen:

    Auktorisation & myndigheter: Vi hjälper dig med det administrativa inför din start i Danmark.
    Möblerat boende: Vi ordnar boende inför din ankomst och presenterar alternativ som passar din placering.
    Språk & introduktion: Du får en intensiv språkutbildning på ca 20 timmar med erfarna språklärare samt en introduktionsvecka där du kommer in i arbetssättet, systemen och den danska vården.
    Personligt stöd: Du har en personlig kontakt genom hela processen, från första samtalet tills du är etablerad.

Din erfarenhet:

    Legitimerad läkare
    Specialist i allmänmedicin
    Kunna prata och skriva på flytande svenska
    Meriterande att kunna förstå och prata danska

Låter det intressant för dig? Ansök genom att skicka ditt CV till mig Felix på felix.hellstrom@vbsverige.se eller göra en intresseanmälan på vår hemsida (https://vbsverige.se/lakare-i-danmark/).

Vi ser fram emot att starta en dialog med dig!

OM OSS

Vårdbemanning Sverige startade sin verksamhet 2014 och är idag ett av Sveriges största bemanningsföretag inom hälso- och sjukvård. Sedan 2019 har vi utsetts till ett av landets Gasellföretag av Dagens Industri, och utmärker oss som ett av landets snabbast växande företag. Vi erbjuder bemannings- och rekryteringslösningar till Sveriges regioner, privata vårdgivare och kommuner.

Så fungerar det

Det första steget till att arbeta via oss i Danmark är att vi startar en profil på dig i vårt verksamhetssystem. Vi börjar processen med ett initialt telefonsamtal där vi får veta mer om dig, din bakgrund och dina erfarenheter, samtidigt som du får svar på alla dina frågor om oss och om hur allt fungerar. För att kunna starta din profil och gå vidare behöver vi också få in ett antal handlingar från dig, såsom ditt CV och dina referenser.

Under våra samtal går vi även igenom vilket/vilka ställen du vill eller kan tänka dig jobba på, vilket geografiskt område som passar dig bäst samt ramarna för lönepaketen. När vi har hittat rätt matchning och samlat in alla uppgifter, sammanställer vi detta till en presentation för Nordic Medicare.

När presentationen är klar lämnar vi över till Nordic Medicare som då tar vid för den fortsatta processen. De kommer att hålla en uppföljande intervju med dig och sköta den konkreta dialogen kring själva anställningen. Det är också direkt med Nordic Medicare som du går igenom alla slutgiltiga arbetsrättsliga villkor, avtalsspecifika bestämmelser, juridik och eventuella frågor kring forskarskatteordningen. På så sätt får du en samlad, trygg och tydlig dialog om alla kontraktets detaljer direkt med din kommande arbetsgivare.

När du är ute och arbetar har du kontinuerlig dialog med din närmsta kontaktperson hos oss, som vägleder och stöttar dig genom uppdraget från början till slut. Vi sätter stort värde på att vara tillgänglig för dig. Du kan alltid nå oss på telefon eller mejl när du behöver.

jobs.title: Specialist i allmänmedicin till Jylland – flexibla kliniker med gott stöd
jobs.description:

Här får du chansen till ett meningsfullt arbete med stor flexibilitet, rimliga patientflöden och ett starkt team av sjuksköterskor runt dig. Du kommer att få mer stöd från övrig vårdpersonal och hanterar mindre administration. Det gör att du äntligen kan fokusera på det medicinska!

Vi erbjuder ett års visstidsanställning, men ser gärna att det leder till en tillsvidareanställning.

Vi har just nu behov på följande platser, där du kan välja den plats som passar dig bäst:

    Christiansfeld
    Esbjerg Ø
    Sønderborg
    Aabenraa

Vi erbjuder:

Arbetstider och balans i livet:

Arbetet är som utgångspunkt heltid, måndag till fredag kl. 08–16, men det finns möjlighet att arbeta på minst 75 % tjänstgöringsgrad. Du arbetar alltså vardagar 08–16, med betald lunch och helt utan jour, övertid eller helgarbete. Du får en mer förutsägbar arbetsdag och betydligt bättre möjligheter att planera livet utanför arbetet.

Ekonomi och förmåner:

Som svensk specialistläkare kan du, om du uppfyller kraven, omfattas av den danska expertskatten med en fast skattesats på 32,8 %. Det innebär mer pengar kvar i plånboken och större frihet på fritiden.

Vi löser det praktiska åt dig:

Att flytta till ett annat land ska inte behöva vara krångligt. Du behöver inte börja om, du tar med dig din erfarenhet och kompetens, så hjälper vi dig genom hela processen:

    Auktorisation & myndigheter: Vi hjälper dig med det administrativa inför din start i Danmark.
    Möblerat boende: Vi ordnar boende inför din ankomst och presenterar alternativ som passar din placering.
    Språk & introduktion: Du får en intensiv språkutbildning på ca 20 timmar med erfarna språklärare samt en introduktionsvecka där du kommer in i arbetssättet, systemen och den danska vården.
    Personligt stöd: Du har en personlig kontakt genom hela processen, från första samtalet tills du är etablerad.

Din erfarenhet:

    Legitimerad läkare
    Specialist i allmänmedicin
    Kunna prata och skriva på flytande svenska
    Meriterande att kunna förstå och prata danska

Låter det intressant för dig? Ansök genom att skicka ditt CV till mig Felix på felix.hellstrom@vbsverige.se eller göra en intresseanmälan på vår hemsida (https://vbsverige.se/lakare-i-danmark/).

Vi ser fram emot att starta en dialog med dig!

OM OSS

Vårdbemanning Sverige startade sin verksamhet 2014 och är idag ett av Sveriges största bemanningsföretag inom hälso- och sjukvård. Sedan 2019 har vi utsetts till ett av landets Gasellföretag av Dagens Industri, och utmärker oss som ett av landets snabbast växande företag. Vi erbjuder bemannings- och rekryteringslösningar till Sveriges regioner, privata vårdgivare och kommuner.

Så fungerar det

Det första steget till att arbeta via oss i Danmark är att vi startar en profil på dig i vårt verksamhetssystem. Vi börjar processen med ett initialt telefonsamtal där vi får veta mer om dig, din bakgrund och dina erfarenheter, samtidigt som du får svar på alla dina frågor om oss och om hur allt fungerar. För att kunna starta din profil och gå vidare behöver vi också få in ett antal handlingar från dig, såsom ditt CV och dina referenser.

Under våra samtal går vi även igenom vilket/vilka ställen du vill eller kan tänka dig jobba på, vilket geografiskt område som passar dig bäst samt ramarna för lönepaketen. När vi har hittat rätt matchning och samlat in alla uppgifter, sammanställer vi detta till en presentation för Nordic Medicare.

När presentationen är klar lämnar vi över till Nordic Medicare som då tar vid för den fortsatta processen. De kommer att hålla en uppföljande intervju med dig och sköta den konkreta dialogen kring själva anställningen. Det är också direkt med Nordic Medicare som du går igenom alla slutgiltiga arbetsrättsliga villkor, avtalsspecifika bestämmelser, juridik och eventuella frågor kring forskarskatteordningen. På så sätt får du en samlad, trygg och tydlig dialog om alla kontraktets detaljer direkt med din kommande arbetsgivare.

När du är ute och arbetar har du kontinuerlig dialog med din närmsta kontaktperson hos oss, som vägleder och stöttar dig genom uppdraget från början till slut. Vi sätter stort värde på att vara tillgänglig för dig. Du kan alltid nå oss på telefon eller mejl när du behöver.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
As a Mechanical Engineer, you will contribute to the development, procurement, assembly, testing and installation of innovative mechanical structures for the High Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL) of the Compact Muon Solenoid experiment, working with advanced materials and challenging structural and thermal requirements.

You will help oversee the surface assembly and testing of the 250-tonne detector, including its CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and fibre services, as well as its installation and commissioning 100 metres underground. Working in a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will apply your expertise in structural and thermal calculations, finite element analysis and 3D CAD.

Your responsibilities:
- Coordinate a team of technicians in assembling and testing the steel structures of HGCAL, comprising more than 200 tonnes of steel plates per endcap.
- Provide engineering support for all activities at CERN related to the large-scale active detector components, known as "cassettes" (30-60-degree segments of circular structures with diameters of up to 5 m). This will include the cold testing of "electromagnetic cassettes" and their subsequent stacking with lead plates to form the complete electromagnetic endcaps.
- Integrate the hadronic cassettes into the steel structures and provide support for their testing.
- Integrate the electromagnetic (30 tonnes) and hadronic (200 tonnes) sections, including their cabling and piping, and support subsequent large-scale testing on the surface.
- Help oversee the lowering of the HGCAL endcaps into the CMS cavern and their connection to CMS, including the connection and testing of services.

Your profile:
- Strong track record in planning and coordinating the handling, assembling and testing of large mechanical structures.
- Demonstrated experience in performing thermal and structural calculations of complex mechanical structures using finite element analysis.
- Demonstrated experience in developing mechanical assemblies using 3D CAD.
- Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
- Master's Degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment: Knowledge of usual manufacturing methods (milling, turning, etc.), assembly methods (bolted, welding, etc.).
- Knowledge and application of mechanical measurement techniques: including quality control methods.
- Assembly and integration of detectors: capability to develop and validate manufacturing and installation methods.
- Production of 2D drawings and 3D models: proficiency in Catia V5 or equivalent 3D modelling software, good knowledge of drawing annotations.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling applied to mechanics.
- Proficiency in ANSYS would be a strong asset.
- Basic understanding of process engineering systems (i.e. cooling plants) would be an asset.
- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.
- Adopts a pragmatic approach; understands the value of adopting generic rather than gold -plated' technical solutions.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Delivers presentations in a structured and clear way; adjusts style and content to the audience; responds calmly and confidently to questions.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in Radiation Areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.
- Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 48
Grade range: 6
Benchmark job: 200090 - Mechanical Engineer
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

For more information about the position and application process, please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/ep-cms-ec-2026-190-ld/

jobs.title: Workshop Mechanic - Gadbjerg, near Vejle, Denmark
jobs.description:

We run a workshop about 15 km from Vejle in East Jutland, Denmark, in close partnership between GMT and Nordic Rebar ApS. You will be employed by Nordic Rebar ApS, which is based at the workshop.
GMT trades in used machinery for the rebar industry and is a well-known player in the industry across most of the world.

As a workshop mechanic, you will be responsible for keeping the workshop running and the machines in good order. Your tasks will include:

The workshop has an office attached to it, so you will have good colleagues around you, and we have lunch together.

The workshop has modern facilities, including a laser cleaner for removing rust and dirt, and we place great emphasis on the work being carried out safely and properly.

In the workshop itself you will typically be the only mechanic on a daily basis, so you must be able to plan and carry out your tasks independently.

jobs.title: Aquaculture Technician  (Ref no: 454210)
jobs.description:
Working with a team of biologists and engineers, this challenging and demanding position requires the
selected candidate to work in the company's aquatic research facility based in Malta, the largest
private facility of its kind in Europe. The activities carried out at the facility include work on various
aquatic nutrition trials and health related experiments undertaken on a range of freshwater and marine
species of fish, shrimp and live feed; the technician would be involved in all aspects of the daily
operations as well as being involved in specific research assignments.

NOTE: All applicants must have an EU/EEA/UK passport OR be a third-country national (TCN)
presently residing in the EU with the required permits and have an excellent command of the English
language, written and spoken.  

Job description  
A position within the AquaBioTech Group has arisen for a suitably qualified person to work as an
aquaculture / aquatic technician on a variety of research projects at our R&D facility known as ABT
Innovia. The responsibilities of the selected candidate are defined as follows:

Key Accountabilities
. The work is focused on the wet-labs facility of AquaBioTech Group (ABT Innovia), with
primary duties on maintaining livestock and RAS systems. These tasks involve mostly feeding
and health monitoring of the livestock, RAS system maintenance, inspection and
housekeeping, monitoring water quality and experimental trials activities and reporting.
. Day to day coordination and execution of all national and international research projects that
the AquaBioTech Group and its partners are awarded, ensuring that all the research
contracts are managed and executed within the timeframes and budgets provided and all
deliverables are met. This includes ensuring that all SOP and required accreditations, such as
GLP and GMP, are achieved and maintained.
. Be involved in various aspects of the design, engineering and logistics of bringing a RAS
project through to installation and beyond.

Reporting directly to the R&D Facilities Manager, the position is demanding requiring a person who is
highly motivated, methodical and organised. The selected person must be prepared to work to very
tight deadlines in isolated and multi-functional projects and in conjunction with a team of international
staff. AquaBioTech Group has also been awarded, and is continuously seeking to win more, research
projects funded by local government and the EU.

Requirements
. The successful candidate is likely to have a good solid background in aquaculture sciences,
preferably with at least a B.Sc. level of education, although experienced technician candidates are
also encouraged to apply. Experience in laboratory operating procedures and GMP and GLP is
also a bonus, but not essential as all training in these procedures will be provided.
. The selected candidate will be required to speak and write English fluently, and knowledge of any
other languages would be considered an asset, although not essential.
. The selected candidate must have a clean EU / EEA passport OR be a third-country national (TCN)
presently residing in the EU with no travel restrictions or legal convictions and be in possession of
a clean driving licence.

Training provided
Successful candidates will go through our internal onboarding procedure, whereas all information and
documentation will be provided before start date, for information and signing.

Any assistance with accommodation/relocation
AquaBioTech Group offers all employees company accommodation, which comes at cheaper rates
compared to personal renting, and which will be available immediately for new employees to use upon
their arrival. All preparation related to accommodation is handled by the company.

Salary
Euro 17,500 to Euro 19,000 per year.

The successful candidate will be offered a long-term, fixed-term contract with the company. The
starting package offered for this position will be structured largely upon the chosen candidate,
reflecting the experience the candidate brings to the company, but also in line with the cost of living in

How will the interviews be held  
Both online and in-person interviews will be held, depending on the location of the individual.
