jobs.title: Chemical Engineer at CERN
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
You will join a multidisciplinary team developing the next generation of high-performance superconducting radiofrequency (SRF) cavities. In this role, after dedicated training in the team, you will develop and optimise advanced surface treatments essential to their performance, including chemical polishing, electrochemical polishing and electroplating. You will also contribute to the design, procurement, commissioning, and acceptance of a new surface treatment facility dedicated to SRF components.

Your responsibilities:
- Develop, operate and optimise chemical and electrochemical surface-processing techniques for SRF accelerating cavities and their subassemblies.
- Optimise existing processes by developing and conducting laboratory-scale chemical and electrochemical trials, applying multiphysics simulation tools to improve process performance and reproducibility.
- Define technical requirements and coordinate the design, procurement, testing, commissioning and acceptance of new equipment and facilities for the chemical and electrochemical surface finishing of SRF components.
- Develop, validate, document and implement operating procedures, process specifications and quality control methods for the surface finishing of SRF components.
- Work closely with engineers, physicists, technicians, safety specialists and external suppliers, communicating results and technical recommendations through reports, reviews and project meetings.
- Ensure that all necessary safety measures and documentation are kept up to date and effectively implemented across existing and new processes and facilities.

Your profile:
- Strong background in applied electrochemistry and corrosion.
- Field experience in modelling, simulation, developing and optimising chemical or electrochemical treatment processes.
- Good knowledge of chemical engineering unitary operations and chemical process safety.
- Familiarity with electrochemical characterisation techniques.
- Knowledge of materials science, covering both organic and inorganic materials.
- Knowledge of wet surface finishing processes and initial practical experience would be considered an asset.
- Knowledge of metallurgy would be considered an asset.
- Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Chemical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Knowledge of electrochemistry, corrosion and protection.
- Knowledge of metals and alloys: composition, structure, properties, heat treatments.
- Knowledge and application of thermodynamics and energetics.
- Knowledge and application of numerical modelling in fluid mechanics and/or heat transfer.
- Contributes to promoting a positive atmosphere in the team through an optimistic and constructive attitude; addresses issues.
- Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
- Works conscientiously and reliably; delivers on promises.
- Actively promotes safety and encourages others to do the same; respects safety rules and procedures.
- Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Medical hazard
Exposure to carcinogens, mutagens or agents toxic to reproduction.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

jobs.title: Mechanical Technician at Cern
jobs.description:
What you'll do:
You will join a multidisciplinary team responsible for developing more efficient superconducting radiofrequency (SRF) cavities for future CERN accelerators. In this hands-on role, after dedicated training in the team you will contribute to the improvement of thin-film coating technologies through the design, fabrication, commissioning and operation of physical vapour deposition (PVD) equipment.

Your responsibilities:
- Design mechanical components and coating equipment using 3D CAD tools and produce the associated manufacturing and assembly drawings.
- Assemble, install, test, commission and operate physical vapour deposition coating systems and their associated equipment.
- Manufacture and modify metallic and ceramic components using conventional machining and computer numerical control (CNC)-based manufacturing techniques.
- Participate in coating activities, record operating parameters and document process procedures.

jobs.title: Ski service / Ski Technician
jobs.description:
Description of the employer:
Norefjell Skisenter is a ski resort located at Norefjell in Krødsherad, Norway. The resort offers alpine skiing, ski school, ski rental, ski service, ski shop and various guest services and activities during the winter season.

The ski resort employs seasonal and permanent staff across several departments, including ski instructors, ski rental, ski service, ski shop, lift operations, restaurants and guest services. The resort welcomes both Norwegian and international guests throughout the winter season and operates with varying staffing needs depending on guest numbers and seasonal demand.

Job description:
The Ski Technician is responsible for the maintenance, preparation and servicing of skis and snowboards at Norefjell Skisenter. The position involves working primarily in the ski service workshop and handling both the resort's rental equipment fleet and guests' personal equipment.

Main duties and responsibilities:
- Maintain, repair and prepare alpine skis and snowboards for daily use.
- Perform machine and manual ski servicing, including base grinding, edge tuning, waxing and polishing.
- Prepare and maintain the resort's rental ski fleet to ensure that equipment is safe, functional and in good condition.
- Carry out repairs and adjustments to skis, snowboards and bindings within the scope of the position.
- Perform regular inspection and maintenance of rental equipment.
- Service guests' skis and snowboards according to their requirements and the ski service's quality standards.
- Operate and maintain ski service machinery and workshop equipment.
- Identify damage, wear and technical issues and determine the appropriate service or repair.
- Ensure correct handling and preparation of ski and snowboard equipment before it is returned to guests or placed back into the rental fleet.
- Follow safety procedures and manufacturer recommendations when working with machinery and equipment.
- Keep the workshop clean, organised and efficient.
- Provide professional customer service and explain completed services and recommended maintenance to guests when required.
- Cooperate with the ski rental, ski shop and other resort departments.
- Assist with other operational tasks within the ski service department when required.

The position requires good technical understanding of skis and snowboards, attention to detail and an interest in ski equipment and maintenance. Previous experience from a ski workshop or ski service department is preferred. Experience operating professional ski service machinery is an advantage.

The position is seasonal and primarily involves working during the winter season. Working hours may vary from week to week depending on guest numbers and whether the resort is operating during peak or low season. Weekend and public holiday work may be required.

Work experience:
Previous experience from a ski workshop, ski service department or ski rental is preferred. Experience Wintersteiger machines, base grinding, edge tuning, waxing and ski repairs is an advantage.

Technical skills:
Good understanding of alpine skis, snowboards, bindings and related equipment. The candidate should be able to identify damage and wear and carry out appropriate maintenance, repairs and adjustments. Experience operating and maintaining professional ski service machinery is an advantage.

Language:
Good English communication skills are required in order to communicate with colleagues and international guests. Norwegian or other European languages are an advantage.

Certificates and qualifications:
Relevant ski technician or ski service qualifications are an advantage. Training or certification related to machinery operation, workshop safety or equipment maintenance is also beneficial.

Other skills:
The candidate must be precise, quality-oriented and able to work independently. Good organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently during busy periods are required. The candidate must also be service-minded and able to cooperate well with colleagues across different departments.

Additional information:
Norefjell Skisenter can assist with accommodation and rental arrangements. All seasonal employees also receive free access through the toll road to and from the mountain, as well as free parking.
All seasonal employees are also provided with a season pass and employee discounts at the ski shop, ski rental, and restaurants such as Skistua and NON at Norefjell Ski & Spa.

jobs.title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
jobs.description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Lead the certification lifecycle, ensuring game certifications, re-certifications, and market-specific regulatory documentation remain accurate and up to date.
    Ensure games, promotions, configurations, and operational activities comply with jurisdictional and regulatory requirements before release.
    Coordinate regulatory documentation with Compliance, DEVS, Projects, testing laboratories, and game providers.
    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.
    Support internal and external audits by preparing documentation, coordinating evidence, and following up on audit actions.
    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

    Reporting, Improvement & Coordination
    Audit Readiness & Compliance Documentation

Who and what we are after?

    Minimum of 3 years’ experience within the iGaming industry in Compliance, Product Operations, Certification Management, QA, or a similar operational role.
    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.
    Good understanding of casino games, game certifications, regulated markets, and operational compliance requirements.
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.
    Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
    Experience developing or maintaining compliance documentation, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory procedures.
    Experience supporting or leading process improvement and operational governance initiatives.
    Comfortable working with compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and operational metrics.
    An interest in automation and AI-assisted operational processes.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
    Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams.
    Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and regulated environment.
    Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.
    Ability to work collaboratively as part of a team while also working independently and taking ownership of allocated responsibilities.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters to us
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast and lunch prepared every day in our penthouse kitchen – you can save up to €3,000 a year
    Birthday leave – as we want you to celebrate your day
    Company and team-building events – trust us, these are legendary
    Relocation package to Malta, including a flight and two weeks of accommodation
    And much more – see for yourself!

Apply today and be part of our success story!

jobs.title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
jobs.description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

Meet the criteria? Apply today and become part of the Immense Group journey.

As the strategic technology leader for service transformation, the role also provides direction and governance to the IT organization, ensuring technology investments, platforms, and architecture enable the future state of service delivery.

Working in close partnership with Operations leadership to understand service performance, customer needs, and operational challenges through data-driven insights, the role actively uncovers commercial opportunities by identifying new digital capabilities, value-added services, and innovation initiatives that expand the client's service portfolio, strengthen strategic partnerships, and drive sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

Transform traditional BPO delivery into standardized, technology-enabled, and data-driven service models.

Establish scalable frameworks that can be replicated across multiple accounts and business units.



Enterprise Architecture & Technology Leadership

Define the target architecture for digital service delivery and guide the evolution of supporting technology platforms.

Ensure technology decisions support scalability, interoperability, security, governance, and operational excellence.

Lead and steer the IT organization in delivering technology capabilities that support business transformation.

Partner with IT leaders to prioritize investments, modernize platforms, and accelerate innovation.

Challenge existing service delivery models and drive continuous innovation.

Promote Agile, DevSecOps, product-oriented delivery, platform thinking, and automation-first principles across service operations.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technology adoption.



Operational Excellence

Redesign business processes to improve efficiency, quality, resilience, and customer experience.

Establish governance models, KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics that provide end-to-end visibility into service performance.

Standardize processes and operating procedures to improve consistency across accounts.

Ensure transformation initiatives deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes.



Commercial Growth

Identify opportunities to expand service scope through digital capabilities, AI solutions, automation, consulting, and managed services.

Partner with Sales, Account Management, and Client Success teams to develop transformation roadmaps and business cases.

Position the organization as a strategic digital transformation partner for clients.

Support revenue growth through upselling, cross-selling, and innovative service offerings.



Financial & Value Realization

Improve account profitability through technology-enabled productivity gains and optimized delivery models.

Develop business cases that quantify expected benefits, ROI, and cost savings.

Track realization of transformation benefits and continuously optimize value delivery.



Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Lead cross-functional transformation programs involving Operations, IT, Digital, AI, Product, and Client teams.

Mentor operational and technology leaders in digital transformation, enterprise architecture, and modern service delivery practices.

jobs.title: Experienced Large-Format Tile Installer Wanted  Troms, Norway
jobs.description:
Experienced Large-Format Tile Installer Wanted – Tromsø, Norway

We are looking for a highly experienced and independent tile installer for a project in Tromsø, Norway. The work primarily involves the installation of large and thin ceramic tiles/slabs, so we are specifically looking for a specialist with documented experience in large-format installations.

This is not a position for a tile installer who has only worked with standard tile sizes. You must have hands-on experience installing large-format tiles and ceramic slabs where handling, precision, and finish are critical.

Responsibilities

Your work will include:

    Installation of large-format tiles on walls and floors
    Tiles measuring 120 × 120 cm
    Ceramic tiles/slabs measuring 120 × 240 cm or larger
    Thin large-format tiles approximately 6 mm thick
    Measuring, planning, fitting, and cutting
    Safe transportation, lifting, and handling of large tiles/slabs
    Inspection and preparation of substrates
    Application of adhesive with correct and full coverage
    Precise installation, grouting, and finishing
    Independent quality control of completed work

Qualifications

To be considered for this position, you must:

    Have at least 5 years of documented experience working with large-format tiles
    Have hands-on experience with tiles/slabs measuring 120 × 240 cm or larger
    Have experience working with thin tiles approximately 6 mm thick
    Be able to safely handle, lift, cut, and install large-format tiles
    Be able to work independently and plan your own workday
    Be precise, quality-conscious, and solution-oriented
    Be able to document relevant experience through your CV, references, and/or photos from previous projects

General tiling experience without documented large-format experience is not sufficient for this position.

Preferred Qualifications

It is particularly advantageous if you have:

    7–15 years of experience working with large-format tiles
    Experience with ceramic slabs larger than 120 × 240 cm
    Completed full projects involving thin large-format ceramic slabs
    Worked independently throughout the entire process, from substrate inspection to final installation
    References or a project portfolio demonstrating previous large-format work

Employment Conditions

    Location: Tromsø, Norway
    Position: Full-time
    Start: By agreement
    Salary: Based on documented skills and experience
    Candidates with approximately 7–15 years of relevant large-format tile experience can normally expect a salary of around NOK 300–320 per hour

How to Apply

Send your CV together with a clear description of your experience working with large-format tiles to:

Email: andre@wildcarduntap.com

Please use the subject line: Large-Format Tile Installer – Tromsø

Applications from candidates who only have experience with standard or smaller tile formats will not be prioritized.

jobs.title: Work as a nurse in Norways beautiful Vestland Region
jobs.description:
On behalf of municipalities in the Vestland region in Western Norway, we are recruiting registered nurses for permanent full-time positions within local healthcare services.

Vestland is a well-known region on Norway’s west coast, famous for its fjords, mountains and beautiful coastline. The municipalities have a continuous need for qualified nurses in both home care services and nursing homes, where you will play an important role in providing safe and reliable care to patients of all ages.

These positions offer a stable job, a meaningful everyday working life and good opportunities for professional development within the Norwegian public healthcare system. You will work in well-organised teams that focus on cooperation, clear routines and high professional standards.

Your responsibilities

    Clinical nursing in home care, nursing homes or assisted living facilities
    Observation, assessment, medication management and accurate documentation
    Follow-up of patients with diverse medical conditions and functional levels
    Collaboration with relatives, coordinating units and external partners
    Interdisciplinary cooperation with doctors, therapists and other health professionals
    Contributing to service development, improvement work and quality assurance

Most of the available roles are within core municipal services, particularly home nursing and long-term care. Here, you will play a key role in the daily follow-up of patients, whether providing support in their homes or offering comprehensive care in an institutional setting.

Depending on your background and interests, you may also be considered for roles in other municipal healthcare services, such as assisted living facilities, public health clinics or GP practices. This gives you the opportunity to grow in different directions and contribute where your skills are most valuable.

We are looking for nurses who:

    Hold a valid license as a nurse from an EU/EEA country
    Is motivated to obtain Norwegian authorisation (we assist with the process)
    Speak fluent English and are highly motivated to learn Norwegian
    Are willing to complete our free Norwegian language course
    Feel confident in their clinical skills and can manage varied and unpredictable situations
    Work well both independently and as part of a team
    Holds a driver’s license (preferred)

We offer:

    A full-time permanent position in the Norwegian public healthcare system
    Competitive salary and working conditions
    A supportive work environment that values cooperation and professional confidence
    Opportunities for further development and specialization
    Free online Norwegian language course with a private teacher
    Relocation assistance and help with housing
    Personal follow-up throughout the recruitment and relocation process

Life in Vestland

Vestland is a region shaped by fjords, mountains and a long coastline, where nature is a natural part of everyday life. People live in smaller towns and communities with short distances and a calm, well-organised pace of life. The surroundings offer easy access to outdoor activities all year round, without being far from modern services and infrastructure. Life in Vestland is steady, safe and well suited for those who prefer a simpler and more balanced way of living. You can read more about the region here.

Want to know more? Feel free to get in touch for further information, or send us your application.

jobs.title: Danish-speaking Assistance Coordinator in Spain
jobs.description:

What does the role involve?

Your responsibilities will include:

    Answering telephone calls and emails
    Listening to customers and understanding their situation
    Opening and following up on cases
    Providing information about insurance coverage
    Assisting with arrangements involving doctors, clinics, transport, hotels or repatriation when required
    Working with insurance companies, doctors, clinics and other partners

Our assistance centre operates 24/7, and working hours are organised across daytime, evening, night and weekend shifts.

Who are we looking for?

You do not need a particular educational background to apply. What matters most is that you enjoy helping people, communicate well and are comfortable working in a busy environment.

Experience in customer service, travel, healthcare, insurance, hospitality or other people-focused roles may be relevant, but it is not a requirement.

A background in areas such as languages, travel and tourism, healthcare, law, insurance or international studies may also be relevant, but is not required.

We are looking for someone who:

    Speaks and writes Danish fluently
    Speaks and writes English confidently
    Is comfortable communicating by telephone and in writing
    Is organised and accurate
    Enjoys finding solutions
    Works well both as part of a team and independently
    Learns new systems quickly
    Is flexible and positive

Additional languages are an advantage.

To proceed in the recruitment process, you must be able to provide a clean criminal record certificate.

What we offer

    A full-time position in accordance with Spanish employment law
    Thorough and structured training
    A competitive salary and good employment conditions
    A social and inclusive working environment
    Varied working days where you can make a genuine difference
    Opportunities for personal and professional development
    Attractive offices in Torrevieja or Fuengirola

How to apply

Please submit your application and CV. Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on an ongoing basis.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Viking

Viking Travel Care assists travelers and expatriate employees around the world on behalf of travel insurance companies. We coordinate assistance for Nordic travelers and, through our global network of medical providers and partners, provide support in situations ranging from minor travel-related incidents to complex medical emergencies.

Viking Travel Care is part of Viking Assistance Group, a leading Nordic provider of roadside assistance, vehicle-related services and assistance solutions. Viking has offices in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki, Torrevieja and Fuengirola, Spain.

jobs.title: Electromechanical Engineer - Normal-Conducting Magnets
jobs.description:
What you'll do
You will help shape the next generation of normal-conducting accelerator magnets for the Future Circular Collider (FCC), from design and prototyping through industrialisation and system integration. Working with CERN teams and industrial partners, you will develop scalable manufacturing and procurement strategies and apply lessons learned from the testing, maintenance and renovation of existing accelerator magnets to the development and delivery of reliable, cost-effective FCC magnet systems.

Your responsibilities
Design and develop cost-effective normal-conducting magnet technologies for the FCC, from concept and modelling through prototyping and system integration.
Study and propose manufacturing and procurement strategies for FCC magnets, tailored to the scale of the project and targeting an efficient and effective production, installation and maintenance.
Plan, organise and coordinate the maintenance, repair, testing and modification of existing magnets in operation, including specific renovation campaigns, applying the experience gained to the development of FCC magnets.
Prepare technical specifications, reports and other engineering documentation, and communicate technical results to relevant stakeholders.

Your profile
Experience in the design or construction of accelerator magnets or comparable complex electromechanical equipment.
Experience in analysing mechanical or magnetic measurements and using them to validate and improve designs.
Experience in the procurement of magnets or similar equipment, either in industry or in a laboratory, would be an asset.
Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of mechanical or electrical engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Design and modelling of normal conducting magnets and permanent magnet systems.
Operation and maintenance of normal conducting magnet systems.
Design and analysis of mechanical structures.
Knowledge and application of magnetic materials, and electric insulations.

Medical hazard
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

Employment conditions
Interventions in underground installations.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Shift work, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
Work in Radiation Areas.
Operations on low or high voltage electrical installations or in their vicinity requiring a specific authorisation.

For more information please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/electromechanical-engineer-normal-conducting-magnets/

jobs.title: Nurse
jobs.description:
Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

www.ill.eu/careers

jobs.title: Zelfstandig werkende koks I
jobs.description:
DaDa Wan Leidschendam, gevestigd in het grootste winkelcentrum van Nederland zoekt jou!

Bij Dada Wan geniet je van “worldly food with small town prices”. Onze missie is om gasten te verwelkomen met heerlijke, wereldse gerechten tegen een betaalbare prijs.

Voor deze unieke locatie in Leidschendam, naast Den Haag, zoeken wij een kok die ons keukenteam wil komen versterken.

Wat neem je mee als kok?

1. Je voert voorbereidende werkzaamheden uit, waaronder het wassen van groenten, het snijden en fileren van zalm, en het snijden van lamskoteletten en rundvlees voor de bereiding van stoneplate-gerechten. Dit doe je samen met een keukenteam van circa acht collega’s, onder leiding van de chef-kok.

2. Je bereidt en maakt diverse gerechten, waarbij je tussentijdse kwaliteits- en hygiënecontroles uitvoert volgens de geldende richtlijnen.

3. Je maakt gerechten gereed voor uitgifte en voert hierbij een eindcontrole uit, waarna de bedieningsmedewerkers (of robots) de gerechten kunnen bezorgen.

4. Je plant de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en plaatst bestellingen voor voedingsmiddelen en andere voorraadaanvullingen bij vaste leveranciers. Tevens controleer je de geleverde producten op kwaliteit en kwantiteit.

5. Je houdt toezicht op de werkzaamheden van hulpkrachten, geeft instructies en stuurt waar nodig bij.

6. Voor sluitingstijd zorg je voor een schone werkplek, reinig je keukenapparatuur en -machines, en assisteer je eventueel bij het schoonmaken van de gehele keuken en het opslaan van geleverde goederen.

7. Je bent een echte teamspeler, stelt je flexibel op en beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

8. Je draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit, denkt mee over optimalisaties en helpt bij het samenstellen en aanpassen van menukaarten, recepturen en bereidingsinstructies.

Je hebt een afgeronde MBO-3 opleiding (of vergelijkbaar), met kennis van basis kooktechnieken.

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Tule meille palvelupäälliköksi Lapin ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan alueelle!**

Haluatko johtaa omaa palvelualueettasi ja vastata asiakkuuksien, henkilöstön ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä? Meillä työ tehdään vastuullisesti osana luotettavaa tiimiä.

Etsimme tavoitteellista ja kehittämisorientoitunutta palvelupäällikköä, joka nauttii ihmisten johtamisesta, asiakastyöstä ja liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä.

Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnasta kokonaisvaltaisesti. Johdat arjen tekemistä tavoitteellisesti, kehität palvelun laatua ja toimintaa sekä varmistat asiakastyytyväisyyden ja toiminnan kannattavuuden. Samalla huolehdit siitä, että toiminta on sujuvaa, turvallista ja arvojemme mukaista.

Roolissasi toimit keskeisessä asemassa asiakkaiden, henkilöstön ja sisäisten sidosryhmien välillä. Vaikutat suoraan asiakaskokemukseen, henkilöstön onnistumiseen ja liiketoiminnan tuloksellisuuteen sekä ja johdat muutosta sekä kehität toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti.

Tehtävässä vastaat palvelualueesi toiminnan ja asiakassuhteiden johtamisesta sekä niiden kehittämisestä, laadun ja tehokkuuden varmistamisesta sekä myynnillisestä työotteesta ja uusien liiketoimintamahdollisuuksien tunnistamisesta. Arjessa johdat henkilöstöä ja tuet työkykyä sekä vastaat talouden, resurssien ja kannattavuuden kokonaisvaltaisesta hallinnasta.

**Odotamme sinulta**

Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva koulutus, esimerkiksi korkeakoulututkinto. Kokemus esihenkilötehtävistä ja/tai palveluliiketoiminnasta on eduksi, mutta ei välttämätöntä.Ymmärrät talouden tunnuslukuja ja kannattavuuden johtamista. Työskentelet asiakaslähtöisesti ja myynnillisellä otteella, tunnistat asiakkaiden tarpeita ja osaat tarjota niihin toimivia ratkaisuja.

Olet vuorovaikutustaitoinen, oikeudenmukainen ja johdonmukainen esihenkilö, joka osaa motivoida, kehittää ja valmentaa tiimiään arjessa. Toiminnassasi korostuvat vastuullisuus, ratkaisukeskeisyys, liiketoimintalähtöinen ajattelu ja kyky johtaa kokonaisuuksia. Haluat myös aktiivisesti edistää yhdenvertaista ja arvostavaa työyhteisöä.

Tehtävä edellyttää voimassa olevaa ajokorttia sekä oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä työssä liikutaan asiakkaiden ja tiimin tarpeiden mukaisesti eri kohteiden välillä laajalla työskentelyalueella.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vastuullisen roolin liiketoiminnan ytimessä sekä mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ja kehittää toimintaa aidosti.

Lisäksi tarjoamme:

- kilpailukykyisen palkan n. 3400–3800 €/kk kokemuksesta riippuen

- kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan tuen tehtävässä onnistumiseen

- mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja rakentaa urapolkuasi kasvavassa organisaatiossa

- kansainvälisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

- turvallisen ja arvostavan työympäristön reilut työehdot, turvallisen työympäristön ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista huolehtimisen


Työskentelemme joustavasti hybridityömallilla ja työpäivät ovat vaihtelevia asiakkaiden ja oman alueen tarpeiden mukaan.

**Yhdenvertaisuus ja vastuullisuus**

Meille jokainen työntekijä on tärkeä. Johdamme työyhteisöä yhdenvertaisesti ja kohtelemme kaikkia kunnioittavasti – emme hyväksy syrjintää missään muodossa. Huolehdimme turvallisesta työympäristöstä ja työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista sekä toimimme vastuullisesti kaikessa tekemisessä.

**Miksi meille kannattaa tulla töihin**

Meillä viihdytään – työntekijöidemme eNPS on huipputasolla ja arjessamme näkyy arvostus, luottamus ja yhdessä onnistuminen. Olemme saaneet myös tunnustusta työstämme: Vuonna 2024 meidät valittiin Suomen ihmisläheisimmäksi työpaikaksi Vuonna 2025 sijoituimme samassa kategoriassa kolmannelle sijalle Vuonna 2025 saavutimme 3. sijan Suomen ihmisläheisin työelämäteko -kategoriassa

**Hae mukaan rakentamaan kasvutarinaamme!**

**Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 14.9.2026.** Ensimmäinen haastattelukierros pidetään Kuusamossa 1.10.2026, varaathan päivän etukäteen itsellesi.

Procurement Analyst is a specialist analytical role responsible for developing pricing strategy, conducting commercial data analysis, and leading supplier negotiation and category sourcing strategy to support the profitable expansion of the business. Proven ability to conduct commercial negotiation and develop sourcing strategy. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to translate data into strategic recommendations for senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Customer Service Containerlogistiek
jobs.description:
Onze klant is een internationale speler in de logistieke sector, actief in de ruime regio rond de haven van Antwerpen. Ze combineren de slagkracht van een wereldwijd netwerk met de warme en open sfeer van een familiebedrijf. Met een sterke focus op intermodaal transport zorgen zij er dagelijks voor dat goederen efficiënt en veilig op hun bestemming geraken.

In deze rol als Customer Service Containerlogistiek ben jij de spil in het plannen en opvolgen van intermodaal transport, met een focus op containervervoer. Je streeft continu naar de perfecte balans tussen een top service voor de klant en een efficiënte inzet van transportmiddelen. Met jouw proactieve communicatie en overzicht zorg je dat alle partijen precies weten waar ze aan toe zijn en stuur je bij waar nodig.

Functieomschrijving

  • Inplannen en nauwgezet opvolgen van intermodaal containervervoer via weg, spoor en binnenwateren.
  • Proactief informeren van klanten en internationale agenten over de status van hun zendingen.
  • Intensief afstemmen van de dagelijkse planning met de interne operationele afdelingen.
  • Verwerken en oplossen van klachten of afwijkingen in de dossiers.
  • Nauwkeurig registreren van alle rit- en klantgegevens in de interne systemen.
  • Meedenken over het nog efficiënter inrichten van werkprocessen en communicatie.

Profiel

  • Je beschikt over een eerste leidinggevende ervaring of bent een ervaren planner die klaar is voor een stap als teamlead binnen de logistiek of expeditie.
  • Grondige kennis van transportprocessen en intermodaal containervervoer
  • Je weet mensen te motiveren, communicaties vlot te stroomlijnen en bewaart de rust in hectische situaties.
  • Collega's omschrijven jou als besluitvaardig, organisatorisch sterk en mensgericht.

jobs.title: Safari Guide, Lapland Safaris Levi
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Safari Guides for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the winter season 2026–2027. We are looking for Safari Guides to work in Luosto, Levi, Saariselkä, Ylläs and Olos.**

As a Safari Guide, you get to introduce our international guests to the magnificent nature of Finnish Lapland and guide them through adventure activities. You may act as a guide, for example, on a snowshoe safari at the top of a fell, take the guests on a visit to a reindeer farm and a husky kennel, or snowmobile into the snowy forest to see the Northern Lights. In some of our destinations a part of safari guides job is to also guide various bus tours.

Your work tools can be snowmobiles, ice fishing gear, e-fatbikes, skis and snowshoes. As a guide, your workdays consist of preparing for the safari programs, meeting the guests before the safaris, as well as taking care of the clothing of your guests. You will help them dress up properly before each safari and after the activity you will take care of the clothes that you provided such as overalls, socks, boots and gloves. One of the most essential parts of the job is to help dress our guests with winter clothes, and all our safari guides work as part of our equipment team. After the safaris, cleaning and maintaining the equipment used on safaris is an important part of a safari guides daily routine as well. Whatever you do, every day you get to see the excitement on your guests faces as they prepare for new and unique experiences!

We are looking for people who enjoy being outdoors regardless of the weather and to maintain a positive attitude even on long and busy days. Your workdays are rarely the same, and a working day can consist of one or several different tasks, and a lot of work is also done in the evening. Changes to your daily tasks may come with short notice.

In addition to outdoor work, variation to your days comes from indoor clothing maintenance work. Work tasks and guest groups vary a little between destinations. The guides we are looking for are versatile and multitalented, with an open attitude towards different work tasks.

**In all our destinations,** knowledge of French language, is considered an advantage. We train our employees in first aid skills, but we value previously acquired first aid skills as well. At least a class B driver's license is an essential requirement for the job. BE driver's license and experience of driving a 9-seater vehicle in snowy conditions are considered advantageous, as well as knowledge of the area. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

**In Luosto,** the safari guides may act as elf guides during the Christmas season. **In Luosto and Levi**, knowledge of French language (fluent) is a prerequisite.

**We expect from you:**

- Positive attitude and excellent cooperation and interaction skills

- Customer service-focused and group management skills

- Flexibility and ability to work under pressure

- Passion for outdoors and Interest in Finnish Laplands nature, culture and history

- Fluent English - knowledge of French, German, Italian or Spanish is considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Fun working days and a supportive team

- The opportunity to learn about the nature of the north

- Numerous leisure opportunities enjoying the real winter

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides for new employees a paid Arctic Guide -course at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and will last until the end of March 2027, in Rovaniemi a few positions end already mid-January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, minimum hourly wage between 10,80-13,60 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

**In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required.**

If you need a work permit or visa for Finland, **we must be able to process your application in time** due to the length of the permit process. You can check your work permit requirements here: https://migri.fi/en/home

The employee pays and applies for the work permit themselves, with the assistance of Lapland Staff. Please submit your job application to us before the following dates:

Work permit for seasonal work (whole winter season, over 3 months in Finland): **10.8.**

Visa: **10.8.**

Certificate for seasonal work (Christmas season, less than 3 months in Finland): **10.9.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineers and Architects
jobs.description:
Nolwenture was established in 2012 and continues to grow and adapt, with an exciting portfolio of national and international clients across many industry sectors. We work together to make our clients' vision a reality and enable their core operations to be more efficient. In 2025 we became part of the ProVerse Group, who were a customer and for whom we continue to work with to create immersive experiences, with the communication and visualisation needed for remote operations. Nolwenture remains independent to offer a wide range of software development services. We are now looking for:

**Senior Software Engineers and Architects**

The Senior Software Engineers at Nolwenture are responsible for supporting both client and internal projects, playing to the individual's strengths within the project team – in the role of Lead Developer, Product Owner or Project Manager.

As a senior developer, you will work with modern technologies that are kept up-to-date by the entire team's contributions in order to keep our best practices current and ahead of the game. You will also support mid-level, junior and trainee level team members with their project tasks and broader learning and development.

You will work directly with our clients throughout the project lifecycle; gathering requirements, managing expectations, and helping to plan and coordinate delivery alongside the wider team.

For even more experienced and skilled candidates we also offer Architect level appointments.

**Why work with us?**

We are more than just software coders. At the core of our value proposition is the strength of our team, highly experienced and with diverse backgrounds and interests. We invest in our people, tools and processes, technical skills and capabilities.

Our shared mindset and strong ethics are reflected in our working culture. Everyone has a voice across the company, as it should be in a creative industry, where we have trust and a safe environment to innovate.

**Requirements**

We expect you to

- possess a strong understanding about software development

- have a desire to work on both web and mobile applications

- comply with our documentation processes and best practices

- be fluent in English as it is our operating language

- have good communication skills; at Nolwenture we work very closely with our clients

- be comfortable working directly with clients and confident taking on light project management responsibilities (e.g. previous experience as a Scrum Product Owner or had Scrum Master duties or having run sessions on story mapping or requirement gathering)

- be willing to adapt to our ways, learn new stuff and challenge yourself

- (and this is important!) readily ask others for help and return help where needed

- be familiar with, or keen to work with, Claude Code and other AI-assisted development tools as part of our everyday workflow


We work with a variety of programming languages, but a JavaScript background will suit us well as we use a lot of NodeJS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React and React Native.

You will benefit from knowing additional languages (e.g. Swift, Kotlin and Python) and being familiar with Scrum project methodology and tools within the Atlassian suite (Jira, Tempo, Confluence). A background in areas such as Unity, WebRTC stream processing, DevOps, UI, robotics or GIS, or other data visualisation and physics / simulations experience, DB (sql/postgres etc.), administration (DBA) is of interest to us too.

Furthermore, an interest or experience in AI/ML will be highly appreciated.

**Work location**

Joensuu headquarters ideally. Other possible locations include Kuopio and Helsinki, and working remotely is also a long-term option.

**How to apply**

We are only accepting applications from candidates with a Finnish residence permit for work or EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship. Please send an email with a covering note along with your CV to recruitment@nolwenture.com and we will explain the process further from there onwards.

**_Want to know more about us? Please visit our website for further information https://nolwenture.com/_**

jobs.title: Research Assistant
jobs.description:
The iCell (Immune Cell Therapy Research Group) at the Finnish Red Cross Blood Service, Research and Development, invites applications for a one-year fixed-term position as a Research Assistant. Our laboratory is located at the Biomedicum 1, Helsinki.
The iCell research group at Finnish Red Cross Blood Service is a dynamic research group dedicated to advancing novel immunotherapies against cancer. Our primary interest lies in the research and development of CAR-T and CAR-NK cell therapies, aiming at addressing current clinical needs through innovative product development.

Our research focuses on NK cell modifications, expansion, persistence, and killing efficacy. We employ various techniques, including primary cell culture, base editing, flow cytometry, lentiviral transduction, cytotoxic assays, and in vivo models.

We have an opening for a motivated Research Assistant to work on genetic modifications and gene editing of CAR-NK cells to enhance their efficacy against cancer.

Main responsibilities

Performing laboratory experiments related to immune cell engineering and characterization
Conducting cell culture, molecular biology, and gene editing procedures
Assisting in data collection and documentation
Maintaining laboratory records and inventories
Supporting laboratory organization, equipment maintenance, and general operations
Collaborating with researchers and other team members in ongoing projects

Qualifications

The successful candidate holds a relevant degree in life sciences, biotechnology, biomedicine, or a related field and has practical laboratory experience, particularly in cell culture techniques.

Experience in one or more of the following areas is considered an advantage:
Immunology
Molecular biology
Gene editing technologies
GLP/GMP-compliant laboratory work

Bioinformatics expertise is considered an additional asset when combined with experience in one or more of the areas listed above.

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated and proactive individual with a strong interest in laboratory-based research and development. They should be eager to learn new methods and technologies and possess excellent collaboration and communication skills.

What we offer

At the Blood Service, you will become part of a unique chain of help with voluntary donors and healthcare staff. We offer you an interesting and meaningful task as part of a motivated and professional team. Comprehensive orientation and support from your supervisor and team will help you get started in your work and develop in your own role. The well-being of our employees is particularly important to us: we invest in the well-being of our personnel e.g. by offering a wide range of sports and well-being benefits (see the list of benefits below). Read more about Blood Service as a workplace [here.](https://www.veripalvelu.fi/en/work-with-us/)

The position has a fixed term of one year with the possibility of extension subject to project funding.

The salary for this position is determined in accordance with the Collective Agreement for the Terveyspalveluala. The position is classified in Salary Grade 4, with a base salary of EUR 2847,83 per month for a full-time employee. In addition to the base salary, remuneration includes a personal salary component, which incorporates a length-of-service guarantee.

In this position, lentiviruses are handled, which might cause a health risk to an HIV-positive person. Therefore, this position is not suitable for an HIV-positive person, and the selected individual must regularly present an acceptable statement from occupational health services regarding their medical fitness.

How to apply and inquiries

In your application, please detail your experimental skills in cell culture, immunology, molecular biology, GLP/GMP-work, and gene editing, the duration of your experience with these techniques, and your motivation for research, development and lab work. Include preferably two possible references.

For more information on the position, please contact iCell group leader Helka Göös (helka.goos@bloodservice.fi).
Please submit your application through our electronic recruitment system. Applications submitted by email will not be considered.


Benefits


- Culture, sports, well-being and commuting benefits (Epassi)

- Extended occupational health care

- Lunch benefit

- Commuting exercise incentive

- Long vacations

- Employee sports benefits



Finnish Red Cross Blood Service

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service provides hospitals with safe and effective blood products and laboratory services that are essential for patient care. We also maintain the Stem Cell Registry and the Blood Service Biobank.

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service is a non-profit organization. Our annual budget is approximately EUR 60 million, and we employ around 500 people.

The Finnish Red Cross Blood Service conducts active scientific research to advance biomedical knowledge in our areas of expertise. Read more about our Research Strategy [here](https://www.veripalvelu.fi/en/research/research-strategy/).

Email: hr@veripalvelu.fi Location: Haartmaninkatu 8

jobs.title: Work flexibly, earn extra - Join Imercos Black Friday Team!
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a temporary job in November and December, with the opportunity to earn extra money and gain valuable work experience? Do you enjoy being physically active and working at a fast pace? Then now is the time to seize the opportunity!

We are looking for motivated and hardworking temporary workers for Imerco’s warehouse in Vallensbæk. You will help ensure that thousands of Danes receive their Christmas presents on time.

The job requires that you can work 4 shifts per week during the period from November 20 to December 12. It is essential that you are available to work on the weekends of November 28–29 and December 5–6.

Your primary task will be packing online orders for private customers. You will work at a packing station and handle a wide range of products – from Christmas decorations and kitchen equipment to electronics and gift items. The products must be securely packed in cardboard boxes so that they arrive safely at the customer.

On a typical working day, you will pack approximately 100–150 boxes, depending on the size of the orders.

We expect you to:

  • Have a good eye for detail – especially during the busy Christmas period, when accuracy is important

  • Be reliable, punctual, and able to take responsibility for your shifts

  • Be physically fit enough to stand and work actively throughout the day

  • Have good energy and a positive attitude, even when the pace is high

  • Be available for 4 shifts per week from November 20 to December 12

  • Be available to work on November 28–29 and December 5–6

Experience from warehouse work, retail, or other physically demanding jobs is an advantage, but not a requirement. The most important things are that you are hardworking and willing to put in an effort during the busiest months of the year.

We also offer an exciting temporary position in a well-established and busy retail company, where you will become part of a strong team with great team spirit. You will have the opportunity to work morning, evening, or night shifts, while earning extra money during the busy season.

We offer a total hourly wage of DKK 156.39 per hour. In addition, evening, night, and weekend supplements are provided.

Employment terms

jobs.title: Pædagog til Eventyrhuset - Børnehave i Dragør
jobs.description:
Brænder du for nærvær, fællesskab og faglighed?
Drømmer du om en hverdag, hvor du kan gøre en forskel - og samtidig have tid og rum til at udvikle din pædagogiske praksis? Så læs videre!

Vi søger en engageret og fagligt stærk pædagog til vores børnehave i Eventyrhuset - en privat, integreret daginstitution i smukke Dragør. Hos os får du ikke bare et arbejde, men en arbejdsplads med hjerte, højt til loftet og stor mulighed for både medbestemmelse og udvikling.

Om Eventyrhuset

Eventyrhuset består af to afdelinger med i alt ca. 110 børn - ca. 44 vuggestuebørn og ca. 66 børnehavebørn. Vores personalegruppe tæller omkring 30 dedikerede medarbejdere: pædagoger, medhjælpere, køkkenpersonale, gårdmand og administration.

Eventyrhuset har som privat institution en institutionsbestyrelse med det øverste ansvar for driften, økonomien og personalet, samt en engageret forældrebestyrelse som sikrer forældrenes stemme i beslutningsprocesserne og står for de sociale aktiviteter som sommerfest, julefest mm.

Børnehaven - hvor tryghed, leg og læring går hånd i hånd

I vores børnehave er der tre grupper med, hver med en normering på 22 børn. Hver gruppe har en fast stab bestående af to pædagoger og to medhjælpere.

Vi prioriterer fællesskab og samarbejde - både mellem børn og voksne og på tværs af stuerne. Hos os kender alle børn alle voksne, og det giver en tryg og tillidsfuld atmosfære i hverdagen.

Vi arbejder løbende med at styrke vores pædagogiske praksis, og vi har et fælles fokus på relationer, nærvær og det enkelte barns trivsel og udvikling.

Din rolle som pædagog

Som pædagog i Eventyrhusets børnehave bliver du en del af en fast gruppe, hvor du - sammen med dine 3 stuekollegaer - får ansvaret for ca. 22 børn.

Vi tror på, at kvalitet kræver tid og forberedelse. Derfor har du som pædagog hos os hver uge 2 timer afsat til "andet arbejde", som f.eks. planlægning, refleksion og dokumentation - uden børn.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok og hjælper hinanden på tværs af stuer og faggrupper.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

·       Har en uddannelse som pædagog.

·       Er professionel, omsorgsfuld og initiativrig.

·       Brænder for relationer, leg og nærvær i det pædagogiske arbejde.

·       Er god til at samarbejde og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet.

·       Har IT-kompetencer på brugerniveau (fordel, men ikke et krav).

Hvad får du hos os?

·       Mulighed for selv at vælge ugentligt timeantal.

·       2 timers forberedelsestid hver uge.

·       Betalt madordning med sund og lækker frokost.

·       Firma-betalt sundhedsforsikring - også for dine hjemmeboende børn.

·       Betalt ICDP-kursus, hvis du ikke allerede er uddannet.

·       En hverdag i skønne omgivelser med masser af udeliv.

·       Et sted, hvor nytænkning og faglig udvikling er en del af kulturen.

·       Ingen lukkedage i sommerferien, så du er selv med til at styre hvornår du holder ferie.

Ansættelsesvilkår

·       Stillingen er på det antal timer, som passer dig bedst.

·       Start: Hurtigst muligt - men vi venter gerne på den rette.

·       Løn og vilkår efter overenskomst med BUPL og Børneringen.

·       Vi indhenter børne- og straffeattest og referencer som en del af processen.

Klar til nye eventyr?

Hvis du har spørgsmål eller er nysgerrig på stillingen, så kontakt os endelig. Vi giver gerne en rundvisning, så du kan mærke stemningen selv. Du kan også læse mere om Eventyrhuset på vores hjemmeside: www.eventyrhuset.info.

Send din ansøgning og CV til post@eventyrhuset.info eller kontakt os på tlf. 28760260, hvis du vil besøge os først.

Vi holder samtaler løbende, og lukker annoncen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Eventyrhuset… Her bliver hverdagens øjeblikke til noget helt særligt

Arbejdsopgaver

  • Renoveringsopgaver

  • Reparation og udskiftning af VVS-installationer

jobs.title: Lindebjerg A/S søger en Mekaniker til teknisk klargøring
jobs.description:
VIL DU VÆRE EN DEL AF EN LANDSDÆKKENDE SUCCES?

Er du en praktisk anlagt person med hænderne godt skruet på – og har du lyst til at blive en vigtig del af et stærkt team i vækst? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi søger en effektiv og engageret mekaniker til vores afdeling i Middelfart, hvor du bliver en del af et dedikeret team, der sikrer høj kvalitet i vores produkter – både før og efter levering til kunderne.

️ Hvad skal du lave?

Som mekaniker får du en alsidig hverdag med både klargøring og tekniske opgaver. Dine primære arbejdsområder vil være:

 

  • ✅ Reparation og servicering af kundescootere

  • ✅ Teknisk klargøring af nye og brugte scootere

  • ✅ Montering af ekstraudstyr

  • ✅ Kvalitetssikring og slutkontrol

  • ✅ Vedligeholdelse og orden i værkstedet sammen med dine kollegaer

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har teknisk snilde og evt. erfaring fra værksted eller lignende

  • Er mødestabil, struktureret og går op i kvalitet

  • Trives med både rutineprægede og varierende opgaver

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungerer godt i et team

  • Er fleksibel og klar til at tage fat, når der er travlt

Erfaring med el-køretøjer eller reparation er en fordel – men ikke et krav. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En spændende hverdag med masser af ansvar og variation

  • Et uformelt og hjælpsomt arbejdsmiljø med gode kollegaer

  • Gode arbejdsforhold og en arbejdsplads i vækst

  • Mulighed for at blive en del af en landsdækkende virksomhed med ambitioner

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og CV med billede til job@lindebjerg.dk. Skriv "Mekaniker" i emnefeltet.

Der afholdes løbende samtaler, så vi opfordrer interesserede kandidater til at søge snarest muligt.

Om Lindebjerg

DEN GODE SERVICE ER DET VIGTIGSTE FOR OS
Det er vores fornemste opgave at have tilfredse kunder. Dette opnår vi ved at sætte vores kunder i centrum ved altid at være service minded, have top engagerede og kompetente medarbejdere, sælge kvalitetsprodukter, samt altid at være omstillingsparate, så vi kan tilpasse os vores kunders behov.

Lindebjerg er blandt landets absolut førende leverandører af el-køretøjer indenfor vores branche. Vi har solgt mere end 15000 køretøjer, som i dag kører på de danske landeveje.

Virksomheden er landsdækkende. Vores hovedkontor er placeret i Middelfart og lokationen råder over hele 2600 kvadratmeter fordelt på showroom, lager, værksted og administration. Udover vores hovedkontor, har vi showrooms fordelt i hele Danmark, derved kan vi altid være tæt på vores kunder. Vi er netop i gang med åbning af to nye showrooms, herudover har vi lokationer i Aabenraa, Esbjerg, Holstebro, Aalborg, Aarhus, Odense, Sorø, Hillerød og København.

Hos Lindebjerg sætter vi en ære i at omsætte ideer til handling og sidder derfor også med helt fremme i bussen når det handler om at forretningsudvikle, inden for branchen. 
I dagligdagen tilbyder vi stor frihed under ansvar og vægter det sunde arbejdsmiljø og godt kollegaskab, i et uformelt miljø, højt.

jobs.title: Vastuumyyjä iCare secondhand myymälään Kallioon
jobs.description:
**Vastuumyyjä, iCare Hyväntekeväisyysmyymälä**

**Sijainti:** Helsinki, Kallio

**Työsuhde:** Määräaikainen vanhempainvapaan sijaisuus 1.11.2026-30.9.2027

**Työaika:** Osa-aikainen 32 h/vko

**Palkkaus:** Kaupan alan TES, tuntipalkka 13,66€-15,64€/h+ vastuumyyjälisä 5% (\*palkka tarkistetaan 1.10.26, jolloin tulee tulee voimaan uudet vaativuusluokat, palkka kuitenkin vähintään kuten ilmoitettu)

Haluatko yhdistää asiakaspalvelun, second hand -maailman ja hyvän tekemisen? Pelastusarmeija avaa talvella uuden iCare Hyväntekeväisyysmyymälän Helsingin Kallioon, ja etsimme nyt myymälän operatiiviseen vetovastuuseen innostunutta, vastuullista ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä vastuumyyjää.

iCare-myymälät ovat osa Pelastusarmeijan hyväntekeväisyystyötä. Myymälöissä tarjotaan asiakkaille laadukkaita second hand -tuotteita ja samalla tuetaan Pelastusarmeijan auttamistyötä Suomessa. Tutustu toimintaamme: https://www.pelastusarmeija.fi/icare-myymalat

**Mitä pääset tekemään?**

Vastuumyyjänä olet tärkeässä roolissa luomassa erinomaista asiakaskokemusta ja varmistamassa myymälän sujuvaa arkea.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat:

- Asiakaspalvelu, myyntityö ja kassatyöskentely

- Positiivisen ja viihtyisän asiakaskokemuksen varmistaminen

- Työntekijöiden ohjaaminen päivittäisessä työssä

- Myymälän yleisilmeen, tuotteiden esillepanon ja siisteyden ylläpitäminen

- Tuotteiden vastaanotto, lajittelu, arviointi ja hinnoittelu

- Taka- ja varastotilojen sekä logistiikan koordinointi

- Tavarankierron ja päivittäisten prosessien sujuvuuden varmistaminen

- Sosiaalisen median sisällöntuotanto yhdessä tiimin kanssa

- Kuukausitilitysten laatiminen ja raportointi myymälätoiminnan esihenkilölle


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta asiakaspalveluun ja myyntityöhön

- Hyviä organisointi- ja priorisointitaitoja

- Itseohjautuvaa ja vastuullista työotetta

- Positiivista asennetta ja hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja

- Kykyä toimia osana tiimiä ja ohjata päivittäistä tekemistä

- Kiinnostusta kiertotalouteen ja second hand -toimintaan

- Sitoutumista yhteisiin tavoitteisiin

- Valmiutta fyysiseen työskentelyyn


**Eduksi katsomme**

- Kokemuksen asiakaspalvelu- ja myyntityöstä

- Kokemuksen vaatemyymälän ylläpidosta

- Kokemuksen työntekijöiden ohjaamisesta tai tiimin vetämisestä

- Kokemuksen second hand -alalta

- Tietämyksen vaatemateriaaleista, tuotemerkeistä ja second hand -hintatasosta

- Sosiaalisen median osaamisen


**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Mahdollisuuden osallistua uuden iCare-myymälän käynnistämiseen

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävänkuvan

- Lämminhenkisen työyhteisön ja ihanat asiakkaat

- Mahdollisuuden yhdistää kiinnostuksesi muotiin, kiertotalouteen ja hyväntekeväisyyteen

- Merkityksellisen työn osana Pelastusarmeijan auttamistyötä

- Työterveyshuollon

- Epassi-edun sekä muut henkilöstöedut


**Tietoa Pelastusarmeijasta**

Pelastusarmeijan työn päämäärä on auttaa ihmistä kokonaisvaltaisesti. Työhön kuuluu mm. sosiaalinen apu, ruoka-apu, aikuisten harrastustoiminta, lasten ja nuorten kerhot, leirit, pyhäkoulu sekä hengelliset tilaisuudet. Pelastusarmeijalla on lasten päiväkoteja ja leiritoimintaa, sosiaalipalvelukeskus, vanhusten hoitokoti, asumispalvelua sekä iCare Hyväntekeväisyys- sekä kirpputorimyymälöitä. Hyväntekeväisyystyömme painopisteessä ovat kotimaan vähävaraiset lapsiperheet, yksinäiset vanhukset ja syrjäytymisvaarassa olevat nuoret. Kotimaan avuntarvitsijoiden tukemiseksi järjestämme vuosittain Joulupata- ja Auta ihmistä -keräykset. Tuemme kansainvälisen Pelastusarmeijan työtä mm. kummilapsitoiminnan ja katastrofikeräysten avulla.

**Näin haet**

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian rekrytointijärjestelmän kautta. Liitä mukaan:

- CV

- Hakemus

- Suosittelijoiden yhteystiedot


Hakuaika päättyy **21.9.2026**, mutta käsittelemme hakemuksia ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Haastattelut voidaan aloittaa jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä, joten kannattaa hakea mahdollisimman pian.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.

Lisätiedot: Soittoaika maanantaina 14.9 kello 10-13, Myymälätoiminnan esihenkilö Susan Hillenbrand p. 0505990279
