jobs.title: Purchaser
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by keeping materials moving, solving supply challenges and working closely with suppliers?

In this role, you will play an important part in ensuring material availability and reliable supply chain execution across Tanas operations.



Your responsibilities:

As a Purchaser, you are responsible for day-to-day operational purchasing. You ensure that materials and components are ordered, confirmed and delivered according to business needs, supplier agreements and production requirements.

You create, maintain and follow up purchase orders based on material demand, purchase requisitions, stock requirements and agreed supplier terms. You actively monitor supplier confirmations, delivery schedules and open orders, and work proactively to secure timely deliveries.

You also maintain accurate purchasing information in our ERP system and support the resolution of discrepancies between invoices, receipts and purchase orders.

You communicate regularly with suppliers to follow order status, delivery schedules, shortages, and possible changes. When needed, you coordinate corrective actions, identify delivery risks and escalate critical shortages, delays or supplier performance issues to the relevant stakeholders.

You collaborate closely with internal stakeholders in operations, production, logistics, finance and other relevant functions, as well as with external suppliers. Through your work, you help ensure that information flows smoothly and operations can run reliably across the organization.



What we expect from you:

We are looking for someone with relevant education in supply chain management, logistics, business administration, engineering or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also provide a strong foundation for succeeding in the role.

You have previous experience in purchasing, supply chain coordination, logistics, production planning or a similar operational role. You understand order-to-delivery processes and have basic commercial knowledge of prices, lead times and delivery terms.

Experience in ERP systems is required, and previous experience with NetSuite is considered a strong advantage. Experience in heavy machinery, industrial equipment, manufacturing or a similar operational environment is strongly preferred.

You work systematically and accurately, but you are also able to react quickly and prioritize when urgent material needs or delivery challenges arise. You communicate confidently with suppliers, take ownership of open issues and approach problems with a practical and solution-oriented mindset.

Success in this role also requires strong cooperation skills and the ability to work effectively with different functions and stakeholders. Fluency in written and spoken Finnish and English is required.



What we offer:

You will join a professional and collaborative Operations team where your work has a direct impact on material availability, operational continuity and the reliability of our global supply chain.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to deepen your purchasing and supply chain expertise in an international technology company. You will work with a broad supplier network and collaborate across functions, giving you a comprehensive view of Tanas operations and supply chain.

Our working culture is down-to-earth and pragmatic, with a strong focus on openness, cooperation and getting things done together. At Tana, you will contribute to solutions that improve efficiency in waste management and support a more sustainable future.

If you are ready to take on an important role in operational purchasing and help us build a reliable, responsive supply chain, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Preferably Jyväskylä, other locations negotiable.



For more information, please contact Henrik Häggblom, VP Services & Operations, tel. +358 40 75 19027, during the following times:

Friday 11th September 12:00-13:00, Monday 14th September 12:00-13:00 or Tuesday 22nd September 13:00-14:00.



Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 27 September 2026. Please note that interviews may be conducted during the application period as suitable candidates are identified.




Tana Oy

TANA From Waste to Value®

Tana Oy is a Finnish environmental technology company founded in 1971. We are one of the leading developers and providers of mobile equipment and solutions for solid waste management focusing on waste treatment companies and waste yards.

The company slogan is TANA From Waste to Value®. We not only produce the best fit-for-purpose machines designed to reduce the environmental impact of waste, but also provide tailored life cycle services, supported by a strong local presence and expertise. Our commitment to sustainability and core competence in innovative R&D ensure that we not only meet but exceed industry standards, delivering efficient solutions to our customers worldwide. Nowadays TANA machines are exported to more than 50 countries.

jobs.title: Ordinarie servitör/barservitör med intresse för öl och bryggeri
jobs.description:
Park Alandia Hotell är ett hotell med 90 rum. I hotellet finns Park Restaurang & Bar med 70 sittplatser i restaurangen och 60 platser i baren. Här finns även en konferens- och festvåning och snyggaste poolen i stan! Skön live musik spelas fredag-lördag året om och vår uteservering med ca 90 sittplatser har många soltimmar. Hotellet kan från sensommaren 2026 även stoltsera med sitt egna bryggeri.

Park Alandia Hotell är ett familjeägt bolag där laganda, att ha kul på jobbet och att brinna för det man gör står i fokus. Hos oss jobbar 25 personer året runt och nu behöver vi förstärkning av en pigg och glad kollega till vår restaurang och bar.

Vi söker dig som brinner för öl och utöver servering i bar, restaurang och konferens även kan bistå vår bryggtekniker vid ölprovningar. Tids nog ser vi gärna att du även kan hålla egna provningar. Hos oss arbetar vi alla tillsammans som ett team mot gemensamma mål och vår ambition är att varje gäst ska trivas och få en härlig upplevelse hos oss. Det är med stolthet vi serverar god mat, drinkar och inom kort även öl från vårt egna bryggeri.

**Dina arbetsuppgifter**

Vi söker dig som är noggrann och tycker om att ge gästen det lilla extra. Arbetsuppgifterna består av följande:

- Servera

- Duka av och på

- Kassahantering

- Blanda drinkar

- Bistå vid och även hålla ölprovningar

- Övrigt förekommande serveringsuppgifter


**Personliga egenskaper**

Som medarbetare hos oss behöver du vara serviceinriktad och alltid sträva efter att ge våra gäster den bästa helhetsupplevelsen. Som person är du positiv, ansvarstagande, stresstålig, har lätt för att samarbeta, och har förståelse för att alla arbetskamrater är värdefulla. Du har god struktur i ditt arbete samt ordning och reda runt om dig.

**Kvalifikationskrav**

Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete med servering. Du behöver kunna svenska och engelska. Finska är mycket meriterande. Du behöver vara minst 20 år gammal samt ha alkopass/serveringspass.

**Varaktighet**

Tjänsten är på hel- eller deltid hos oss på Park Restaurang & Bar. Serveringsjobbet är skiftesarbete med ett rullande arbetsschema med kvällspass under veckans alla dagar. Anställningen börjar enligt överenskommelse, så snart som möjligt.

**Lön**

Lön enligt överenskommelse.

Vi ser framemot att läsa din ansökan och hoppas du skickar in den tillsammans med din CV redan idag till jobb@parkalandia.com ! Sista ansökningsdag är den 30.9.2026 men intervjuer kommer att ske löpande och platsen kan bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdag. Har du frågor kontakta Lizette på tel. 018-14130.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you ready to embark on a transformative journey to decarbonize the maritime industry?
We are looking for a Process Engineer willing to mix creativity and engineering skills to develop design of fuel systems for the marine industry.
The preferred location for this position is Vaasa (Finland) but also Helsinki, Turku (Finland), Trieste (Italy) are negotiable.

Your role and responsibilities
As a Process Engineer you will have the possibility to follow the entire lifecycle of our products from initial design to operational support through manufacturing, installation and commissioning at shipyard.
Your work will mainly focus on engineering solutions for fuel supply systems for LNG, Methanol and Ammonia.
You will be responsible of the design of piping & instrument diagrams (P&ID) and defining process equipment (pumps, heat exchangers, compressors etc.). You will also be responsible for creating thermodynamic and pressure drop calculations/simulations, developing operating procedures and other supporting technical documents for the fuel supply system.
In this position you will be part of an international team working in close collaboration with other engineering disciplines as well as with customers, classification societies, suppliers and other stakeholders. Youll also have the opportunity to play an active role in the constant development activities for the fuel supply systems for all the fuels.

Requirements for the position:
* MSc in Chemical and Process Engineering or Energy Technology
* Knowledge of the marine/shipbuilding industry is seen as an advantage
* Experience with AutoCAD
* Experience with Process simulation software (AspenTech, MATLAB, AFT Fathom)


Qualifications/to be able to succeed in the position we expect you to have:
* Good technical knowledge and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work independently
* Responsible, flexible, proactive, stress-resistant and planning skills
* Fluency in the English language, both written and verbal
* Good communication and collaboration skills


The primary location for this role is Finland but this role can also be based in Italy where the annual salary range would be 27 887 EUR – 39 270 EUR , depending on seniority, and in accordance with the salary provisions in the National Collective Labor Agreement for workers in the metalworking and plant installation industry (CCNL Metalmeccanico). At Wärtsilä, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. This range reflects the expected compensation for the role, based on market data and our job architecture. The final salary offered will depend on factors such as the scope and responsibilities of the role, the required competencies, and your relevant education, skills, and experience. We also take internal equity into account to ensure fairness across our organisation.

Why you and us?
You are valued – as your true self. At Wärtsilä YOU matter. We value diversity and are committed in supporting inclusive work community.
Your growth is supported. We believe in continuous learning & teamwork. Wärtsilian community has your back when it comes to development opportunities – so you can develop beyond your potential.
You get to make a difference. Innovation and sustainability are important for us. Every day, we - Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality.

Contact and next steps
Please submit your application before the application deadline 22nd of September 2026 through our Careers portal. Applications through email will not be considered. After submitting your application, you will receive a confirmation email.

jobs.title: SprinDrive: Manufacturing Engineer (Electromechanics)
jobs.description:
**Type:** Full-time, permanent

**Location:** Laserkatu 6, 53850 Lappeenranta, Finland

**Application deadline:** 24.9.2026

Want to bridge the gap between engineering and manufacturing in cutting-edge magnetic bearing technology?

**What will you be doing?**

SpinDrive is looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join its R&D team in Lappeenranta. In this role, youll support the development and production of Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components by combining practical assembly work with manufacturing development, workstation setup, documentation, and supplier coordination. You will report to SpinDrives Lead Mechanical Engineer and collaborate closely with mechanical and electrical engineers, suppliers, and supply chain stakeholders.

A key part of the role is to help establish and organize SpinDrives own practical test assembly and test winding capabilities. As SpinDrive develops its in-house workshop, you will help define the workspace, identify and source suitable tools, equipment, measuring instruments, consumables, insulation materials, and other workshop requirements as well as establish practical ways of working. You will use your industrial experience and knowledge of local suppliers and subcontractors to help us build an efficient and well-organized manufacturing environment.

The role includes hands-on coil winding and related electrical assembly, but it is broader than winding alone. We are looking for a practical manufacturing professional who can take ownership of day-to-day assembly test activities, organize the workstation and tooling, and support engineers during prototype builds. Serial production is later outsourced to SpinDrive international subcontractors, and you will help to support technical discussions with them.

**Key responsibilities:**

In this role, you will test, manufacture, and improve precision coil winding solutions for Active Magnetic Bearing (AMB) components while supporting prototype production and assembly activities. You will perform test coil winding, preparation, soldering, insulation, impregnation, and related assembly processes, while helping establish and organize the required workspace, tooling, equipment, materials, and workflows.

Working closely with the engineering team, you will develop practical fixtures, tooling, work instructions, and assembly methods, interpret technical documentation, and provide feedback on manufacturability. You will establish appropriate quality, testing, documentation, and traceability practices and collaborate with local suppliers and subcontractors to source equipment, materials, tooling, and manufacturing services. You will also support technical discussions with SpinDrive international subcontractors for volume manufacturing.

**What kind of person thrives in this role and why?**

You might be the person we are looking for if you enjoy hands-on technical work and taking responsibility for making a workshop and manufacturing process work in practice. You are comfortable operating in an environment where processes, tooling, and workspaces are still being developed, and you enjoy finding practical solutions rather than waiting for predefined procedures.

We especially value practical manufacturing experience, good organizational skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently while communicating effectively with engineers and suppliers. Experience with local Finnish manufacturing suppliers and subcontractors is particularly valuable, as the role will involve building the practical infrastructure around our in-house assembly activities.

**We hope you have:**

- At least 3 years of practical experience in industrial manufacturing, assembly, maintenance, electrical or mechanical production, or related hands-on work.

- Experience with electrical motors, coils, wires, electrical components, or similar industrial equipment.

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and manufacturing documentation. Experience organizing workspaces, production areas, tooling, equipment and materials.

- Experience sourcing or working with local suppliers, subcontractors, tools, equipment, or manufacturing services.

- Good communication skills and full working proficiency in English.

- Solution-oriented, self-driven, and well-organized working style.

- Willingness to perform hands-on work while also taking ownership of broader manufacturing and workshop-development activities.


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with precision coil winding, electric motor manufacturing, or electrical assembly.

- Experience developing or improving tooling, fixtures, insulation, winding, or assembly methods.

- Established knowledge of Finnish/local suppliers for industrial tools, equipment, materials, machining, fabrication or specialist manufacturing services.

- Experience with prototype manufacturing and low-volume production.

- Experience in international manufacturing environments.

- Experience with CAD tools or the ability to work effectively with CAD-based technical documentation.


**What SpinDrive offers you:**

- Work closely with experienced engineers developing next-generation magnetic bearing technology for industrial applications

- Shape practical manufacturing solutions where your hands-on expertise has a direct impact on product quality

- Grow your technical skills in an international team collaborating across engineering, R&D, and supplier networks

- Travel internationally and build relationships with manufacturing partners across Europe

- Join a scaling technology company where you can contribute beyond a narrow role definition

- The compensation will include the salary and stock options to share the benefits of SpinDrives growth.


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by SpinDrive Oy. The role is based mainly onsite in Lappeenranta, Finland, and includes some travel to supplier locations. We hope you can work mainly from the office, with the possibility for occasional remote workdays. The onboarding period will take place primarily in Lappeenranta and is expected to last approximately 2–3 months. The start date is as soon as possible, but the latest in November 2026.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral researcher in synthesis and analysis
jobs.description:
The University of Helsinki (https://www.helsinki.fi/en), founded in 1640, is one of the worlds leading universities for multidisciplinary research. The university has an international academic community of 40,000 students and staff members. The Department of Chemistry (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-science/faculty/chemistry) at the Faculty of Science (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/faculty-science) carries out research on chemistry and its applications at an international level and provides academic teaching based on high quality research.
The Department of Chemistry invites applications for one
POSTDOCTORAL RESEARCHER
position in Synthesis and Analysis. The successful applicant will join the developing research group at the Department of Chemistry. The position is fixed-term for 12 months with a possible extension. Employment starts as soon as possible.

Position description
The postdoctoral position funded by the Research Council of Finland aims to design closed-loop dissolution/activation laboratory and scaled-up methodologies for recycling platinum group metals and rare-earth elements using green chemicals energy- and resource-efficient approaches - including organometallurgy and mechanochemistry - complying with sustainable development, resource safety and circular economy. This interdisciplinary project lays on the interface between coordination chemistry, metal dissolution and organometallurgy, organic chemistry, methodology development and mechanochemistry. Postdoctoral researchers tasks will include the development of recycling protocols for different metals, advanced characterization of the reaction mixtures and obtained isolated materials. The work will also comprise help in the supervision of undergraduate, graduate and visiting students. The researcher is expected to present their findings in scientific meetings, prepare funding applications for travel and research grants, as well as prepare manuscripts for publication in international scientific journals. The position has a trial period of 6 months.

Requirements
Motivated, ambitious and self-driven candidates with a PhD degree in a relevant field (chemistry or related) interested in metal recycling are encouraged to apply. Experience in the fields of coordination complex chemistry, molecular metal compounds, homogeneous metal catalysis, organic synthesis, mechanochemistry of metals, as well as experience in analytical techniques including NMR, PXRD, HRMS and ICP-MS/AES are advantageous. Most importantly, you should have strong motivation for research in a highly multidisciplinary topic, enthusiasm to learn new things and contribute ideas, and possess the ability to conduct your research independently while being an active member of an international research team. Excellent written and oral communication skills in English will be needed. We will offer a meaningful, original and ambitious scientific project in an international, top-level research environment. From the applicant we expect high motivation to conduct demanding experimental work, as well as a curiosity driven science-enthusiastic mindset.

Salary and benefits
The salary will be in accordance with the University salary system (requirement level 5). In addition, the appointee will be paid a salary component based on personal performance. The starting salary will be approximately 3900–4200 €/month.
University of Helsinki offers comprehensive services to its employees, including occupational health care, sports facilities, and ample opportunities for professional development and language studies. The International Staff Services office (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/university/working-at-the-university) assists employees from abroad with their transition to work and life in Finland.
How to apply
Applications should include:
* a CV with a list of publications,
* a brief description of your research interests (1 page) with clear indication on the motivation to apply for this position,
* a copy of a PhD degree certificate.

If you are interviewed, you will be asked for contact details for two references.
Please send us an application that you have crafted yourself, reflecting your own capability and thoughts. Applications generated by AI do not meet our expectations.
The deadline for applications is October 8th, unless the right candidate is found before. Interviews will commence right away, already during the application period.

Additional information
For further inquiries regarding the position, please contact Research Council of Finland Fellow, Dr. Anže Zupanc (anze.zupanc@helsinki.fi). For more information on Dr. Zupancs publications, see Anže Zupanc (0000-0002-3697-7839) - ORCID and Anže Zupanc - Google Scholar.

jobs.title: Power Electronics Simulation Engineer, Tampere
jobs.description:
About the role

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of power electronics and electrical grid technology. You will join a niche team of experts where your work directly impacts how high-voltage grids operate globally.

In this position, you will be part of the NPI (New Product Introduction) team, focusing on the simulation and validation of advanced grid solutions. Your main tool will be the RTDS (Real-Time Digital Simulator), and your daily work involves Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations. Because the role requires hands-on management of RTDS hardware and laboratory equipment, this position is fully office/lab-based in Tampere.

Work tasks

Your main responsibilities include:
- Running and designing Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) simulations.
- Managing and developing RTDS hardware setups.
- Using Matlab & Simulink for simulation and building test benches.
- Analyzing fault situations and system performance in a high-voltage grid context.
- Collaborating closely with design engineers to validate control systems.

You are offered...
- Long-term Mentorship: A thorough and supportive onboarding process into a niche technology area.
- International Opportunities: While the base role is in Tampere, there is a possibility for global site assignments (1–2 years down the line) for those interested in international travel.
- Cutting-edge Tech: Access to the latest simulation hardware and the chance to work on large-scale grid projects.

We are looking for

We value potential and learning agility above all else. This is a highly specialized field, and we are prepared to provide long-term onboarding for the right person. Whether you are a recent graduate with a strong academic background or a professional looking to pivot into grid technology, your ability to grasp complex systems is what matters.

Requirements:
- Technical Education: A University degree (M.Sc.) in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or Control Engineering.
- Control Theory: A deep understanding of the interface between power electronics and the electrical grid (control side expertise is critical).
- Software Tools: Proficiency in Matlab & Simulink.
- Communication: Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly in English (our primary working language).
- Location: Readiness to work onsite in Tampere (no remote work option due to hardware requirements).

We appreciate if you'll have...
- Previous experience with RTDS, HIL testing, or high-voltage laboratories.
- Familiarity with the power electronics industry

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

**Type:** Full-time - Fixed term, 12 months

**Location:** Helsinki, Vaasa or Turku

**Application deadline**: 20.9.2026

Interested in using data to improve supply chain processes? Join Wärtsilä Energy to develop reporting, data solutions and smarter ways of working across supply chain management.

**Key responsibilities**

In this position, your focus will be on developing more data-driven ways of working within Wärtsilä Energys Supply Chain Management organisation, particularly in procurement and strategic sourcing. You will work hands-on with data and Power BI, develop reports and data products, define KPIs and help improve how supply chain data is structured and used.

You will work closely with supply chain professionals and data specialists to develop ideas further and turn business needs into practical data solutions. You will coordinate development projects and explore how new tools, including AI and intelligent agents, could support supply chain processes. You will be supported by Wärtsiläs data experts on more technically demanding topics, but you are also expected to be a hands-on contributor who develops solutions and drives improvements from idea to implementation.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You are a proactive and curious person who enjoys working with data, learning new topics and finding better ways of doing things. You are comfortable taking ownership, bringing structure to development work and moving things forward independently. You communicate clearly with different stakeholders and are willing to test and learn when working with new tools and topics. You are also comfortable coordinating projects and keeping development work moving forward in collaboration with others.

**What we are looking for:**

- Several years of experience in project coordination or development work

- A relevant academic background in engineering, supply chain, business or a similar field, combined with an understanding of supply chain processes

- Hands-on experience with data, reporting and Power BI

- A proactive, independent and analytical working style with the ability to structure information and drive improvements forward

- Good communication and collaboration skills in English


**Additionally valued:**

- Previous experience working with procurement, purchasing or strategic sourcing, as it will help you understand the business context and related data

- Experience with automation and AI solutions, intelligent agents or applying AI in a business environment

- Familiarity with SAP, Salesforce, Databricks or other ERP and data platforms

- Good skills in Finnish


**We can offer you:**

- Broad opportunities to build expertise by working with supply chain, procurement, data and digitalisation professionals

- Versatile responsibilities where you can develop new ways to use data across supply chain management and turn ideas into practical improvements

- A truly international working environment where you will get to collaborate with a variety of colleagues from different departments

- An opportunity to continue discussions of future employment before ending the 12-month period

- Good introduction to Wärtsiläs operations and processes, helping you understand development needs and contribute to meaningful improvements


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time, fixed-term position for 12 months, where you will join Wärtsilä Energy as aTalents employee. We hope you are available to start as soon as possible.

Your immediate team is split between Helsinki and Vaasa, but you can be based in Helsinki, Vaasa or Turku. Wärtsilä offers a flexible hybrid working model, and we hope you can work from the office regularly.

jobs.title: Liikunnanohjaaja, Tanssittava
jobs.description:
**Liikunnanohjaaja, Tanssittava**

**Tanssittava etsii uusia liikunnanohjaajia joukkoonsa!**

Tanssittava on kasvava tanssi- ja liikuntastudio, joka tarjoaa monipuolista ja helposti lähestyttävää toimintaa eri-ikäisille harrastajille. Toimimme useilla toimipisteillä **Pirkanmaalla** ja tunneillamme käy viikoittain satoja harrastajia. Toimintaperiaatteemme perustuvat sensitiivisyyteen, ja toimintaamme ohjaavia arvoja ovat yksilöllisyys, laadukkuus sekä asiakkaidemme kokonaisvaltaisen hyvinvoinnin tukeminen.

Etsimme joukkoomme **ammattitaitoista, innostavaa ja luotettavaa liikunnanohjaajaa.**

**Opetustunteja tarjolla**

Tarjoamme **sijaistuksia ja tiiviskursseja jo heti**, joten ohjaamisen voi aloittaa nopeasti. **Vakiintuneempia viikoittaisia tunteja on tarjolla tammikuusta 2027 alkaen.**

Ohjaustunteja on tarjolla pääasiassa **iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin**. Tunteja on mahdollista tarjota myös aamu -ja päiväaikaan.

Etsimme monipuolisia liikunnanohjaajia, joilla on osaamista esimerkiksi ryhmäliikunnasta, kehonhuollosta, liikkuvuudesta, pilateksesta, joogasta, tai toiminnallisesta harjoittelusta. **Myös muiden lajien ja tuntikonseptien osaaminen kiinnostaa!** Jos sinulla on mielessäsi laji tai tuntikonsepti, jota Tanssittavan valikoimassa ei vielä ole, kerro siitä rohkeasti hakemuksessasi.

**Toivomme sinulta**

- liikunta-alan koulutusta ja/tai vahvaa osaamista omalta lajialaltasi

- aikaisempaa kokemusta ryhmien ohjaamisesta

- innostavaa ja kannustavaa ohjaustapaa

- hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja

- vastuullista ja oma-aloitteista työskentelytapaa

- halua kehittää omaa ohjaamistaan ja Tanssittavan tuntitarjontaa


**Tarjoamme**

- sijaistuksia ja tiiviskursseja jo syksyllä 2026

- mahdollisuuksia vakiotunteihin tammikuusta 2027 alkaen

- ohjaustunteja iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin

- mahdollisuuden ehdottaa ja toteuttaa uusia lajeja ja tuntikonsepteja

- joustavuutta tuntimäärien ja opetuksen suhteen

- mahdollisuuden olla mukana kehittämässä kasvavan studion toimintaa

- mukavan ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Lähetä meille vapaamuotoinen hakemus, jossa kerrot lyhyesti itsestäsi, koulutuksestasi, ohjauskokemuksestasi ja omasta osaamisestasi.

Kerrothan hakemuksessasi myös:

- mitä lajeja tai tuntikonsepteja haluaisit ohjata

- milloin olet käytettävissä

- mahdolliset omat laji- tai tuntikonseptiehdotuksesi


Hakemukset lähetetään osoitteeseen toimisto@tanssittava.fi

**Haku päättyy 1.11. tai sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**

Tervetuloa mukaan Tanssittavan kasvavaan yhteisöön!

jobs.title: Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing
Department of Food Science
Faculty of Science
University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science (FOOD), Faculty of Science (SCIENCE), University of Copenhagen (UCPH) invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor or Associate Professor in Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing. The research areas of FOOD have a shared mission to contribute to new pathways for society and industry to support the development of solutions based in biology to improve sustainable food production, food security and food safety. FOOD is recognized for excellence in food research, education and industrial collaboration. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. FOOD has the ambition to reinforce our teaching and research in designing and optimizing biology-based solutions as future sustainable food and ingredient technologies. UCPH is strengthening this area by offering the new MSc Biosolutions program in Kalundborg, Denmark, the largest bio-based manufacturing hub in Scandinavia, home to large fermentation-based manufacturers, and a vibrant innovation environment. The candidate for this position is expected to significantly contribute to this new Biosolutions initiative.

The aim of the position is to explore the production and use of new solutions based on both biology and engineering addressing sustainability challenges inherent in food systems today. Although we welcome a diverse range of applicants, the focus of the position will be processing in relation to biochemically based solutions and could include the following disciplines:

  • Food process technology, ideally with an emphasis on fermentation & downstream processing
  • Food process system engineering
  • Use of sensor technologies such as in-line or at line spectroscopic tools
  • Large-data, modelling and prediction of food and ingredient processes.
  • Understanding of biological production systems and their use, and with an emphasis on downstream processing
A central part of the activities anchored to this position will be taking place in Campus Kalundborg, and it is crucial that the candidate is able to leverage the local ecosystem to foster strong collaboration with industry. Qualifications are expected in the following areas:

  • A collaborative and innovative mindset
  • Documented scientific impact and outreach in past research work
  • A proven track record in attracting external funding at both national and international level
  • Experience with international collaborations
  • Ability to establish industrial collaboration
  • Excellent interpersonal and communicative skills
Tenure-track assistant professor
The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations regarding publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within Ingredient Biochemical Processing. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.

The candidate must be an inspiring teacher with a vision on teaching development, especially in connection with the new MSc Biosolutions program. A new campus with research and teaching facilities is currently being built in Kalundborg and the candidate is expected to contribute to setting up the facilities

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

Please read more here

For tenure-track assistant professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5a_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Assistant_professors.pdf

For associate professors: https://jobportal.ku.dk/videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-videnskabelige-stillinger/kriterier-for-meritering-maj-2026/5b_Criteria_for_recognising_merit_-Associate_professors.pdf

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

The tenure-track assistant programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

Salary and employment conditions
The position is open from 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Employment is as either tenure track assistant professor or associate professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The Professor will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

Filing of application
The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level or associate professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including:
    • Please describe and document international network and relations
    • Please describe and document internationally based activities
    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark
    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media
    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans
  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:
    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students
    • Teaching experience
    • Formal pedagogical training
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers
Applying for the associate professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding
  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)
  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans
  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines
  • Complete publication list
  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers
The deadline for applications is 28 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

Interviews will be held on 8 March 2027.

Please refer to the following no. in future communication in this case:

211-0263/26-2N, Tenure-track Assistant Professor Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

211-0760/26-2E, Associate Professor of Food and Ingredient Biochemical Processing.

jobs.title: Tenure Track assistant professor, associate professor or professor of Food Processing & Technology
jobs.description:
Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor of Food Processing & Technology
Department of Food Science
Faculty of Science
University of Copenhagen

The Department of Food Science, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen invites applications for a position as Tenure-track Assistant Professor, Associate Professor or Full Professor in Food Processing and Technology. Applicants must be capable of, and interested in, conducting and developing basic and applied interdisciplinary research of high international standard in the field of food processing and technology. The position will involve extensive collaborations within the department and with national and international academic groups and industrial partners. Research within the Department has a mission to unearth new solutions for society and industry to support sustainable food production, food security and safety as well as production of high-quality food promoting human health and wellbeing. The Department of Food Science is recognized for excellence in food research, education, and industrial collaborations. The Department is an international workplace with Danish and English as parallel working languages, however it is expected that the successful candidate will be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 3 to 6 years. We encourage applications from a range of disciplines within the food science and technology area, ideally covering the understanding of food macromolecular interactions on a mechanistic level, how processing and formulation affect or determine these interactions, and how this influences final product quality with focus on functional properties.

We are seeking a candidate who will establish an internationally leading research program, and we encourage a diverse range of applicants whose work may center on one or more of the following disciplines:

  • Developing a mechanistic understanding of interactions of food macromolecules in complex matrices during processing or formulation spanning dairy, plant, and single-cell protein sources.

  • How this knowledge can be used in the rational design of functional ingredients and healthy foods using established and emerging processing technologies

  • Development and utilization of high throughput methods for characterizing and quantifying the physicochemical behavior of food macromolecules in complex matrices.

  • Modelling and the use of machine learning/AI for simulation and prediction of the outcome of process unit operations on food and ingredient functionality.

  • Formulation and fluid dynamics of complex emulsions and the mechanisms governing this.

In addition, it is expected that this position will be involved in a significant amount of collaboration with industry, and therefore it is expected that the successful candidate has a documented successful track record in industry collaboration and working with innovation-oriented research. Furthermore, we expect that the successful candidate has a genuine interest in leadership and the wellbeing and development of their group.

Tenure-track assistant professor
The tenure-track assistant professor’s duties will primarily include research, including obligations with regards to publication/scientific communication and research-based teaching with associated examination obligations within the Tenure Track Assistant Professorship. To a limited extent the position may also include other duties.

The tenure-track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

Assessment of applicants for the tenure-track assistant professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, internationally competitive research. The ability to attract external funding will be considered together with outreach qualifications. Teaching qualifications are not mandatory but documented teaching qualifications and teaching experience will be considered.

Associate professor and full professor

Applicants are required to have university level teaching experience, documented teaching competencies and must be able to explain and reflect upon own teaching practice and portfolio. Formal pedagogical training or supervision equivalent to the University of Copenhagen teacher training programme for assistant professors is required.
In particular, the candidate must actively contribute with research-based teaching on the BSc in Food Science and Nutrition, and the MSc in Food Science and Technology programs, with an emphasis on the specialization in Dairy Science and Technology.

Duties include the applicant’s own research, development of the field, assessment tasks, grant applications, and research management such as supervision and training of research fellows and other staff. The successful applicant must also teach, supervise, prepare and participate in examinations, and fulfill other tasks requested by the Department.

Assessment of applicants for the associate professorship and full professorship will primarily consider their level of documented, original scientific production at an international level, including contributions to developments in their field, as well as their documented teaching qualifications. Managerial and out-reach qualifications of applicants including ability to attract external funding will also be considered.

University of Copenhagen’s criteria for recognising merit
General criteria apply to the appointment of assistant professor / associate professor / professor at the University of Copenhagen. The criteria (research, teaching, Innovation & societal impact, organizational contribution and leadership) are considered as a framework for an overall assessment of the applicant. In addition, each applicant will be assessed according to the specific requirements listed in this advertisement.

Applicants are encouraged to read the University of Copenhagen's Guidance on the merit criterion Innovation and Societal Impact here

The tenure-track assistant programme
The tenure-track programme is a career programme and an assigned mentor will provide the tenure-track assistant professors with guidance related to career development, other academic topics and administrative procedures.

Performance of the tenure-track assistant professor will be followed via internal yearly evaluations and a mid-term and final international evaluation by an assessment committee. If the ‘final appraisal’ is positive you will be promoted as associate professor. Performance and progression towards the criteria below will be evaluated with due consideration of differences between research fields.

After a 6-year tenure-track period tenure-track assistant professors are expected to meet the criteria for appointment of associate professors at the University of Copenhagen.

Salary and employment conditions
The position is open from 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is covered by the Memorandum on Job Structure for Academic Staff.

Employment is either as tenure track assistant professor, associate professor or professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

This position comes with an opportunity to negotiate a start package that will help leverage the candidate’s scientific deliverables in the initial years of employment. The negotiation for the start package takes place as part of the recruitment process. Please read about the contents of the programme and conditions, as well as UCPH’s extensive support for international researchers, here Start package programme – University of Copenhagen .

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

The successful candidate will be a part of the Section for Ingredients and Dairy Technology. The section has internationally acknowledged expertise within novel sustainable processing technologies, protein, polyphenol and lipid chemistry, functionality, and modification of food components, kinetics, oxidation, food engineering, rheology, digitalisation, and advanced data analysis. The section is also equipped with pilot facilities for brewing, dairy and bioprocessing. The section has extensive collaborations on research projects with major food industries in both Denmark and abroad.

Further information on the Department is linked at Department of Food Science – University of Copenhagen Inquiries about the position can be made to Inquiries about the position can be made to Head of Department, Colin Ray (+45 93565911, colin.ray@food.ku.dk) or Head of Section, Mogens Larsen Andersen (+45 3533 3262, mola@food.ku.dk).

Filing of application
The position may be applied for at the tenure-track assistant professor level, associate professor level or full professor level. Please note that it is possible to apply at more than one level. If applied at more than one level, separate applications must be submitted (see below).

The application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

Applying for the tenure-track assistant professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including:

    • Please describe and document international network and relations

    • Please describe and document internationally based activities

    • Positions held at universities/research institutions outside Denmark

    • Outreach activities, i.e. popular lectures or other activities in the media

    • Grants held, personal or in part. Career development grants.

  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)

  • Research plan - description of current and future research plans

  • If available, description and documentation of teaching and supervision experience and qualifications- please describe and document:

    • Experience with supervision of BSc and MSc students

    • Teaching experience

    • Formal pedagogical training

  • Complete publication list

  • Separate reprints of up to 5 particularly relevant papers

Applying for the associate professorship or full professorship please include

  • Curriculum vitae including information about external funding

  • Diplomas (Master and PhD degree or equivalent)

  • Research plan – description of current and future research plans

  • Description and documentation of teaching experience and qualifications according to university guidelines

  • Complete publication list

  • Separate reprints of 5 particularly relevant papers

The deadline for applications is 27 October 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.

After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Interview Committee.

You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

Interviews will be held on 25 February 2027.

jobs.title: Kunnossapidon työntekijä
jobs.description:
Ylivieskan kaupungin kuntatekniikan palvelut vastaa kaupunkimme katujen, kevyen liikenteen väylien, muiden yleisten alueiden ympärivuotisesta kunnossapidosta ja viemäriverkoston toimivuudesta.
Teemme töitä pääsääntöisesti ulkona säällä kuin säällä, joten joustava asenne ja vaihteleviin olosuhteisiin sopeutuminen ovat meille tärkeitä. Meillä pääset tekemään konkreettista ja näkyvää työtä osana reipasta ja ammattitaitoista tiimiä. Tarjoamme monipuolisia käytännön työtehtäviä sekä vakaan ja kannustavan työyhteisön kehittyvässä kaupungissa.
Haemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen kunnossapidon työntekijää katujen, viemäreiden ja yleisten alueiden hoitoon sekä kunnossapitoon. Työtehtävät sisältävät tarvittaessa myös maanrakennustöitä (lapiotyöt/putkitus) työmailla. Työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa sekä ennen kaikkea joustavaa asennetta työntekoon.

Odotamme hakijoilta:
Ammatillista perustutkintoa (mielellään maanrakennusalan ammattitutkinto) ja/tai kokemusta maanrakennusalalta
Oma-aloitteisuutta
Rehtiä ja reipasta asennetta työtä kohtaan
Eduksi katsotaan Tieturva 1- ja työturvallisuuskortti, traktorin ajotaito sekä tasolaserin käyttötaito. Työ vaatii liikkumista koko kaupungin alueella, joten B-ajokortti on välttämätön.

Mitä tarjoamme:
Ylivieskan kaupungilla sinua odottaa itsenäinen ja vastuullinen rooli osana tiivistä työyhteisöä. Mikäli kaikki hakukriteerit eivät täyttyneetkään, mutta koet olevasi etsimämme henkilö, niin laita rohkeasti hakemusta tulemaan!
Työ alkaa: 1.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.
Työaika: 38 h 15 min / vko.
Palkkaus: 2262€/kk, Kunnallisen teknisen henkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen (TS) mukaan mahdollinen ammattialalisä

Toimitathan hakemuksesi sähköisesti 4.10.2026 klo 23:59 mennessä.

jobs.title: Open Application: Domestic Helper Opportunity in the Capital region
jobs.description:
OPEN APPLICATION: DOMESTIC HELPER / HOUSEKEEPER – HELSINKI, ESPOO & VANTAA

Are you looking for meaningful work where you can support families in their everyday lives?

Curon Helpperi is continuously looking for experienced Domestic Helpers to join our friendly and supportive team in the Capital Region. This is an open application, which means that we may not have a suitable position available immediately. We review applications as our staffing needs change and new work opportunities become available.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Domestic Helper, you provide practical day-to-day support that helps households run smoothly and makes everyday life easier for families.

The work is varied, and your tasks depend on each clients individual needs. Your working week could include cooking, cleaning, laundry care, organizing, ironing, childcare support, or helping seniors with their everyday routines.

Your tasks may include:

* Cleaning and maintaining clients homes

* Meal planning and cooking

* Laundry care, ironing and folding clothes

* Childcare and/or support for seniors

* Light gardening and outdoor tasks

* Pet care, such as walking a dog


WORKING HOURS AND LOCATION

* Work is mainly available from Monday to Friday between 8:00 and 17:30

* Occasional evening or weekend work may also be available

* The work takes place in several client homes across the Capital Region

* Most clients are located in Helsinki and Espoo, but work may also be available in Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas


WE OFFER

* Opportunities for gig work, part-time work or full-time employment, depending on our current staffing needs and your availability

* A supportive working environment and a caring team

* Training, guidance and support in your work

* An ongoing employment contract when applicable

* Salary according to the Facility Services Collective Agreement

For example, the salary for a full-time position with 100% working hours is €2,074 per month. The hourly salary is €13 per hour.


WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* At least two years of experience as a domestic helper or housekeeper, or at least two years of cleaning experience combined with strong cooking skills

* Ability to prepare both Western dishes and food from other cuisines

* Ability to work independently and take initiative

* Fluent English or Finnish — you must be able to communicate well in at least one of these languages

* You are already living in Finland and have the right to work in Finland

* A positive attitude, reliability and respect for clients privacy

A valid driving licence and access to a car are considered an advantage but are not required.


APPLICATION PROCESS

If this type of work feels right for you, please submit an open application through the link below.

Please note that this is an ongoing open application, and we may not have a suitable position available immediately. Applications are accepted only through the application form. We will contact suitable candidates when work opportunities become available.

Thank you for your interest in working with Curon Helpperi. We look forward to receiving your application!

Location: Helsinki, Espoo, Vantaa, Kauniainen and other nearby areas
Start date: According to our staffing needs and the candidates availability
Application period: Ongoing

jobs.title: Ledig graverstilling
jobs.description:
Stillingen som graver ved Tvede-Linde-Mellerup kirker er ledig til besættelse snarest, gerne 1. oktober 2026. Stillingen er på 37 timer pr. uge.

Den ledende graver skal varetage følgende opgaver på vore tre kirker i Tvede, Linde og Mellerup samt sognehuset og arealerne omkring præstegården i Tvede.
  • Varetage og være ansvarlig for kirkegårdenes og præstegårdsarealernes vedligeholdelse, gravfæstelser m.m.
  • Lede og fordele arbejdsopgaverne i graverteamet
  • Varetage indledende registrering af gravsteder, opdatere gravstedsbreve, legater og udskrive fakturaer
  • Udføre kirketjeneste ved kirkelige handlinger på skift og sammen med gravermedhjælper
  • Samarbejde med øvrige kirkelige myndigheder
  • Varetage periodevis rengøring af kirker og kontorer m.m.
  • Bistå præster og samarbejde med andre ansatte med løsning af diverse opgaver omkring kirkelige arrangementer

Vi forventer at du:
  • Er pligtopfyldende, effektiv og mødestabil
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også indgå i fælles opgaver og samarbejder
  • Kan tilrettelægge opgaver og administrere arbejdstiden over hele året
  • Kan håndtere diverse små maskiner, flere arbejdssteder og mangeartede opgaver
  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsparat på kort tid til uforudsete opgaver
  • Er udadvendt og imødekommende for folk, der kommer på kirkegårdene
  • Har kørekort og kan stille bil til rådighed for kørsel mellem kirkegårdene
  • Kan medvirke ved afvikling af kirkelige handlinger
  • På alle måder har overskud til at skabe et sundt og godt miljø for graverteamet

Kirkerne har automatiske ringeanlæg.

Der er ikke krav om gartnerisk uddannelse, men det vil ses som en fordel.

Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og OAO-S samt organisationsaftalen for kirkefunktionærer med kerneopgaver som kirketjener eller graver og det tilhørende protokollat for gravere.

Aftalerne kan ses på www.folkekirkenspersonale.dk

Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for gravere gennemføres indenfor 2 år efter ansættelsens start.

Stillingen indplaceres i løngruppe 1, hvis der ikke er gartnerisk uddannelse.
Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 342.523 kr. - 421.573 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026 for 37 timer ugentlig).
Stillingen indplaceres i løngruppe 2, ved gartnerisk uddannelse.

Årslønnen aftales indenfor intervallet 350.435 kr. - 438.259 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026 for 37 timer ugentlig).

Der er rådighedsforpligtelse til stillingen. Der ydes rådighedstillæg efter gældende overenskomst. Rådighedstillægget udgør årligt 16.297 - 27.246,56 kr. (nutidskroner pr. 1. august 2026)
Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og FAKK

Pension kommer oveni efter overenskomstens bestemmelser.

Det er en betingelse, at den obligatoriske 5 ugers uddannelse for gravere gennemføres inden for 2 år efter ansættelsens start, hvis uddannelsen ikke allerede er gennemført.

Ansættelse sker ved Tvede-Linde-Mellerup-sognes menighedsråd

Aftale om indplacering i lønintervallet indgås mellem menighedsrådet og FAKK

Er der spørgsmål vedr. stillingen, kan man rette henvendelse til menighedsrådsformand Laila Hjorth Fournais Clausen på tlf. 40105820

Ansøgning med relevante bilag sendes via ansøgningsknappen.

Ansøgningen skal være menighedsrådet i hænde snarest og senest 20. sept 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes af finde sted umiddelbart herefter.

jobs.title: Senior Information Security Specialist
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about making a meaningful impact on businesses in developing countries and experienced in implementing security frameworks? Join our team as Senior Information Security Specialist at Impact Fund Denmark (IFDK).

At IFDK, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh. 

 

Here is what you get with us

  • A leading role in shaping and strengthening our information security

  • Collaboration with highly skilled IT professionals in a friendly and inclusive culture 

  • Access to the full suite of Microsoft enterprise tools in a modern and tech-driven environment 

 

The job

We are on a mission to continue strengthening our information security efforts.

Reporting to the SVP Technology & Operations, you will address critical security questions and strengthen the management of information security, incl. risk mitigation, regulatory compliance, building of awareness culture, and strengthening of detect, response and continuity capabilities. The information security effort has strong support from the board and executive management, emphasizing its business-critical nature.

You will work closely together with the Technology team to implement relevant security measures, and you will join an international organisation on a vital mission with a unique opportunity to elevate the organisation’s information security to the next level. Your contributions will be central to empowering IFDK to achieve its goals and successfully navigate the challenges of the future.

 

Main tasks and responsibilities

  • Threat & data management: Identify critical security risks and develop proactive strategies to manage and protect critical data.

  • Conduct risk assessments and report: Perform continuous risk assessments to identify potential threats and vulnerabilities and present findings to executive stakeholders

  • Implement security controls: Deploy security controls to mitigate identified risks and continuously monitor the effectiveness of these controls to ensure they remain compliant and adapted to emerging threats.

  • Train and educate: Stay up to date with the latest security trends and facilitate ongoing training and awareness programs for all employees. Help ensure they understand their roles in the information security ecosystem to promote greater ownership and a security culture.

 

Your qualifications and experience

  • Experience from a position where you successfully have led complex changes or projects regarding cyber and information security – preferably within the financial sector e.g. as a consultant.

  • Knowledge of relevant legal and security frameworks e.g., ISO27001/2, DORA etc.

  • Relevant experience in information security management, risk assessment and executive security reporting

  • Relevant technical skills and knowledge about the Microsoft 365 security stack (Entra ID, Defender, Purview), security monitoring and incident response.

 

Personal competences

  • Independent, proactive and self-driven

  • Outgoing and a natural relationship builder 

  • Ability to communicate across levels, from technical to C-level

  • Positive team player

 

Ready to build the digital foundation for global impact? 

As part of the recruitment process, we need your targeted CV, preferably with a brief motivational statement at the top. Please submit it via the apply button today or no later than September 18th, 2026. We will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so do not wait too long to apply. 

CVs not submitted via the apply button will not be considered. The start date is as soon as possible, but we are ready to wait for the right candidate. 

 

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Dynamics 365 F&O Developer
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Build the financial engine behind global sustainable impact

 

Do you want to build and evolve the financial technology platform that enables investments — from climate and health to food systems worldwide? And are you ready to play a pivotal technical role in one of the most ambitious digital transformations in Danish development finance?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

Here is what you get with us:

  • A central role in evolving our Dynamics 365 F&O platform

  • Collaboration with skilled colleagues, data engineers, and business stakeholders in a friendly, inclusive culture

  • Access to the full Microsoft enterprise stack in a modern, tech-driven environment

 

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

Please note:

  • This position operates out of our main office in Copenhagen, and regular presence at the office is required. 

  • While we welcome applications and are open to candidates from outside of Denmark, please note that Impact Fund Denmark will not provide relocation assistance.

 

The team

A place where great ideas can come from anyone

Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. We challenge each other, support each other, and take pride in creating solutions that make a real difference across the organisation. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our D365 F&O platform

We are looking for a Dynamics 365 F&O Developer to take a key role in developing, customising, and maintaining the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations platform that underpins our financial operations and reporting globally. You will work closely with our Solution Architect, Business Application Manager, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust, scalable, and well-governed solutions.

 

You will, for example:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy customisations and extensions in Dynamics 365 F&O

  • Integrate D365 F&O with other systems in our stack, including Dynamics 365 CE, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, and third-party SaaS applications

  • Configure and optimise financial modules including General Ledger, Accounts Payable/Receivable, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, and Budgeting

  • Collaborate with the Solution Architect to align development work with our enterprise architecture principles and integration patterns

  • Participate in and contribute to requirements workshops, translating business needs into technical designs and functional specifications

  • Support and maintain existing D365 F&O configurations, data entities, and custom solutions — and troubleshoot issues as they arise

  • Contribute to DevOpsSec practices, including ALM, source control, release management, and deployment pipelines

  • Produce clear technical documentation and support knowledge transfer within the team

 

You bring deep F&O expertise and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Dynamics 365 F&O development and configuration, you understand how to turn complex financial requirements into well-engineered solutions that stand the test of time.

 

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Have solid hands-on experience developing in Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations

  • Are comfortable configuring core financial modules and translating business processes into D365 workflows

  • Have experience with integration patterns and tools, such as Data Entities, OData, Logic Apps, or Azure Integration Services

  • Understand the Power Platform ecosystem (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse) and how it connects to F&O

  • Are familiar with Lifecycle Services (LCS), Azure DevOps, and CI/CD practices for D365

  • Communicate clearly with both engineers and business stakeholders — bridging the technical and functional worlds

  • Desirably have experience from the financial sector or international development finance

 

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve. You will work with:

  • Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O)

  • Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE)

  • Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse)

  • Microsoft Fabric & Azure Data Services

  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

  • Several fit-for-purpose SaaS solutions and integrations

 

What we offer
