jobs.title: (Senior) Power Apps & Web Application Developer (Dynamics 365 & Dataverse)
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Build the digital backbone that powers our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance teams

 

Do you want to be hands-on in building the platform that powers how we manage every investment, from lead through to exit? And are you ready to take technical ownership of a growing, business-critical application that combines low-code Power Apps with modern JavaScript/Node.js web development, used every day by our Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance colleagues?

At Impact Fund Denmark, you join a mission-driven organisation with a clear purpose — to finance projects that bring sustainable development to life, from forestry in Paraguay to solar energy in Brazil and diagnostics in Bangladesh.

 

Here is what you get with us:

  • A hands-on, technically deep role at the centre of our internal Investment Management application, spanning both Power Platform and custom web application development

  • Close collaboration with our Business Application Manager and external development resources, as part of a small, focused core development team

  • The opportunity to shape a platform still early in its journey — with a clear roadmap and real influence over how it evolves, including its growing web application layer

 

Global impact, strong IT culture and meaningful teamwork

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark's development finance institution, investing in sustainable solutions that create measurable impact in developing countries. While headquartered in Copenhagen, our work extends across more than 45 countries, supported by six regional offices, uniting 24 nationalities under one purpose.

You will be part of the Technology & Operations team, which is currently expanding, including specialists in processes, architecture, data, and IT Security. Here, you will join experienced and collaborative professionals who are eager to share knowledge and support each other across disciplines.

 

The team

A place where great ideas can come from anyone

Joining us means becoming part of a warm, ambitious, and genuinely collaborative Technology & Operations Team. We are a group that thrives on shared purpose, celebrates each other's wins, and is not afraid to roll up our sleeves when things get complex. Our work spans a broad range of initiatives that shape the organisation's digital backbone — but what truly defines us is how we do it: together.

On this application specifically, you will work day-to-day alongside our Business Application Manager, who coordinates prioritisation and the release process, and a small pool of external developers who provide specialist and overflow capacity. Together, you form the core development team — working closely with Product Owners, Super Users, and functional subject-matter experts from Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to keep the backlog moving and the platform improving.

You will be surrounded by talented colleagues who bring curiosity, professionalism, and a healthy sense of humour to the table. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are building a culture where learning is continuous and where you will have the space to influence how we work.

 

You develop and evolve our internal investment management application

Our internal Investment Management application is built on Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps, and the Dynamics 365 platform (using only capabilities that do not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence). It supports the full investment lifecycle — from lead and screening, through portfolio management and monitoring, to exit. Alongside this low-code foundation, an increasing share of the application is built as custom web applications — using JavaScript and Node.js — to deliver functionality that goes beyond what Power Apps supports out of the box.

We are looking for a Power Apps & Web Application Developer to take day-to-day technical ownership of the application's codebase and configuration and be the technical lead for the application and its growth over the coming years. You will work closely with our Business Application Manager and external developer resources as the core development team, turning a continuously prioritised backlog into reliable, well-built functionality for the business — spanning both the Power Platform and our custom web application components. You will take the lead on deciding when a requirement is best solved with low-code Power Apps versus custom web development, in dialogue with the Business Application Manager.

You will, for example:

  • Platform development: design, build, and maintain Power Apps (model-driven and canvas) and Dataverse solution components — tables, relationships, business rules, and automation — that underpin the application

  • Web application development: design, build, and maintain custom web applications and services using JavaScript and Node.js, extending the platform beyond native Power Apps capabilities and integrating tightly with Dataverse via APIs

  • Dynamics 365 configuration: configure and extend Dynamics 365 platform capabilities used within the application, strictly limited to functionality that does not require a Dynamics 365 Sales licence

  • Process automation: build Power Automate flows that automate approvals, notifications, and data flows between the application, our ERP, and other enterprise systems

  • Backlog delivery: work from the prioritised Kanban backlog together with the Business Application Manager, who owns the board and coordinates prioritisation and release

  • Requirements translation: engage directly with super users and functional SMEs across Investment, Risk, Valuation and Finance to understand needs and translate them into technical designs

  • Collaboration with external resources: coordinate day-to-day with external developers on shared backlog items, ensuring consistent quality, patterns, and documentation across the codebase

  • Testing and release: support structured testing cycles and releases, working with super users to validate functionality before it reaches the wider organisation

  • Production support: troubleshoot and resolve issues in the live application — both the Power Platform components and the custom web application layer — protecting data integrity and keeping the platform reliable for daily use

  • Documentation: maintain clear technical documentation of the data model, configurations, and customisations to support governance and knowledge transfer

 

You bring hands-on Power Platform and web development skills, and a collaborative mindset

With your background in Power Platform, Dynamics 365, and modern web development, you become invested in turning business requirements from investment, risk, valuation, or finance stakeholders into robust, well-structured solutions.

We imagine that you:

  • Technical foundation: have a relevant degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

  • Platform expertise: have solid hands-on experience developing with Microsoft Dataverse, Power Apps (model-driven and canvas), and Power Automate

  • Web development skills: have solid hands-on experience building web applications and services with JavaScript and Node.js, and are comfortable working across both front-end and back-end code

  • Dynamics 365 knowledge: understand Dynamics 365 as a platform, including entity modelling, business rules, and security roles

  • Collaborative delivery: are comfortable working from a shared, continuously prioritised backlog alongside a Business Application Manager and external developers

  • Communication: communicate clearly with both technical colleagues and non-technical business stakeholders across departments

  • Problem-solving: take a structured, hands-on approach to troubleshooting issues in a live, business-critical application

  • Have experience with plugin development (C#) or PCF component development on the Power Platform

  • Are familiar with Azure DevOps and ALM practices for Power Platform and web application deployment

Bonus points if you:

  • Have experience with modern JavaScript frameworks or libraries (such as React, Vue, or Express) for building web applications

  • Having domain knowledge from investment management, risk, valuation, or finance processes, is a plus

  • Have experience from the financial sector or an impact-focused organisation, is a plus

 

Our technology stack

Our current environment is built on Microsoft technology and continues to evolve, with a growing web application layer alongside it. As Power Apps & Web Application Developer, you will work with:

  • Microsoft Dataverse (our core data platform for this application)

  • Microsoft Power Apps (model-driven and canvas apps)

  • Microsoft Power Automate

  • JavaScript and Node.js for custom web application and API development

  • Dynamics 365 as a platform (excluding functionality requiring a Dynamics 365 Sales licence)

  • Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O), as an integrated neighbouring system

  • Azure DevOps for backlog, source control, and release management

  • Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, and more)

 

What we offer

  • An opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects with real social and environmental impact

  • A focused, hands-on role with real ownership of a growing, business-critical platform

  • A collaborative, value-driven, and international work environment

  • Opportunities for professional development, training, and continuous learning

  • A brand-new office with modern facilities close to Nordhavn Metro and S-Train station

 

Ready to build the backbone of our investment, risk and finance operations?

jobs.title: Area IT Manager Finland and Europe
jobs.description:
Ruukki Construction aims to drive the construction industry towards carbon neutrality with its products. Our 1,350 employees in 10 European countries and 14 specialized manufacturing sites provide steel-based building products and services for roofs and walls in sustainable buildings. We serve our customers locally under our main brands Ruukki and Plannja. Our net sales in 2024 were approximately EUR 481 million. We are of Nordic origin and share our values and long experience in the steel and construction industry with our parent company SSAB.

Do you want to be part of building a more sustainable future and be part of a professional and successful team in an international company? Maybe this is your new challenge!

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

We are looking for a strategic minded and hands-on Area IT Manager to manage local IT development and support activities in Finland and to oversee our regional IT operations across Ruukki locations in Central Eastern Europe. This role combines leadership, operational responsibility, and strategic execution in a dynamic international environment.

The role has two main managerial responsibility areas; Firstly, oversee local IT development and support activities in Finland, ensuring business continuity from the IT perspective. And in this context act as line manager for the area IT team: manage performance, recruitment, budgeting, and other HR responsibilities. Secondly, you will lead a team of regional IT managers in Central and Eastern Europe: you will set goals, monitor progress, optimize resource allocation and ensure that best practices are evaluated and implemented as part of the knowledge sharing process.

All in all, you will contribute to the implementation of Ruukkis IT and business strategies and roadmaps. And when fit for purpose act as project manager for selected initiatives, such as IT and production capability development, acquisitions, and carve-outs.

The preferred location is Alajärvi, or any of our location in South Ostrobothnia, Finland.

Key Responsibilities

Ensure day-to-day IT support and development activities are aligned with Ruukki and SSAB IT policies (executed by internal teams and external vendors).

Lead the development of the Area Europe IT roadmap and resource planning.

Manage team-level IT costs, including annual budgeting and development proposals.

Oversee contracts and vendor management, including invoicing.

Collaborate with SSAB common IT on infrastructure and application development.

Define and implement collaboration models with business stakeholders across Europe.

Act as a general point of contact for infrastructure-related topics within Ruukki Construction IT management.

What we are looking for

· Strong knowledge of business applications and IT infrastructure (including security).

· Experience in strategy and roadmap execution.

· Solid understanding of business process development.

· Strong project management skills.

· Familiarity with agile methodologies and service delivery frameworks (e.g., ITIL).

· Proven vendor management skills.

· Strong leadership and team management capabilities.

· Has excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.

· The ideal candidate communicates fluently in Finnish and in English both written and oral.

We Offer

Our workplace fosters collaboration and personal growth, and everything we do is guided by our commitment to sustainability. Safety, innovation and reliability are at the heart of our business and ensure that everyone in our community thrives. Great colleagues and a supportive work community. Healthy work-life-balance and flexibility (hybrid working model). Lunch and wellbeing benefits. Occupational health services and much more!

Location

Your home base will be Ruukki Alajärvi (South Ostrobothnia) Finland. Some domestic and international travel is required.

How to Apply

Our recruitment partner Barona IT Talent will handle the application process and candidate communication. Please submit your application no later than 4th of October, 2026.

For more information, please contact:

Arja Martikainen, +358 40 7621564 (best reached Tue-Thu between 1-3 PM) or via emailat arja.martikainen(at)barona.fi

Please note: Background check may be a part of the recruitment process.

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement. Equally due to GDPR, please do not submit your application directly to recruiter email.

jobs.title: Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S / Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S
jobs.description:
Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Om NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics er en transportvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Trekantsområdet. Vores centrale placering og vores dygtige medarbejdere gør os i stand til at løfte både store og små opgaver effektivt.
Vi leverer hurtige og præcise løsninger til enhver transportopgave, og med eget værksted holder vi vores biler kørende 24 timer i døgnet – samtidig med at vi holder omkostningerne nede.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsfuld chauffør til vores velfungerende team. Hos os er samarbejde vigtigt – vi hjælper hinanden, så dagens opgaver løses effektivt og uden unødige problemer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Kørsel med lastbil i dagdistribution

  • Levering og aflæsning hos faste kunder

  • Sortering og håndtering af gods ved pålæsning

  • Arbejdstid typisk mellem 06:00–17:00

Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring, hvor du kører med en af vores erfarne chauffører, så du lærer ruter, procedurer og arbejdspladsen at kende. Vi står altid klar til at hjælpe, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har kørekort C og/eller CE

  • Har gennemført lastbilchaufføruddannelsen

  • Er mødestabil, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har god fysik og kan håndtere gods

  • Trives med dagarbejde og faste rutiner

  • Kan kommunikere venligt og professionelt med kunder og disponenter

➕ Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med distribution eller lignende kørsel

⭐ Vi tilbyder:

  • En fast stilling i en virksomhed med ordnede forhold

  • Velholdte lastbiler

  • Grundig oplæring i ruter og procedurer

  • Gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

Interesseret?

Send din ansøgning og relevante dokumenter til:
job@naka.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og ser frem til et godt samarbejde.

Truck Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

About NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics is a transport company headquartered in the Triangle Region of Denmark. Our central location and skilled employees enable us to handle both large and small transport assignments efficiently.

We provide fast and precise solutions for every transport task, and with our own workshop, we keep our fleet running 24 hours a day while maintaining cost efficiency.

About the Position

We are looking for a flexible and responsible driver to join our well-functioning team. Teamwork is important to us, and we help each other ensure that daily tasks are completed efficiently and without unnecessary issues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Driving a truck on day distribution routes

  • Delivering and unloading goods for regular customers

  • Sorting and handling freight during loading

  • Working hours typically between 06:00 and 17:00

You will receive thorough training alongside one of our experienced drivers, allowing you to become familiar with routes, procedures, and the workplace. We are always available to support you if challenges arise during the workday.

We Expect You To:

  • Hold a Category C and/or CE driving licence

  • Have completed the professional truck driver qualification/training

  • Be reliable, independent, and responsible

  • Be physically fit and able to handle freight

  • Enjoy daytime work and structured routines

  • Communicate politely and professionally with customers and dispatchers

➕ It Is an Advantage If You:

  • Have experience with distribution driving or similar transport work

⭐ We Offer:

  • A permanent position in a company with well-organized working conditions

  • Well-maintained trucks

  • Thorough training in routes and procedures

  • Good colleagues and an informal working environment

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

Interested?

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@naka.dk

We look forward to hearing from you and to a successful future collaboration.

There are 2 vacancies available.

jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description:
Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr

NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce.

Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that.

The Social Comms role: We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment.

As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â 

The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public.

You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work.

You'd be a great fit if

  • You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious.
  • You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have.
  • You've run or grown popular social accounts before.
  • You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you.
  • You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about.
  • You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included.
  • You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time.
  • You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits.

Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks.

jobs.description:

Electrical Service Technician - Infrastructure Systems
Do you enjoy working on technical installations that directly contribute to safe traffic flow, reliable infrastructure and public safety? As an Electrical Service Technician, you will work on complex infrastructure projects involving tunnels, bridges, locks, pumping stations and water-related installations. No two days are the same, and your work has a visible impact on systems that must remain operational 24/7.
What we offer
At Employ IR, we provide you with the space and freedom for your own initiative and development. We believe it is important that you can apply your expertise within our organization. There is plenty of room to develop yourself and advance your career. Additionally, we offer: - Salary between €4.357 - €5.200 gross per month, depending on experience; - Employ IR covers work-related and relocation costs; - 8% holiday allowance on top of your annual salary; - 25 vacation days per year; - Company car, also available for private use; - A solid pension scheme for a secure future; - Opportunities for career growth, technical training and additional courses; - A safe, stable and supportive working environment focused on teamwork, technical quality and responsibility.
Job description
You will mainly work on electrical, measurement and control systems within dry and wet infrastructure. These systems are essential for keeping tunnels, bridges, locks, pumping stations and traffic-related installations safe and operational. Your work includes preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, commissioning and technical improvements. What you bring
This role is suited to a technician who enjoys variety, responsibility and independent work. You stay calm when faults occur, communicate clearly with clients and colleagues, and take pride in delivering safe and high-quality technical work.

jobs.title: Agile Coach Definition
jobs.description:
Agile coach
As organizations transition to Agile methodologies, they may need the expertise of an Agile Coach. An Agile Coach is someone who helps organizations successfully implement Agile methodologies. In addition, the Agile coach ensures that teams and individuals develop the right Agile skills and mindset. In this text, we will discuss the definition, competencies and responsibilities of an Agile Coach.
Definition Agile Coach
An Agile Coach is someone who helps organizations successfully implement Agile -methodologies. In addition, the Agile coach ensures that teams and individuals develop the right Agile skills and mindset. The goal of an Agile Coach is to advise organizations on how to improve their practices and integrate Agile methodologies. Agile Coaches are experts in understanding and adhering to Agile principles and ensuring that teams and individuals use the right tools and techniques to achieve desired results.
Key competencies
An Agile Coach needs a number of key competencies to be effective in his or her role. Some of these competencies are:
Knowledge of Agile methodologies : Is familiar with Agile methodologies and the principles behind them. He or she should be able to clearly explain and guide the application of these principles in practice.
Coaching and Training: Must be able to coach and train effectively. This includes the ability to ask the right questions, provide feedback and ensure good communication.
Leadership: Must be a Servant Leader. Servant-Leadership is a "way of being and doing" in which the leader is subservient to the growth of others, the organization and himself. In doing so, this philosophy contributes to a development of society as a whole.
Problem Solving: Must be able to solve problems and identify bottlenecks in the Agile process. He or she should be able to identify appropriate solutions and advise on their implementation.

jobs.title: Vrijwilliger Ouderensoos
jobs.description:
Wil jij als vrijwilliger bijdragen aan een gezellige vrijdagmiddag op onze ouderensoos? Wie zijn wij Wij zijn een dagbesteding voor ouder wordende mensen met een verstandelijke beperking op de Paardenmarkt in het centrum van Delft. Op deze locatie zijn verschillende woningen en ook een dagcentrum. Op het dagcentrum is op vrijdagmiddag een soos. De bezoekers komen daar voor de gezelligheid. Er moet niets, het gaat vooral om samen zijn. We doen spelletjes, kaarten, sjoelen. Drinken een kopje koffie en een drankje. Soms is er een bingo of komt er een koor optreden. Er komen gemiddeld 25 cliënten, de meeste wonen ook op locatie de Paardenmarkt. Sommigen komen met de bus van externe locaties. Het zijn oudere cliënten die functioneren op een laag tot hoog ontwikkelingsniveau. Kijk voor meer informatie over de locatie: Werken bij Ipse de Bruggen in Delft en Den Haag: een impressie Jouw baan als Vrijwilliger Ouderensoos Op vrijdagmiddag help je van 13.00 tot 16.30 uur bij de voorkomende werkzaamheden. Dat zijn spelletjes doen, koffiezetten, helpen bij het sjoelen en een gezellig praatje maken. Bij de soos werken meer vrijwilligers. Het is een gezellig groepje! Sommigen helpen ons al jaren, sommigen nog niet zo lang. Jouw profiel Je houdt van gezelligheid. En je vindt het leuk om samen met andere vrijwilligers en begeleiders onze bezoekers een leuke middag te bezorgen. Wat krijg je van ons Het aantal uren is in overleg; uiteraard houden wij rekening met je agenda en mogelijkheden. Wij zorgen goed voor onze vrijwilligers: Je wordt enthousiast ingewerkt. Je kunt je reiskosten declareren (in overleg onkosten). Er is jaarlijks een cursusaanbod over uiteen lopende thema’s. Wij zetten onze vrijwilligers regelmatig in het zonnetje. En hele dankbare gezichten omdat door jouw hulp meer mogelijk is. Informatie Je werkt bij Ipse de Bruggen vaak met kwetsbare cliënten en daarom zijn wij zeer zorgvuldig in ons selectiebeleid. De aanvraag Verklaring omtrent het gedrag (VOG), het navrage

van referenties en het opvragen van informatie bij de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd maken om die reden onderdeel uit van de selectieprocedure. Voor informatie kun je contact opnemen met Leonie Vugts (begeleider DAC Paardenmarkt), tel: 088 - 967 74 60.

RESPONSABILITÉS :

Vos missions :
Rattaché(e) à la Responsable des Opérations France, vous assurez la gestion globale de l'établissement, avec un focus sur la qualité, satisfaction clients, le développement commercial et la réalisation des objectifs financiers.


Vos responsabilités :


1. Gestion opérationnelle
- Garantir le bon fonctionnement quotidien de l'établissement
- Être présent(e) sur le terrain, au contact des équipes et des clients.
- Veiller au respect des procédures et standards de l'enseigne.
- Assurer le suivi des normes HACCP et la qualité des prestations.
- Superviser l'entretien des équipements en lien avec la direction technique.


2. Management
- Superviser, animer et coordonner une équipe d'environ 10 collaborateurs.
- Participer au recrutement et au développement des équipes selon les procédures RH.
- Former les équipes aux standards et procédures internes.
- Organiser les plannings et gérer l'organisation du travail (réception, étages, petit déjeuner).
- Évaluer et accompagner les collaborateurs dans leur évolution professionnelle.


3. Développement commercial
- Collaborer avec l'équipe siège pour optimiser le taux d'occupation (réservations, tarification, offres promotionnelles).
- Suivre la concurrence et adapter l'offre commerciale.
- Développer la clientèle sur la zone primaire des hôtels.
- Gérer activement la relation client.



4. Satisfaction clients :
- Garantir une expérience client fluide, qualitative et conforme aux standards de l'enseigne
- Gérer les réclamations avec réactivité et professionnalisme
- Mettre en œuvre les actions correctives et d'amélioration continue
- Suivre les indicateurs de satisfaction et de qualité de service

4. Suivi financier :
- Assurer le suivi des budgets et comptes d'exploitation.
- Analyser les indicateurs clés de gestion (PM, CA, TO, ratios).
- Veiller à la rentabilité de l'établissement
- Participer à l'optimisation des coûts et à la maîtrise des dépenses


Conditions du poste :
-  Salaire fixe annuel : 48K€ brut annuel
-  Prime sur objectifs : 10 % de la rémunération brute annuelle.
-  Statut  : Cadre (Forfait 218 jours)


Processus de recrutement :

Puis
- 1 entretien avec notre Responsable des Opérations France
- 1 entretien avec notre Responsable des Ressources Humaines

Profil recherché :
- Vous êtes diplômé en Gestion et Management hôtelier, avec une expérience confirmée en tant que Directeur(trice) de 3-5 ans minimum
- Vous maîtrisez l'anglais ;
- Vous êtes autonome, extrêmement rigoureux, réactif, disposez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles et de leadership ;
- Vous faites preuve d'un sens commercial aigu dans le but d'optimiser la rentabilité des établissements hôtelier

jobs.description:
Description du poste :

En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums.
L'entreprise Sopra Steria recherche actuellement des profils :

Description de l'entreprise

Sopra Steria , acteur majeur de la Tech en Europe avec 56 000 collaborateurs dans près de 30 pays, est reconnu pour ses activités de conseil, de services numériques et d'édition de logiciels. Il aide ses clients à mener leur transformation digitale et à obtenir des bénéfices concrets et durables. Le Groupe apporte une réponse globale aux enjeux de compétitivité des grandes entreprises et organisations, combinant une connaissance approfondie des secteurs d'activité et des technologies innovantes à une approche résolument collaborative.
Sopra Steria place l'humain au centre de son action et s'engage auprès de ses clients à tirer le meilleur parti du digital pour construire un avenir positif. En 2023, le Groupe a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 5,8 milliards d'euros.
The world is how we shape it

Description du poste

Le Data Center of Excellence Sopra Steria (DCoE), entité transverse du pôle France, est au cœur de l'accompagnement et de la transformation Data / IA de nos clients.

Convaincu que la Data est le moteur d'un socle industriel évolutif et durable, construit pour répondre aux enjeux buisness, nous travaillons sur toute la chaine afin d'apporter de la valeur à nos clients sur tous les niveaux (métier, IT, CxO.) en lien avec nos équipes conseils et delivery.

Le DCOE regroupe les expertises technologiques et méthodologiques sur toute la chaine de valeur Data : de la stratégie de transformation, à la mise en place d'usage d'IA au quotidien, en passant par la gouvernance et les architectures Data Cloud et on premise.

Environnement de travail

En tant que Consultant Analytics & IA vous intégrerez notre centre d'excellence Data, ce qui vous permettra d'intervenir auprès de divers clients dans des secteurs d'activités variés ( Banque, Assurance, Secteur Public, Télécom, Média, Jeux, Industrie et Services ) sur l'ensemble du territoire Français. Nous intervenons en appuis des équipes delivery, lors de la phase de prospection, d'avant-vente et de réalisation des projets.

Vous travaillerez en priorité sur les sujets d'Analytics & d'industrialisation IA (traitement des données, qualité, modélisation, visualisation, veille, innovation) tout en intégrant les meilleures pratiques d'industrialisation des projets IA à l'échelle d'une organisation.

Nous travaillons en partenariat avec les éditeurs phares du marché, ainsi qu'avec les hyperscaler.

Vos missions***Analyser des ensembles de données complexes pour répondre à des questions commerciales stratégiques et opérationnelles***Participer à des ateliers de conception et de conseil avec les clients.***Aider les clients à valoriser leurs données en leur donnant du sens à travers des outils d'exploration et de dashboarding.***Proposer des solutions de IA/ML, incluant méthodologies, architectures et outillages, tout en assurant l'accompagnement des clients.***Posséder des compétences sur des stacks MLOps et les meilleures pratiques, ex. Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world's leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Operations provide secure and efficient processing of Pictet's banking transactions and investment funds. Our teams ensure all activities follow regulations and manage risks.
By developing and maintaining a modern, robust infrastructure, we guarantee reliable, high-quality services for Pictet wealth management, asset management and real estate clients.

Your role

The main objective of this position is to perform in-depth analysis and checks on all types of investments in funds managed by FundPartner Solutions (FPS). The Valuer will play a key role in establishing and verifying valuation procedures, with a particular focus on Hedge Funds and Private Assets. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical skills, rigor, and a collaborative team spirit to analyze Audited Financial Statements and ensure the highest standards of accuracy and compliance.

• Audited Financial Statement Analysis: Analyze Audited Financial Statements of Hedge Funds and Private Assets to ensure accurate valuation and compliance with internal and regulatory standards.

• Risk Reporting Management: Manage risk reporting and conduct risk analysis through audited financial statements to identify areas of improvement or potential risks.
• Valuation Activities Reporting: Measure and report on valuation activities, ensuring excellent client service by providing accurate and timely reports.
• Back Testing Reporting: Present back testing reports to Conducting Officers or Boards as required, demonstrating the ability to clearly communicate findings and recommendations.

Your profile

• Master's degree in Economics or Finance
• Fluent in french and english
• 3 to 5 years experience in valuation, pricing, or corporate action, with a strong focus on analyzing Audited Financial Statements of Hedge Funds and Private Assets.

Experience in drafting or working on Audited Financial Statements is a plus.

Experience in the audit of alternative funds (Hedge Funds or Private Assets) is also considered a strong asset.

• Excellent knowledge of financial products and their valuation.
• Broad knowledge of funds regulation and fund administration.
• Experience with data vendors such as Bloomberg, Markit, ICE, Reuters.
• Proficient use of data and communication tools (e.g. MS Office suite, Business Object, Tableau, etc).
• Experience in the audit of alternative funds (Hedge Funds or Private Assets) is a plus.
• Experience with online collaboration tools and digital reporting platforms is an asset.
• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
• High level of rigor and organizational skills.
• Excellent problem-solving abilities.
• Strong team spirit and ability to collaborate effectively.
• Ability to present complex information clearly to senior management, Conducting Officers, or Boards, including back testing reports.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Join our Audit Recruitment Days – 22 and 23 October 2026


Make your mark:

Forget the traditional job interview process. KPMG Luxembourg's Audit Recruitment Days are a two-day immersive experience  designed to give you a real feel for what it means to be an Auditor at KPMG. Through interactive challenges, innovative assessment activities you'll get the chance to explore how modern audit is evolving while also getting to know our people, our culture and life in Luxembourg, all while being considered for a career opportunity at KPMG Luxembourg..

Audit is evolving rapidly. Emerging technologies, data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming the profession, creating exciting opportunities for curious minds who combine strong business understanding with a passion for innovation.

Whether your background is in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering or Technology, the Recruitment Days will allow you to experience how modern Audit combines professional judgment, technology and collaboration to create trust.


What to expect:

Day 1 - Step into #TeamBlue: You'll start the day at our KPMG Luxembourg headquarters where you'll kick things off with interactive presentations about KPMG and the world of Audit. After lunch, you'll dive into the Audit Tech Challenge, a collaborative activity that gives you a real taste of modern Audit in action. In the afternoon, you'll get to discover Luxembourg through a fun team-based urban rally. The day will end with a special networking dinner with our Partners and Service Line Leaders before returning to your accommodation for the night, provided by KPMG.

Day 2 - Time to shine: This is where you'll show your strengths and take part in your a business interview with our Audit professionals. Following the interview, you'll get to participate in an engaging Virtual Reality Cchallenge, meet our people in a lively speed-networking session, and have an exclusive office tour. We'll wrap the day up with lunch followed by a closing session, where a few surprises and highlights await!

The following week, you'll receive feedback because we value transparency and growth! If the outcome is positive, you will also receive a job offer to join KPMG Luxembourg.


Your future role:

As a Junior Auditor, you'll do much more than just review financial information.

You'll combine audit expertise with technology, data and innovation to help clients build trust in an increasingly digital world. Your responsibilities will include:

Applying your accounting and finance knowledge to real client engagements using IFRS, Luxembourg GAAP and international auditing standards.  
Working alongside experienced auditors to understand business processes, identify risks and deliver high-quality audits.  
Leveraging data, technology and emerging AI-enabled tools to support audit procedures and improve efficiency.  
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to solve complex business challenges.  
Contributing to innovative projects that improve audit methodologies, data analytics and digital transformation.  
Continuously developing both your audit expertise and your digital capabilities throughout your career.


Who we're looking for:

We're looking for ambitious, sharp-minded people who are ready to grow and make an impact with us at KPMG Luxembourg. If you check these boxes, we want to hear from you! Here's what you need to know:

Start date: We are looking for candidates available to start in October 2027 and January 2028.
Education: You have (or will soon have) a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Audit, Accounting, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science or IT. Bonus points if you're interested in professional accountancy qualifications (e.g., IRE).
Languages: You're fluent in English, plus either French, German, or Luxembourgish.
Mindset: Analytical, curious about technology, eager to learn, collaborative and ready to embrace innovation.  
Integrity: You value quality, ethics and doing the right thing.


What's in it for you:

Your future starts here! At KPMG, you'll get:

Training and support: A full-on learning experience, including our Induction Week plus all the resources to keep leveling up.  
Career growth: Want to work in another department or in a different office? We make it part of your professional development.
Impactful work: Work with top experts, collaborate with global clients, and use cutting-edge technology to make a difference.
Fun and community: From KPMG Plage to staff parties and sports activities, we make work-life balance a reality.
Flexibility: Work from home or at different office locations – we're all about that modern work setup.
Inclusive culture: We champion diversity, gender equality, and strong support for the LGBTQ+ community. You belong here!
This isn't just another job opportunity - it's your chance to join a dynamic, forward-thinking team that values your potential. Join #TeamBlue and be part of something bigger!

jobs.description:
Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist – Semantic AI, Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering
Job ID: 10517592 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

At Amazon we believe that Every Day is still Day One! We're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth and Amazon's Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering (C-RME) team is at the heart of that mission, using science and data to drive scalable maintenance best practices across Amazon business units globally.
We are seeking a Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist to lead key semantic layer and knowledge intelligence initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of knowledge engineering, ontology design, and applied AI, owning workstreams for the development of semantic foundations and dedicated science approaches that ensure their accuracy, consistency, and explainability in service of agentic and non-agentic AI across RME.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will contribute to the success of Central and Field RME teams working with new launches of Amazon buildings, as well as ensure that our Field teams benefit from state-of-the art AI solutions to support Global Operational Excellence.
You will closely work with our team of senior scientists and systems engineers in our knowledge intelligence team, which is leading the full lifecycle of graph-based AI solutions, from customer problem formulation and ontology design to production deployment, enabling network-wide data discovery, decision support, and compliance monitoring.
A core part of your mandate is to lead the semantic modelling and ontological foundation layer that supports both explainability and retrieval capabilities. This foundation feeds into transversal initiatives spanning multiple teams and products involving multiple AI approaches. You will closely work with Senior Applied Scientists owning explainability, causal reasoning, intelligent retrieval and question answering over knowledge graphs.

As a Senior Applied AI Engineer/Scientist, you will:

• lead the semantic layer for agentic AI, including developing and assessing the ontological foundations that enable autonomous workflows and cross-site best practice sharing. You will also disseminate governance and standardization practices that ensure downstream consumers (including retrieval and explainability systems) operate on consistent, well-defined semantics
• design, build, and deploy graph-based AI solutions that combine knowledge graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and ML models to extract meaning from large-scale unstructured document collections, enabling data discovery, classification, and governance across RME
• define and own knowledge pipelines that extract, transform, and enrich entity relationships from diverse unstructured and semi-structured sources into production-grade knowledge graphs, ensuring reliability and accuracy of the overall information architecture
• collaborate with fellow senior scientists to design, deploy, and operate graph and vector databases to support retrieval, causal reasoning, and analytics use case as well as ensure contributing scientists maintain versioning, validation state, and provenance for every knowledge graph entry
• collaborate with fellow senior applied scientists to ensure ontology and schema design decisions optimize for queryability, so that question-answering and retrieval systems can leverage the semantic layer with minimal impedance mismatch
• integrate LLMs and ML models into text processing pipelines for classification, embedding generation, document similarity, entity extraction, and semantic analysis, applying rigorous experimentation and evaluation methodology to select the best fit-for purpose approach
• design ontological structures that support explainability, enabling agents and reasoning systems to trace reasoning paths and surface provenance, enabling governance-level transparency for autonomous AI actions
• optimize models and inference pipelines for production constraints including latency, throughput, cost, and infrastructure reliability
• establish best practices and standards for knowledge engineering and applied science processes, elevating the maturity of RME's data, information, and AI capabilities
• mentor and train colleagues on knowledge graph concepts, semantic modelling, and applied AI techniques

About the team

The Amazon Reliability and Maintenance Engineering (RME) team maintains and optimizes technologies ranging from large, modern, purpose-built warehouses utilizing robotics and high-volume conveyance all the way through the value chain to small, high-speed warehouses placed as close to our customers as possible. Central Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) uses science and data to drive scalable maintenance best practices across Amazon business units globally. We do this to meet our customer promise, reduce costs, and support the Climate Pledge.

asic Qualifications

- Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
- Experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing, or experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware
- • MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Computational Linguistics, Information Science, or a related quantitative field (or equivalent industry experience)
- • Proven experience developing and deploying production knowledge graphs in real business scenarios at enterprise scale
- • Deep expertise in semantic technologies, modelling languages (RDF, OWL, etc..), and querying languages (SPARQL, Gremlin, Cypher, or other GQLs);
- • Experience with MLOps practices: building production-grade pipelines, CI/CD for ML, containerization, and monitoring of deployed AI solutions
- • Appetite for staying at the forefront of semantic web technologies and graph applications

Preferred Qualifications

- Knowledge of AWS services including compute, storage, networking, security, databases, machine learning, and serverless technologies
- • PhD in a relevant field with publications in knowledge representation, NLP, or graph-based AI
- • Familiarity with graph visualization tools and techniques
- • Experience leveraging graph theory (traversals, centrality, community detection) and graph analytics in applied settings
- • Experience designing clean, modular, and testable ML code in a collaborative environment

jobs.title: Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d) f. Liechtenstein gesucht A26/9821 Li (Hausdame/Housekeeper)
jobs.description:
Liechtenstein

Gesucht wird für einen gehobenen 2-Personen-Privathaushalt in einem stilvollen kleinen Familienschloss in Liechtenstein eine erfahrene und engagierte **Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d).** Die private Residenz umfasst rund 15 Zimmer sowie ein parkähnliches Grundstück. Sie arbeiten in einem gepflegten, repräsentativen Umfeld gemeinsam mit weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses und übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit hoher Eigenständigkeit.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Verantwortungsvolle Führung und Organisation des gehobenen Privathaushalts
- Sicherstellung einer tadellosen Sauberkeit, Ordnung und gepflegten Atmosphäre im gesamten Haus
- Reinigung und Pflege hochwertiger Oberflächen, Materialien und Einrichtungen
- Fachgerechte Wäschepflege, einschließlich Waschen, Bügeln, Falten und Versorgen anspruchsvoller Textilien
- Sicherer und sorgfältiger Umgang mit hochwertigen Stoffen, Antiquitäten, Kunstgegenständen und wertvollem Inventar
- Vorbereitung und Zubereitung kleiner Mahlzeiten, insbesondere des Frühstücks
- Aufmerksame Betreuung der Hausherren sowie professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Gästen
- Unterstützung bei Empfängen, Einladungen und besonderen Anlässen
- Koordination und Abstimmung mit den weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses
- Konsequente Einhaltung und Kontrolle der geltenden Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards

Ihr Profil

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Hausdame, Gouvernante oder in einer vergleichbaren Position in einem gehobenen Privathaushalt
- Fundierte Vorkenntnisse aus der 4- oder 5-Sterne-Hotellerie
- Ausgeprägte Gastgeberqualität, Serviceorientierung und ein sicheres, kultiviertes Auftreten
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in der Pflege hochwertiger Wäsche und Textilien
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit Antiquitäten, Kunstobjekten und anspruchsvoller Einrichtung
- Selbstständige, strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Diskretion und Loyalität
- Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit in einem privaten, exklusiven Umfeld
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gepflegte Erscheinung und ausgezeichnete Umgangsformen
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Arbeitszeiten am Wochenende
- Ausgezeichneter Leumund

Geboten wird

- Eine verantwortungsvolle und langfristig ausgerichtete Position in einem außergewöhnlichen privaten Umfeld
- Ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima in einem professionell geführten Haushalt
- Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden in Haus und Garten
- Eine vielseitige, anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
- Ein überdurchschnittliches Gehalt, welches sich an Erfahrung und Qualifikation orientiert

Bei der Wohnungssuche ist die Familie gerne behilflich, es handelt sich hier um eine Vollzeit-Anstellung. Gebeten wird um vollständige Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Lebenslauf, Referenzen und Angaben zu Ihrer Verfügbarkeit. Die Position ist nach Absprache zu besetzen und wird ausnehmend gut vergütet.

🌟 Stellenangebot: Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in (MTR / MTRA) - Basel, Schweiz

Ihre Perspektive in Basel
Möchten Sie Ihre Fachkompetenz in einem hochmodernen medizinischen Umfeld einbringen und von den attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens profitieren?
Im Auftrag einer renommierten Radiologie-Praxis bzw. Klinik im Raum Basel suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Expertise im Bereich der Mammographie sowie Vielseitigkeit in der allgemeinen Bildgebung.
Ihre Aufgaben
Schwerpunkt Mammographie: Eigenverantwortliche und empathische Durchführung von Mammographien auf höchstem technischem Niveau sowie Betreuung der Patientinnen während des gesamten Untersuchungsablaufs.
Allgemeine Radiologische Diagnostik: Kompetente Durchführung von Routine- und Spezialuntersuchungen in den Bereichen Röntgen, Computertomographie (CT) und Magnetresonanztomographie (MRT).
Prozess- & Qualitätsmanagement: Einhaltung und Sicherstellung höchster Qualitäts-, Strahlenschutz- und Hygienestandards.
Patientenorientierung: Professionelle, einfühlsame Vorbereitung und Betreuung der Patienten in einer vertrauensvollen Atmosphäre.
Das bringen Sie mit
Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTR / MTRA (Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in) oder eine vergleichbare, in der Schweiz anerkannte Qualifikation.
Fachkompetenz: Nachweisbare, vertiefte Erfahrung und hohe Routine in der Mammographie.
Vielseitigkeit: Gute Praxiskenntnisse und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Geräten der Sparten Röntgen, CT und MRT.
Persönlichkeit: Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Empathie im Umgang mit Patienten sowie eine zuverlässige, selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Das erwartet Sie
Attraktive Vergütung: Schweizer Gehaltsstandard inklusive hervorragender Sozialleistungen und Vorsorgekonzepte.
Modernste Technologie: Arbeiten mit Geräten der neuesten Generation in einem dynamischen und professionellen Team.
Umfassender Relocation-Support: Als Deutsch-Schweizer Vermittlungsverbund begleiten wir Sie persönlich beim Übergang nach Basel (Anerkennung der Diplome, Behördengänge, Wohnungssuche, steuerliche Orientierung).
Work-Life-Balance: Geregelte Arbeitszeiten, planbare Schichten und die hohe Lebensqualität der Dreiländereck-Region Basel.
Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?
Senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Diplome) einfach per E-Mail an uns. Wir begleiten Sie diskret, kostenfrei und Schritt für Schritt auf Ihrem Weg zu Ihrer neuen Herausforderung in der Schweiz!

jobs.description:
Experience the power of a game-changing career  

Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as a Business Developer (Hybrid), you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.  

What you will do in this role  

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  

As a Business Developer (Hybrid) on our team, you will:  

- **Manage OEM Account Information:** - Find and identify existing OEM accounts through research.
- Build and keep a list of new OEM accounts we might want to work with.
- Gather and update details about current OEM accounts, including their industry, what they use our products for (use cases), past successful projects, platforms they use, and other relevant information.
- **Help Partners Use Our Portal:** - Assist in keeping the Partner OEM portal up-to-date and easy to use.
- Develop ideas to get more partners to use the portal as their main source of information.
- **Find Leads for Sales:** - Look at upcoming trade shows to find potential OEM accounts.

jobs.title: Senior Professional Data-Engineer (Data Engineer)
jobs.description:
who we are At adorsys, we are not just developers and analysts; we are pioneers shaping the digital future for banking and insurance sectors. For over a decade, we have crafted innovative software solutions that grant our clients a decisive edge in their business. We foster an international and agile work environment that thrives on diversity, creativity, and collaboration.
What awaits youWe are looking for experienced Data Engineers to join an international platform team responsible for the infrastructure and data management of intelligent automation services in the finance domain. The services leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning models to generate automated booking proposals from various financial data sources.

The team is currently modernizing its platform to ensure long-term scalability, stability, and performance. By 2026, all core components and data pipelines will be migrated to a modern infrastructure stack based on Kubernetes, Apache Iceberg, and other state-of-the-art technologies.

As a Data Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing scalable data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, and streaming solutions, ensuring high data quality, governance, and security standards.

Your profile Main Tasks & Responsibilities
• Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Apache NiFi.
• Implement and manage data lakehouse structures based on Apache Iceberg, including schema evolution, partitioning, and time travel features.
• Develop and optimize SQL queries and data access layers with Trino, ensuring high performance and reliability.
• Integrate diverse data sources (Kafka, S3, RDBMS, REST APIs, etc.) into unified pipelines.
• Ensure data quality, security, and governance across the data infrastructure.
• Perform performance tuning, monitoring, and troubleshooting of data pipelines and distributed systems.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (data scientists, platform engineers, business stakeholders) to deliver data-driven solutions.
• Document technical designs, concepts, and processes.

Required Skills & Experience
• Proven experience with Apache Iceberg, Apache NiFi, and Trino.
• Understanding and ability to work with Apache Spark code.
• Experience with ETL/ELT processes and integrating APIs.
• Hands-on expertise in real-time streaming with Apache Kafka.
• Strong background in large-scale data processing and distributed systems.
• Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), especially S3, IAM, Glue.
• Programming languages: Python, Java, or Scala.
• Containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes.
• CI/CD & DevOps tools: Git, Jenkins, Terraform, GitHub Actions.
• Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Splunk.
• Strong knowledge of SQL and performance optimization techniques.

Nice to Have
• Experience with Azure cloud services.
• Familiarity with CI/CD automation and Infrastructure as Code.
• Practical knowledge of security configurations in data processing.

Soft Skills
• Structured and solution-oriented working style.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills within interdisciplinary teams.
• Ability to document and explain complex technical processes in a clear manner.

Project Context

The platform team develops and maintains the data infrastructure for automation services in the accounting and finance sector. These services use artificial intelligence to continuously improve booking suggestions based on historical cloud data, ensuring seamless integration into familiar workflows.
To ensure scalability and long-term stability, the platform is being migrated to a new infrastructure (Kubernetes, Apache Iceberg, etc.) by 2026. This transformation secures performance, scalability, and future-proof operations.

Why us?We're not just offering a job; we're inviting you to be part of a movement. With us, you'll navigate the exciting terrain of finance and banking and contribute to sustainable financial living. Benefit from a German firm's structure and security, coupled with competitive remuneration and a culture that nurtures growth.

Your contact personLucian Mihaila

About usWe have been developing individual software for banks and insurance companies for more than 10 years. We do this to give our customers a real competitive advantage. Our teams accompany the clients from the first idea to the finished product.
Regardless of whether an existing service needs to be modernized or the solution for a new business model is missing: we develop software for a digital future.

jobs.title: Tugiisik
jobs.description:
tugiisik 3-aastasele rõõmsale ja armsale poisile

Tööülesanded: Tugiisiku töö toimub peamiselt lapse abistajana heas eestikeelses tavalasteaias. Lapsel on kõne hilistumine, kuid vaatamata kõne puudumisele on ta kõigest huvituv, lustlik ja aktiivne. Ta on liikumisel ja tegevustes osav, ettevaatlik ning vaatlev-uuriv. Vahetevahel võib ta olla ka ulakas ja mitte kohe kuuletuda.
Laps vajab tugiisiku abi ja juhendamist eelkõige: • lasteaia tegevustest osa võtmisel; • lasteaia päevakava ja kodukorra järgimisel; • riietumisel; • söömisel; • hügieenitoimingutel; • turvalisuse ja järelevalve tagamisel. Tugiisiku jaoks on laps väga tore ja pigem kerge klient: ta on hästi kontakteeruv, rõõmsameelne ja koostöövalmis.

Omalt poolt pakume: Tugiisik võetakse tööle Tallina Perekeskuse poolt käsunduslepinguga. Töökoormus, tööaeg ja motivatsioonisüsteem on läbiräägitavad.

Muud nõuded: Tugiisikuks sobib täisealine inimene, kes on läbinud tugiisiku koolituse ja/või töötanud eelnevalt lastega.
Kandidaadilt ootame sobivaid isikuomadusi, head suhtlemisoskust, rahulikku meelt, usaldusväärsust ja valmisolekut lapse igapäevast toimetulekut toetada. Tugiisik peab: • oskama näha last tervikuna; • suutma suhelda lapse, tema pere ja lähedastega; • suutma kanda vastutust lapse ohutuse ja turvalisuse eest; • tegutsema vastavalt olukorrale; • järgima vastastikuse usalduse, lugupidamise ja konfidentsiaalsuse põhimõtteid. Tugiisik peab läbima korrapärase tervisekontrolli nakkushaiguste suhtes, sealhulgas iga kahe aasta järel kopsude röntgenuuringu. Tugiisikul peab olema tervisekontrolli läbimise kohta perearsti väljastatud tervisetõend. Tugiisikuks ei sobi inimene, kes on süüdi mõistetud tahtlikult toimepandud kuriteo eest või kes ei vasta muudele seadustes sätestatud nõuetele.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.title: CLEANER
jobs.description:
**About the position**

Safai Cleaning Services is looking for a reliable and motivated Cleaner to perform cleaning and facility service duties at our customer locations.

The work includes maintaining clean, safe, and hygienic premises in accordance with the employers instructions and customer requirements.

**Main duties**

The Cleaners duties may include:

- Perform a variety of cleaning duties (including nursing home, Airbnb, residential, and regular cleaning).

- Regular cleaning and maintenance of customer premises

- Cleaning floors, surfaces, sanitary facilities and common areas

- Vacuuming, mopping and dusting

- Waste collection and disposal according to workplace instructions

- Maintaining cleanliness and hygiene standards

- Using cleaning equipment and materials safely

- Following employer instructions and work schedules

- Following occupational safety regulations

- Following customer-site rules and security instructions


**Requirements**

We are looking for a person who:

- Previous working experience in cleaning filed at Finland

- Due to work location the driving license is must

- Working with elderly required criminal certificate

- Is reliable, responsible and punctual

- Is able to work independently

- Has good attention to cleanliness and quality

- Is physically able to perform cleaning duties

- Is willing to work at different customer locations when required

- Follows occupational safety and workplace instructions

- Has a professional attitude towards customers and colleagues


Previous experience in cleaning or facility services is considered an advantage.

**Working hours**

Working hours are scheduled according to operational and customer needs and in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.

The position involves an average working time arrangement of 8 hours per week.

Depending on work requirements and the applicable collective agreement, work may include:

- Additional working hours

- Weekdays, Night and Sunday work

- Other scheduled shifts in accordance with the agreement


**Salary and benefits**

Salary and applicable supplements are paid in accordance with the Collective Agreement for the Facility Services Sector (Kiinteistöpalveluala TES).

The applicable hourly wage at the commencement of employment is €12.26 per hour, or the valid TES minimum wage applicable at the time of payment.

Applicable supplements, such as evening, night, Sunday and overtime compensation, are paid according to the collective agreement.

**Work location**

The work is performed primarily at Safai Cleaning Services customer locations in the Pirkanmaa region. Work may also be assigned to other customer locations in Finland when reasonably required by the employers business operations.

jobs.title: Daglig Leder til Beni Burger i Carlsbergbyen
jobs.description:
Beni er en ny burgerbar i Carlsberg Byen, skabt i samarbejde mellem Norrlyst Koncernen og Casper Drømme. Vi har rygende travlt og søger derfor en dygtig og engageret daglig leder, der har lyst til at være en central del af den daglige drift og udviklingen af Beni.

Som daglig leder bliver du den, der sikrer, at restauranten spiller – både foran gæsterne og bag kulisserne. Du får et tæt samarbejde med teamet og ledelsen og kommer til at have ansvar for den daglige drift af Front of House.

DINE PRIMÆRE ANSVARSOMRÅDER

  • Daglig drift – sikre, at restauranten fungerer optimalt fra åbning til luk.

  • Personaleplanlægning – udarbejdelse af vagtplaner, koordinering af medarbejdere og sikring af det rette hold på gulvet.

  • Varebestilling – holde styr på lager, forbrug og bestilling af varer, så vi altid er klar til service.

  • Floor management – være synlig og nærværende på gulvet, lede teamet under service og sikre den gode gæsteoplevelse.

Stillingen er en kombination af administrative opgaver og hands-on drift i restauranten. Du skal derfor både trives foran computeren med planlægning og koordinering og på gulvet, hvor tempoet er højt, og beslutningerne skal træffes hurtigt.

VI FORESTILLER OS, AT DU

Har erfaring fra en lignende rolle i restaurantbranchen – gerne fra et koncept med højt tempo, mange gæster og fokus på både kvalitet og effektiv drift.

Du er struktureret og kan bevare overblikket, når der er travlt. Du tager ansvar, går forrest og har naturlig autoritet uden at være bange for selv at tage fat, når der skal gives gas på gulvet.

Du har blik for både gæster, kolleger og driften og forstår, at den gode restaurantoplevelse skabes af et stærkt team, tydelig ledelse og godt købmandskab.

VI TILBYDER

  • En fuldtidsstilling som daglig leder på Beni.

  • En central rolle i et nyt og ambitiøst burgerkoncept.

  • Mulighed for at være med til at forme og udvikle restauranten fra starten.

  • Et stærkt team og en arbejdsplads med højt tempo, godt humør og masser af energi.

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig sammen med Norrlyst Koncernen.

Stillingen er med start hurtigst muligt.

Hvis du kan se dig selv stå i spidsen for den daglige drift på Beni, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Directeur d'hôtel H/F (H/F)
jobs.description:
Notre client est un groupe hôtelier à taille humaine, multi-enseignes, exploitant plusieurs établissements sous franchises Accor et Louvre Hotels Group en France.
Nous recherchons pour un de leur établissement situé en région lyonnaise, leur futur :

Directeur d'hôtel H/F
CDI - Statut Cadre
Basé à Lyon
Plus de 150 chambres - Hôtellerie économique
Encadrement d'une 20aine de personnes

Vos motivations :
Vous souhaitez relever un véritable challenge de direction au sein d'un actif hôtelier à fort potentiel. Vous appréciez les environnements où tout reste à construire, où votre impact est visible et où les résultats dépendent directement de votre capacité à mobiliser les équipes et à mettre en œuvre des actions concrètes.
Vous aimez les postes terrain, avec une forte dimension opérationnelle, commerciale et managériale. Vous recherchez une structure à taille humaine vous laissant une réelle autonomie dans vos décisions tout en bénéficiant du soutien d'un groupe solide.

Vos missions :
Rattaché à la Direction des Exploitations, votre mission principale consiste à redonner une dynamique de performance à cet actif stratégique du groupe en activant l'ensemble des leviers opérationnels, commerciaux et humains.
- Développement commercial : définir et piloter le plan d'action commercial, développer les partenariats locaux, renforcer la visibilité de l'établissement, optimiser le mix clientèle et contribuer à l'amélioration durable du chiffre d'affaires.
- Revenue management et performance : En relation avec le revenue manager du groupe, suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (taux d'occupation, prix moyen, RevPAR, GOP), analyser les résultats, identifier les axes d'amélioration et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires.
- Management : recruter, encadrer, accompagner et fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs. Développer une culture de la performance, de l'engagement et de la satisfaction client.
- Exploitation : garantir le bon fonctionnement quotidien, veiller au respect des standards de marque, assurer la qualité de service et maintenir un haut niveau de satisfaction client.
- Gestion sociale : accompagner les évolutions organisationnelles du site et assurer un dialogue social constructif dans un contexte d'internalisation récente des équipes de ménage.
- Pilotage économique : élaborer et suivre les budgets, optimiser les charges d'exploitation et garantir la rentabilité des établissements.

Votre profil :
Issu d'une formation en hôtellerie, tourisme ou gestion, vous justifiez d'une expérience significative en direction d'hôtel ou en direction adjointe au sein d'établissements à forte capacité.
- Vous êtes reconnu pour votre forte orientation résultats et votre capacité à développer l'activité commerciale d'un établissement. Véritable manager de terrain, vous savez mobiliser les équipes, accompagner le changement et créer une dynamique positive dans des contextes exigeants.
- Doté d'une excellente culture opérationnelle, vous maîtrisez les enjeux de rentabilité, de revenue management et de satisfaction client. Vous faites preuve d'autonomie, de leadership et d'une forte capacité d'analyse.

jobs.title: Konevuookraamon esihenkilö
jobs.description:

_Ramirent Finland Oy on Suomen suurin palveluyritys, joka tarjoaa konevuokrauksen rinnalla laaja-alaisesti palveluita rakennusalan ja teollisuuden asiakkailleen. Palvelemme asiakkaitamme maanlaajuisesti yli 500 luotettavasta ammattilaisesta koostuvan henkilöstön voimin. Ramirent kuuluu Loxam-konserniin, joka on yksi maailman suurimmista konevuokraamoista. Haluamme panostaa toimintamme ensiluokkaiseen asiakaskokemukseen sekä pitkiin asiakassuhteisiin, mikä onnistuu osaavien ja innostuneiden työntekijöiden avulla. Ramirent on arvostettu ja pidetty työpaikka, mistä tunnustuksena meille on myönnetty kansainvälisesti arvostettu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatti. Toimimme työnantajana vastuullisesti, teemme töitä turvallisessa työympäristössä ja huolehdimme henkilöstön ammatillisesta kehityksestä, terveydestä sekä hyvinvoinnista. Lisätietoa yrityksestä: https://rakennatyopaikkasi.ramirent.fi/_

_Ramirent vuokraa työkoneita ja -laitteita asiakkaiden työmaille ympäri Suomen. Ramirentin toimintaperiaatteisiin kuuluu niin laadukkaan palvelun kuin tuotteiden tarjoaminen, mikä tarkoittaa hyvin huollettua kalustoa ja asiantuntevaa henkilöstöä._

_Etsimme hyvillä esihenkilötaidoilla ja asiakaspalveluasenteella varustettua jämäkkää ja energistä tekijää. Esihenkilönä vastaat mm. toimipisteen asiakaspalvelusta, kalustosta, tuloksesta, työturvallisuudesta sekä tavoitteiden asettamisesta henkilökunnalle. Isona osana työstäsi osallistut tiimisi rinnalla päivittäiseen työhön._

**_Toivomme sinulta_**

- _Kokemusta esihenkilötyöskentelystä sekä jämäkkää, modernia esihenkilöotetta_

- _Asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä_

- _Järjestelmällisyyttä ja kykyä vastuunkantoon ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, mutta myös yhteistyöhön sidosryhmien kanssa_

- _Motivaatiota osallistua tarvittaessa vuokraamon päivittäisiin töihin (asiakaspalvelu, kaluston tarkastukset, varastointi jne.) hanskat kädessä_

- _Teknistä ja/tai kaupallista koulutusta, sekä kokemusta tekniikan parissa toimimisesta aiemmassa työelämässä tai vapaa-ajalla_

- _Kykyä käyttää tarvittavia tietoteknisiä järjestelmiä ja omaksua uusia asioita muuttuvassa työympäristössä_

- _Joustavuutta ja paineensietokykyä usein hektisessä ja monitahoisessa työssäsi_

- _Hyviä kommunikointitaitoja_

- _Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja tarvittaessa pärjäät englannin kielellä_


**_Eduksesi luemme myös_**

- _Suhteet rakennusliikkeisiin ja/tai teollisuuteen Pohjois-Suomen alueella_

- _Kokemuksen myynti- ja/tai asiakaspalvelutyöstä_

- _BE-ajokortin_


**_Mitä tarjoamme sinulle_**

_Työtäsi on tukemassa modernit järjestelmät ja osaava tiimi sekä koko alan suurimman toimijan asiantunteva henkilöstö. Saat tehtävääsi kattavan perehdytyksen ja ympärillesi ammattitaitoisen ja mielekkään työporukan. Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisia urapolkumahdollisuuksia kansainvälisessä organisaatiossa ja hyvät työsuhde-edut mm. lounas- ja virike-etu ja kattavan työterveyshuollon palvelut. Lisäksi koko henkilöstömme on mukana bonusohjelmassa._

jobs.title: Vastuumyyjäksi S-market Tikkulaan
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORI

Haemme S-market Tikkulaan osa-aikaista vastuumyyjää (32 h/vko) määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen 31.12.2027 asti.

Tule kanssamme tekemään ihan tavallista marketkaupan työtä, jonka seurauksena syntyy poikkeuksellisen hyvä kauppa asiakkaillemme sekä sujuva, mutkaton työarki Tikkulan huipputiimillemme! Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä vastuullisessa ja monipuolisessa roolissa osana ammattitaitoista työyhteisöä.

Vastuumyyjän roolissa työtä tehdään koko viikon akselilla ja Tikkulan S-market palvelee asiakkaita 24h, joten kyseessä on vaihteleva vuorotyö sisältäen myös yötyötä.Tehtävän aloitus on marraskuussa 2026 sopimuksen mukaan ja määräaikaisen työsuhteen kesto on 31.12.2027 asti.

Vastuumyyjä vastaayksikön tuloksellisesta toiminnasta yhdessä muun vastaavatiimin kanssa, esihenkilön johdolla. Toimit tärkeässä roolissa yksikön päivittäisessä johtamisessa varmistaen, että myymälän arki sujuu tehokkaasti ja asiakaslähtöisesti. Työssäsi osallistut aktiivisesti asiakaspalveluun, myyntityöhön, hyllytyksiin, verkkokauppakeräilyyn ja muihin myymälän ylläpidon työtehtäviin. Omassa roolissasi organisoit vuoroa, tuet tiimiäsi arjen tilanteissa sekä edistät hyvää työilmapiiriä. Tehtävässä tarvitaan joustavuutta, paineensietokykyä ja pilkettä silmäkulmassa.

Edellytämme kaupan alan osaamista ja nopearytmisen ruokakaupan arjen ymmärtämistä. Odotamme tiimityöskentelytaitoja, vastuuntuntoisuutta ja valmiutta kehittyä päivittäisessä johtamisessa. Sinulla onkin ympärillä hyvä tukiverkosto, joka tukee sinua ammatillisessa kasvussa ja ohjaa arjen onnistumisiin pitkin matkaa.

Tarjoamme monipuolisen vastuullisen roolin, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan onnistuneen työarjen toteutumiseen yksikössä. S-market Tikkulassa sinut toivottaa tervetulleeksi osaava huipputiimi.

Perehdytämme sinut kaikkiin tehtäviin ja esihenkilösi tukee sekä opastaa sinua onnistumisiin pitkin matkaa. Meillä pääset kehittämään osaamistasi myös valmennuksen ja koulutusmahdollisuuksiemme kautta sekä voit halutessasi osoittaa kiinnostusta ja motivaatiota urapolun rakentamiseen vastuutehtävien parissa.

Työntekijänämme saat käyttöösi myös Satakunnan Osuuskaupan ja S-ryhmän erinomaiset henkilöstöedut. S-ryhmän henkilökunta saa alennuksia kaikista S-ryhmän toimipaikoista, kuten Prismasta, S-marketista ja Sokos Hotelleista sekä S-ryhmän ravintoloista. Lisäksi tarjoamme etuja yhteistyökumppaneilta ja hyvinvointiin liittyen. Eduistamme voit lukea lisäätäältä!

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa marketpäällikkö Pia Jakonen sähköpostilla pia.jakonen@sok.fi tai ryhmäpäällikkö Merja Perttula-Vuori sähköpostilla merja.perttula-vuori@sok.fi.

📅Haethan tehtävää viimeistäänkeskiviikkona 23.9.2026.Käytämme rekrytoinnissa Recright-videohaastattelua ensimmäisenä vaiheena. Mahdolliset jatkohaastattelut toteutetaan yksilöhaastatteluina.

Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on paikallinen yritys, jonka omistavat satakuntalaiset asiakasomistajat. Tehtävämme on tuottaa asiakasomistajillemme palveluita ja etuja. Toimimme marketkaupassa, matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupassa ja liikennekaupassa. Satakunnan Osuuskauppa on alueensa suurin yksityinen työnantaja, ja savuton työpaikka. Olemme osa valtakunnallista S-ryhmää.
