jobs.title: Interior Outfitting Design Lead
jobs.description:
SUOMEN SUURIN PIENI INSINÖÖRITOIMISTO ETSII LISÄÄ TYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ.

Meillä Suuri tarkoittaa monipuolisia työtehtäviä suurilla energia-, prosessi-, meri- ja puolustusteollisuuden toimijoilla. Pieni tarkoittaa yrityskulttuuria ja johtamistapaa: meillä ihmiset tunnetaan, työntekijöitä kuunnellaan ja jokaisen osaamista halutaan kehittää.

LIITY MUKAAN TOTEUTTAMAAN VAATIVIA MERITEOLLISUUDEN KOKONAISHANKKEITA

Etsimme kokenutta Interior Outfitting Design Leadiä vastaamaan majoitus-, matkustaja- ja työskentelytilojen teknisestä suunnittelusta sekä eri suunnittelualojen yhteensovittamisesta asiakkaallemme Turun seudulla.

Pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa kansainvälisissä hankkeissa, joissa yhdistyvät arkkitehtuuri, tekninen suunnittelu, rakentaminen ja projektinhallinta.

TEHTÄVÄSSÄSI VASTAAT

* Sisustus- ja accommodation-ratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja koordinoinnista

* Projektien laadun, budjetin ja aikataulun hallinnasta

* Teknisten spesifikaatioiden sekä toteutusdokumentaation laatimisesta

* Sisustusratkaisujen kustannuslaskennasta

* Suunnitteluaikataulujen laatimisesta ja seurannasta

* Eri suunnittelualojen rajapintojen yhteensovittamisesta

* Asiakkaiden, viranomaisten, telakoiden ja toimittajien kanssa tehtävästä yhteistyöstä

* 2D- ja 3D-suunnittelumallien teknisestä ohjauksesta

* Hankintojen teknisestä tuesta

* Laadunvarmistuksesta, tarkastuksista ja testauksesta

* Uusien materiaalien, ratkaisujen ja toimintatapojen kehittämisestä.

TEHTÄVÄSSÄ KÄSITELTÄVIÄ KOKONAISUUKSIA

* Layout-suunnittelu

* Ergonomia ja käyttömukavuus

* Valaistusratkaisut

* Seinä- ja kattorakenteet

* Ovet ja ikkunat

* Kalusteet ja kiintokalusteet

* Pintamateriaalit ja sisustusratkaisut

* Palo-osastoidut rakenteet

* Eristys- ja lattiarakenteet.

ODOTAMME SINULTA

* Usean vuoden kokemusta sisustus-, accommodation-, laiva- tai offshore-suunnittelusta

* Vahvaa teknistä osaamista sisustus- ja outfitting-ratkaisuista

* Kokemusta projektien johtamisesta ja koordinoinnista

* Tuntemusta kansainvälisistä standardeista ja määräyksistä

* Ymmärrystä offshore- ja meriteollisuuden vaatimuksista

* AutoCAD-osaamista

* Kokemusta 3D-suunnittelutyökaluista, kuten AVEVA E3D/PDMS-, SolidWorks- tai PLM/PDM-ympäristöistä

* Vahvoja ongelmanratkaisu- ja yhteistyötaitoja

* Sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa

MENESTYT TEHTÄVÄSSÄ, JOS OLET

* Ratkaisukeskeinen ja käytännönläheinen

* Järjestelmällinen ja tarkka

* Asiakaslähtöinen ja yhteistyökykyinen

* Oma-aloitteinen ja vastuunkantokykyinen

* Teknisesti utelias ja kehityshaluinen

* Tehokas toimimaan kansainvälisessä projektiorganisaatiossa.



TARJOAMME SINULLE

Ihmiset ensin. Meillä työntekijöiden hyvinvointi, kehittyminen ja erilaiset elämäntilanteet otetaan huomioon. Pyrimme joustamaan työajan ja työskentelytapojen suhteen projektien mahdollistamissa rajoissa. Etätyöstä voidaan sopia tehtävän ja asiakasprojektin vaatimusten mukaisesti.

Urasuunnittelua. Urasuunnittelusi alkaa ensimmäisestä työpäivästäsi. Keskustelemme tavoitteistasi ja autamme sinua kehittämään osaamistasi haluamaasi suuntaan. Kasvavassa asiantuntijayrityksessä voit päästä nopeasti mukaan uusiin tehtäviin ja laajentamaan vastuutasi.

Monipuolisia tehtäviä. Laaja asiakas- ja yhteistyöverkostomme tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kokeilla erilaisia tehtäviä yrityksissä, jotka ovat toimialansa eturintamassa. Yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa osallistut asiantuntijatiimeihin, jotka toteuttavat huippuprojekteja Suomessa ja ympäri maailmaa.

Tietoa meistä. CoE Group on kasvava suomalainen suunnittelu- ja konsultointiyritys. Edustamme suomalaista teknologia-alan huippuosaamista ja arvostamme työyhteisömme hyvinvointia ja kehittymistä. Yrityksemme on perustettu vuonna 2012 ja sen kotipaikka on Vaasa. Henkilöstöämme työskentelee eri puolilla Suomea ja Ruotsia.

KIINNOSTUITKO?

Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 25.9.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja kutsumme sopivia hakijoita haastatteluun mahdollisimman pian. Rekrytointipäätöksen pyrimme tekemään lokakuun alkuun mennessä.

jobs.description:
Balling Ventilation – Denmark (Zealand & Funen)

Balling Ventilation is a busy Danish ventilation and contracting company based in Stenløse, working across Zealand (Sjælland) and Funen (Fyn). We install ventilation systems in homes and buildings – from single-room units and heat recovery systems (MVHR) to crawl space ventilation and radon mitigation – and we do a lot of diamond core drilling.

We are growing fast and need 2 new colleagues to start as soon as possible.

Who we're looking for

  • Bricklayers (murere) who want to learn diamond core drilling and ventilation installation, or

  • Other skilled trades (carpenters, electricians, plumbers, general construction workers, etc.) who are motivated to learn ventilation work and diamond drilling

No prior ventilation experience required – we will train you. What matters is that you are reliable, hardworking, and want to learn a skilled trade with great long-term prospects.

What we offer

  • Hourly wage: 180–250 DKK depending on qualifications and experience

  • + 12.5% holiday pay (feriepenge) on top of your wage

  • Your own company van and tools

  • Plenty of work: minimum 160 hours per month guaranteed – and the opportunity to work 250+ hours per month if you want to, because we are very busy

  • Full training in ventilation installation and diamond core drilling

  • Varied work at different sites across Zealand and Funen

Requirements

  • Skilled trade background (bricklayer or other construction trade)

  • Willing to relocate to Denmark – we can help by referring you to housing options

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Rantasalmelle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Rantasalmen alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi

**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**

Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**

Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

jobs.title: Vaski Group: Business Controller (Seinäjoki)
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Seinäjoki

Application deadline: 10.9.2026

Would you like to take ownership of business controlling in an international industrial company? Vaski Group is looking for a **Business Controller** to join its financial team in Seinäjoki.

Vaski Group is a fast-growing company in the industrial machinery sector, specialising in flat bar and sheet metal processing and automation. Over the past five years, the company has grown from €0 to over €50 million in revenue and from a team of just four people to 270 skilled professionals – all while maintaining strong profitability. Of the Groups 270 employees, approximately 150 are based in Finland. Vaski combines the strengths of three established brands, Vaski, Pivatic, and Ursviken.

Vaski Groups growth creates an ambitious and fast-paced environment where things evolve quickly and expectations are high. Success requires the ability to thrive under the pressure that comes with rapid growth, take ownership and remain effective as the organisation continues to develop and scale. This makes the role rewarding: it offers the opportunity to have an impact and grow alongside Vaski in a significant phase of its journey.

**What will you be doing?**

As Business Controller, you will work at the intersection of finance, projects and operations, helping Vaski Group turn financial data into better business decisions. You will work closely with project and production teams in Finland and Sweden and report to the Group Finance Director.

Your key responsibilities include monitoring the financial performance and costs of customer delivery projects, developing budgeting and forecasting, and supporting operations with financial insights. You will also follow R&D projects funded by for example Business Finland, ensuring accurate financial administration and reporting.

An important part of your role will be developing Vaski Groups controlling practices. You will have the opportunity to shape your own responsibilities, challenge existing ways of working and contribute to the selection, implementation and development of a new reporting system. You will also handle financial matters related to delivery projects, such as bank guarantees.

**What makes you a great fit?**

We are looking for an experienced controller who enjoys working close to the business and is comfortable operating in an evolving environment. You can discuss financial topics with production and project professionals, translate numbers into practical insights and proactively identify areas for improvement.

You dont expect every process to be ready-made. Instead, you are motivated by the opportunity to build better ways of working and take ownership of developing them together with the finance team and the rest of the Vaski organization.

**We require you to:**

- A relevant degree, for example in finance, accounting, business or industrial engineering

- Approximately 5 years of experience in controlling or business controlling, with the ability to independently take ownership of financial analysis and development

- A proactive and analytical approach, with the confidence to challenge existing practices and drive improvements when necessary

- Strong Excel skills and confidence working with financial data, budgeting, forecasting and monitoring project cost structures

- Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience from manufacturing, industrial or similar environment

- Experience working in a growing, international organization where processes and practices are still evolving

- Familiarity with Power BI and/or Odoo

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Vaski Group offers you:**

- A fast-growing international company that allows working alongside technically advanced products at the forefront of industrial automation

- Ownership of a responsible role where your ideas help build a stronger foundation for Vaski Groups financial processes

- A growing global employer that offers great career development opportunities

- A team where trust, a hands-on mindset and long-term thinking shape the way you work together

- A chance to make your mark in a growth-company environment where you have room to build new practices as the business evolves

- A comprehensive benefits package including medical expense, travel, and occupational and leisure accident insurance, as well as wellbeing, lunch, and mobile phone benefits


**Practicalities:**

In this full-time and permanent position you will be employed directly to Vaski Group.The preferred starting date is as soon as possible or during autumn 2026. The start time will be negotiated based on your availability. The position is based at Vaski Groups Seinäjoki office, and we hope you are able to work at the office approximately three days per week. Typical office days at Vaski are Mondays and Fridays. Since this is a group-level position, occasional traveling within sites in Finland and Sweden is required.

The salary will be agreed based on your experience and expertise. The position is also part of Vaski Groups white collar workers bonus scheme.

**Got interested?**

Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format by the latest 10th of September via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/378972/create/ .

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email.

We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with Vaski Group here: https://vaski.com/. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Kiira Dahlström (+358 44 902 0238, kiira.dahlstrom\[at\]atalent.fi).

jobs.title: Tekninen asiakaspalvelija / Vuokraamotyöntekijä (Kerava&Espoo)
jobs.description:

Dag Log – Brøndby (Storkøbenhavn)

Er du en stabil, ansvarsbevidst og erfaren lastbilchauffør, som trives med varierende opgaver? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores team hos Dag Log.

Vi søger en lastbilchauffør til blandet kørsel, hvor opgaverne kan variere mellem distributionskørsel, afhentning og levering samt eventuelt længere ture – afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og ønsker.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fuldtidsstilling med ordnede forhold

  • Har erfaring med lastbilkørsel
    (gerne både distributions- og landevejskørsel)

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og har styr på dokumentation og kørselsregistrering

Arbejdssted

Vores base ligger i Brøndby (Storkøbenhavn).

Ansøgning

Lyder det som noget for dig?
Så send din ansøgning og evt. CV til:

Dag-group@outlook.dk

Truck Driver – Mixed Transport

Dag Log – Brøndby (Greater Copenhagen)

Dag Log is seeking 5 new reliable and professional truck driver for mixed transport operations. The position is a key part of our daily logistics operations, where punctuality, quality, and professional customer interaction are essential.

As a driver at Dag Log, you will handle a variety of transport tasks, including distribution, pickup and delivery, and potentially longer-distance routes, depending on your qualifications and operational needs.

Key responsibilities

  • Execution of planned transport assignments with a strong focus on on-time delivery and high service quality

  • Distribution, pickup, and delivery of goods

  • Ensuring correct documentation and transport records

  • Professional interaction with customers and business partners

  • Compliance with all applicable transport legislation and driving/rest regulations

We offer

  • A full-time position with stable and well-organized employment conditions

  • Varied and independent driving assignments

  • Modern vehicles and equipment, including a dedicated truck

  • A professional working environment with skilled and supportive colleagues

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and applicable collective agreements

We expect that you

  • Hold a valid CE driving license

  • Possess a valid EU Driver Qualification Card and digital tachograph card

  • Are reliable, responsible, and well-structured

  • Have experience with truck driving, preferably both distribution and long-distance transport

  • Can work independently and maintain a high level of professionalism

  • Communicate effectively in English (Danish is an advantage)

  • Have a strong focus on safety, quality, and accurate documentation

Work location

The position is based in Brøndby, Greater Copenhagen.

Application

If you are interested in joining a professional and well-established logistics company, please submit your application and CV to:

Dag-group@outlook.dk

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Er du massør med passion for dit fag? Bliv en del af CityFys i Kalundborg! Are you a massage therapist with a passion for your profession? Join CityFys in Kalundborg!
jobs.description:
Hos CityFys søger vi en engageret og dygtig massør til vores virksomhedsordninger i Kalundborg – uanset om du er nyuddannet eller har flere års erfaring! Vi er på udkig efter en passioneret massør, der ønsker at arbejde i et udviklende og støttende miljø, hvor du kan gøre en forskel for vores kunder.

Hvorfor CityFys?

Som massør hos CityFys får du stor frihed under ansvar og fleksible arbejdstider, så du kan tilpasse arbejdet efter dit liv. Vi tror på kontinuerlig udvikling og opfordrer dig til at eksperimentere med forskellige massageteknikker, der passer til hver kundes unikke behov. Hos os bliver du en del af vores "lille-STORE-familie" – et team af professionelle behandlere, der arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe den bedste oplevelse for kunderne.

Vi værdsætter både personlig og faglig vækst, og vi skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor din passion for at hjælpe andre bliver anerkendt og belønnet.

Hos CityFys er vores mål at være Danmarks bedste arbejdsplads for massører og levere kvalitetsbehandlinger til vores kunder.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Faste og attraktive behandlingsdage i CityFys’ virksomhedsordninger og i egen klinik

  • Mulighed for ekstra vikaropgaver og fleksible timer

  • Gratis og løbende efteruddannelse, herunder kurser i triggerpunkter, ergonomi, stretching og meget mere. Læs om kurserne her: CityFys kurser

  • Fordelagtige vilkår, inklusiv fitness- og sundhedsordning

  • Fleksibel aflønning – enten per faktura eller som dataløn

  • Løbende support og sparring, så du kan udvikle dig i dit tempo

Er du klar til at tage din karriere som massør til næste niveau?

Send din ansøgning via vores hjemmeside: http://cityfys.dk/søg-job/  
Vi tilbyder hurtig tiltrædelse og glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Har du spørgsmål? Ring til os på tlf. 70 200 726.

Om CityFys:
CityFys A/S er Danmarks største leverandør af massageordninger og betjener flere af landets største virksomheder. Vi har været i branchen siden 1999 og driver egne wellnessafdelinger i DGI Huset Herning, DGI Byen København og Water & Wellness Randers.

 

English version:

At CityFys, we are looking for an engaged and skilled masseur for our corporate programs in Kalundborg – whether you're newly graduated or have several years of experience! We are seeking a passionate masseur who wants to work in a supportive and developmental environment where you can make a difference for our clients.

Why CityFys?

As a masseur at CityFys, you’ll have great freedom with responsibility and flexible working hours, allowing you to adapt your work to your life. We believe in continuous development and encourage you to experiment with different massage techniques tailored to each client’s unique needs. With us, you will become part of our "small-BIG family" – a team of professional therapists who work closely together to create the best experience for our clients.

We value both personal and professional growth, and we create a work environment where your passion for helping others is recognized and rewarded.

At CityFys, our goal is to be Denmark's best workplace for masseurs and to deliver high-quality treatments to our clients.

We offer:

  • Fixed and attractive treatment days in CityFys’ corporate programs and in oue own clinic

  • Opportunity for additional substitute work and flexible hours

  • Free and ongoing further education, including courses in trigger points, ergonomics, stretching, and much more. Read about the courses here: CityFys courses

  • Beneficial conditions, including fitness and health plans

  • Flexible compensation – either per invoice or as salary

  • Ongoing support and guidance, allowing you to develop at your own pace

Are you ready to take your career as a masseur to the next level?

Send your application via our website: CityFys Job Postings
We offer quick onboarding and look forward to hearing from you!

Have any questions? Call us at +45 70 200 726.

About CityFys:
CityFys A/S is Denmark's largest provider of massage services and serves some of the country's largest companies. We have been in the industry since 1999 and run our own wellness departments at DGI Huset Herning, DGI Byen Copenhagen, and Water & Wellness Randers.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Odense
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter! 

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året..

Hvad skal du lave? 

  • Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister, der tryller buler og ridser væk. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.: 
  • Du fixer buler, spartler, sliber og afdækker (sprøjtelakerer), Så bilerne står som nye 
  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 

Hvem er du? 

  • Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der: 
  • Har uddannelse eller erfaring som autolakerer 
  • Kan holde styr på opgaverne, selv når der er travlt 
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver 
  • Har kørekort (B) – så du ikke behøver skubbe bilerne selv 
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens 

Hvad får du? 

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi betaler for talent! 
  • Gode kollegaer, der kan deres kram (og deler værkstedshistorier i pauserne) 
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med 
  • Mulighed for udvikling 
  • En arbejdsplads med humor, godt humør og højt til loftet  

 Hvad gør du nu? 

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads! 

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige medarbejder med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette. 

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme.  

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

jobs.title: Social Care Worker
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Job Title: Social Care Worker Reporting to: Social Care Leader, Social Care Manager & Service Manager. Purpose: To provide high-quality care to young people resident in Pathways Ireland and support the management team in delivering a safe, stable, caring and therapeutic service. Key Duties: • Provide high-quality care and uphold the rights, dignity and welfare of young people. • Contribute to a safe, stable, caring and therapeutic environment. • Support the implementation and development of care plans and programmes of care. • Promote young people’s physical, emotional, educational, social and recreational development. • Develop personal, interpersonal, social and problem-solving skills. • Plan and participate in appropriate activities and supervise outings. • Support young people to participate actively in their own care and engage appropriately within community/family settings. • Complete required activity risk assessments in line with company policy. • Maintain accurate files, records and reports, including documentation for reviews and case conferences. • Report accidents, incidents, complaints, allegations and relevant developments to management. • Work collaboratively with colleagues and attend meetings, supervision, training and induction. • Follow organisational policies, procedures and health & safety requirements. • Contribute to hygiene, cleanliness and the effective running of the centre. • Promote positive links with families, schools, community organisations, local services and An Garda Síochána. • Administer and accurately account for centre monies. • Support adequate staffing levels and undertake other duties as directed. • Supervise social care students on placement. • Adhere to the CORU Code of Professional Conduct and Ethics, maintain CORU registration and complete CPD as required. Essential Qualifications: Applicants must be registered with the CORU Social Care Workers Registration Board, or have applied through a Section 91 application and be awaiting registration. Relevant approved Social Care qualifications include BA/B.A. (Hons) awards in Social Care, Applied Social Care, Social Care Practice, Professional Social Care Practice, Social Care Work or Applied Social Studies in Social Care. Skills & Competencies: Knowledge of child development, behaviour management, attachment, leadership and childcare legislation. Strong communication, interpersonal, reflective practice and report-writing skills. Ability to work independently and within a team, support colleagues, build positive relationships with young people and remain calm in crisis situations. Other Requirements: Flexibility and willingness to work shifts, weekends and unsocial hours. Computer, counselling, recreation and report-writing skills required. This job description outlines the general duties of the post and is subject to periodic review.

jobs.title: Data protection intern
jobs.description:
Are you a Master's student in a university or university of applied sciences and want to learn more about data protection? Are you interested in themes such as law, data protection and privacy?

We are looking for a data protection intern to join our team for three months, from October 1st 2026, to December 31st, 2026.

This internship is designed for international students eager to learn Finnish while working. Our goal is to ensure that individuals from diverse language and cultural backgrounds can smoothly work in the city, and learn the language needed in their jobs.

As a data protection intern, you will be working in the data protection team of the Education Division. We support schools, daycare centers, and other education providers in the city with both data protection and privacy related matters.

In this role, you will be working with various tasks, among other things:

- Review of privacy documentation on educational software and applications used by the Education Division
- Date requests: Handling of data requests from data subjects
- Legal case analysis: Going through legal databases and libraries to update our data protection instructions and processes
- Review sections of AI instructions intended for schools

You should have basic Finnish language skills, as the main working language is Finnish, with English used to support your tasks. We will support your Finnish language development throughout the internship and expect you to actively engage in improving your skills in everyday work situations.

You will join a team that values collaboration and mutual support as our key strengths, and we hope you share the same mindset. Our team fosters a psychologically safe environment for learning. Your workplace will be in Kalasatama, situated in our new and modern workspaces next to the metro station.

The salary for this position is 1 880,37€ per month.

Hopefully you like what you've read so far. We would love to hear from you!


Eligibility criteria:

Please note that this data protection intern position is exclusively available to students pursuing their master's degree at a university or university of applied sciences during the employment contract. Relevant fields of study include (but are not limited to) Law and Administration Studies. Previous experience in data protection and knowledge of the education sector will be considered an advantage.


To promote equality and non-discrimination, the City of Helsinki encourages anonymous recruitment, and this recruitment process will be conducted anonymously. The purpose of anonymous recruitment is to focus attention on the applicants professional competence and work experience. Please complete the job application form as usual. When writing your application, ensure that it follows the principles of anonymity. The hiring manager will select candidates for interviews based on an anonymous summary, which does not display the applicants name, age, gender, or native language.

jobs.title: Cost Engineer - Merchant, Handling
jobs.description:
**Cost Engineer - Merchant, Handling**

An exciting opportunity awaits you as Cost Engineer in our Propulsion and Handling division at Kongsberg Maritime. In this role, you will be a part of the Sales Support team in Merchant Handling business, delivering support to our external and internal customers worldwide during sales projects. The core task of our team is to understand customer requirements and expectations and turn them into solid technical and commercial proposals supporting the sales of anchoring, mooring & towing solutions.

We are looking for a proactive, structured and cooperative person to support key stakeholders in smooth execution of costing processes. You will be working closely with the Product Management, Delivery organization, Supply Chain and our Global Sales to deliver technically robust solutions to our external and internal customers worldwide.

**Key accountabilities**

- Maintain accurate cost data within our costing tools, ensuring high quality and predictability

- Actively contribute to development and continuous improvement of CPQ tools

- Act as a goto support for nonstandard and complex costings, enabling informed commercial and project decisions

- Conduct deepdive analyses into project and product cost structures to identify insights, risks, and improvement opportunities

- Collaborate closely with purchasing and production organizations, engineering, sales and project teams to support business success


**Qualifications and experience**

- Minimum of bachelors degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience

- Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and understand complex product portfolios

- Fluent spoken and verbal communication skills in English

- Experience with CPQ, ERP, and PLM tools or practical experience in information system development is considered an asset

- Strong skills within Excel are considered an asset


**You are**

- Able to communicate in precise and structured way with a customer-oriented approach

- Self-driven and solution-oriented, able to make things happen and accept responsibility for the results

- Capable of fostering collaboration among stakeholders and supporting effective teamwork.

- Proactive and have a customer focused mindset

- Having a global perspective and being open to different challenges, cultures and ways of operating

- Ready to challenge yourself and develop continuously


**What we can offer you** With us, you will be offered a competitive salary, good benefit package, flexible work hours, and good development opportunities in an international environment. In accordance with the company's remote work policy, you have the possibility for partly flexible remote work. By choosing us, you get to work in an inspiring and safe work environment with sustainable and exciting solutions for the future.

**Work Location** Rauma, Finland

**Point of contact** In case of questions, please contact Sales Support Manager, Merchant – P&H Aleksi Selin, +358 453450788, on: Wednesday 9.9. 15.00-16.00 Tuesday 15.9. 16.00-17.00 Friday 18.9. 15.00-16.00

**Interested?** Please submit your application by 21.9.2026 through our recruitment system.

**Kongsberg Maritime is a global leader in maritime technology.** We deliver advanced solutions to the merchant fleet, offshore, fishing, and naval vessels, setting new standards for safe, efficient, and sustainable operations - both for new builds and existing fleets. In close collaboration with customers and research environments, we develop technology that solves real challenges at sea. Today, more than **30,000 vessels** operate with our systems on board. Kongsberg Maritime has more than **8,300 employees in 35 countries.**

Technologies for sustainable oceans

Our **Propulsion and Handling division** delivers world class products for propulsion, handling systems and waterjet for all marine industry sectors including merchant, offshore and naval. Our products enhance operational efficiency and deliver safe, secure, reliable and sustainable products to our valued customers.

jobs.title: IB MYP/DP Instructional Leader for Language Acquisition and Teacher
jobs.description:
The school seeks to appoint an **energetic and visionary Instructional Leader** to lead the Language Acquisition department across both the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) and Diploma Programme (DP). This role combines strategic instructional leadership with teaching responsibilities in MYP and DP Language Acquisition. This is a full-time, permanent position within our IB World School, where inquiry-driven learning, academic rigor, critical thinking, and global citizenship are at the heart of the educational experience. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in shaping teaching and learning across the continuum, fostering innovation, and ensuring excellence in programme implementation.

**Key Instructional Leader Responsibilities**

- **Provide strategic leadership for the Language Acquisition Faculty**, setting a clear vision for excellence and curriculum development aligned with the IB continuum. In this role, you will champion our school's vision to be a community where every student is known, inspired, and challenged.

- **Drive pedagogical innovation and instructional excellence**, inspiring and empowering faculty to implement data-driven, research-informed, and student-centred practices that enhance engagement, conceptual understanding, and authentic learning.

- **Ensure coherent vertical and horizontal curriculum alignment (Grades 6–12)**, safeguarding progression, rigor, and consistency across the MYP and DP programmes.

- **Lead the monitoring and evaluation of instructional quality**, using data, classroom observation, student voice, and professional dialogue to ensure high standards of provision and continuous improvement.

- **Actively contribute to and collaborate with the team of Instructional Leaders and the Pedagogical Leadership Team**, shaping whole-school teaching and learning strategy and ensuring collective efficacy.

- **Safeguard compliance with IB Programme Standards and Practices**, ensuring programme integrity, smooth student transitions across the continuum, and a deep commitment to inclusivity and access.

- **Align faculty goals and instructional strategies with ISHs strategic vision and long-term priorities**, translating whole-school direction into impactful classroom practice.

- **Model exemplary teaching and learning practices**, demonstrating deep pedagogical knowledge and credibility as a leader of learning.

- **Lead professional growth through coaching and mentoring**, building teacher capacity, reflective practice, and instructional leadership within teams.

- **Cultivate trust-based professional relationships**, fostering collaboration, psychological safety, and a positive, high-performing school culture.

- **Promote equity, inclusion, and diversity**, ensuring that teaching practices and curriculum design reflect and value the richness of the school community.

- **Engage in ongoing professional reflection and growth**, using feedback and evidence to refine leadership impact and sustain continuous improvement.


**Key Teaching Responsibilities**

- **Teach Language Acquisition within the MYP and DP pathways**, delivering a rigorous, concept-driven curriculum aligned with IB standards. Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- **Design and implement engaging, inquiry-based learning experiences** that promote curiosity, conceptual understanding, and meaningful connections to real-world contexts.

- **Cultivate intercultural understanding, global engagement, and international-mindedness,** enabling students to explore and appreciate diverse perspectives, identities, and cultures through language learning.

- **Develop students confidence and competence as multilingual communicators,** fostering the ability to interpret, create, and exchange meaning effectively in a variety of authentic contexts.

- **Differentiate instruction effectively**, responding to diverse learning profiles, language needs, and abilities to ensure equitable access and sustained academic growth.

- **Assess student learning using IB criteria-based assessment practices**, providing timely, constructive feedback that supports reflection, goal-setting, and continuous improvement.

- **Integrate technology, interdisciplinary learning, and experiential approaches** to deepen engagement and strengthen transferable skills.

- **Collaborate actively with colleagues** to design coherent, cross-curricular learning experiences that support the holistic development of students across the IB continuum.

- **Maintain a culture of vigilance regarding student well-being**, proactively identifying changes in behaviour or engagement and reporting concerns in accordance with the schools safeguarding policies and procedures.


**Salary**

The minimum salary for the position is €3,800 - €4531.33 per month which applies to teachers with 5 years teaching experience, teaching the minimum full time hours. This includes (i) a monthly stipend of €950.10, plus (ii) salary of a full time teacher. Salary is paid according to the higher of the Private Schools collective agreement or the schools own salary scale.

**Qualifications & Experience**

- Bachelors or Masters degree in Languages, Education, or a related field.

- Teaching certification and significant (minimum 5 years) experience teaching Languages, preferably in an IB setting or international school.

- Experience teaching English, EAL, Finnish, or Spanish would be of interest, and the ability to contribute across more than one language acquisition programme would be an advantage.

- Strong understanding of IB philosophy, inquiry-based learning, and global citizenship education.

- Ability to foster debate, discussion, and independent inquiry in the classroom.

- Experience with project-based learning, primary source analysis, and historical inquiry.

- Excellent communication, adaptability, and classroom management skills.

- High levels of proficiency in speaking, reading and writing in English

jobs.title: Business Development Manager til Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed
jobs.description:
CenSec – Center for Defence, Space & Security 

Vil du arbejde med at styrke vækst, innovation og internationalisering inden for den danske forsvarssektor? Og være med til at udvikle Danmarks nationale innovations- og erhvervsklynge for aktører inden for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed?   

  

Om stillingen 

CenSecs mission er at være drivkraften bag et stærkt dansk SMV-økosystem, der former fremtidens løsninger inden for forsvar, sikkerhed og rum – og som Business Development Manager kommer du til at spille en vigtig rolle her.   

Du kommer til at arbejde primært med klyngens forsvarsdomæne og med et særligt fokus på droner, autonome enheder og internationalt samarbejde. 

En del af arbejdet udføres på tværs af projekter, hvor du vil få ansvaret for leverancerne heri, som bl.a. indbefatter dialog med industrien.  

Du får til opgave at planlægge og afvikle forskellige klyngeaktiviteter, lige fra mindre netværksmøder til større konferencer. Klyngeaktiviteterne skal hjælpe CenSecs medlemmer med at få ny viden, skabe samarbejde på tværs og øge medlemmernes kommercielle udvikling. Aktiviteterne har både nationalt og internationalt fokus. 

Udover arbejdet med klyngeaktiviteterne får du til opgave at rekruttere nye medlemmer, være kontaktperson for medlemsvirksomheder og deltage i interne udviklingsopgaver- og processer.  

Arbejdet med udvikling af klyngen omfatter også en del administration, opgaver relateret til formidling og kommunikation, samt samarbejde med andre aktører i det forsvarsindustrielle økosystem på både nationalt og europæisk niveau.  

 

Din profil 

Der kan være mange indgangsvinkler til denne stilling, og vi stiller derfor ikke krav til en særlig baggrund. Vigtigst er det at du er en “do’er”, som har vilje og evne til at omsætte input og viden til konkret værdi for vores medlemmer og samarbejdspartnere.

Vi forventer en høj grad af selvstændighed og professionalisme, og at du kan varetage det ansvar og mandat, der medfølger at være ansat i den nationale klyngeorganisation for forsvarsindustrien. 

Derudover er du ekstrovert, kommunikativt stærk, omstillingsparat, fleksibel og taler og skriver engelsk på højt niveau. 

 

Vi tilbyder 

En betydningsfuld rolle i en internationalt anerkendt klyngeorganisation, som skaber innovation, vækst og arbejdspladser. Du får opgaver og muligheder, der medfører faglig og personlig udvikling i et internationalt miljø med ansvar efter evner og ambitioner.  

Dine kollegaer er ambitiøse, humoristiske og uformelle, og trods forskellige ansvarsområder, arbejder vi sammen som et team og hjælper hinanden.  

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsuge med to ugentlige fremmødedage på vores kontor i Viborg og hjemmearbejde de resterende ugedage.  

 

Arbejdstid og løn m.m. 

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt på funktionærvilkår. 

I forbindelse med projekt- og klyngeaktiviteter i ind- og udland vil der være nogen rejseaktivitet, som altid aftales på forhånd og i god tid. 

Løn efter kvalifikationer og evner til at skabe værdi for CenSec. 

 

Læs mere om CenSec her: www.censec.dk  

 

Om CenSec 

CenSec er Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed.  

Som national klynge er vores mandat at samle og styrke hele økosystemet, heriblandt virksomheder, videninstitutioner og myndigheder. 

Vi har en dyb forståelse af økosystemet og en dybdegående viden om vores medlemmer. Vores ambition er at være et omdrejningspunkt hvor alle aktører ser os som den primære drivkraft til at fremme samarbejde på tværs og øge innovation i industrien.  
  
Vi er en tillidsbaseret og stærk medlemsorganisation. Siden 2004 har vi arbejdet for at styrke netværk, samarbejds- og forretningsmuligheder på tværs af sektorer og grænser, gennem facilitering af nationale og internationale netværksaktiviteter.  
  
CenSec – skaber innovation, vækst og robusthed for Danmark.  

  

Ansøgning 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt venligst Anders Laustsen, på tlf. 52 13 15 42 eller skriv til anders@censec.dk  

Vi ser frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og CV til samme mailadresse snarest muligt og senest den 27. september 2026. 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført løbende med henblik på ansættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi forbeholder os ret til at ansætte før deadline, hvis vi finder den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: HVAC Design Engineer - Offshore Substations; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, PL - Gdynia
jobs.description:
Are you a Mechanical Engineer with HVAC design experience and a passion for creating robust technical solutions? Do you want to design HVAC systems for offshore substations supporting some of the world's largest renewable energy projects? Then this could be your next opportunity.

Your Position

We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Mechanical Engineer with experience in HVAC system design to strengthen our HVAC team.

In your new position as HVAC Engineer in the Renewables division, you will join our experienced Mechanical & HVAC team. You will design and engineer HVAC systems for offshore substations and work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, clients, suppliers, procurement, fabrication yards and commissioning teams.

You will contribute throughout the project lifecycle, from concept and tender work through detailed design, procurement, construction support and commissioning. Your work will help create robust, safe and efficient HVAC solutions for complex offshore installations.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be either Esbjerg, Nordhavn or Gdynia. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

In this role, you will primarily work on EPCI (Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Installation) contracts for offshore substation projects.

Typical responsibilities include developing HVAC design solutions and technical documentation for offshore substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Design, Engineering & System Integration: Designing ventilation, cooling, heating and pressurization systems, including calculations and equipment sizing.
  • Developing HVAC philosophies, specifications, diagrams, technical requisitions and other project documentation.
  • Compliance, HSE & Quality Assurance: Ensure full compliance with applicable standards, codes, and regulatory requirements, while supporting and adhering to health, safety, and environmental standards in all activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Specifying HVAC equipment and supporting procurement, bid evaluation, vendor follow-up and document review.
  • Coordinating technical interfaces with electrical, structural, piping, fire protection and control system disciplines, and participating in client meetings and design reviews.
  • Supporting fabrication, testing and commissioning activities, including FATs, SATs and site support when required, while adhering to health, safety and environmental standards.

Your profile & qualifications

We are looking for a structured and solution-oriented Mechanical Engineer who is passionate about HVAC design and wants to make a personal contribution to offshore renewable energy projects. You collaborate effectively across disciplines, communicate clearly and take ownership of your engineering deliverables.
We are looking for an outgoing and positive professional who is passionate about renewable energy and wants to leave their personal mark on it. You have a proactive and organised approach to your work and are eager to help innovate the future of sustainable solutions

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Marine Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline.
  • Experience with HVAC engineering and design, preferably from industrial, marine, energy or offshore projects.
  • Knowledge of ventilation, cooling, refrigeration, heating and pressurization systems, including DX and water-based cooling solutions.
  • Experience with technical documentation, equipment specifications and coordination in multidisciplinary EPC projects; offshore substation, offshore wind, marine or industrial plant experience is considered a strong advantage.
  • Professional English communication skills and a strong commitment to teamwork, quality and safety.
  • A strong focus on quality and safety, demonstrated through attention to detail and adherence to HSE requirements.

With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible via the link on the page.
For questions, contact Rafid Kajo, Manager, Mechanical & HVAC, at +45 7916 6867 or +45 3016 6613

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. jobs.title: Johtava sosiaalityöntekijä, Soihtu, Salo
jobs.description:
Tehtäväsi

Johtavana sosiaalityöntekijänä toimit Asiakasohjaus Soihdun itäisen alueen tiimin lähiesihenkilönä. Vastaat Salon, Salon poliisiasemalla toimivan Ankkuri-toiminnan sekä Paimion toimipisteiden henkilöstön esihenkilötyöstä ja toiminnan kehittämisestä.

Asiakasohjaus Soihtu vastaanottaa ja käsittelee kaikki alle 65-vuotiaiden sosiaalihuoltolain ja lastensuojelulain mukaiset ilmoitukset ja yhteydenotot uusien asiakkaiden kohdalla sekä toteuttaa palvelutarpeen arviointia. Lisäksi Soihtu arvioi ja toteuttaa kiireellisiä lastensuojelun tukitoimia.

Tehtävässäsi toimit moniammatillisen yhteistyön asiantuntijana ja rakennat toimivia yhteistyökäytäntöjä eri viranomaisten, kuntien ja järjestötoimijoiden kanssa. Vastaat osaltasi työn sisällön ja yhteistyöverkostojen kehittämisestä sekä huolehdit sujuvasta yhteistyöstä eri toimijoiden välillä. Tehtävä voi sisältää tarvittaessa myös asiakastyötä.

Toiminta-alueeseen kuuluvat Salo, Somero, Paimio ja Sauvo. Vakituiset toimipisteet sijaitsevat Salossa ja Paimiossa, minkä lisäksi teemme jalkautuvaa työtä alueen muihin kuntiin.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Pääset osaksi sitoutunutta, kokenutta ja moniammatillista työyhteisöä, jossa työtä tehdään yhdessä asiakkaiden parhaaksi.

Salon Soihtu-tiimissä työskentelee johtavan sosiaalityöntekijän lisäksi kahdeksan sosiaalityöntekijää, kuusi sosiaaliohjaajaa sekä sairaanhoitaja. Tiimin tukena toimii myös vakituinen perheterapeutti vahvistamassa systeemistä työotetta.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja vaikuttavan tehtävän, jossa pääset hyödyntämään johtamisosaamistasi, kehittämään palveluita sekä tukemaan henkilöstön työhyvinvointia ja ammatillista onnistumista. Etsimme tiimille esihenkilöä, joka johtaa työtä positiivisella sykkeellä ja innostaa myös muita onnistumaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Toivomme sinulta vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä sekä laaja-alaista sosiaali- ja lastensuojelupalveluiden osaamista. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää hyviä esihenkilö- ja johtamistaitoja, vahvaa sosiaalihuollon lainsäädännön tuntemusta sekä kykyä itsenäiseen päätöksentekoon.

Arvostamme erityisesti kykyä tukea vaativaa asiakastyötä, edistää työhyvinvointia sekä ylläpitää myönteistä ja kannustavaa työilmapiiriä. Lisäksi odotamme sinulta erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja moniammatillisessa toimintaympäristössä sekä valmiutta toimia muuttuvassa ja nopeatempoisessa työssä.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain (817/2015) 7 §:n mukainen kelpoisuus tehtävään. Lisäksi tehtävässä edellytetään erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa ja tyydyttävää ruotsin kielen taitoa.

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: VVS-Montør søges
jobs.description:
Erfaren VVS-montør søges

Vil du være en del af en veldrevet virksomhed med høj faglighed, stor frihed og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab?

Niels Mølgaard ApS søger en dygtig og engageret VVS-montør, der er klar til nye udfordringer og ønsker at blive en del af et professionelt team med fokus på kvalitet, service og godt håndværk.

Trives du i en hverdag med afvekslende opgaver, ansvar og tæt kontakt til kunder? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om stillingen

Med reference til afdelingslederen bliver du en del af en veletableret og dynamisk VVS-installationsvirksomhed, hvor kvalitet, faglig stolthed og et godt arbejdsmiljø er centrale værdier.

Hos os er medarbejderne vores vigtigste ressource. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på godt kollegaskab, sammenhold, humor og en positiv omgangstone i hverdagen. Du får primært arbejdsområde i Aarhus og omegn, hvor du kommer til at servicere både private- og erhvervskunder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du vil få en alsidig hverdag med spændende opgaver inden for:

• Service- og reparationsarbejde for private kunder, erhvervskunder og boligforeninger

• Renoverings- og ombygningsprojekter

• Energioptimering og energirenoveringer

• Mindre entrepriser

• Fejlfinding, vedligeholdelse og kundeservice

Arbejdet udføres hovedsageligt i Aarhus og omegn.

Vi tilbyder

• Et spændende og fast job i en solid virksomhed med ordnede forhold

• Stor grad af frihed under ansvar i et velfungerende team af kompetente og erfarne kolleger

• En flad organisation med kort vej fra idé til handling og solid administrativ opbakning i hverdagen

• Attraktiv lønpakke efter kvalifikationer, firmabil og smartphone til rådighed

• Moderne værkstedsfaciliteter, herunder komplet blikkenslagerværksted

• Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling gennem kurser og efteruddannelse

• Sociale arrangementer og et stærkt fællesskab

Vi forventer, at du

• Er uddannet VVS-montør og gerne kompetent erfaring

• Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst

• Har fokus på kvalitet og god service

• Er samarbejdsvillig og bidrager positivt til teamet

• Bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag

• Har almindeligt kørekort (kategori B)

Tiltrædelse

Efter aftale, gerne hurtigst muligt.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@nmvvs.dk med emnet "VVS-montør".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig og måske byde dig velkommen som vores nye kollega hos Niels Mølgaard ApS.

Om virksomheden

Niels Mølgaard ApS er en familieejet virksomhed, etableret i 1984, og er i dag blandt Østjyllands førende specialister inden for VVS, energi og blik. Virksomheden løser opgaver for både private kunder, erhverv og entrepriser og har stor fokus på kvalitet, faglighed og godt håndværk. Med ca. 30 medarbejdere og løbende efteruddannelse af alle ansatte tilbyder Niels Mølgaard ApS et professionelt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø. Virksomheden har adresse i Højbjerg ved Aarhus og omfatter desuden søsterselskaberne NME Ejendomsadministration og VVS-shoppen.dk

jobs.title: Rengøringstekniker søges
jobs.description:
Rengøringstekniker søges – gerne med erfaring i gulv- og murbehandling

Vi søger en dygtig og kvalitetsbevidst rengøringstekniker, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team. Vi lægger vægt på godt håndværk, grundighed og høj service – og vi ser meget gerne, at du har erfaring med specialrengøring, gulvbehandling og behandling af murværk/facader.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver vil variere og kan blandt andet omfatte:

  • Daglig og periodisk rengøring

  • Hovedrengøring og specialrengøring

  • Gulvbehandling, herunder grundrens, skuring, polish og pleje af forskellige gulvtyper

  • Maskinel gulvrengøring

  • Mur- og facadebehandling, herunder afrensning og rengøring af forskellige overflader

  • Klargøring og efterbehandling af overflader

  • Anvendelse af professionelle rengøringsmaskiner, produkter og metoder

  • Kvalitetskontrol af eget arbejde

  • Dialog og god service over for kunder

Vi forestiller os, at du

Har erfaring som rengøringstekniker eller med professionel rengøring. Det er en stor fordel, hvis du har praktisk erfaring med gulvbehandlinger og mur-/facadebehandlinger og er vant til at arbejde med maskiner og professionelle rengøringsmidler.

Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret, tager ansvar for dine opgaver og går op i at levere et flot resultat. Samtidig forventer vi, at du er stabil, fleksibel og serviceminded og kan indgå positivt i et team.

Relevant uddannelse eller kurser inden for rengøring og overfladebehandling er en fordel, men praktisk erfaring og den rette indstilling vægter højt.

Kørekort B er en fordel

Vi tilbyder

Et alsidigt job med forskellige typer opgaver og mulighed for at bruge dine faglige kompetencer inden for både almindelig rengøring og specialopgaver.

Du bliver en del af en arbejdsplads, hvor vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, ordentlighed og godt samarbejde. Vi tilbyder gode kolleger, grundig introduktion til opgaverne og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Ansøgning

Lyder jobbet som noget for dig?

Send en kort ansøgning og gerne dit CV. Fortæl gerne om din erfaring med professionel rengøring og særligt, hvis du har arbejdet med gulvbehandling, specialrengøring eller mur-/facadebehandling.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Tegevusjuhendaja on vahetu teenuse osutaja, kelle tegevuse eesmärk on luua turvaline, struktureeritud ja toetav keskkond, mis arvestab kliendi individuaalsete eripäradega. Muud nõuded: Otsime inimesi, kes on loomult rahulikud, kannatlikud ja järjepidevad, samas aktiivse hoiakuga ning uuendusmeelsed.
Tegevusjuhendaja väljaõpe ei ole otseselt tööle saamisel nõutav, küll aga eeldame valmidust õppima asumiseks ning kvalifikatsiooni omandamiseks. Ka tööandja pakub koolitamisvõimalusi. jobs.description:
English version below

À la suite d'une mobilité interne, nous recherchons un Ingénieur procédés analytiques (h/f) pour notre laboratoire.

Rejoindre l'équipe du laboratoire pour jouer un rôle central dans l'excellence analytique de notre activité Électronique, un secteur en forte expansion. Vos responsabilités clés vous placeront au cœur de l'innovation et de l'expertise.

Description du poste :

- Piloter l'innovation analytique : Mener les développements analytiques stratégiques et la qualification de nouvelles molécules pour garantir la fiabilité de nos produits.

- Expertise de pointe : Diriger les développements en ICP-MS et Chromatographie Ionique, spécifiquement pour les molécules organosilicitées et organométalliques.

jobs.title: AI Response Analyst
jobs.description:
The work

iMerit, an EXL company, is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.

Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Review images alongside the prompts and responses attached to them

  • Interpret both visual and conversational context before scoring anything

  • Compare multiple responses and rank them against defined criteria

  • Confirm that descriptions and claims about an image reflect what is actually there

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably evaluated

  • Write clear justification for every ranking you submit

What you bring

  • A sharp eye for visual detail and the patience to look twice

  • Strong critical thinking, research skills, and reading comprehension

  • Sound judgment and well supported decision making

  • Professional written English, including the ability to describe what you see precisely

  • The consistency to apply detailed guidelines the same way, task after task

  • Experience in image annotation, content review, editing, research, design, or localization is welcome but not essential.

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project.Â

jobs.title: Sales Jedi
jobs.description:
Great salary | Profit share | 100% remote |
Work from anywhere in Europe | SaaS

 

Awesome opportunity for a self-motivated and energetic people person to join our remote team and help sell our world-leading SaaS products, from anywhere in Europe.

We pay a great salary, based on experience and location. We don’t pay commissions, because good sales are a team effort—from engineering, to operations, marketing, and support, our high-performing team all contribute to a great product and service that our clients love. Everybody in the company is rewarded with a share of profit each December—we succeed together.

Our much-loved products are in demand and are proven to make a difference to our clients’ lives. You’ll be selling world-leading software through a well-considered process that leaves room for personal flair.

 

SaaS experience is extremely beneficial but strong communication skills, patience, curiosity, keenness to learn and friendliness are key to success in this role.

Join our Rebel Alliance

Creative Force is experiencing strong growth and as we scale our efforts in 2026 and beyond, we’re looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our diverse team of Jedis to help recruit new clients as they navigate the decision process, and transform them into long-term supporters.

You’ll be a respected member of our remote global sales team and will be well supported with the tools, knowledge and answers you need to provide exceptional levels of service, and to make the most from solid sales traction with our two in-demand products.

As you master the Force and the multitude of skills needed in this role, attracting clients to join our mission, you will be recognised and rewarded with strong career and salary progression.

Responsibilities

 

  • Help prospects find the specific value they seek (this is the product you are looking for)
  • Collaborate with our diverse international team to push us on the leading edge of our fields
  • Learn to be a product expert and confidently answer product questions from prospects
  • Discover how to be an expert in SaaS for recognition programs
  • Master our sales technology stack
  • Support the complete sales cycle, from qualified lead to close
  • Skillfully navigate consultative sales discussions and live demos

Essentials

 

  • Applications are open to all experience levels, with a minimum of 1 year proven success in SaaS sales or a similar role
  • Must live in Europe
  • Digital native, with enthusiasm for technology
  • Discipline and self-motivation (key to success in remote work)
  • Loads of energy, humour, passion, and empathy
  • Genuine interest to help provide amazing value for people
  • Superior communication skills
  • Commitment to continuous improvement
  • You have access to fast, reliable internet and a dedicated space to work without distractions
  • Meet and exceed measurable performance goals to succeed and progress in this role

What we offer

Work-life balance

  • 38 hour work week, Monday to Friday (your weekends are yours)
  • 20 days paid annual leave
  • 20 days paid parental leave (available after one year)
  • 12 days paid public holidays (your local country/region public holidays)
  • Your birthday is a holiday every year

Personal development and wellbeing

  • Commitment to continued learning and development
  • A culture of promoting work life balance
  • Access to mental health support

Location and compensation

  • Full-time role, based remotely, work anywhere within Europe
  • No commission structure. Competitive salary, indexed to your experience and location
  • Budget for computer and office equipment (pending 6 month probationary period)

 

Respect, growth and stability

  • Friendly, sociable, responsible, collaborative team (a great place to be)
  • Respect for each other’s time, value and contribution
  • Regular communication with global team via chat and video calls
  • Dynamic, young, growing tech company leveraging all the latest tech tools and leading industry trends
  • Stable, bootstrapped, independent business (no VCs calling the shots)

jobs.title: SaaS Product Support Jedi
jobs.description:
We’re on the hunt for a sharp, self-driven SaaS pro who’s as comfortable troubleshooting API and integrations as they are navigating human conversations.

Our European client base is growing fast and we need someone who can keep up. Our software isn’t your average plug-and-play; it has a steep learning curve so you’ll need to be technically savvy while also being the kind of person clients genuinely enjoy talking to. If you’ve got SaaS in your DNA, thrive in async/remote environments, and can juggle multiple threads without breaking a sweat — keep reading.

The role

You’ll join a lean, high-performing global support team working across two SaaS products, Award Force and Good Grants. Day to day you’ll be communicating with colleagues and clients across countries, cultures, and time zones.

Support happens across email tickets, phone, and 1-1 Zoom calls. Once you’ve leveled up on product knowledge, you’ll run onboarding sessions and client meetings covering issue resolution, best practices, and product adoption.

You’ll also be hands-on with bug testing and reporting, feeding considered feedback to our product teams— always pushing to make our products better.

We have a startup mindset. We experiment with new tools, iterate on processes, and move fast. Got a great idea? Pitch it. We’re not big on bureaucracy, only results. We don’t expect you to be a slave to your chair but flexibility is a must.

You’ll need to tick these boxes
  • You’re based in the UTC +1 or +2 timezone range. This is non-negotiable. Our European team and clients operate in this window and we don’t allow shift work. If you live outside this range, this one’s not for you
  • 2+ years of professional experience, ideally in a SaaS support or client-facing role
  • Native-level English fluency (bilingual? Even better!)
  • Terms like HTML, CSS, JS, API, integrations, dev console, staging & production environments, GitHub repos, and database queries don’t make you flinch. You don’t need to write code, but you need to get it
  • You’ve got exceptional interpersonal and communication skills—written and verbal
  • Client calls energise you. Four to five Zoom meetings a day? Bring it on
  • You’re a natural problem solver who loves helping others untangle theirs
  • Your writing is clean, well-structured, and detail-oriented
  • You’re curious by nature and love learning new things
  • You’re not allergic to upselling or fielding “sales-y” questions
  • You’re organised and process-driven. Multiple tools for different workflows? No problem — you thrive in that setup
  • You’re self-motivated and independent, but you also value being part of a tight-knit team
  • Remote work isn’t just something you dabble in—it’s where you do your best work. You’ve got fast, reliable internet and a distraction-free workspace ready to go

 

Responsibilities

Product support

  • Go deep on product knowledge through self-driven learning—become the expert

  • Be the first point of contact on all inbound support via email/tickets, phone, and eventually live chat

  • Run 1-1 Zoom sessions with clients for technical consultation and query resolution

  • Maintain our consistently impressive first-reply-time metric (yeah, we’re proud of it)

  • Provide technically accurate responses backed by hands-on testing of scenarios

  • Collaborate with engineering to squash bugs and keep clients in the loop with timely updates

  • Spot patterns in user issues and flag them for product improvement

 

Be seriously good with clients

  • Speed matters. Respond quickly and decisively
  • Listen deeply—get to the root of the issue and own it until it’s resolved
  • Treat every client interaction with genuine respect and appreciation
  • Build trusting, long-term relationships rooted in honesty and transparency

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



About the Role

Join Replit's key teams across the company, such as AI Research, Strategic Finance, or the Office of the CEO, for a unique paid internship built for sharp quantitative and creative minds. You will work alongside our top executives, in addition to world-class engineers, designers, and finance team on some of the hardest problems in AI-native software creation and accelerating key areas of our business.



We are creating a dedicated track for students with strong mathematical backgrounds because the problems we are solving sit at the intersection of deep math and applied AI, including agent reasoning, systems optimization, and improving how our models learn and perform at scale. Your work will directly shape how millions of users build software.




You Will:

 - Contribute to real engineering problems that push the boundaries of AI-powered software creation

 - Collaborate with engineers, designers, and product managers on infrastructure that powers Replit's platform

 - Prototype novel approaches to problems in AI, systems, or tooling where mathematical rigor is the differentiator

 - Ship work that impacts millions of developers globally, in an environment where your ideas are heard and often implemented



Required Skills and Experience:

 - Currently pursuing a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field

 - At least one semester of schooling remaining after the internship

 - Demonstrated excellence in competitive mathematics such as IMO and IOI, quantitative research, or advanced coursework

 - Genuine curiosity about AI, agent systems, company building, or developer tooling

 - Extremely bullish on Replit and the future of AI-native software creation. We would love to see what you have built on the platform
   



What We Value:

 - First-principles thinking: Ability to break down complex problems from the ground up and reason about them rigorously

 - Mathematical intuition: Strong grasp of the underlying math behind machine learning, optimization, or systems

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating well with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication: Ability to explain complex quantitative concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Curiosity and speed: Genuine excitement for hard problems and the drive to iterate quickly



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Kierownik (K/M) w Dziale Administracjii - nabór
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: Zakres realizowanych zadań na stanowisku:
1. Kierowanie pracami Działu Administracji; dokonywanie podziału zadań
podległym pracownikom i ich nadzór.
2. Prawidłowe i sprawne wykonywanie zadań, przestrzeganie przepisów prawa oraz
porządku i dyscypliny w ramach kierowania działem.
3. Terminowość i rzetelność załatwianych spraw wynikających z realizacji powierzonych
zadań.
4. Racjonalne wykorzystywanie środków w ramach zatwierdzonych budżetów.
5. Kontrola prawidłowości zakupów, transportu i dostaw.
6. Przygotowanie okresowych ocen, analiz, informacji, i sprawozdań.
7. Kontrola rachunków pod względem merytorycznym za zrealizowane zlecenia,
zamówienia i umowy.
8. Coroczne określanie podstawy do naliczenia podatku od nieruchomości, oraz z tytułu
trwałego zarządu.
9. Nadzór nad brygadą remontową.
10. Monitorowanie wykorzystania kart drogowych przez pracowników Działu, oraz
prawidłowości rozliczenia kosztów eksploatacji pojazdów służbowych.
11. Wydawanie i podpisywania zaświadczeń w sprawach wynikających z działalności
Działu.
12. Wykonywanie innych zadań nie objętych zakresem czynności, a zleconych przez
Dyrektora MOPS.
Praca w systemie jednozmianowym w godz. 7.30-15.30 od PN do PT.
Umowa o pracę na czas określony 6 miesięcy.
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: Wymagania niezbędne związane ze stanowiskiem:
1. Posiadanie obywatelstwa polskiego z zastrzeżeniem art. 11 ust. 2 i 3 ustawy o pracownikach samorządowych.
2. Posiadanie pełnej zdolności do czynności prawnych oraz korzystania w pełni z praw publicznych.
3. Brak skazania prawomocnym wyrokiem sądu za umyślne przestępstwo ścigane z oskarżenia publicznego lub umyślne przestępstwo skarbowe.
4. Posiadanie wykształcenia wyższego.
5. Posiadanie minimum 4 lata stażu pracy w ramach umowy o pracę.
6. Koncepcja organizacji pracy Działu Administracji.
Wymagania dodatkowe związane ze stanowiskiem:
1. Preferowane doświadczenie w pracy w obszarze administracji na stanowisku urzędniczym
